## 3. Shader math

| # | Maxwell | Vulkan / AMD | Emulators / ports | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3.1 | **FMNMX and `.SAT` with NaN return the other operand / 0** (IEEE minNum). Games rely on this to stop NaN spreading (one NaN pixel blown up by bloom or temporal passes flickers or fills the screen). | `GLSL.std.450 FMin/FMax/FClamp`: result undefined when an operand is NaN (NMin/NMax are the NaN-dropping forms). AMD hardware min/max usually drops NaN; the compiler may still assume no NaN. | Ryujinx emits FMin/FMax/FClamp (`CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs:336, 956, 972`; saturate = FClamp 0..1, `Instructions/InstEmitAluHelper.cs:419-423`). NXN translated shaders use `isnan` selects; MNG measured Metal min/max/saturate drop NaN (`probe.m:1-4`). | GLSL450; NXN |
| 3.2 | **FMZ multiply mode** (`FMUL/FFMA/...` field `Fmz`, `.FMZ`): 0 × anything = 0, including Inf/NaN (DX9 rule). | IEEE: 0 × Inf = NaN. | Ryujinx decodes `Fmz` (`Decoders/InstDecoders.cs:306-309, 1901`) but no emitter reads it. Ours: same. Census needed (check 13). | RYU-SH |
| 3.3 | **Denormals**: per-instruction `.FTZ`. | AMD flushes fp32 denormals by default; `VK_KHR_shader_float_controls` sets it per shader. | Ryujinx ignores `.FTZ`. Low risk. | RYU-SH (no `Ftz` use in `Instructions/`) |
| 3.4 | **Warp size 32**: `SHFL`, `VOTE`, `S2R LANEID`, ballots are 32-bit. | AMD RDNA runs wave32 or wave64 per shader (the driver chooses; RADV fragment default wave64); `VK_EXT_subgroup_size_control` `requiredSubgroupSize = 32` fixes it. | Ryujinx adapts lane masks to `QueryHostSubgroupSize()` (default 32, `IGpuAccessor.cs:218`; `Instructions/InstEmitWarp.cs:72, 106`, `InstEmitMove.cs:175-185`). Ours: not overridden, no required size (check 6). | <https://docs.mesa3d.org/envvars.html> (`RADV_PERFTEST=pswave32`) |
| 3.5 | **Discard (`KIL`)** keeps the quad's derivatives valid (demote semantics). | `OpKill` terminates; later derivatives in the quad undefined. | Ryujinx emits `OpKill` (`CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs:508`). | — |
| 3.6 | **Implicit-LOD sampling in divergent control flow** works on Maxwell (TEX unit uses quad neighbours). | Undefined in non-uniform control flow; AMD whole-quad mode usually works. | — | VKSPEC (derivatives) |
| 3.7 | **Integer division** does not exist (compiled to `XMAD`/`IMAD` sequences); MUFU.RCP(0) = +Inf, LG2(0) = -Inf. | Same IEEE edge cases through `1/x`, `Log2`. | Low risk. | — |
| 3.8 | **FP64** in some TotK cutscene shaders. | No FP64 on some hosts. | yuzu FP64 → FP32 (YZ-2306, PR 10693); ours: `softfloat64` job flag (`tools/xlate/Program.cs` `QueryHostSupportsShaderFloat64`). | — |
| 3.9 | **Integer vertex inputs read as raw bits** (bone indices `R8UI`). | Float-declared inputs convert integers. | NXN Mario: stretched characters; re-translated with `uint` inputs. Ours: attribute types passed to `QueryGraphicsState` (`Program.cs`). | NXN |

## 4. Memory model

| # | Maxwell / Tegra | Vulkan / AMD discrete | Emulators / ports | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4.1 | **One memory**: the CPU reads GPU-written buffers and textures after a fence; the GPU sees CPU writes after `FlushMappedRange` or, in practice, immediately (TotK skips flushes). Block-linear layout is defined, so a buffer copy into texture storage is a texture upload. | Images live in VRAM with private tiling; buffer bytes copied into image memory are not texels. | yuzu PR 10942 (small CPU writes); MNG alias visibility barriers for copies through two buffers over one allocation. Ours: GPU-written ranges of CPU-visible pools marked at fence completion; GPU-only pools nothing (check 8). | MNG `docs/how-it-works.md:67-71` |
| 4.2 | **Counter reports** (`ReportCounter`, `SET_REPORT_SEMAPHORE_A..D` 0x1b00): `{counter, timestamp}`; TIMESTAMP puts 0 in the counter; SAMPLES_PASSED counts visible samples; ZCULL stats. | Occlusion queries are separate objects; results copied to a buffer. | NXN TotK: timestamp counter 0 matters for conditional clears. Ours: every report writes `{0, time}`; occlusion counts are always 0 (check 5). DK3D writes `SET_REPORT_SEMAPHORE_OFFSET` (`0x6C0` = 0x1b00) with payload `0` and `OPERATION=Counter`, `STRUCTURE_SIZE=FourWords` (`dk_variable.cpp:193-240`): TIMESTAMP = unit `Crop`, counter `Payload`, written when the ROP has retired every earlier draw; SAMPLES_PASSED = unit `Crop`, counter `0x15`; ZCULL stats = four one-word reports at +0, +4, +8, +12. TIMESTAMP_TOP is not a 3D report: a gpfifo `Semaphore` release of 16 bytes with `ReleaseWfiDisable`, written when the command processor reaches it, without waiting for earlier work (`:246-253`). So `TIMESTAMP - TIMESTAMP_TOP` around a span is its GPU duration. Layout: two 64-bit words, counter then timestamp (`Primer.md:578`). Each report is followed by a tiled-cache flush (`:256`). `ResetCounter` (`0x54C` = 0x1530) zeroes SAMPLES_PASSED; it is the reset for the timestamp types too (`:282-300`). Unit: `dkTimestampToNs(ts) = ts * 625 / 384`, i.e. **614.4 MHz** GPU ticks (1.63 ns), not the 19.2 MHz system tick (`include/deko3d.h:1367-1373`) (check 21). | OGD 0x1b00; NXN; DK3D `dk_variable.cpp:183-300`, `include/deko3d.h:1367` |
| 4.3 | **Semaphores / events** written by the GPU in order; CPU polls them. | Writes on a completion thread after the fence. | Ours: `vk_completion_add`, submit order. | — |
| 4.4 | **Inline uniform updates** (`UpdateUniformBuffer`) happen in command order between draws; reading the buffer at record time gives the last value. | Must snapshot. | NXN: snapshotted at encode time; Mario's wave sim diverged when two writes reordered. | NXN |
| 4.5 | **GPU-written index buffers** (8-bit indices written earlier in the same submission). | No `uint8` index type without `VK_EXT_index_type_uint8`; CPU widening reads stale bytes. | NXN widens on the GPU (`wide_run`). Ours: CPU widening at record time; device-local byte indices skipped (check 9). | NXN |
| 4.6 | **Compute shared memory**: 48 KiB per block on GM20B. | AMD 64 KiB. | Ours: `QueryComputeSharedMemorySize` from job (`Program.cs`). | OGD `clb1c0.h` |
| 4.7 | **Virtual memory pools** map physical pool pages; the same bytes reachable at two GPU addresses. | Two `VkBuffer`s over one allocation need alias-aware barriers. | MNG `MTL4VisibilityOptionResourceAlias`. | MNG `docs/how-it-works.md:67-71` |
| 4.8 | **Command list calls**: a `CallCommands` / `CallList` is not a GPU subroutine. DK3D `dkCmdBufCallList` stores a `Call` control entry (`dk_cmdbuf.cpp:327-338`); `dkQueueSubmitCommands` walks the entries on the CPU and recurses into the called list at submit (`dk_queue.cpp:287-296`), emitting gpfifo entries that point at the command words, which the GPU fetches later (prefetch can be switched off per entry, `:176`). So list structure is fixed at submit, command words are read when fetched. | n/a | Ours: `OP_CALL` is walked at replay, `CallCommands` inlines the recording at record time (`vk_exec.c` `walk`, `nvn_api_cmd.c` `inline_recording`). Equivalent for control flow; deferred bind handles are the data read late (2.4). | DK3D `dk_cmdbuf.cpp:327`, `dk_queue.cpp:280-298` |

## 5. Fixed function

| # | Maxwell / NVN | Vulkan / AMD | Emulators / ports | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.1 | **Provoking vertex: last** (GL convention, NVN default; `SET_PROVOKING_VERTEX` 0x1684, NVN 55 `SetProvokingVertexMode`). Flat-interpolated outputs (instance/particle ids, material indices, flat normals) come from the last vertex. | **First vertex** unless `VK_EXT_provoking_vertex` with `provokingVertexMode = LAST_VERTEX`. | Ours: last-vertex mode where `provokingVertexLast` is available (`vk_pipeline.c` `create_graphics`; check 1). DK3D: `ProvokingVertexLast` (`0x5A1`) is set to 1 at queue setup and per rasterizer state from `DkProvokingVertex` (`maxwell/gpu_3d_base.cpp:76`, `gpu_3d_state.cpp:67`); `DkRasterizerState` defaults to Last (`include/deko3d.h:823`). Confirms last as the hardware-side default. | OGD 0x1684; `runtime/nvn_ext.c`; DK3D `include/deko3d.h:794-823` |
| 5.2 | **Primitive restart**: any index value, compared against the raw index for any index size; can apply to lists (`SET_DA_PRIMITIVE_RESTART_TOPOLOGY_CHANGE`) and to non-indexed draws (`..._VERTEX_ARRAY` 0x0de8). | Restart only at all-ones of the index type; lists need `primitiveTopologyListRestart`. | Ryujinx enables it for draw-arrays only on GL (RYU-SU comment). NXN: TotK terrain strips use 0xffff. Ours: non-all-ones restart not replayed, logged. DK3D: `PrimitiveRestartEnable` (`0x591` = 0x1644) + `PrimitiveRestartIndex` (`0x592` = 0x1648), index written only when enabled; any value; `PrimitiveRestartWithDrawArrays` (`0x37A` = 0x0de8) is forced 0 at setup (`maxwell/gpu_3d_ibo.cpp:21-30`, `gpu_3d_base.cpp:73`). Nothing on lists vs strips beyond that. | OGD 0x1644, 0x1648; DK3D `maxwell/gpu_3d_ibo.cpp:21-30` |
| 5.3 | **Point size**: `SET_POINT_SIZE` (0x1518) when the shader does not write it; GLSLC clamps a written size to a driver constant. | Point size must be written by the shader. | Ryujinx writes the `PointSize` from graphics state at VS start (`Translation/EmitterContext.cs:84-88`); ours reads the `SetPointSize` state from the support buffer (translator patch 0008). | NXN |
| 5.4 | **Line width**, smooth lines (`SET_LINE_WIDTH_FLOAT` 0x13b0, `SET_ANTI_ALIASED_LINE`). | `wideLines`, `VK_EXT_line_rasterization`. | Ours: 1 px, logged. | OGD |
| 5.5 | **Polygon offset units** are twice the API value in the register; NVN API takes GL units. | `depthBiasConstantFactor` in format-dependent r. | Ryujinx `units / 2f` from the register (RYU-SU). Ours takes NVN API units (right) but D32F instead of D24 (1.7). DK3D `constantFactor * 2.0f` (1.7). | OGD 0x15bc, 0x187c; DK3D `maxwell/gpu_3d_state.cpp:154` |
| 5.6 | **Dual-source blending**: SRC1 factors read the shader's second output. | Needs fragment output `Location 0, Index 1`. | Ryujinx declares `Index` only when `DualSourceBlendEnable` (`Translation/Translator.cs:196`, `CodeGen/Spirv/Declarations.cs:608-617`). Ours: SRC1 factors mapped (`vk_pipeline.c` `blend_factor`) but the translator is always given `false` (`Program.cs` `QueryGraphicsState`) (check 12). | — |
| 5.7 | **Alpha-to-coverage** with dither (`SET_ALPHA_TO_COVERAGE_DITHER_CONTROL` 0x12e0), alpha test (fixed function on Maxwell). | A2C without dither; no alpha test. | Ryujinx emulates alpha test and A2C dither in the shader from graphics state; ours passes `AlphaTestOp.Always`, A2C false to the translator (`Program.cs` `QueryGraphicsState`). | OGD 0x12e0, 0x16b4 |
| 5.8 | **Logic ops** on colour targets. | `logicOp` feature; ignored on float targets. | Ours: in the pipeline key. | OGD 0x19c4 |
| 5.9 | **Vertex formats**: `*SCALED` 8/16-bit, RGB10A2 SNORM/SCALED, 3-component formats, 32-bit scaled. | No 32-bit SCALED; 3-component formats often unsupported. | Ours: 32-bit scaled read as integers (logged), 3-component widened (`vk_pipeline.c` vertex format table). | — |
| 5.10 | **Transform feedback**, rasterizer discard. | `VK_EXT_transform_feedback`. | Ours: rasterizer discard without XFB = no draw (`nvn_api_cmd.c`). | OGD 0x0744 |
| 5.11 | **Depth bounds, sample mask, conservative raster**. | Optional features. | Ours: ignored, logged (`nvn_ext.c`). | OGD 0x0fa4 |
| 5.12 | **Blend factors on targets without alpha** (RGBX emulated as RGBA). | Destination alpha reads the stored value. | Ryujinx replaces DST_ALPHA factors on no-alpha targets (`FilterBlendFactor`, RYU-SU). | RYU-SU |

## 7. Checks for our runtime

Grep-level look on 2026-10-22, statuses updated 2026-10-26; "saw" is what the grep and short reads showed, not a test result.

1. **Provoking vertex.** Vulkan draws flat outputs from the first vertex, NVN from the last. `vk_pipeline.c` enables
   `provokingVertexLast` and chains `VkPipelineRasterizationProvokingVertexStateCreateInfoEXT{LAST_VERTEX}` in
   `create_graphics`; without the feature it logs that flat outputs come from the first vertex. **Fixed.**
2. **Unwritten vertex outputs.** `spirv_add_outputs` (`vk_pipeline.c`) adds outputs initialised to (0, 0, 0, 1) for
   FS inputs the VS lacks. Our translator never links stages, so Ryujinx's `InitializeVertexOutputs` would initialise
   no user output; translator patch 0006 initialises the unlinked outputs. **Fixed.**
3. **Masked clears.** `vk_exec.c` skips colour clears with a partial channel mask (`W_CLEAR_MASK`); `clear_ds` skips stencil
   clears with a partial mask (`W_STENCIL_MASK`). TotK issues such clears (NXN). Check the log for
   `colour clear with channel mask` and `stencil clear with mask`. DK3D (1.3) confirms what the replay must do: colour clear = scissor 0 + channel mask, stencil clear = `value & mask` merged under the front write mask; so a draw with `colorWriteMask` / `stencilWriteMask` set to the clear mask is the exact equivalent. **Missing.**
4. **D24 → D32F.** `vk_formats.c` maps D24S8 to `D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT`; `vk_exec_draw.c` `record_fixed` passes NVN units
   unscaled. Depth EQUAL passes and decal offsets can z-fight. Look at: per-pass depth-test op histogram, EQUAL passes
   against D24 targets. **N/A for TotK**: a census of the field and fight saves (2026-10-22) saw depth targets
   0x34 (DEPTH32F) and 0x32 (DEPTH16) only; biased draws (units -5 and 1, factor -0.5 and -0.2) are on DEPTH32F.
5. **Counters and conditional rendering.** `vk_exec_xfer.c` (as of 2026-10-22): every report writes `{0, time}`;
   SAMPLES_PASSED is always 0; a condition is read on the CPU at record time and an unfinished report reads 0. Grep the
   NVN log for counter types other than TIMESTAMP; any occlusion-driven visibility (flares, culling) is off. **Fixed 2026-10-22**:
   SAMPLES_PASSED counts come from Vulkan occlusion queries between RESET and REPORT (`vk_exec_xfer.c`, ~4 queries
   per frame in the field, ~21 in a fight); the game's CPU reads them (guest f_70010c3298) to cull objects.
6. **Subgroup size.** The translator assumes 32; RDNA4 may run fragment shaders in wave64. `vk_caps.c` and
   `vk_pipeline.c` `pin_subgroup32` pin stages to 32 lanes with `VkPipelineShaderStageRequiredSubgroupSizeCreateInfo`
   where `subgroupSizeControl` allows it, and otherwise tell the translator the GPU's own size
   (`TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP_PIN=0` forces that). **Fixed.**
7. **Images aliased onto GPU-only pool memory.** `vk_texture.c` `bind_pool_memory` binds each `VkImage` into its pool
   allocation; textures are keyed by address plus descriptor, and each new image starts `UNDEFINED` (`init_image`). Two descriptors over the
   same storage, or bytes written through a buffer, do not see each other's data on AMD. Check: count distinct keys per
   address per frame. **Risk** (yuzu PR 10418 class).
8. **GPU writes into CPU-visible pools.** `note_gpu_write` (`vk_exec_xfer.c`) stamps pages when the fence
   completes, so a texture sampled later in the same submission keeps its old upload; GPU-only pools are skipped.
   MNG saw at most one buffer copy per frame in TotK, so low priority. **Risk.**
9. **Index buffers.** `vk_exec_draw.c` `op_draw_idx`: byte indices widened on the CPU at record time, skipped in
   device-local memory; `restart_for`: a non-all-ones restart index logged and dropped. Census (2026-10-22): 130-170 byte-index draws/frame widened on the
   CPU, 0 device-local, 0 non-all-ones restarts. **OK**; `VK_KHR_index_type_uint8` (supported) would drop the CPU cost.
10. **Feedback loops.** Census (2026-10-22): 425/frame (field) to 667 (fight), G-buffer material/decal shaders
    sampling the 1600x900 targets of the open pass. The terrain G-buffer pass reads its own albedo, normal and R32F
    targets at the fragment's pixel; on the RX 9070 the reads returned stale data as ~16x14 px dark rectangles on the
    ground, and the sage spirit next to Link was not drawn. `vk_exec_draw.c` (feedback loops) now detects such a draw:
    with `VK_EXT_attachment_feedback_loop_layout` and `dynamicRenderingLocalRead` the target moves to the feedback
    layout and a by-region barrier precedes the draw; without them the pass restarts behind a full barrier
    (`TOTK_FEEDBACK`). **Fixed.**
11. **Border colours.** `vk_texture.c` `make_sampler`: custom colour only with `customBorderColorWithoutFormat`, else transparent
    black; integer formats use the float path. Confirm the RX 9070 reports the feature (grass map needs 0.5).
    **OK if supported.**
12. **Dual-source blend.** `vk_pipeline.c` `blend_factor` maps SRC1 factors; `Program.cs` `QueryGraphicsState` always passes
    `dualSourceBlendEnable = false`, so no `Index 1` output exists. Log pipelines with SRC1 factors. **Mismatch if used.**
13. **FMZ / NaN.** Count `FMUL/FFMA/FMUL32I/FFMA32I` words with the `Fmz` field set (`Decoders/InstDecoders.cs:1901`
    bit positions) in `build/v121/shaders/`; FMin/FMax/FClamp NaN results are undefined (3.1). Census (2026-10-22):
    FMZ in 1 instruction of 12397 shaders, FTZ in 12241 shaders, FMNMX in 7457. The translator emits GLSL.std.450
    FMin/FMax (Ryujinx `GenerateMinimum`), not NMin/NMax. **FMZ: no fix needed. FMNMX: OK** (RX 9070 test: FMin/FMax(NaN, 1) = 1 both orders, FClamp(NaN, 0, 1) = 0).
14. **Point size / line width.** Census: `SetLineWidth 4.5` ~1/frame (2 line draws into a 144x144 R8 target),
    `SetPointSize 5` ~14/frame; 4 point VS rely on it. Point size: translator patch 0008 reads it from the support
    buffer, **fixed**. Line width: 1 px, non-default values logged (`nvn_ext.c`), **mismatch, minor**.
15. **Block height.** `nvn_tex.c` truncates like NVN (2.1). DK3D rounds up (`dk_image.cpp:446`); every other step matches. **OK.**
16. **Depth mode and clamp.** `vk_pipeline.c` `create_graphics` (`negativeOneToOne` from `nvn_depth_minus_w`, `depthClampEnable`
    from NVN state). DK3D agrees on the z maths (1.5) and the clamp switch (1.6). **OK.**
17. **Depth bias argument order.** `vk_exec_draw.c` `record_fixed` (units, clamp, factor); DK3D takes the same three and doubles units for the register (1.7). **OK.**
18. **Sampler LOD.** `vk_texture.c` `make_sampler`. **OK.**
19. **Viewport / scissor arrays.** Single viewport (`vk_exec_draw.c` `record_fixed`), extra scissors logged. Census: 0 differing. **OK.**

20. **Depth-compare sampling in compute** (VUID-vkCmdDispatch-None-06479): one compute shader samples a 4x4 R32F
    CPU-written placeholder through an R32_SFLOAT view with compare on, ~1/frame. Needs a D32 copy. **Minor.**
21. **Report timestamps: unit and instant.** `write_counter` (`vk_exec_xfer.c`) writes host `ns * 12 / 625` (19.2 MHz
    ticks) at fence completion for every report; `nvnDeviceGetTimestampInNanoseconds` converts back with the same factor
    (`nvn_ext.c`). DK3D: GPU ticks convert at 625/384 ns (614.4 MHz), TIMESTAMP is written when the ROP has retired
    the earlier work, TIMESTAMP_TOP when the command processor reaches it (4.2). Two consequences for the engine's GPU time (dynamic resolution and speed follow it):
    (a) if the 1.2.1 consumer scales raw report ticks with its own constant rather than the NVN conversion call, our
    19.2 MHz unit is 32x off from the hardware's; find that consumer before fixing the unit; (b) the delta needs
    `vkCmdWriteTimestamp2` with `TOP_OF_PIPE` for TIMESTAMP_TOP and `BOTTOM_OF_PIPE` for TIMESTAMP, per submission
    segment, converted to whichever unit (a) shows. **Mismatch (instant); unit unverified.**

`docs/tester-guide.md`:

```md
# Tester guide: running TotK Recomp on your GPU

This guide is for testing the build on a GPU other than the developer's (AMD RX 9070). You build it from source with
your own copy of the game and your own console keys. Nothing from the game is in this repository, and nothing you build
from it may be shared.

## What you need

- Windows 10 or later, an x86-64 CPU with AVX2, about 60 GB free.
- A GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and `VK_EXT_external_memory_host`, with a current driver.
- *Tears of the Kingdom* base game (1.0.0) and the 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update, dumped from your own Switch as NSP or XCI.
- `prod.keys` dumped from your own Switch. Never send it to anyone, and never paste it into a log or an issue.

## Build

1. Follow [building.md](building.md): the toolchain, then build steps 1-6 (Python environments, `config.local.toml`
   with your own paths, extraction, the shader translator, lifting and linking, shader preparation). The result is
   `build\<ver>\totk.exe`, with `<ver>` the game version you built (`v143` or `v121`).
2. Check the build without the game: `build\<ver>\totk.exe --selftest` must print a pass.
3. To run the build on another of your machines, package a portable folder ([building.md](building.md), "Portable
   folder"). The folder holds game code: for your own machines only.
4. The installer ([installer.md](installer.md)) is the other route to a machine without the toolchain: it builds the
   game there from your own files. No installer release is published yet.

## Run and collect the log

Every run writes its log to `logs\totk.log` next to `totk.exe`; the four runs before it are kept as `totk.1.log` to
`totk.4.log`, and Open log folder in the settings menu's Advanced tab (F1) shows them. Copy the log before you start the
game again. A file stops at 64 MiB. Started with `2> file`, the game writes its log to that file instead.

From `cmd.exe` in the repository root, with the validation layer on:

```bat
set TOTK_VK_VALIDATION=1
build\<ver>\totk.exe
```

`TOTK_VK_VALIDATION=1` turns on the Vulkan validation layer (it comes with the Vulkan SDK). It makes the game slower;
do one run with it and one without (`set TOTK_VK_VALIDATION=`).

Keep the window in the foreground: an unfocused window stalls the game. Shaders the preparation did not cover compile on first use, so
the first minutes of play can stutter.
Play into the open field (load a save, walk around for a minute, fight something if you can), then close the window.

## Choosing the GPU

A laptop with an iGPU and a discrete GPU, or two cards, lists every GPU at the top of the log (`vk: gpu 0: ...`).

- `set TOTK_GPU_NAME=Radeon` picks the first usable GPU whose name contains that text (case does not matter).
- `set TOTK_GPU_INDEX=1` picks GPU 1 from that list.

The line `vk: using gpu N: <name>` says which one ran.

## What to send back

1. `logs\totk.log` from each run. It contains no keys and no game files. The lines that matter most start with
   `vk caps:` (GPU, driver, features and the fallbacks taken), `vk: gpu`, `validation` and `gfx_shader:`.
2. GPU model, driver version, CPU, RAM, and whether it is a laptop. Copy system info in the settings menu's Advanced
   tab (F1) puts these and your changed settings on the clipboard. Say which game update you ran.
3. What you saw: how far it got (menu, loading, field), roughly how smooth it ran, and screenshots of anything wrong
   (black or missing areas, flickering, wrong colours, missing grass). Win+Shift+S is fine.
4. If it crashed or hung: what you were doing. The log of that run ends with the crash report, so send it whole.
5. For a bug you can trigger again: a recording of your input (`set TOTK_INPUT_RECORD=input.txt`, see
   [controls.md](controls.md), "Scripted input") and the save you started from.

## Switches for the developer's questions

Only set these when asked; each forces a fallback the build picks by itself on GPUs that need it.

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TOTK_VK_NO_FLOAT64=1` | Translate shaders without 64-bit floats |
| `TOTK_VK_SSBO_ALIGN=64` | Treat storage buffers as needing 64-byte alignment |
| `TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP_PIN=0` | Do not pin shaders to 32 lanes; tell the translator the GPU's own subgroup size |

Each switch makes the first launch translate every shader again.

```

`installer/__init__.py`:

```py
"""The TotK installer: builds a playable folder from the player's own game files (docs/installer.md).

    python -m installer --base FILE --update FILE --keys FILE --lang CODE --dest DIR [--root DIR] [--temp DIR]

Modules: layout (where the bundled tools are, release or repository), events (JSON progress on stdout and the log
file), state (totk-install.json), runner (which steps run: resume and update), steps (the six steps), ini (totk.ini),
cli (the command line). text/en.json holds the English text of every message id the events carry.

Standard library only, apart from what the extraction tools import (cryptography). Runs on Python 3.14.
"""

```

`installer/__main__.py`:

```py
import sys

from installer.cli import main

sys.exit(main())

```

`installer/cli.py`:

```py
"""Command line: python -m installer --base FILE --update FILE --keys FILE --lang CODE --dest DIR [--root DIR]
                                     [--temp DIR] [--verify]

A first install needs every option. On a folder with totk-install.json (resume after a cancel or failure, or update
with a newer release) only --dest is needed: --lang defaults to the recorded language, and the game files are needed
only when the extraction has to run again. Prints JSON events on stdout (events.py). Exit code: 0 done, 1 failed,
2 bad command line, 3 cancelled (Ctrl+C or Ctrl+Break).
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import signal
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from . import layout as layouts
from . import state as statefile
from .events import Reporter
from .runner import Context, run_steps
from .steps import all_steps

EXIT = {'ok': 0, 'failed': 1, 'cancelled': 3}


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        Reporter().error('cli.usage', {'detail': message})
        sys.exit(2)


def temp_folder(base, dest):
    """One temp folder per install folder, so two installs never share generated files."""
    tag = hashlib.sha256(str(dest).lower().encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
    return base / f'{dest.name or "root"}-{tag}'


def cancel(signum, frame):
    raise KeyboardInterrupt


def main(argv=None):
    ap = Parser(prog='python -m installer', description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--base', type=Path, help='base game, XCI or NSP')
    ap.add_argument('--update', type=Path, help='1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update NSP')
    ap.add_argument('--keys', type=Path, help='prod.keys')
    ap.add_argument('--lang', help='game language, a Switch language code (en-US, en-GB, ja, de, ru, ...)')
    ap.add_argument('--dest', type=Path, required=True, help='install folder')
    ap.add_argument('--root', type=Path, help='release folder or repository (default: the folder above installer/)')
    ap.add_argument('--temp', type=Path, help='temp folder (default: temp/ of the release, build/install-temp in a '
                                              'repository)')
    ap.add_argument('--verify', action='store_true', help='hash every kept file, also those this release made')
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    # The window cancels with Ctrl+Break to the installer's process group (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP), which also reaches
    # the tools it runs; Python's default for it ends the process without recording anything.
    for name in ('SIGBREAK', 'SIGTERM'):
        if hasattr(signal, name):
            signal.signal(getattr(signal, name), cancel)
    layout = layouts.find(args.root)
    dest = args.dest.resolve()
    temp = temp_folder((args.temp or layout.temp).resolve(), dest)
    log = temp / 'logs' / time.strftime('install-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.log')
    rep = Reporter(log_path=log)
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    try:
        state = statefile.load(dest)
    except statefile.StateError as e:
        rep.error(e.id, {'path': str(e.path)})
        rep.emit('end', result='failed', seconds=0)
        return 1
    ctx = Context(layout, dest, temp, rep, args, state=state, verify=args.verify)
    steps = all_steps()
    rep.emit('start', release=layout.release, mode=ctx.mode, dev=layout.dev, dest=str(dest), log=str(log),
             steps=[s.id for s in steps])
    result = run_steps(steps, ctx)
    rep.emit('end', result=result, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - t0, 1))
    rep.close()
    return EXIT[result]

```

`installer/events.py`:

```py
"""Progress events: one JSON object per line on stdout for the window and tests, the same in English to a log file.

Every event has "type" and "t" (seconds since the start). Types:

    start     release, mode (install, resume, update), dest, log, steps (the step ids in order)
    step      step, state: started | done (seconds) | skipped (reason: current, not_needed)
    progress  step, phase, and done/total/unit (bytes, chunks, objects, shaders) when the amount is known
    space     dest, need, free (bytes on the install disk; with the temp folder on the same disk need includes it),
              temp, temp_need, temp_free, same_disk
    warning   id, params
    error     id, params, step (absent outside a step)
    end       result: ok | failed | cancelled, seconds

Text is never the payload: ids name a step ("step.<id>"), a phase ("phase.<step>.<phase>") or a message ("<id>"),
and installer/text/en.json holds their English text with {param} placeholders. The log renders events with it.
"""
import json
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

CATALOG = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'text' / 'en.json'
PROGRESS_EVERY = 0.5   # seconds between two progress events of one phase


def load_catalog(path=CATALOG):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def render(catalog, id, params=None):
    """The English text of id, or the id itself when the catalog lacks it."""
    text = catalog.get(id, id)
    try:
        return text.format(**(params or {}))
    except (KeyError, IndexError, ValueError):
        return f'{text} {params}'


class Reporter:
    def __init__(self, out=None, log_path=None):
        self.out = out or sys.stdout
        self.t0 = time.monotonic()
        self.catalog = load_catalog()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.log_file = None
        self.last_progress = {}
        if log_path:
            Path(log_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.log_file = open(log_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8', buffering=1)
        self.log_path = log_path

    def elapsed(self):
        return time.monotonic() - self.t0

    def log(self, text):
        """A line for the log file only."""
        if self.log_file:
            with self.lock:
                self.log_file.write(f'[{self.elapsed():8.1f}] {text}\n')

    def emit(self, type, **fields):
        event = {'type': type, 't': round(self.elapsed(), 2), **fields}
        with self.lock:
            self.out.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
            self.out.flush()
        self.log(self.describe(event))
        return event

    def describe(self, e):
        c = self.catalog
        kind = e['type']
        if kind == 'step':
            name = render(c, 'step.' + e['step'])
            extra = f' ({e["seconds"]:.1f} s)' if 'seconds' in e else f' ({e["reason"]})' if 'reason' in e else ''
            return f'{name}: {e["state"]}{extra}'
        if kind == 'progress':
            text = render(c, f'phase.{e["step"]}.{e["phase"]}')
            if e.get('total'):
                text += f' {e["done"]}/{e["total"]} {e.get("unit", "")}'.rstrip()
            return text
        if kind in ('warning', 'error'):
            return f'{kind}: {render(c, e["id"], e.get("params"))} [{e["id"]}]'
        return json.dumps(e, ensure_ascii=False)

    def step(self, step, state, **fields):
        return self.emit('step', step=step, state=state, **fields)

    def progress(self, step, phase, done=None, total=None, unit=None, force=False):
        """A progress event, at most one per PROGRESS_EVERY per phase unless it is the first or the last."""
        now = time.monotonic()
        key = (step, phase)
        last = self.last_progress.get(key)
        final = total is not None and done is not None and done >= total
        if last is not None and not final and not force and now - last < PROGRESS_EVERY:
            return None
        self.last_progress[key] = now
        fields = {'step': step, 'phase': phase}
        if done is not None:
            fields['done'] = done
        if total is not None:
            fields['total'] = total
        if unit:
            fields['unit'] = unit
        return self.emit('progress', **fields)

    def warning(self, id, **params):
        return self.emit('warning', id=id, params=params)

    def error(self, id, params, step=None):
        fields = {'id': id, 'params': params}
        if step:
            fields['step'] = step
        return self.emit('error', **fields)

    def close(self):
        if self.log_file:
            self.log_file.close()
            self.log_file = None

```

`installer/gui.py`:

```py
"""The installer window: python -m installer.gui

A front end over the CLI (docs/installer.md): it collects the game files, the keys file path, the game language and the
install folder, runs `python -m installer ...` as a subprocess and shows its JSON events. Decisions live in guilogic.py;
this file only draws. The window text is in installer/text/<en|ru>.json under "ui.*" and "launcher.*" ids.

    --selftest [--shots DIR]   build every screen in both languages and close by itself (PNG per screen with --shots)
    --lang en|ru               window language (default: the Windows display language)
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

try:
    from PIL import ImageGrab   # only the screenshots of --selftest --shots need it; the release has no PIL
except ImportError:
    ImageGrab = None

from . import ini
from . import layout as layouts
from .guilogic import (DONE, FAILED, PENDING, RUNNING, SKIPPED, UI_LANGUAGES, Catalog, Form, Model, Process,
                       amount, default_game_language, describe_event, parse_line, windows_ui_language)

POLL_MS = 100
GLYPH = {PENDING: '\u25cb', RUNNING: '\u25b6', DONE: '\u2714', SKIPPED: '\u2013', FAILED: '\u2716'}
COLOR = {PENDING: '#808080', RUNNING: '#1a5fb4', DONE: '#26a269', SKIPPED: '#808080', FAILED: '#c01c28'}
PAD = 14


def fix_tcl_paths():
    """The embeddable Python keeps Tcl/Tk next to python.exe (python/tcl); point Tcl at it when it is not found."""
    tcl = Path(sys.executable).resolve().parent / 'tcl'
    if tcl.is_dir() and 'TCL_LIBRARY' not in os.environ:
        for lib, var in (('tcl9.0', 'TCL_LIBRARY'), ('tk9.0', 'TK_LIBRARY')):
            if (tcl / lib).is_dir():
                os.environ[var] = str(tcl / lib)


class App:
    def __init__(self, root, ui_lang, layout, run_args=None):
        self.root, self.layout = root, layout
        self.cat = Catalog(ui_lang)
        self.model = Model()
        self.process = None
        self.closing = False
        self.run_args = run_args or {}   # extra CLI options for tests: temp, verify
        self.log_entries = []            # events and raw lines of the run, rendered by render_log
        self.bound = []                  # (widget, option, id, params) retranslated on a language switch
        self.vars = {n: tk.StringVar() for n in ('base', 'update', 'keys', 'dest')}
        self.vars['lang'] = tk.StringVar()
        self.lang_code = default_game_language(ui_lang)
        self.screen = None
        self.fitted = None               # the (width, height) fit last gave the window

        root.title(self.cat('ui.title'))
        icon = layout.runtime / 'totk.ico'
        if os.name == 'nt' and icon.is_file():
            root.iconbitmap(default=str(icon))
        root.protocol('WM_DELETE_WINDOW', self.on_close)
        style = ttk.Style(root)
        style.configure('Title.TLabel', font=('Segoe UI', 15, 'bold'))
        style.configure('Notice.TLabel', background='#fff3cd', foreground='#664d03', padding=8)
        style.configure('Err.TLabel', foreground='#c01c28')
        style.configure('Version.TLabel', foreground='#808080')

        top = ttk.Frame(root, padding=(PAD, PAD, PAD, 0))
        top.pack(fill='x')
        self.title = self.label(top, 'ui.title', style='Title.TLabel')
        self.title.pack(side='left')
        version = ttk.Label(top, style='Version.TLabel')
        self.bind_text(version, 'text', 'ui.version', version=layout.release)
        version.pack(side='left', padx=(10, 0), pady=(6, 0))
        sw = ttk.Frame(top)
        sw.pack(side='right')
        self.ui_var = tk.StringVar(value=self.cat.lang)
        for code in UI_LANGUAGES:
            ttk.Radiobutton(sw, text=code.upper(), value=code, variable=self.ui_var, style='Toolbutton',
                            command=self.switch_language).pack(side='left', padx=1)
        self.body = ttk.Frame(root, padding=PAD)
        self.body.pack(fill='both', expand=True)
        self.frames = {'form': self.build_form(), 'run': self.build_run(), 'finish': self.build_finish()}
        self.vars['lang'].set(self.lang_label(self.lang_code))
        self.vars['dest'].trace_add('write', lambda *_: self.refresh_form())
        self.show('form')

    # ---- text -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def bind_text(self, widget, option, id, **params):
        self.bound.append((widget, option, id, params))
        widget.configure(**{option: self.cat(id, **params)})

    def label(self, parent, id, **kw):
        w = ttk.Label(parent, **kw)
        self.bind_text(w, 'text', id)
        return w

    def button(self, parent, id, command, **kw):
        w = ttk.Button(parent, command=command, **kw)
        self.bind_text(w, 'text', id)
        return w

    def retext(self):
        self.root.title(self.cat('ui.title'))
        for widget, option, id, params in self.bound:
            widget.configure(**{option: self.cat(id, **params)})
        self.fill_languages()
        self.refresh_form()
        self.refresh_run()
        self.refresh_finish()
        self.render_log()

    def switch_language(self):
        self.cat.set_language(self.ui_var.get())
        code = self.selected_lang()
        self.retext()
        self.vars['lang'].set(self.lang_label(code))
        self.fit()

    def lang_label(self, code):
        return self.cat('lang.' + code)

    def fill_languages(self):
        code = self.selected_lang()
        self.lang_box.configure(values=[self.lang_label(c) for c in ini.LANGUAGES])
        self.vars['lang'].set(self.lang_label(code))

    def selected_lang(self):
        """The game language code behind the combobox text (kept when it is not one of the labels)."""
        shown = self.vars['lang'].get()
        for code in ini.LANGUAGES:
            for lang in UI_LANGUAGES:
                if shown == Catalog(lang)('lang.' + code):
                    return code
        return self.lang_code

    # ---- screens --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def show(self, name):
        for f in self.frames.values():
            f.pack_forget()
        self.frames[name].pack(fill='both', expand=True)
        self.screen = name
        self.fit()

    def fit(self):
        """Size the window to its largest screen (an unpacked frame still reports the size its children ask for), so
        a screen or language switch neither cuts text nor moves the buttons. The window only grows: opening the log
        makes it taller, and a size the user dragged it to stays. Every text change that can add lines calls it again,
        or pack takes the missing height from the button bars."""
        self.root.update_idletasks()
        sizes = [(f.winfo_reqwidth(), f.winfo_reqheight()) for f in self.frames.values()]
        chrome = self.root.winfo_reqheight() - self.body.winfo_reqheight()   # the title row above the body
        w = max(self.root.winfo_reqwidth(), max(s[0] for s in sizes) + 2 * PAD)
        h = chrome + max(s[1] for s in sizes) + 2 * PAD
        if (w, h) == self.fitted:   # refresh_run calls it on every poll: leave the window alone while nothing grew
            return
        self.fitted = (w, h)
        self.root.minsize(w, h)
        self.root.geometry(f'{max(w, self.root.winfo_width())}x{max(h, self.root.winfo_height())}')

    def notice(self, parent):
        w = ttk.Label(parent, style='Notice.TLabel', wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.bind_text(w, 'text', 'ui.notice')
        return w

    def build_form(self):
        f = ttk.Frame(self.body)
        bar = ttk.Frame(f)   # packed first so pack shrinks the text above it, never the buttons
        bar.pack(side='bottom', fill='x', pady=(12, 0))
        self.start_button = self.button(bar, 'ui.start', self.start)
        self.start_button.pack(side='right')
        self.form_intro = self.label(f, 'ui.intro', wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.form_intro.pack(anchor='w', pady=(0, 8))
        self.notice(f).pack(fill='x', pady=(0, 10))
        grid = ttk.Frame(f)
        grid.pack(fill='x')
        grid.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        rows = (('base', 'ui.base', 'ui.pick_game'), ('update', 'ui.update', 'ui.pick_update'),
                ('keys', 'ui.keys', 'ui.pick_keys'))
        self.form_rows = {}
        for i, (name, label_id, pick_id) in enumerate(rows):
            lab = self.label(grid, label_id)
            lab.grid(row=i, column=0, sticky='w', pady=4, padx=(0, 10))
            ttk.Entry(grid, textvariable=self.vars[name]).grid(row=i, column=1, sticky='ew', pady=4)
            b = self.button(grid, 'ui.browse', lambda n=name, p=pick_id: self.pick_file(n, p))
            b.grid(row=i, column=2, padx=(8, 0))
            self.form_rows[name] = lab
        i = len(rows)
        self.label(grid, 'ui.game_language').grid(row=i, column=0, sticky='w', pady=4)
        self.lang_box = ttk.Combobox(grid, textvariable=self.vars['lang'], state='readonly', width=30)
        self.lang_box.grid(row=i, column=1, sticky='w', pady=4)
        self.lang_touched = False
        self.lang_box.bind('<<ComboboxSelected>>', lambda _e: setattr(self, 'lang_touched', True))
        self.fill_languages()
        self.label(grid, 'ui.dest').grid(row=i + 1, column=0, sticky='w', pady=4)
        ttk.Entry(grid, textvariable=self.vars['dest']).grid(row=i + 1, column=1, sticky='ew', pady=4)
        self.button(grid, 'ui.browse', self.pick_dest).grid(row=i + 1, column=2, padx=(8, 0))
        self.update_hint = ttk.Label(f, wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.update_hint.pack(anchor='w', pady=(8, 0))
        self.form_error = ttk.Label(f, style='Err.TLabel', wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.form_error.pack(anchor='w', pady=(8, 0))
        self.label(f, 'ui.keys_private', wraplength=620, justify='left').pack(anchor='w', pady=(8, 0))
        return f

    def build_run(self):
        f = ttk.Frame(self.body)
        bar = ttk.Frame(f)
        bar.pack(side='bottom', fill='x', pady=(8, 0))
        self.cancel_button = self.button(bar, 'ui.cancel', self.cancel)
        self.cancel_button.pack(side='right')
        self.log_toggle = self.button(bar, 'ui.show_log', self.toggle_log)
        self.log_toggle.pack(side='left')
        self.run_header = ttk.Label(f, font=('Segoe UI', 11, 'bold'))
        self.run_header.pack(anchor='w')
        self.step_rows = {}
        self.steps_box = ttk.Frame(f)
        self.steps_box.pack(fill='x', pady=(8, 8))
        self.phase_label = ttk.Label(f, wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.phase_label.pack(anchor='w')
        self.bar = ttk.Progressbar(f, mode='determinate', maximum=1000)
        self.bar.pack(fill='x', pady=(4, 6))
        self.space_label = ttk.Label(f, wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.space_label.pack(anchor='w')
        self.warn_label = ttk.Label(f, wraplength=620, justify='left', foreground='#9a6700')
        self.warn_label.pack(anchor='w')
        self.log_frame = ttk.Frame(f)
        self.log = tk.Text(self.log_frame, height=10, wrap='word', state='disabled', font=('Consolas', 9))
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(self.log_frame, command=self.log.yview)
        self.log.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)
        scroll.pack(side='right', fill='y')
        self.log.pack(side='left', fill='both', expand=True)
        self.log_open = False
        return f

    def build_finish(self):
        f = ttk.Frame(self.body)
        bar = ttk.Frame(f)
        bar.pack(side='bottom', fill='x', pady=(12, 0))
        self.button(bar, 'ui.close', self.on_close).pack(side='right')
        self.open_button = self.button(bar, 'ui.open_folder', self.open_folder)
        self.open_button.pack(side='right', padx=(0, 8))
        self.back_button = self.button(bar, 'ui.back', lambda: self.show('form'))
        self.back_button.pack(side='left')
        self.finish_title = ttk.Label(f, style='Title.TLabel', wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.finish_title.pack(anchor='w')
        self.finish_text = ttk.Label(f, wraplength=620, justify='left')
        self.finish_text.pack(anchor='w', pady=(8, 8))
        self.finish_steps = ttk.Frame(f)
        self.finish_steps.pack(fill='x', pady=(0, 8))
        self.finish_notice = self.notice(f)
        self.finish_notice.pack(fill='x', pady=(8, 0))
        return f

    # ---- form -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def form(self):
        return Form(base=self.vars['base'].get(), update=self.vars['update'].get(), keys=self.vars['keys'].get(),
                    lang=self.selected_lang(), dest=self.vars['dest'].get())

    def refresh_form(self):
        form = self.form()
        state = form.installed_state()
        if state is not None:
            self.update_hint.configure(text=self.cat('ui.update_mode'))
            recorded = ini.canonical_language(state.get('lang'))
            if recorded in ini.LANGUAGES and not self.lang_touched:
                self.vars['lang'].set(self.lang_label(recorded))
        else:
            self.update_hint.configure(text='')
        self.fit()

    def pick_file(self, name, pick_id):
        types = [(self.cat('ui.type_game'), '*.nsp *.xci'), (self.cat('ui.type_all'), '*.*')]
        if name == 'update':
            types = [(self.cat('ui.type_nsp'), '*.nsp'), (self.cat('ui.type_all'), '*.*')]
        if name == 'keys':
            types = [(self.cat('ui.type_keys'), '*.keys'), (self.cat('ui.type_all'), '*.*')]
        path = filedialog.askopenfilename(title=self.cat(pick_id), filetypes=types)
        if path:
            self.vars[name].set(os.path.normpath(path))

    def pick_dest(self):
        path = filedialog.askdirectory(title=self.cat('ui.pick_dest'), mustexist=False)
        if path:
            self.vars['dest'].set(os.path.normpath(path))

    # ---- run ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def start(self):
        form = self.form()
        problems = form.problems()
        if problems:
            self.form_error.configure(text=' '.join(self.cat(p) for p in problems))
            self.fit()
            return
        self.form_error.configure(text='')
        command = form.command(self.layout.python, root=self.layout.root if self.layout.dev else None,
                               temp=self.run_args.get('temp'), verify=self.run_args.get('verify', False))
        self.begin(command, self.layout.root)

    def begin(self, command, cwd):
        self.model = Model()
        self.model.dest = self.vars['dest'].get().strip()
        self.clear_log()
        self.build_step_rows(self.model.steps)
        self.cancel_button.configure(state='normal')
        self.bound = [b for b in self.bound if b[0] is not self.cancel_button]
        self.bind_text(self.cancel_button, 'text', 'ui.cancel')
        self.show('run')
        self.refresh_run()
        self.process = Process(command, cwd=cwd, helper_python=self.layout.python)
        self.root.after(POLL_MS, self.poll)

    def build_step_rows(self, steps):
        for w in self.steps_box.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        self.step_rows = {}
        for s in steps:
            row = ttk.Frame(self.steps_box)
            row.pack(fill='x', pady=1)
            glyph = ttk.Label(row, width=3)
            glyph.pack(side='left')
            name = ttk.Label(row)
            name.pack(side='left')
            self.step_rows[s] = (glyph, name)

    def poll(self):
        if self.process is None:
            return
        try:
            while True:
                line = self.process.lines.get_nowait()
                if line is not None:
                    self.feed(line)
        except Exception:
            pass
        code = self.process.poll()
        self.refresh_run()
        if code is None:
            self.root.after(POLL_MS, self.poll)
            return
        self.model.finish(code)
        self.process = None
        self.refresh_run()
        self.refresh_finish()
        self.show('finish')
        if self.closing:
            self.root.destroy()

    def feed(self, line):
        """One stdout line of the CLI: an event updates the model and the log, anything else goes to the log as is."""
        event = parse_line(line)
        if event is None:
            if line.strip():
                self.log_entries.append(line.rstrip())
                self.append_log(line.rstrip())
            return
        before = list(self.model.steps)
        self.model.apply(event)
        if self.model.steps != before:
            self.build_step_rows(self.model.steps)
        self.log_entries.append(event)
        self.append_log(describe_event(self.cat, event))

    def refresh_run(self):
        m = self.model
        for s, (glyph, name) in self.step_rows.items():
            state = m.states.get(s, PENDING)
            glyph.configure(text=GLYPH[state], foreground=COLOR[state])
            name.configure(text=self.cat('step.' + s) + (f'  ({self.cat("ui.state_" + state)})'
                                                          if state in (SKIPPED, FAILED) else ''),
                           font=('Segoe UI', 10, 'bold') if state == RUNNING else ('Segoe UI', 10))
        mode = m.mode or 'install'
        self.run_header.configure(text=self.cat('ui.running_' + mode if mode in ('install', 'resume', 'update')
                                                else 'ui.running_install'))
        if m.current and m.phase:
            text = self.cat(f'phase.{m.current}.{m.phase}')
            if m.total:
                text += '  ' + amount(self.cat, m.done, m.total, m.unit)
        elif m.current:
            text = self.cat('step.' + m.current)
        else:
            text = ''
        self.phase_label.configure(text=text)
        frac = m.fraction()
        if frac is None:
            if str(self.bar.cget('mode')) != 'indeterminate':
                self.bar.configure(mode='indeterminate')
                self.bar.start(15)
        else:
            if str(self.bar.cget('mode')) == 'indeterminate':
                self.bar.stop()
                self.bar.configure(mode='determinate')
            self.bar.configure(value=frac * 1000)
        self.space_label.configure(text=m.need_text(self.cat))
        self.warn_label.configure(text='\n'.join(self.cat(i, **p) for i, p in m.warnings))
        self.fit()   # new step rows and warnings make the screen taller

    def toggle_log(self):
        self.log_open = not self.log_open
        if self.log_open:
            self.log_frame.pack(fill='both', expand=True, pady=(8, 0))
        else:
            self.log_frame.pack_forget()
        self.bound = [b for b in self.bound if b[0] is not self.log_toggle]
        self.bind_text(self.log_toggle, 'text', 'ui.hide_log' if self.log_open else 'ui.show_log')
        self.fit()

    def clear_log(self):
        self.log_entries = []
        self.render_log()

    def render_log(self):
        """The whole log from the kept events in the current language (raw CLI lines stay as they are)."""
        self.log.configure(state='normal')
        self.log.delete('1.0', 'end')
        for entry in self.log_entries:
            text = entry if isinstance(entry, str) else describe_event(self.cat, entry)
            if text:
                self.log.insert('end', text + '\n')
        self.log.see('end')
        self.log.configure(state='disabled')

    def append_log(self, text):
        if text:
            self.log.configure(state='normal')
            self.log.insert('end', text + '\n')
            self.log.see('end')
            self.log.configure(state='disabled')

    def cancel(self):
        if self.process:
            self.cancel_button.configure(state='disabled')
            self.bound = [b for b in self.bound if b[0] is not self.cancel_button]
            self.bind_text(self.cancel_button, 'text', 'ui.cancelling')
            self.process.cancel()

    def on_close(self):
        if self.process:
            if not messagebox.askyesno(self.cat('ui.title'), self.cat('ui.confirm_cancel')):
                return
            self.closing = True
            self.cancel()
            return
        self.root.destroy()

    # ---- finish ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def refresh_finish(self):
        m = self.model
        result = m.result or 'ok'
        self.finish_title.configure(text=self.cat('ui.result_' + result))
        if result == 'ok':
            text = self.cat('ui.done_text', dest=m.dest)
        elif result == 'cancelled':
            text = self.cat('ui.cancelled_text')
        else:
            err = m.error or ('ui.process_died', {'code': m.exit_code}, None)
            text = self.cat(err[0], **err[1])
            if m.log_path:
                text += '\n\n' + self.cat('ui.log_file', path=m.log_path)
        self.finish_text.configure(text=text)
        for w in self.finish_steps.winfo_children():
            w.destroy()
        for s in m.steps:
            state = m.states.get(s, PENDING)
            ttk.Label(self.finish_steps, text=f'{GLYPH[state]}  {self.cat("step." + s)}',
                      foreground=COLOR[state]).pack(anchor='w')
        if result == 'ok':
            self.open_button.state(['!disabled'])
        else:
            self.open_button.state(['disabled' if not Path(m.dest or '.').is_dir() else '!disabled'])

    def open_folder(self):
        dest = self.model.dest
        if dest and Path(dest).is_dir():
            os.startfile(dest)


# ---- self test ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SAMPLE_START = {'type': 'start', 'release': 'selftest', 'mode': 'install', 'dest': 'Z:/selftest/TotK', 'log': 'D:\\log.txt',
                'steps': ['check', 'extract', 'lift', 'compile', 'prepare', 'cleanup']}
SAMPLE_RUN = [

    {'type': 'plan', 'run': ['check', 'extract'], 'skip': {}},

     'temp_need': 0, 'temp_free': 0, 'same_disk': True},

     'unit': 'bytes'},
]


SAMPLE_OK = [SAMPLE_START, {'type': 'plan', 'run': ['check', 'extract'], 'skip': {'lift': 'current', 'compile': 'current',

             {'type': 'step', 'step': 'check', 'state': 'started'},

             {'type': 'step', 'step': 'cleanup', 'state': 'done', 'seconds': 0.1},
             {'type': 'end', 'result': 'ok', 'seconds': 3}]


def grab(root, path):
    if ImageGrab is None:
        raise SystemExit('--shots needs Pillow')
    root.attributes('-topmost', True)
    root.update()
    x, y, w, h = root.winfo_rootx(), root.winfo_rooty(), root.winfo_width(), root.winfo_height()
    ImageGrab.grab(bbox=(x, y, x + w, y + h), all_screens=True).save(path)


def selftest(layout, shots=None):
    """Every screen in both languages; the window closes itself. Returns 0 when nothing raised."""
    fix_tcl_paths()
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.geometry('+60+40')
    app = App(root, 'en', layout)
    steps, mixed = [], []

    def shot(name):
        root.update()
        if shots:
            Path(shots).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            grab(root, Path(shots) / f'{name}.png')

    def run_all():
        for lang in UI_LANGUAGES:
            app.ui_var.set(lang)
            app.switch_language()
            tag = lang
            app.vars['dest'].set('Z:/selftest/TotK')
            app.vars['base'].set('Z:/selftest/totk.xci')
            app.vars['update'].set('Z:/selftest/totk-1.2.1.nsp')
            app.vars['keys'].set('Z:/selftest/prod.keys')
            app.show('form')
            app.start()   # missing files: shows the problems
            steps.append(app.form_error.cget('text'))
            shot(f'form-{tag}')
            app.model = Model()
            app.clear_log()
            app.build_step_rows(app.model.steps)
            app.show('run')
            for e in SAMPLE_RUN:
                app.feed(json.dumps(e))
            app.log_open = False
            app.toggle_log()
            app.refresh_run()
            shot(f'run-{tag}')
            if lang == 'en':   # the log follows the window language: no English line may remain after the switch
                app.ui_var.set('ru')
                app.switch_language()
                text = app.log.get('1.0', 'end')
                mixed.append('Checking' in text or 'Extracting' not in text and 'Распаковка' not in text)
                app.ui_var.set('en')
                app.switch_language()
            app.model = Model()
            for e in SAMPLE_OK:
                app.model.apply(e)
            app.model.dest = 'Z:/selftest/TotK'
            app.model.finish(0)
            app.refresh_finish()
            app.show('finish')
            shot(f'finish-ok-{tag}')
            app.model = Model()
            for e in SAMPLE_RUN[:3] + [{'type': 'error', 'id': 'check.disk_space', 'step': 'check',
                                        'params': {'path': 'Z:/selftest/TotK', 'need_gb': 36.4, 'free_gb': 20.1}},
                                       {'type': 'end', 'result': 'failed', 'seconds': 3}]:
                app.model.apply(e)
            app.model.finish(1)
            app.refresh_finish()
            shot(f'finish-failed-{tag}')
            app.model = Model()
            app.model.finish(3)
            app.refresh_finish()
            shot(f'finish-cancelled-{tag}')
            app.toggle_log()
        root.destroy()

    root.after(200, run_all)
    root.after(60000, root.destroy)   # never leaves a window open
    root.mainloop()
    return 0 if len(steps) == len(UI_LANGUAGES) and all(steps) and mixed == [False] else 1


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument('--selftest', action='store_true')
    ap.add_argument('--shots', type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--lang', choices=UI_LANGUAGES)
    ap.add_argument('--root', type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    layout = layouts.find(args.root)
    if args.selftest:
        return selftest(layout, args.shots)
    fix_tcl_paths()
    root = tk.Tk()
    App(root, args.lang or windows_ui_language(), layout)
    root.mainloop()
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())

`installer/guilogic.py`:

```py
"""The installer window without Tk: text catalogs, the form, the event model and the CLI subprocess.

gui.py draws; everything it decides lives here so tests/installer_gui_test.py runs it headless.

    Catalog      text of an id in the window language (installer/text/<lang>.json), English when that lacks it
    Form         what the player entered; command() and problems() build and check the CLI call
    Model        folds the CLI's JSON events (events.py) into step states, progress, space, errors and the result
    Process      runs `python -m installer ...`, cancels it with Ctrl+Break and feeds lines to a queue
"""
import ctypes
import json
import os
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from . import ini
from . import state as statefile
from .events import render

TEXT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'text'
UI_LANGUAGES = ('en', 'ru')
STEP_ORDER = ('check', 'extract', 'lift', 'compile', 'prepare', 'cleanup')
# message parameter -> catalog id prefix of the names that replace its raw values
PARAM_NAMES = {'lang': 'lang.', 'known': 'lang.', 'step': 'step.', 'input': 'param.input.'}
LANG_RU = 0x19   # primary language id of Russian in a Windows LANGID


def load_texts(lang):
    path = TEXT / f'{lang}.json'
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.is_file() else {}


class Catalog:
    """Window text: ids from text/<lang>.json, then text/en.json, then the id itself."""

    def __init__(self, lang='en'):
        self.english = load_texts('en')
        self.set_language(lang)

    def set_language(self, lang):
        self.lang = lang if lang in UI_LANGUAGES else 'en'
        self.texts = load_texts(self.lang)

    def has(self, id):
        return id in self.texts or id in self.english

    def __call__(self, id, **params):
        text = self.texts.get(id) or self.english.get(id)
        if text is None:
            return id
        return render({id: text}, id, {k: self.param(k, v) for k, v in params.items()})

    def param(self, name, value):
        """A message parameter as the player should read it: language codes, step ids and input names become the
        catalog's names (the ones the pickers and the step list show); the rest stays as it is."""
        prefix = PARAM_NAMES.get(name)
        if prefix:
            if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
                return ', '.join(self.param(name, v) for v in value)
            ident = prefix + str(value)
            if self.has(ident):
                return self(ident)
            if name == 'known':
                return ', '.join(self(prefix + c) if self.has(prefix + c) else c for c in str(value).split(', '))
        return flat(value)


def flat(value):
    return ', '.join(str(v) for v in value) if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else value


def windows_ui_language():
    """'ru' when the Windows display language is Russian, else 'en'."""
    try:
        langid = ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetUserDefaultUILanguage()
    except (AttributeError, OSError):
        return 'en'
    return 'ru' if langid & 0x3ff == LANG_RU else 'en'


def default_game_language(ui):
    return 'ru' if ui == 'ru' else 'en-US'


def gib(n):
    """Bytes as decimal gigabytes with one digit, the unit the check.disk_space message uses."""
    return f'{n / 1e9:.1f}'


def amount(cat, done, total, unit):
    """'6.0 / 16.0 GB', '120 / 4000 files'..., the progress of a phase whose size is known."""
    if unit == 'bytes':
        return cat('ui.amount_bytes', done=gib(done or 0), total=gib(total))
    id = f'ui.amount_{unit}'
    return cat(id if cat.has(id) else 'ui.amount_other', done=done or 0, total=total, unit=unit or '')


# ---- the form ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

@dataclass
class Form:
    base: str = ''
    update: str = ''
    keys: str = ''
    lang: str = ''
    dest: str = ''

    def installed_state(self):
        """The recorded state of the install folder (totk-install.json), or None. Never raises."""
        if not self.dest.strip():
            return None
        try:
            return statefile.load(Path(self.dest.strip()))
        except statefile.StateError:
            return None

    def update_mode(self):
        return self.installed_state() is not None

    def problems(self):
        """Ids of the entries that are missing or wrong, in screen order. A folder with totk-install.json needs only
        itself; the CLI asks for the game files when it must extract again."""
        found = []
        update = self.update_mode()
        if not self.dest.strip():
            found.append('ui.need_dest')
        if not update:
            for name in ('base', 'update', 'keys'):
                value = getattr(self, name).strip()
                if not value:
                    found.append(f'ui.need_{name}')
                elif not Path(value).is_file():
                    found.append(f'ui.missing_{name}')
            if self.lang not in ini.LANGUAGES:
                found.append('ui.need_lang')
        else:
            for name in ('base', 'update', 'keys'):
                value = getattr(self, name).strip()
                if value and not Path(value).is_file():
                    found.append(f'ui.missing_{name}')
        return found

    def command(self, python, root=None, temp=None, verify=False):
        cmd = [str(python), '-m', 'installer']
        for flag, value in (('--base', self.base), ('--update', self.update), ('--keys', self.keys),
                            ('--lang', self.lang), ('--dest', self.dest)):
            if value.strip():
                cmd += [flag, value.strip()]
        if root:
            cmd += ['--root', str(root)]
        if temp:
            cmd += ['--temp', str(temp)]
        if verify:
            cmd.append('--verify')
        return cmd


# ---- events -> state ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PENDING, RUNNING, DONE, SKIPPED, FAILED = 'pending', 'running', 'done', 'skipped', 'failed'


def parse_line(line):
    """The event dict of a stdout line, or None when it is not a JSON event (a traceback line, noise)."""
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('{'):
        return None
    try:
        event = json.loads(line)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return event if isinstance(event, dict) and isinstance(event.get('type'), str) else None


class Model:
    """What the window shows, folded from events. apply() takes one event; nothing else mutates it."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.steps = list(STEP_ORDER)
        self.states = {s: PENDING for s in self.steps}
        self.mode = ''
        self.release = ''
        self.log_path = ''
        self.dest = ''
        self.current = None          # step id running
        self.phase = None
        self.done = self.total = None
        self.unit = None
        self.space = None            # the space event
        self.warnings = []           # (id, params)
        self.error = None            # (id, params, step)
        self.result = None           # ok | failed | cancelled once the end event arrived
        self.seconds = None
        self.exit_code = None

    def apply(self, e):
        kind = e['type']
        if kind == 'start':
            self.__init__()   # a new run: nothing of an earlier one stays
            self.steps = list(e.get('steps') or STEP_ORDER)
            self.states = {s: PENDING for s in self.steps}
            self.mode, self.release = e.get('mode', ''), e.get('release', '')
            self.log_path, self.dest = e.get('log', ''), e.get('dest', '')
        elif kind == 'plan':
            for s, reason in (e.get('skip') or {}).items():
                if s in self.states and self.states[s] == PENDING:
                    self.states[s] = SKIPPED
        elif kind == 'step':
            s, state = e.get('step'), e.get('state')
            if s not in self.states:
                self.states[s] = PENDING
                self.steps.append(s)
            if state == 'started':
                self.states[s], self.current = RUNNING, s
                self.phase = self.done = self.total = self.unit = None
            elif state == 'done':
                self.states[s] = DONE
                self.current = None if self.current == s else self.current
            elif state == 'skipped':
                self.states[s] = SKIPPED
        elif kind == 'progress':
            if e.get('step') in self.states and self.states[e['step']] == PENDING:
                self.states[e['step']] = RUNNING
            self.current = e.get('step', self.current)
            self.phase = e.get('phase')
            self.done, self.total, self.unit = e.get('done'), e.get('total'), e.get('unit')
        elif kind == 'space':
            self.space = e
        elif kind == 'warning':
            self.warnings.append((e.get('id', ''), e.get('params') or {}))
        elif kind == 'error':
            self.error = (e.get('id', ''), e.get('params') or {}, e.get('step'))
            if e.get('step') in self.states:
                self.states[e['step']] = FAILED
        elif kind == 'end':
            self.result = e.get('result')
            self.seconds = e.get('seconds')
            self.current = None

    def fraction(self):
        """0..1 of the current phase, or None when its size is unknown."""
        if self.total:
            return max(0.0, min(1.0, (self.done or 0) / self.total))
        return None

    def finish(self, exit_code):
        """The process ended. A missing end event (the process died) counts as failed, or cancelled on exit code 3."""
        self.exit_code = exit_code
        if self.result is None:
            self.result = 'cancelled' if exit_code == 3 else 'failed'
        if self.result == 'failed' and self.error is None:
            self.error = ('ui.process_died', {'code': exit_code}, self.current)
        for s, state in self.states.items():
            if state == RUNNING:
                self.states[s] = FAILED if self.result == 'failed' else PENDING

    def need_text(self, cat):
        """The space line, or '' before the check step reported."""
        sp = self.space
        if not sp:
            return ''
        key = 'ui.space_one' if sp.get('same_disk') or not sp.get('temp_need') else 'ui.space_two'
        return cat(key, path=sp.get('dest', ''), need=gib(sp.get('need', 0)), free=gib(sp.get('free', 0)),
                   temp=sp.get('temp', ''), temp_need=gib(sp.get('temp_need', 0)),
                   temp_free=gib(sp.get('temp_free', 0)))


def describe_event(cat, e):
    """One log line for an event, in the window language."""
    kind = e['type']
    if kind == 'step':
        text = f'{cat("step." + e["step"])}: {cat("ui.state_" + e["state"])}'
        if 'seconds' in e:
            text += f' ({cat("ui.seconds", n=format(e["seconds"], ".1f"))})'
        elif e.get('reason'):
            text += f' ({e["reason"]})'
        return text
    if kind == 'progress':
        text = cat(f'phase.{e["step"]}.{e["phase"]}')
        if e.get('total'):
            text += '  ' + amount(cat, e.get('done'), e['total'], e.get('unit'))
        return text
    if kind in ('warning', 'error'):
        return f'{cat("ui.log_" + kind)}: {cat(e["id"], **(e.get("params") or {}))}'
    if kind == 'space':
        return cat('ui.log_space', need=gib(e.get('need', 0)), free=gib(e.get('free', 0)))
    if kind == 'end':
        return f'{cat("ui.log_end")}: {cat("ui.result_" + str(e.get("result")))}'
    return ''


# ---- the CLI subprocess ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP = 0x200
CREATE_NO_WINDOW = 0x08000000

_BREAK = """
import ctypes, sys, time
k = ctypes.windll.kernel32
pid = int(sys.argv[1])
k.FreeConsole()
if k.AttachConsole(pid):
    k.SetConsoleCtrlHandler(None, True)
    k.GenerateConsoleCtrlEvent(1, pid)
    time.sleep(1)
    k.FreeConsole()
else:
    sys.exit(1)
"""


def send_break(proc, python=None):
    """Ctrl+Break to the process group of proc (started with CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP). The window itself may have no
    console (pythonw), so a short helper process attaches to the child's console and sends it."""
    helper = [str(python or sys.executable), '-c', _BREAK, str(proc.pid)]
    flags = CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == 'nt' else 0
    r = subprocess.run(helper, creationflags=flags, capture_output=True)
    return r.returncode == 0


class Process:
    """`python -m installer ...` with its stdout lines going to self.lines (a queue).

    poll() returns the exit code once the process ended and its output is drained, else None."""

    def __init__(self, command, cwd=None, helper_python=None, creationflags=None):
        self.command = command
        self.helper_python = helper_python
        self.lines = queue.Queue()
        flags = (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | CREATE_NO_WINDOW) if creationflags is None else creationflags
        env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8', PYTHONUTF8='1', PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1')
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                     stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, creationflags=flags)
        self.cancelled_at = None
        self.reader = threading.Thread(target=self.read, daemon=True)
        self.reader.start()

    def read(self):
        for raw in iter(self.proc.stdout.readline, b''):
            self.lines.put(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        self.proc.stdout.close()

    def cancel(self):
        if self.cancelled_at is None and self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.cancelled_at = time.monotonic()
            send_break(self.proc, self.helper_python)

    def poll(self):
        code = self.proc.poll()
        if code is not None and not self.reader.is_alive() and self.lines.empty():
            return code
        return None

    def kill(self):
        if self.proc.poll() is None:
            self.proc.kill()

`installer/hostcheck.c`:

```c
// Host check of the installer's first step, compiled with the bundled clang at install time: does the CPU run
// -march=x86-64-v3 code, and does a Vulkan 1.3 device exist. Prints one JSON object on stdout.
// The Vulkan loader is opened at run time, so a machine without one gets "loader": false instead of a failed start.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#define open_lib() LoadLibraryA("vulkan-1.dll")
#define lib_sym(l, n) ((void *)GetProcAddress((l), (n)))
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#define open_lib() dlopen("libvulkan.so.1", RTLD_NOW)
#define lib_sym(l, n) dlsym((l), (n))
#endif

static void json_string(const char *s) {
    putchar('"');
    for (; *s; s++) {
        if (*s == '"' || *s == '\\') printf("\\%c", *s);
        else if ((unsigned char)*s < 0x20) printf("\\u%04x", *s);
        else putchar(*s);
    }
    putchar('"');
}

int main(void) {
    __builtin_cpu_init();
    printf("{\"x86_64_v3\": %s, ", __builtin_cpu_supports("x86-64-v3") ? "true" : "false");
    void *lib = open_lib();
    PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr gipa = lib ? (PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr)lib_sym(lib, "vkGetInstanceProcAddr") : NULL;
    if (!gipa) {
        printf("\"loader\": false, \"devices\": []}\n");
        return 0;
    }
    printf("\"loader\": true, ");
    PFN_vkCreateInstance create = (PFN_vkCreateInstance)gipa(NULL, "vkCreateInstance");
    VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "totk-install",
                             .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app};
    VkInstance inst = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkResult r = create ? create(&ci, NULL, &inst) : VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        printf("\"instance\": %d, \"devices\": []}\n", (int)r);
        return 0;
    }
    PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices enumerate = (PFN_vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices)gipa(inst, "vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices");
    PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties props = (PFN_vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties)gipa(inst, "vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties");
    PFN_vkDestroyInstance destroy = (PFN_vkDestroyInstance)gipa(inst, "vkDestroyInstance");
    VkPhysicalDevice devs[16];
    uint32_t n = 16;
    if (enumerate(inst, &n, devs) < 0) n = 0;
    printf("\"instance\": 0, \"devices\": [");
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
        props(devs[i], &p);
        printf("%s{\"name\": ", i ? ", " : "");
        json_string(p.deviceName);
        printf(", \"api\": [%u, %u, %u], \"type\": %d}", VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(p.apiVersion),
               VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(p.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(p.apiVersion), (int)p.deviceType);
    }
    printf("]}\n");
    destroy(inst, NULL);
    return 0;
}
