```py
        op0, op1, crn, crm, op2, rt = (bits(w, 19, 2), bits(w, 16, 3), bits(w, 12, 4),
                                       bits(w, 8, 4), bits(w, 5, 3), bits(w, 0, 5))
        if op0 == 0 and not L:
            if crn == 2 and op1 == 3 and rt == 31:  # hints
                return Insn('op', '/* hint */')
            if crn == 3 and op1 == 3 and rt == 31:  # barriers
                if op2 == 2:
                    return Insn('op', 'c->excl_addr = ~0ull;')
                return Insn('op', '__atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);')
            raise Unsupported(f'pstate/system {w:08x}')
        if op0 == 1:  # SYS
            if not L and op1 == 3 and crn == 7 and crm == 4 and op2 == 1:  # DC ZVA
                return Insn('op', f'memset((void*)(uintptr_t)({X(rt)} & ~63ull), 0, 64);')
            return Insn('op', '/* cache maintenance */')
        key = (op0, op1, crn, crm, op2)
        if L:  # MRS
            src = {
                (3, 3, 13, 0, 3): 'c->tpidrro',
                (3, 3, 13, 0, 2): 'c->tpidr',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 0): '19200000ull',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 1): 'rt_ticks()',
                (3, 3, 14, 0, 2): 'rt_ticks()',
                (3, 3, 4, 2, 0): 'c->nzcv',
                (3, 3, 4, 4, 0): 'c->fpcr' if self.sc else 'rt_get_fpcr()',
                (3, 3, 4, 4, 1): 'c->fpsr' if self.sc else 'rt_get_fpsr()',
                (3, 3, 0, 0, 7): '4ull',
                (3, 3, 0, 0, 1): '0x8444c004ull',
            }.get(key)
            if src is None:
                raise Unsupported(f'mrs {key}')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, src))
        dst = {
            (3, 3, 13, 0, 2): 'c->tpidr = {v};',
            (3, 3, 4, 2, 0): 'c->nzcv = {v} & 0xf0000000ull;',
            (3, 3, 4, 4, 0): 'c->fpcr = {v} & 0x7c00000ull; rt_fpcr_sync(c);' if self.sc else 'rt_set_fpcr({v});',
            (3, 3, 4, 4, 1): 'c->fpsr = {v} & 0xf800009full;' if self.sc else 'rt_set_fpsr({v});',
        }.get(key)
        if dst is None:
            raise Unsupported(f'msr {key}')
        return Insn('op', dst.format(v=X(rt)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ loads / stores

    def ldst(self, w, pc):
        V = bits(w, 26, 1)
        if V:
            if self.sc:
                return Insn('op', self.sc.ldst(w, pc))
            return self.ldst_simd(w, pc)
        if bits(w, 24, 6) == 0b001000:
            return self.ldst_excl(w, pc)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b011 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0:  # literal
            opc, rt = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 0, 5)
            addr = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            if opc == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(0, rt, f'LD32({hx(addr)})'))
            if opc == 1:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'LD64({hx(addr)})'))
            if opc == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'(int64_t)(int32_t)LD32({hx(addr)})'))
            return Insn('op', '/* prfm */')
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b101:
            return self.ldst_pair(w)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b111:
            return self.ldst_reg(w)
        if (w & 0xFFE00000) == 0xD9200000 and bits(w, 10, 2):
            return self.stg(w)
        raise Unsupported(f'ldst {w:08x}')

    def stg(self, w):
        """STG (post-index, signed offset, pre-index). Horizon runs without MTE, so storing an allocation tag
        changes no memory; only the base writeback remains (1.4.3 sdk+0x640050)."""
        mode, rn = bits(w, 10, 2), bits(w, 5, 5)
        if mode == 2:
            return Insn('op', '/* stg */')
        off = sext(bits(w, 12, 9), 9) << 4
        dst = 'c->sp' if rn == 31 else f'c->x[{rn}]'
        return Insn('op', f'{dst} = {XS(rn)} + {hx(off & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)}; /* stg */')

    def ldst_excl(self, w, pc):
        size, o2, L, o1, rs, o0, rn, rt = (bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 1), bits(w, 22, 1), bits(w, 21, 1),
                                           bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5))
        nbits = 8 << size
        addr = XS(rn)
        if o1:
            if o2:
                return self.cas(size, rs, rt, addr)
            if bits(w, 31, 1):
                return self.excl_pair(bits(w, 30, 1), L, rs, bits(w, 10, 5), rt, addr)
            return self.casp(bits(w, 30, 1), rs, rt, addr)
        if o2 == 0:
            if L:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'ldx{nbits}(c, {addr})'))
            return Insn('op', f'{{ uint32_t st = stx{nbits}(c, {addr}, {X(rt)}); {set_reg(0, rs, "st")} }}')
        if L:
            return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rt, f'lda{nbits}({addr})'))
        return Insn('op', f'stl{nbits}({addr}, {X(rt)});')

    def excl_pair(self, sz, L, rs, rt2, rt, addr):
        """LDXP/LDAXP/STXP/STLXP. Two W registers form one 64-bit exclusive, two X registers one 128-bit."""
        if L:
            if sz:
                return Insn('op', f'{{ __uint128_t p = ldxp128(c, {addr}); '
                                  f'{set_reg(1, rt, "(uint64_t)p")} {set_reg(1, rt2, "(uint64_t)(p >> 64)")} }}')
            return Insn('op', f'{{ uint64_t p = ldx64(c, {addr}); '
                              f'{set_reg(0, rt, "p")} {set_reg(0, rt2, "p >> 32")} }}')
        if sz:
            st = f'stxp128(c, {addr}, {X(rt)}, {X(rt2)})'
        else:
            st = f'stx64(c, {addr}, (uint64_t){W(rt)} | ((uint64_t){W(rt2)} << 32))'
        return Insn('op', f'{{ uint32_t st = {st}; {set_reg(0, rs, "st")} }}')

    def cas(self, size, rs, rt, addr):
        """CAS{A}{L}{B,H}: Rs is the compare value and receives the old memory value."""
        t = f'uint{8 << size}_t'
        return Insn('op', f'{{ {t} e = ({t}){X(rs)}; __atomic_compare_exchange_n(({t} *)(uintptr_t)({addr}), &e, '
                          f'({t}){X(rt)}, 0, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); {set_reg(size == 3, rs, "e")} }}')

    def casp(self, sz, rs, rt, addr):
        """CASP{A}{L}: register pairs (Rs, Rs+1) compared and (Rt, Rt+1) stored as one 64- or 128-bit access."""
        if rs & 1 or rt & 1:
            raise Unsupported('casp odd register')
        if sz:
            t = '__uint128_t'
            e = f'(({t}){X(rs + 1)} << 64) | {X(rs)}'
            v = f'(({t}){X(rt + 1)} << 64) | {X(rt)}'
            lo, hi = set_reg(1, rs, '(uint64_t)e'), set_reg(1, rs + 1, '(uint64_t)(e >> 64)')
        else:
            t = 'uint64_t'
            e = f'(uint64_t){W(rs)} | ((uint64_t){W(rs + 1)} << 32)'
            v = f'(uint64_t){W(rt)} | ((uint64_t){W(rt + 1)} << 32)'
            lo, hi = set_reg(0, rs, 'e'), set_reg(0, rs + 1, 'e >> 32')
        return Insn('op', f'{{ {t} e = {e}; __atomic_compare_exchange_n(({t} *)(uintptr_t)({addr}), &e, {v}, 0, '
                          f'__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); {lo} {hi} }}')

    def atomic(self, w):
        """LSE LD<op>{A}{L}{B,H} and SWP{A}{L}{B,H}: Rt receives the old memory value, Rs is the operand."""
        size, A, R, rs, o3, opc, rn, rt = (bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 1), bits(w, 22, 1), bits(w, 16, 5),
                                           bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 12, 3), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5))
        nbits = 8 << size
        t = f'uint{nbits}_t'
        p, v = f'({t} *)(uintptr_t)({XS(rn)})', f'({t}){X(rs)}'
        order = ('__ATOMIC_RELAXED', '__ATOMIC_RELEASE', '__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE', '__ATOMIC_ACQ_REL')[A << 1 | R]
        if o3:
            if opc:
                raise Unsupported('ldapr')
            expr = f'__atomic_exchange_n({p}, {v}, {order})'
        elif opc < 4:
            fn, operand = (('add', v), ('and', f'({t})~{X(rs)}'), ('xor', v), ('or', v))[opc]
            expr = f'__atomic_fetch_{fn}({p}, {operand}, {order})'
        else:
            fn = ('smax', 'smin', 'umax', 'umin')[opc - 4]
            expr = f'atomic_{fn}{nbits}({XS(rn)}, {v})'
        return Insn('op', set_reg(size == 3, rt, expr))

    def ldst_pair(self, w):
        opc, mode, L = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 23, 2), bits(w, 22, 1)
        imm7, rt2, rn, rt = sext(bits(w, 15, 7), 7), bits(w, 10, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5)
        if opc == 3:
            raise Unsupported('pair opc 3')
        scale = 3 if opc == 2 else 2
        off = imm7 << scale
        base = XS(rn)
        post = mode == 1
        wb = mode in (1, 3)
        ea = base if post else (f'{base} + {off}' if off >= 0 else f'{base} - {-off}')
        lines = [f'uint64_t ea = {ea};']
        if L:
            if opc == 2:
                lines.append('uint64_t a = LD64(ea), b = LD64(ea + 8);')
            elif opc == 1:  # LDPSW
                lines.append('uint64_t a = (int64_t)(int32_t)LD32(ea), b = (int64_t)(int32_t)LD32(ea + 4);')
            else:
                lines.append('uint64_t a = LD32(ea), b = LD32(ea + 4);')
        else:
            if opc == 2:
                lines.append(f'ST64(ea, {X(rt)}); ST64(ea + 8, {X(rt2)});')
            else:
                lines.append(f'ST32(ea, {W(rt)}); ST32(ea + 4, {W(rt2)});')
        if wb:
            dst = 'c->sp' if rn == 31 else f'c->x[{rn}]'
            if not post:
                lines.append(f'{dst} = ea;')
            else:
                lines.append(f'{dst} = ea + {off};' if off >= 0 else f'{dst} = ea - {-off};')
        if L:
            lines.append(set_reg(1, rt, 'a'))
            lines.append(set_reg(1, rt2, 'b'))
        return Insn('op', '{ ' + ' '.join(lines) + ' }')

    def ldst_reg(self, w):
        size, opc, rn, rt = bits(w, 30, 2), bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 0, 5)
        base = XS(rn)
        wb = None
        if bits(w, 24, 2) == 1:
            ea = f'{base} + {hx(bits(w, 10, 12) << size)}'
        else:
            kind = bits(w, 10, 2)
            if bits(w, 21, 1):
                if kind == 0:
                    return self.atomic(w)
                if kind != 2:
                    raise Unsupported('ldst reg pac')
                rm, option, S = bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 13, 3), bits(w, 12, 1)
                if option not in (2, 3, 6, 7):
                    raise Unsupported('ldst reg option')
                ea = f'{base} + {extend_expr(rm, option, size if S else 0)}'
            else:
                imm9 = sext(bits(w, 12, 9), 9)
                sign_imm = f'+ {imm9}' if imm9 >= 0 else f'- {-imm9}'
                if kind in (0, 2):  # unscaled, unprivileged
                    ea = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                elif kind == 1:  # post
                    ea = base
                    wb = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                else:  # pre
                    ea = f'{base} {sign_imm}'
                    wb = 'ea'
        nbits = 8 << size
        if opc == 0:
            parts = [f'ST{nbits}(ea, {X(rt) if size == 3 else W(rt)});']
            load = None
        elif opc == 1:
            parts = [f'uint64_t v = LD{nbits}(ea);']
            load = set_reg(1, rt, 'v')
        elif size == 3:
            return Insn('op', '/* prfm */')
        elif size == 2 and opc == 3:
            raise Unsupported('ldst size2 opc3')
        else:
            parts = [f'uint64_t v = (uint64_t)(int64_t)(int{nbits}_t)LD{nbits}(ea);']
            load = set_reg(1 if opc == 2 else 0, rt, 'v')
        parts.insert(0, f'uint64_t ea = {ea};')
        if wb:
            # writeback before the register load, so a load into rn wins
            parts.append(f'{"c->sp" if rn == 31 else f"c->x[{rn}]"} = {wb};')
        if load:
            parts.append(load)
        return Insn('op', '{ ' + ' '.join(parts) + ' }')

    def ldst_simd(self, w, pc):
        """FP/SIMD loads and stores are passed through as asm; GPR address regs are remapped."""
        rt = bits(w, 0, 5)
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b011 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0:  # literal -> LDR (imm, offset 0) via scratch
            opc = bits(w, 30, 2)
            size, o = {0: (2, 1), 1: (3, 1), 2: (0, 3)}[opc]
            addr = pc + sext(bits(w, 5, 19), 19) * 4
            new = (size << 30) | 0x3D000000 | (o << 22) | (31 << 5) | rt
            return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(new, {rt}, [], consts=[(5, addr)]))
        if bits(w, 31, 1) == 0 and bits(w, 24, 6) in (0b001100, 0b001101):  # structures
            post = bits(w, 23, 1)
            rn, rm = bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5)
            if bits(w, 24, 1) == 0:
                n = {0: 4, 2: 4, 4: 3, 6: 3, 7: 1, 8: 2, 10: 2}.get(bits(w, 12, 4))
                if n is None:
                    raise Unsupported('ldst multiple opcode')
            else:
                n = ((bits(w, 13, 1) << 1) | bits(w, 21, 1)) + 1
            vregs = {(rt + i) % 32 for i in range(n)}
            gprs = [(5, 'sp' if rn == 31 else rn)]
            if post and rm != 31:
                gprs.append((16, rm))
            return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs))
        rn = bits(w, 5, 5)
        gprs = [(5, 'sp' if rn == 31 else rn)]
        vregs = {rt}
        if bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b101:  # pair
            vregs.add(bits(w, 10, 5))
        elif bits(w, 27, 3) == 0b111 and bits(w, 24, 2) == 0 and bits(w, 21, 1) and bits(w, 10, 2) == 2:
            rm = bits(w, 16, 5)
            if rm != 31:
                gprs.append((16, rm))
        return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ data processing (reg)

    def dp_reg(self, w, pc):
        sf = bits(w, 31, 1)
        rd, rn, rm = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5)
        size = 64 if sf else 32
        op1 = bits(w, 28, 1)
        if not op1:
            if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1010:  # logical shifted
                opc, sh, N, amt = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 21, 1), bits(w, 10, 6)
                if not sf and amt >= 32:
                    raise Unsupported('logical shift amount')
                b = shift_expr(sf, R(sf, rm), sh, amt)
                if N:
                    b = f'(uint{size}_t)~{b}'
                a = R(sf, rn)
                expr = {0: f'{a} & {b}', 1: f'{a} | {b}', 2: f'{a} ^ {b}', 3: f'{a} & {b}'}[opc]
                if opc == 3:
                    return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'logic{size}(c, (uint{size}_t)({expr}))'))
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
            if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1011:  # add/sub shifted or extended
                op, S = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 29, 1)
                if bits(w, 21, 1) == 0:
                    sh, amt = bits(w, 22, 2), bits(w, 10, 6)
                    if sh == 3:
                        raise Unsupported('add shift ror')
                    a = R(sf, rn)
                    b = shift_expr(sf, R(sf, rm), sh, amt)
                    sp_ok = False
                else:
                    if bits(w, 22, 2):
                        raise Unsupported('add ext opt')
                    option, amt = bits(w, 13, 3), bits(w, 10, 3)
                    a = R(sf, rn, sp=True)
                    b = extend_expr(rm, option, amt)
                    if not sf:
                        b = f'(uint32_t)({b})'
                    sp_ok = not S
                if S:
                    fn = ('subs' if op else 'adds') + str(size)
                    return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{fn}(c, {a}, (uint{size}_t)({b}))'))
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{a} {"-" if op else "+"} {b}', sp=sp_ok))
            raise Unsupported(f'dp_reg {w:08x}')
        op2 = bits(w, 21, 4)
        if bits(w, 24, 4) == 0b1011:  # 3-source
            op54, op31, o0, ra = bits(w, 29, 2), bits(w, 21, 3), bits(w, 15, 1), bits(w, 10, 5)
            if op54:
                raise Unsupported('dp3 op54')
            sgn = '-' if o0 else '+'
            if op31 == 0:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{R(sf, ra)} {sgn} {R(sf, rn)} * {R(sf, rm)}'))
            if op31 == 1:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'{X(ra)} {sgn} (uint64_t)((int64_t)(int32_t){W(rn)} * (int64_t)(int32_t){W(rm)})'))
            if op31 == 5:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'{X(ra)} {sgn} (uint64_t){W(rn)} * (uint64_t){W(rm)}'))
            if op31 == 2:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(
                    1, rd, f'(uint64_t)(((__int128)(int64_t){X(rn)} * (__int128)(int64_t){X(rm)}) >> 64)'))
            if op31 == 6:
                return Insn('op', set_reg(1, rd, f'(uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128){X(rn)} * {X(rm)}) >> 64)'))
            raise Unsupported('dp3')
        if op2 == 0:  # add/sub with carry
            op, S = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 29, 1)
            fn = ('sbc' if op else 'adc') + ('s' if S else '') + str(size)
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'{fn}(c, {R(sf, rn)}, {R(sf, rm)})'))
        if op2 == 2:  # conditional compare
            op, imm_form, cond, nzcv = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 11, 1), bits(w, 12, 4), bits(w, 0, 4)
            b = hx(rm) if imm_form else R(sf, rm)
            fn = ('subs' if op else 'adds') + str(size)
            return Insn('op', f'if ({cond_expr(cond)}) (void){fn}(c, {R(sf, rn)}, {b}); '
                              f'else c->nzcv = {hx(nzcv << 28)};')
        if op2 == 4:  # conditional select
            op, o2, cond = bits(w, 30, 1), bits(w, 10, 2), bits(w, 12, 4)
            b = R(sf, rm)
            alt = {(0, 0): b, (0, 1): f'{b} + 1', (1, 0): f'~{b}', (1, 1): f'-{b}'}.get((op, o2))
            if alt is None:
                raise Unsupported('csel variant')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, f'({cond_expr(cond)}) ? {R(sf, rn)} : (uint{size}_t)({alt})'))
        if op2 == 6:
            opcode = bits(w, 10, 6)
            if bits(w, 30, 1):  # 1-source
                if bits(w, 16, 5):
                    raise Unsupported('dp1 opcode2')
                a = R(sf, rn)
                expr = {
                    0: f'rbit{size}({a})',
                    1: f'rev16_{size}({a})',
                    2: f'__builtin_bswap32({a})' if not sf else f'rev32_64({a})',
                    3: f'__builtin_bswap64({a})' if sf else None,
                    4: f'clz{size}({a})',
                    5: f'cls{size}({a})',
                }.get(opcode)
                if expr is None:
                    raise Unsupported('dp1')
                return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
            if 16 <= opcode <= 23:  # CRC32: host has the same instruction
                if self.sc:
                    return Insn('op', self.sc.crc(w))
                gprs = [(p, r) for p, r in ((0, rd), (5, rn), (16, rm)) if r != 31]
                return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, set(), gprs))
            a, b = R(sf, rn), R(sf, rm)
            expr = {
                2: f'udiv{size}({a}, {b})',
                3: f'sdiv{size}({a}, {b})',
                8: f'{a} << ({b} & {size - 1})',
                9: f'{a} >> ({b} & {size - 1})',
                10: f'(uint{size}_t)((int{size}_t){a} >> ({b} & {size - 1}))',
                11: f'ROR{size}({a}, {b} & {size - 1})',
            }.get(opcode)
            if expr is None:
                raise Unsupported('dp2')
            return Insn('op', set_reg(sf, rd, expr))
        raise Unsupported(f'dp_reg {w:08x}')

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ FP / SIMD data processing

    def fp_simd(self, w, pc):
        if self.sc:
            return Insn('op', self.sc.dp(w, pc))
        rd, rn, rm, ra = bits(w, 0, 5), bits(w, 5, 5), bits(w, 16, 5), bits(w, 10, 5)
        vregs = {rd, rn, rm, ra}
        gprs = []
        flags = False
        if (w & 0x5F20FC00) == 0x1E200000:  # FP <-> integer
            opcode = bits(w, 16, 3)
            if opcode in (0, 1, 4, 5, 6):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
        elif (w & 0x5F200000) == 0x1E000000:  # FP <-> fixed point
            opcode = bits(w, 16, 3)
            if opcode in (0, 1):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
        elif (w & 0x9FE08400) == 0x0E000400 and bits(w, 29, 1) == 0:  # AdvSIMD copy
            imm4 = bits(w, 11, 4)
            if imm4 in (1, 3):
                gprs = [(5, rn)]
                vregs = {rd}
            elif imm4 in (5, 7):
                gprs = [(0, rd)]
                vregs = {rn}
            else:
                vregs = {rd, rn}
        elif (w & 0xBFE08C00) == 0x0E000000:  # TBL/TBX
            n = bits(w, 13, 2) + 1
            vregs = {rd, rm} | {(rn + i) % 32 for i in range(n)}
        if (w & 0x5F203C00) == 0x1E202000 or (w & 0x5F200C00) in (0x1E200400, 0x1E200C00):
            flags = True
        gprs = [(p, r) for p, r in gprs if r != 31]  # register 31 is zr in these encodings
        return Insn('asm', asm=AsmInsn(w, vregs, gprs, flags))


def cond_expr(cond):
    return f'COND_{COND_NAMES[cond].upper()}(c)' if cond < 14 else '1'


def emit_asm_batch(batch):
    """Emit one inline-asm block for a run of FP/SIMD instructions."""
    vregs = set()
    gmap = {}
    flags = False
    consts = []
    words = []
    for a in batch:
        vregs |= a.vregs
        flags |= a.flags
        w = a.word
        for pos, g in a.gprs:
            if g not in gmap:
                if len(gmap) + len(consts) >= len(SCRATCH):
                    raise Unsupported('scratch exhausted')
                gmap[g] = SCRATCH[len(gmap) + len(consts)]
            w = (w & ~(31 << pos)) | (gmap[g] << pos)
        for pos, val in a.consts:
            s = SCRATCH[len(gmap) + len(consts)]
            consts.append((s, val))
            w = (w & ~(31 << pos)) | (s << pos)
        words.append(w)
    lines = []
    ins = ['"r"(c)']
    for g, s in gmap.items():
        off = OFF_SP if g == 'sp' else OFF_X + 8 * g
        lines.append(f'ldr x{s}, [%0, #{off}]')
    for i, (s, val) in enumerate(consts):
        ins.append(f'"r"({hx(val)})')
        lines.append(f'mov x{s}, %{len(ins) - 1}')
    for v in sorted(vregs):
        lines.append(f'ldr q{v}, [%0, #{OFF_V + 16 * v}]')
    if flags:
        lines.append(f'ldr x16, [%0, #{OFF_NZCV}]')
        lines.append('msr nzcv, x16')
    lines += [f'.inst 0x{x:08x}' for x in words]
    if flags:
        lines.append('mrs x16, nzcv')
        lines.append(f'str x16, [%0, #{OFF_NZCV}]')
    for v in sorted(vregs):
        lines.append(f'str q{v}, [%0, #{OFF_V + 16 * v}]')
    for g, s in gmap.items():
        off = OFF_SP if g == 'sp' else OFF_X + 8 * g
        lines.append(f'str x{s}, [%0, #{off}]')
    clob = [f'"v{v}"' for v in sorted(vregs)]
    clob += [f'"x{s}"' for s in sorted(set(gmap.values()) | {s for s, _ in consts} | ({16} if flags else set()))]
    clob += ['"cc"', '"memory"']
    body = '\\n\\t'.join(lines)
    return f'__asm__ volatile("{body}" :: {", ".join(ins)} : {", ".join(clob)});'

```

`recomp/module.py`:

```py
"""One loaded NSO module as the generator and its analyses see it: image at a guest base, .text as words,
function seeds, and bounded-cache instruction lifting.

The function seeds and the .eh_frame_hdr reader are adapted from LAS Recomp tools/analyze.py and tools/gen.py
@ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""
import struct
from collections import OrderedDict

import numpy as np

from lifter import Insn, Lifter, Unsupported, hx
from nso import Nso, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE

LIFT_CACHE = 1 << 16  # lifted instructions kept per module; analyses revisit nearby addresses only


def _read_encoded(img, off, enc, pc_base):
    fmt, app = enc & 0x0F, enc & 0x70
    if fmt == 0x0B:  # sdata4
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<i', img, off)[0], 4
    elif fmt == 0x03:  # udata4
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<I', img, off)[0], 4
    elif fmt in (0x0C, 0x04):  # sdata8, udata8
        v, size = struct.unpack_from('<q' if fmt == 0x0C else '<Q', img, off)[0], 8
    else:
        raise ValueError(f'unsupported pointer encoding {enc:#x}')
    if app == 0x10:  # pcrel
        v += off
    elif app == 0x30:  # datarel
        v += pc_base
    return v, size


class Module:
    def __init__(self, name, path, base, simd='c'):
        self.name = name
        self.nso = Nso(str(path))
        self.base = base
        n = self.nso
        self.image = bytes(n.image)
        self.lo = base + n.text[0]
        self.hi = self.lo + n.text[1]
        self.words = np.frombuffer(self.image, dtype='<u4', count=n.text[1] // 4, offset=n.text[0])
        self.lifter = Lifter(base, simd)
        self._cache = OrderedDict()

    # ---- memory

    def in_text(self, a):
        return self.lo <= a < self.hi and a % 4 == 0

    def in_image(self, a, n=1):
        return self.base <= a and a + n <= self.base + len(self.image)

    def word(self, a):
        return int(self.words[(a - self.lo) >> 2])

    def read(self, a, n, signed=False):
        """Little-endian integer of n bytes at guest address a (unrelocated image)."""
        o = a - self.base
        return int.from_bytes(self.image[o:o + n], 'little', signed=signed)

    # ---- lifting

    def lift(self, a):
        """Lifted instruction at a; Unsupported becomes an rt_udf trap."""
        ins = self._cache.get(a)
        if ins is not None:
            self._cache.move_to_end(a)
            return ins
        try:
            ins = self.lifter.lift(self.word(a), a)
        except Unsupported as e:
            ins = Insn('trap', f'rt_udf(c, {hx(a)}); /* {e} */')
        self._cache[a] = ins
        if len(self._cache) > LIFT_CACHE:
            self._cache.popitem(last=False)
        return ins

    # ---- function seeds

    def eh_frame_functions(self):
        """Function starts from .eh_frame_hdr's binary search table (absolute addresses)."""
        img, hdr = self.image, self.nso.eh_start
        if not hdr or hdr >= len(img):
            return []
        _, ptr_enc, cnt_enc, tbl_enc = img[hdr:hdr + 4]
        off = hdr + 4
        _, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, ptr_enc, hdr)
        off += sz
        count, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, cnt_enc, hdr)
        off += sz
        starts = []
        for _ in range(count):
            loc, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, tbl_enc, hdr)
            off += sz
            _, sz = _read_encoded(img, off, tbl_enc, hdr)
            off += sz
            starts.append(self.base + loc)
        return starts

    def seeds(self):
        """Known function starts: .eh_frame_hdr, exported FUNC symbols, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE targets in .text."""
        starts = set(self.eh_frame_functions())
        for _, info, shndx, value, _ in self.nso.syms:
            if shndx and (info & 0xF) == 2:
                starts.add(self.base + value)
        for _, typ, _, add in self.nso.relocs:
            if typ == R_AARCH64_RELATIVE:
                starts.add(self.base + add)
        return sorted(a for a in starts if self.in_text(a))

```

`recomp/nso.py`:

```py
# Adapted from LAS Recomp tools/nso.py @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
"""NSO loader: decompress segments, build the memory image, parse MOD0/dynamic info."""
import struct
import sys
from collections import Counter

import lz4.block

DT_NULL, DT_NEEDED, DT_PLTRELSZ, DT_HASH, DT_STRTAB, DT_SYMTAB, DT_RELA, DT_RELASZ = 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
DT_STRSZ, DT_JMPREL, DT_RELACOUNT = 10, 23, 0x6FFFFFF9
DT_RELRSZ, DT_RELR, DT_GNU_HASH = 0x23, 0x24, 0x6FFFFEF5
R_AARCH64_ABS64, R_AARCH64_GLOB_DAT, R_AARCH64_JUMP_SLOT, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE = 257, 1025, 1026, 1027


class Nso:
    def __init__(self, path):
        raw = open(path, 'rb').read()
        assert raw[:4] == b'NSO0', path
        flags = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0xC)[0]
        self.build_id = raw[0x40:0x60].rstrip(b'\0').hex()
        segs = []
        for i in range(3):
            file_off, mem_off, dec_size = struct.unpack_from('<III', raw, 0x10 + i * 0x10)
            comp_size = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0x60 + i * 4)[0]
            data = raw[file_off:file_off + comp_size]
            if flags & (1 << i):
                data = lz4.block.decompress(data, uncompressed_size=dec_size)
            segs.append((mem_off, data))
        self.bss_size = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 0x3C)[0]
        self.text = (segs[0][0], len(segs[0][1]))
        self.rodata = (segs[1][0], len(segs[1][1]))
        self.data = (segs[2][0], len(segs[2][1]))
        end = segs[2][0] + len(segs[2][1]) + self.bss_size
        self.size = (end + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFF
        img = bytearray(self.size)
        for off, d in segs:
            img[off:off + len(d)] = d
        self.image = img
        self._parse_mod0()

    def u32(self, off): return struct.unpack_from('<I', self.image, off)[0]
    def u64(self, off): return struct.unpack_from('<Q', self.image, off)[0]

    def _parse_mod0(self):
        mod0 = self.u32(4)
        assert self.image[mod0:mod0 + 4] == b'MOD0'
        rel = lambda i: mod0 + struct.unpack_from('<i', self.image, mod0 + 4 + i * 4)[0]
        self.dynamic, self.bss_start, self.bss_end = rel(0), rel(1), rel(2)
        self.eh_start, self.eh_end, self.module_obj = rel(3), rel(4), rel(5)
        dyn = {}
        needed = []
        off = self.dynamic
        while True:
            tag, val = self.u64(off), self.u64(off + 8)
            off += 16
            if tag == DT_NULL:
                break
            if tag == DT_NEEDED:
                needed.append(val)
            dyn.setdefault(tag, val)
        self.dyn = dyn
        strtab = dyn.get(DT_STRTAB, 0)
        self.strtab = strtab
        self.needed = [self.cstr(strtab + n) for n in needed]
        # dynsym count from DT_HASH nchain, or from DT_GNU_HASH (1.4.3 sdk and subsdk0 have no DT_HASH)
        self.syms = []
        nsyms = self.symbol_count()
        if nsyms and DT_SYMTAB in dyn:
            st = dyn[DT_SYMTAB]
            for i in range(nsyms):
                o = st + i * 24
                name, info, other, shndx = struct.unpack_from('<IBBH', self.image, o)
                value, size = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', self.image, o + 8)
                self.syms.append((self.cstr(strtab + name), info, shndx, value, size))
        self.relocs = []
        for base_tag, size_tag in ((DT_RELA, DT_RELASZ), (DT_JMPREL, DT_PLTRELSZ)):
            if base_tag in dyn:
                b, n = dyn[base_tag], dyn[size_tag] // 24
                for i in range(n):
                    r_off, r_info, r_add = struct.unpack_from('<QQq', self.image, b + i * 24)
                    self.relocs.append((r_off, r_info & 0xFFFFFFFF, r_info >> 32, r_add))
        # DT_RELR (1.4.3): packed RELATIVE relocations whose addend is the word in place. An even entry is an address
        # (relocate it, continue after it); an odd entry is a bitmap of the next 63 words.
        if DT_RELR in dyn:
            where = 0
            for i in range(dyn[DT_RELRSZ] // 8):
                e = self.u64(dyn[DT_RELR] + i * 8)
                if e & 1 == 0:
                    self.relocs.append((e, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE, 0, self.u64(e)))
                    where = e + 8
                    continue
                for k in range(63):
                    if e >> (k + 1) & 1:
                        a = where + k * 8
                        self.relocs.append((a, R_AARCH64_RELATIVE, 0, self.u64(a)))
                where += 63 * 8

    def symbol_count(self):
        """Number of .dynsym entries: DT_HASH nchain, else one past the last symbol a DT_GNU_HASH chain reaches."""
        dyn = self.dyn
        if DT_HASH in dyn:
            return self.u32(dyn[DT_HASH] + 4)
        if DT_GNU_HASH not in dyn:
            return 0
        h = dyn[DT_GNU_HASH]
        nbuckets, symoffset, bloom_size = self.u32(h), self.u32(h + 4), self.u32(h + 8)
        buckets = h + 16 + bloom_size * 8
        last = max([self.u32(buckets + 4 * i) for i in range(nbuckets)] + [0])
        if last < symoffset:
            return symoffset
        chains = buckets + 4 * nbuckets
        while not self.u32(chains + 4 * (last - symoffset)) & 1:
            last += 1
        return last + 1

    def cstr(self, off):
        end = self.image.index(b'\0', off)
        return self.image[off:end].decode('utf-8', 'replace')

    def imports(self):
        return [s for s in self.syms if s[0] and s[2] == 0]

    def exports(self):
        return [s for s in self.syms if s[0] and s[2] != 0]


if __name__ == '__main__':
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        n = Nso(p)
        print(f'== {p}  build {n.build_id[:16]}  image 0x{n.size:x}')
        print(f'  text 0x{n.text[0]:x}+0x{n.text[1]:x}  ro 0x{n.rodata[0]:x}+0x{n.rodata[1]:x}  '
              f'data 0x{n.data[0]:x}+0x{n.data[1]:x}  bss 0x{n.bss_size:x}')
        print(f'  needed {n.needed}  syms {len(n.syms)}  imports {len(n.imports())}  exports {len(n.exports())}')
        print(f'  relocs {dict(Counter(r[1] for r in n.relocs))}')

```

`recomp/patches-v143.txt`:

```txt
# Code patches for TotK 1.4.3 main (recomp/patches.py). Ported from MacNativeGames
# games/totk/runtime/game_patches_v143.c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors) at upstream 73c4821,
# each original word checked against the 1.4.3 main. MacNativeGames branches to veneers after the text; here a
# veneer's body is the site's replacement. The patch page holds three floats the runtime writes at every present
# (frame_rate.c): +0 the 30 Hz ratio (seconds * 30), +4 the frame step in seconds, +8 the step in 60 Hz ticks.

set fps60    TOTK_FPS60          1
set realtime TOTK_REALTIME       1
set cloth    TOTK_CLOTH_REALTIME 1
set bounce   TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX    1
set output   TOTK_PATCH_OUTPUT   0
set scene    TOTK_PATCH_SCENE    0

# 60 fps: the adaptive present-interval controller (main+0x2db174, 1.2.1 0x8f26c8) gets the minimum interval 1.
site fps60 main 2db204 6b08015f 7100055f   # clamp: cmp w10, #1 (was cmp w10, w8 = minimum)
site fps60 main 2db208 1a89b10a 1a9fa52a   # clamp: csinc w10, w9, wzr, ge (desired = max(desired, 1))
site fps60 main 2db22c b940468a d503201f   # lower trigger: nop the stored-candidate load
site fps60 main 2db360 6b0801bf 710005bf   # raise path: cmp w13, #1
site fps60 main 2db36c 1a88c1ac 1a9fc5ac   # raise path: csinc w12, w13, wzr, gt (next lower candidate floors at 1)
site fps60 main 2db340 b9400288 52800028   # lower path: mov w8, #1 (minimum interval 1)
site fps60 main 2db34c 2a0a03f5 1a9fa555   # lower path: csinc w21, w10, wzr, ge (result never below 1)

# Real-time step. The frame-step producer feeds both FrameRateMgr call sites with s8 = nominal interval * a 0.5/1.0
# coefficient (sys+0x1da bit 0, fcsel above the site); the nominal interval comes from the patch page, the coefficient
# and FrameRateMgr's own arithmetic stay. x8 is free: the ldxr after the site loads it. The global ratio after the
# controller call (1.2.1 0x8f2394) reads the ratio from the page instead of 60 / interval * 0.5.
site realtime main 3e5658 1e210808 @page:x8 bd400900 1e210808   # fmul s8, s0, s1: s0 = [page+8] first
site realtime main 2daa54 bd425260 @page:x9   # ldr s0, [x19, #0x250] -> adrp x9, page
site realtime main 2daa58 52a84e08 bd400120   # mov w8, #60.0 -> ldr s0, [x9] (global ratio)
site realtime main 2daa6c 5e21d800 d503201f   # scvtf s0, s0 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa70 1e201820 d503201f   # fdiv s0, s1, s0 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa74 1e2c1001 d503201f   # fmov s1, #0.5 -> nop
site realtime main 2daa78 1e210800 d503201f   # fmul s0, s0, s1 -> nop

# Hair and cloth: the actor animation update builds a second clock {seconds = factor / 30, ratio = factor} per
# rendered frame. 1.4.3 inlines it in two actor paths, where the factor was just stored to the ratio slot: the
# replacement stores measured ratio * factor there and computes measured seconds * factor. Two other callers share the
# out-of-line update (main+0x2a0e40), whose s2 (seconds) and s3 (ratio) are scaled by the measured ratio; its third
# caller already passes measured time and stays. x8 and s4 are free at all four sites.
site cloth main 246eac 1e200940 @page:x8 bd400100 1e200940 bd0367e0 bd400500 1e200940   # fmul s0, s10, s0
site cloth main 345904 1e210801 @page:x8 bd400101 1e210801 bd0117e1 bd400501 1e210801   # fmul s1, s0, s1
site cloth main 24944c 94015e7d @page:x8 bd400104 1e240842 1e240863 94015e7d   # bl 0x2a0e40
site cloth main 28bc98 9400546a @page:x8 bd400104 1e240842 1e240863 9400546a   # bl 0x2a0e40

# Trampolines: the contact code scales the bounce vector by 0.1 when time object +0x28 (30 / (ratio * time scale)) is
# over 100; compare +0x28 * +0x38 (30 / time scale) instead, the same value at 30 Hz and independent of the frame rate.
# s1 is set again by the fmov two instructions on.
site bounce main 562a64 bd402920 bd402920 bd403921 1e210800   # ldr s0, [x9, #0x28]; ldr s1, [x9, #0x38]; fmul s0, s0, s1

# Fades (MacNativeGames game_patches_v143.c patch_fade_increment, upstream 3e9e7f67): the distance/LOD mesh fades and
# the pre-actor fades add trunc(2.1 * ratio) to a counter each frame: 2 at 30 fps, 1 at 60, 0 above about 63.5 fps
# (ratio below 1 / 2.1), where a fade stops and its object stays translucent or invisible until a slower frame moves
# it on. Each site floors the increment at 1 without the flags: clz is 32 only for 0, so increment += clz >> 5. The
# scratch register is one the next instruction writes (w10 at 0x0a7ac4: ldrb w10; w11 at the pre-actor sites: add
# w11), or at 0x95dd24 a temporary the function no longer reads (add, strb, return).
set fade     TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX    1
site fade main 0a7ac4 1e380008 1e380008 5ac0110a 53057d4a 0b0a0108   # fcvtzs w8, s0; clz w10, w8; lsr w10, w10, #5; add w8, w8, w10
site fade main 95dd24 1e380008 1e380008 5ac0110a 53057d4a 0b0a0108   # the same, second mesh fade
site fade main 6155e4 1e38000a 1e38000a 5ac0114b 53057d6b 0b0b014a   # fcvtzs w10, s0; clz w11, w10; lsr w11, w11, #5; add w10, w10, w11
site fade main 615660 1e38000a 1e38000a 5ac0114b 53057d6b 0b0b014a   # the same, second pre-actor fade path

# Output size (upstream game_patches_v143.c patch_output_res; runtime/resolution.c switches the set on). The swapchain
# size nnMain writes comes from page +48; the display configuration's canvas (+0x10) and active output (+0x508) from
# page +32, and the configuration goes to page +40. x9 is dead at the publication point.
site output main bdb578 d280f008 @page:x8   # mov x8, #0x780 -> adrp x8, page (x9 is built in between)
site output main bdb584 f2c08708 f9401908   # movk x8, #0x438, lsl #32 -> ldr x8, [x8, #48]
site output main 3dcb28 d360fc64 @page:x9 f9001533 f9401123 f9000a63 d360fc64   # lsr x4, x3, #32: x3 = [page+32] first

# Scene render size (upstream patch_render_res): every path that picks the size meets at main+0x585e48; the renderer's
# +0xcc4 / +0xcc8 take two floats from page +16. x3 is scratch in this function; w9 still holds the output size.
site scene main 585e48 1e220160 @page:x3    # scvtf s0, w11 -> adrp x3, page
site scene main 585e50 bd0cc660 2d420460    # str s0, [x19, #0xcc4] -> ldp s0, s1, [x3, #16]
site scene main 585e54 1e220140 bd0cc660    # scvtf s0, w10 -> str s0, [x19, #0xcc4]
site scene main 585e60 bd0cca60 bd0cca61    # str s0, [x19, #0xcc8] -> str s1, [x19, #0xcc8]

# Camera aspect ratio for a game resolution that is not 16:9 (upstream game_patches_v143.c and aspect_patch.h
# aspect_install / aspect_stub; runtime/resolution.c res_init writes the output's width / height to page +56 and
# switches the set on). Each site leaves the ratio sead's perspective projection (+0xb0) takes in s0: two camera sites
# (update and setup) load the camera's copy of DefaultAspect 1.777778, two viewport routines divide width by height.
# The replacement loads the ratio from the page instead, so a 21:9 output shows more of the world at the sides with
# the vertical view kept (Hor+). x10 is kept on the stack, so no register liveness is assumed.
set aspect   TOTK_ASPECT_PATCH   0

# The game's zstd decoder (BSD zstd, statically linked into main) through the host's libzstd (runtime/ov_zstd.c):
# every call of ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame (main+0x3a1f0: dctx, dst, capacity, src, size, dict, dict size, ddict) and of
# its wrapper ZSTD_decompress_usingDDict (main+0x3a1e0, which tail-branches to it) goes to a host function on the patch
# page (+0xff0 and +0xfe0). The lifted decoder runs its copy loops as chains of small functions; the host decodes the
# same frames several times faster and gives the virtual core up for large inputs. Not main+0x547a04: that caller
# (main+0x547964) resets a static DCtx of its own with which the game's zstd rejects some valid frames
# (corruption_detected on a 473 KB frame the host decodes), and the game relies on that result.
set zstd     TOTK_ZSTD_NATIVE    1
```
