```c
    int away = kern_core_away();
    const uint8_t *id = r->final ? r->key : r->code_hash;
    flight_enter(id);
    const GfxShader *s = translate_one(r, stage, control, code, a);
    flight_leave(id);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    return s;
}

// ---- background translation (gfx_shader_get_async)
// svc_runtime_limit() workers, one per translator child. A job owns copies of the control section and the code, so the
// guest may free or rewrite its program while the job waits. A key stays in X.waits while its job is queued or running,
// and for good when the translation failed, so a failing shader is not sent again on every draw.
typedef struct XJob {
    struct XJob *next;
    int stage;
    Req r;                                                 // r.c1 points into code
    uint8_t *control, *code;
    GfxShaderAnswers a;
} XJob;

typedef struct XWait {
    struct XWait *next;
    uint8_t key[32];
    int failed;
} XWait;

static struct {
    SRWLOCK lock;
    CONDITION_VARIABLE work, done;                         // done: a job finished (gfx_shader_await)
    XJob *head, *tail;
    XWait *waits[256];
    int started;                                           // 1 running, -1 no thread could be created
} X = {SRWLOCK_INIT, CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT, CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT};

static volatile LONG64 n_async;

// Caller holds X.lock.
static XWait **wait_slot(const uint8_t key[32]) {
    XWait **w = &X.waits[key[0]];
    while (*w && memcmp((*w)->key, key, 32)) w = &(*w)->next;
    return w;
}

static DWORD WINAPI xlate_worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    for (;;) {
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
        while (!X.head) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&X.work, &X.lock, INFINITE, 0);
        XJob *j = X.head;
        if (!(X.head = j->next)) X.tail = NULL;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
        const GfxShader *s = translate(&j->r, j->stage, j->control, j->code, &j->a);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
        XWait **w = wait_slot(j->r.key), *e = *w;
        if (e && s) *w = e->next, free(e);
        else if (e) e->failed = 1;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&X.done);
        if (s) InterlockedIncrement64(&n_async);
        free(j->control), free(j->code), free(j);
    }
    return 0;
}
const GfxShader *gfx_shader_get_async(int stage, const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size,
                                      const GfxShaderAnswers *a, int *pending) {
    *pending = 0;
    Req r;
    if (!req_init(&r, stage, control, code, code_size, NULL, a)) return NULL;
    const GfxShader *s = get_async_one(r, stage, control, code, a, pending);
    if (s) ans_note(&r, stage, control, code, a, s);
    return s;
}

static const GfxShader *get_async_one(Req r, int stage, const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code,
                                      const GfxShaderAnswers *a, int *pending) {
    GfxShader *s = mem_find(r.key);
    if (s) return InterlockedIncrement64(&n_hits), s;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&X.lock);
    XWait *w = *wait_slot(r.key);
    int failed = w && w->failed;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&X.lock);
    if (w) return *pending = !failed, NULL;
    paths();
    if (!cache_dir[0]) return fail("no cache directory", NULL);
    if (r.final && (s = disk_load(r.key, r.iid))) return InterlockedIncrement64(&n_hits), mem_insert(s);

    XJob *j = calloc(1, sizeof *j);
    XWait *e = calloc(1, sizeof *e);
    uint8_t *ctl = malloc(CONTROL_SIZE), *cd = malloc(r.length);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
    if (!X.started) {
        int n = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < svc_runtime_limit(); i++) {
            HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 0, xlate_worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
            if (t) CloseHandle(t), n++;
        }
        X.started = n ? 1 : -1;
        if (n) rt_log("gfx_shader: graphics shaders are translated by %d background workers (TOTK_XLATE_PROCS)", n);
        else rt_log("gfx_shader: cannot start the translation workers; translating synchronously");
    }
    XWait **slot = wait_slot(r.key);
    int raced = *slot != NULL;                             // another thread queued it between the checks
    int queued = !raced && X.started == 1 && j && e && ctl && cd;
    if (queued) {
        memcpy(ctl, control, CONTROL_SIZE), memcpy(cd, code, r.length);
        *j = (XJob){.stage = stage, .r = r, .control = ctl, .code = cd, .a = *a};
        j->r.c1 = cd + (r.length - r.c1_len);
        memcpy(e->key, r.key, 32);
        *slot = e;
        if (X.tail) X.tail->next = j;
        else X.head = j;
        X.tail = j;
        WakeConditionVariable(&X.work);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
    if (queued) return *pending = 1, NULL;
    free(j), free(e), free(ctl), free(cd);
    if (raced) return *pending = 1, NULL;
    return translate(&r, stage, control, code, a);         // no worker or out of memory
}

const GfxShader *gfx_shader_await(int stage, const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code, uint64_t code_size,
                                  const GfxShaderAnswers *a) {
    int pending;
    const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get_async(stage, control, code, code_size, a, &pending);
    Req r;
    if (!pending || !req_init(&r, stage, control, code, code_size, NULL, a)) return s;
    uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();   // the wait counts as the render thread's translation time
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
    for (XJob *j = X.head, *prev = NULL; j; prev = j, j = j->next)
        if (!memcmp(j->r.key, r.key, 32)) {                // queued: to the front, the worker takes it next
            if (prev) {
                prev->next = j->next;
                if (X.tail == j) X.tail = prev;
                j->next = X.head, X.head = j;
            }
            break;
        }
    XWait *w;
    while ((w = *wait_slot(r.key)) && !w->failed) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&X.done, &X.lock, INFINITE, 0);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&X.lock);
    perf_end(PERF_XLATE, p0);
    if (w) return NULL;                                    // failed: logged by the worker
    s = gfx_shader_get_async(stage, control, code, code_size, a, &pending);
    return pending ? NULL : s;
}

uint64_t gfx_shader_async_done(void) { return (uint64_t)n_async; }

void gfx_shader_counts(uint64_t *keys, uint64_t *translated) { *keys = (uint64_t)n_keys, *translated = (uint64_t)n_xlated; }

const uint8_t *gfx_shader_key(const GfxShader *s) { return s->key; }

const uint8_t *gfx_shader_input_id(const GfxShader *s) { return s->iid; }

// By input id: memory, then the disk cache under the current translator, then (xlate 1) a translation from the stored
// inputs. NULL when none has it; a failed translation is counted as a failure.
const GfxShader *gfx_shader_load_input(const uint8_t iid[32], int xlate) {
    paths();
    if (!cache_dir[0]) return NULL;
    uint8_t key[32];
    key_of_input(iid, key);
    GfxShader *s = mem_find(key);
    if (s) return s;
    if ((s = disk_load(key, iid))) return mem_insert(s);
    Inputs in;
    if (!xlate || !in_load(iid, &in)) return NULL;
    const GfxShader *t = gfx_shader_get(in.stage, in.control, in.code, in.length, in.c1, &in.a);
    free(in.buf);
    return t;
}

// From the disk cache only, as a shader the caller owns and releases with gfx_shader_release_private (the boot library
// prebuild warms the driver's pipeline cache with it without keeping 40 KB per shader in memory). When the memory
// cache has it, that entry is returned with *owned 0 and must not be released. NULL when not cached.
const GfxShader *gfx_shader_load_private(const uint8_t iid[32], int *owned) {
    *owned = 0;
    paths();
    if (!cache_dir[0]) return NULL;
    uint8_t key[32];
    key_of_input(iid, key);
    GfxShader *s = mem_find(key);
    if (s) return s;
    if ((s = disk_load(key, iid))) *owned = 1;
    return s;
}

void gfx_shader_release_private(const GfxShader *s) {
    if (s) shader_free((GfxShader *)s);
}

// ---- boot prewarm (gfx_shader_prewarm)

typedef struct {
    const uint8_t (*named)[32];                            // loaded into memory, results in out
    size_t n_named;
    const GfxShader **out;
    uint8_t (*other)[32];                                  // other stored inputs: translated when not cached, not loaded
    size_t n_other;
    volatile LONG64 next, done;
    volatile LONG missing, other_cached;
} Warm;

static DWORD WINAPI warm_worker(void *arg) {
    Warm *w = arg;
    for (;;) {
        size_t i = (size_t)InterlockedIncrement64(&w->next) - 1;
        if (i >= w->n_named + w->n_other) return 0;
        if (i < w->n_named) {
            if (!(w->out[i] = gfx_shader_load_input(w->named[i], 1))) InterlockedIncrement(&w->missing);
        } else {
            const uint8_t *iid = w->other[i - w->n_named];
            uint8_t key[32];
            char hex[65], p[PATH_CAP + 80];
            key_of_input(iid, key);
            key_hex(key, hex);
            snprintf(p, PATH_CAP + 80, "%s\\%s.spv", cache_dir, hex);
            if (pack_find(PACK_SPV, key) || file_exists(p)) InterlockedIncrement(&w->other_cached);
            else gfx_shader_load_input(iid, 1);
        }
        InterlockedIncrement64(&w->done);
    }
}

static int iid_cmp(const void *x, const void *y) { return memcmp(x, y, 32); }

typedef struct {
    const uint8_t (*named)[32];
    size_t n_named, n, cap;
    uint8_t (*v)[32];
} InList;

static int in_collect(const char *file, void *ctx) {
    InList *l = ctx;
    char name[80];
    uint8_t iid[32];
    if (strlen(file) != 67) return 1;                      // 64 hex digits + ".in"
    memcpy(name, file, 64);
    name[64] = 0;
    if (!hex32(name, iid) || (l->n_named && bsearch(iid, l->named, l->n_named, 32, iid_cmp))) return 1;
    if (l->n == l->cap) {
        size_t c = l->cap ? l->cap * 2 : 1024;
        uint8_t (*t)[32] = realloc(l->v, c * 32);
        if (!t) return 0;
        l->v = t, l->cap = c;
    }
    memcpy(l->v[l->n++], iid, 32);
    return 1;
}

// The stored inputs not in named (sorted): ids parsed from the in/ file names.
static size_t other_inputs(const uint8_t (*named)[32], size_t n_named, uint8_t (**out)[32]) {
    char dir[PATH_CAP + 80];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s\\in", cache_dir);
    InList l = {.named = named, .n_named = n_named};
    char name[68];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pack_n; i++) {   // the packed inputs, under the name their loose file would have
        if (pack_ix[i].kind != PACK_IN) continue;
        key_hex(pack_ix[i].name, name);
        memcpy(name + 64, ".in", 4);
        if (!in_collect(name, &l)) break;
    }
    plat_file_list(dir, ".in", in_collect, &l);   // in_store writes no loose file for a packed input: no duplicates
    return *out = l.v, l.n;
}

void gfx_shader_prewarm(const uint8_t (*iids)[32], size_t n, const GfxShader **out, int threads, int procs) {
    paths();
    double t0 = (double)GetTickCount64();
    memset(out, 0, n * sizeof *out);
    if (!cache_dir[0]) return;
    uint64_t xl0 = (uint64_t)n_xlated, fail0 = (uint64_t)n_failures;
    uint8_t (*sorted)[32] = n ? malloc(n * 32) : NULL;
    if (sorted) memcpy(sorted, iids, n * 32), qsort(sorted, n, 32, iid_cmp);
    Warm w = {.named = iids, .n_named = n, .out = out};
    w.n_other = other_inputs(sorted, sorted ? n : 0, &w.other);
    free(sorted);
    size_t total = w.n_named + w.n_other;
    threads = threads < 1 ? 1 : threads > 64 ? 64 : threads;
    if ((size_t)threads > total) threads = (int)(total ? total : 1);
    svc_set_limit(procs);
    HANDLE t[64];
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < threads; i++)
        if ((t[k] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, warm_worker, &w, 0, NULL))) k++;
    if (!k) warm_worker(&w);
    for (int m = 0; k && m < k; m += MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS) {
        int c = k - m < MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS ? k - m : MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS;
        while (WaitForMultipleObjects((DWORD)c, t + m, TRUE, 2000) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)
            rt_log("gfx_shader: prewarm: %lld of %zu shaders, %llu translated, %.0f ms", (long long)w.done, total,
                   (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_xlated - xl0), (double)GetTickCount64() - t0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) CloseHandle(t[i]);
    svc_set_limit(svc_runtime_limit());
    rt_log("gfx_shader: prewarm: %zu shaders named by pipeline keys (%ld not available), %zu other stored inputs (%ld "
           "cached); %llu translated, %llu failed, with up to %d translators and %d threads, in %.0f ms", w.n_named,
           (long)w.missing, w.n_other, (long)w.other_cached, (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_xlated - xl0),
           (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_failures - fail0), procs, k, (double)GetTickCount64() - t0);
    free(w.other);
}
const uint32_t *gfx_shader_spirv(const GfxShader *s, uint64_t *words) {
    if (words) *words = s->words;
    return s->spirv;
}

int gfx_shader_stage(const GfxShader *s) { return s->stage; }

int gfx_shader_resources(const GfxShader *s, int kind, const GfxShaderRes **res) {
    if (kind < 0 || kind >= GFX_RES_KINDS) return 0;
    if (res) *res = s->res[kind];
    return s->nres[kind];
}

// The slots of the use mask: answers outside it select the same translation (mask_answers), so a caller may leave
// their texture and image types zero. Parses the reflection: callers keep the result.
uint32_t gfx_shader_slot_mask(const GfxShader *s) { return use_of(s).slots; }

uint32_t gfx_shader_inputs(const GfxShader *s, GfxShaderIo io[32]) {
    if (io) memcpy(io, s->in, sizeof s->in);
    return s->in_mask;
}

uint32_t gfx_shader_outputs(const GfxShader *s, GfxShaderIo io[32]) {
    if (io) memcpy(io, s->out, sizeof s->out);
    return s->out_mask;
}

void gfx_shader_local_size(const GfxShader *s, uint32_t local[3]) { memcpy(local, s->local, sizeof s->local); }

// ---- answers met in play
// The translated-shader key includes the answers a draw's state implies, so a translation made without play (the
// census) does not match the keys play asks for. Every (program, answers) that a gfx_shader_get* call resolves is
// recorded next to pipeline-keys.bin, so the first-start preparation (Task 2.6, here the TOTK_TEST_PREPARE_SHADERS hook)
// translates exactly the variants play needs, from these files alone:
//   shader-answers.bin  "TOTKSANS", version, record size; records: stage (u32), code hash, input id, pack_answers bytes
//                       of the full answers, zero padding. One record per input id: answers outside the shader's use
//                       mask do not change its SPIR-V, are out of its input id and cache key (mask_answers) and so do
//                       not make records of their own (a fight run meets 4126 full pairs, 1238 input ids). The full
//                       answers are kept so a translator with a wider mask still gets them. Under a new translator
//                       the masks, hence the input ids, are new, and play appends records for them.
//   shader-programs.bin "TOTKSPRG", version, 0; records: stage, length, c1 length (u32 each), code hash, control section,
//                       code[length], c1. One per code hash; written before the answers that name it. Game content:
//                       it stays in the ignored pipeline cache directory.
// A file with another header is rewritten; a torn tail (killed process) is cut off at open.
#define ANS_VERSION 1
#define ANS_PACKED 147                                     // pack_answers' size
#define ANS_REC (4 + 32 + 32 + ANS_PACKED + 1)
#define PRG_VERSION 1
#define PRG_HEAD (12 + 32 + CONTROL_SIZE)
typedef struct { char magic[8]; uint32_t version, rec_size; } RecHeader;
typedef struct { uint64_t *v; uint32_t cap, n; } Set64;    // open addressing, 0 empty
typedef struct { uint8_t *p; size_t n, cap; } Bytes;

static struct {
    SRWLOCK lock;
    volatile LONG on;
    char ans_path[PATH_CAP], prg_path[PATH_CAP];
    Set64 pairs, progs;                                    // input ids, code hashes seen (in the files or this run)
    Bytes ans, prg;                                        // pending
    uint64_t pairs_new;                                    // added this run
} RC = {SRWLOCK_INIT};

static int set_add(Set64 *s, uint64_t h) {                 // 1 if new
    h = h ? h : 1;
    if ((s->n + 1) * 2 > s->cap) {
        uint32_t cap = s->cap ? s->cap * 2 : 4096;
        uint64_t *t = calloc(cap, sizeof *t);
        if (!t) return 0;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < s->cap; i++)
            if (s->v[i]) {
                uint32_t j = (uint32_t)s->v[i] & (cap - 1);
                while (t[j]) j = (j + 1) & (cap - 1);
                t[j] = s->v[i];
            }
        free(s->v), s->v = t, s->cap = cap;
    }
    uint32_t j = (uint32_t)h & (s->cap - 1);
    for (; s->v[j]; j = (j + 1) & (s->cap - 1))
        if (s->v[j] == h) return 0;
    s->v[j] = h, s->n++;
    return 1;
}

static int bytes_put(Bytes *b, const void *p, size_t n) {
    if (!n) return 1;
    if (b->n + n > b->cap) {
        size_t cap = b->cap ? b->cap * 2 : 65536;
        while (cap < b->n + n) cap *= 2;
        uint8_t *t = realloc(b->p, cap);
        if (!t) return 0;
        b->p = t, b->cap = cap;
    }
    memcpy(b->p + b->n, p, n), b->n += n;
    return 1;
}

static uint64_t hash8(const uint8_t *sha) {
    uint64_t v;
    memcpy(&v, sha, 8);
    return v;
}

static void unpack_answers(const uint8_t *p, GfxShaderAnswers *a) {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof *a);
    memcpy(a->tex_type, p, 32), p += 32;
    memcpy(a->img_type, p, 32), p += 32;
    memcpy(a->img_format, p, 32), p += 32;
    memcpy(a->attr_type, p, 32), p += 32;
    memcpy(a->frag_out_type, p, 8), p += 8;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) a->local[i] = (uint16_t)(p[0] | p[1] << 8), p += 2;
    memcpy(&a->shared_bytes, p, 4), p += 4;
    a->depth_minus_w = *p;
}

// Reads a record file's body (after its header) into *body; 0 when absent, and a file with another header is removed.
static int rec_read(const char *path, const char *magic, uint32_t version, uint32_t rec_size, uint8_t **body, size_t *n) {
    *body = NULL, *n = 0;
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return 0;
    RecHeader h;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long len = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    int ok = len >= (long)sizeof h && fread(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) == 1 && !memcmp(h.magic, magic, 8) &&
             h.version == version && h.rec_size == rec_size;
    if (ok && len > (long)sizeof h) {
        *n = (size_t)len - sizeof h;
        ok = (*body = malloc(*n)) && fread(*body, 1, *n, f) == *n;
    }
    fclose(f);
    if (!ok) {
        free(*body), *body = NULL, *n = 0;
        if (len > 0) rt_log("gfx_shader: %s has another format or version; it is rewritten", path), remove(path);
    }
    return ok;
}

// Walks shader-programs.bin records; returns the byte length of the whole records. fn may be NULL.
static size_t prg_walk(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, void (*fn)(const uint8_t *rec, void *ctx), void *ctx) {
    size_t o = 0;
    while (n - o >= PRG_HEAD) {
        uint32_t len, c1;
        memcpy(&len, b + o + 4, 4), memcpy(&c1, b + o + 8, 4);
        size_t size = PRG_HEAD + (size_t)len + c1;
        if (len > (64u << 20) || c1 > len || size > n - o) break;
        if (fn) fn(b + o, ctx);
        o += size;
    }
    return o;
}

static void prg_seen(const uint8_t *rec, void *ctx) { set_add(ctx, hash8(rec + 12)); }

static void truncate_to(const char *path, size_t size) {
    if (!plat_file_truncate(path, size)) return;
    rt_log("gfx_shader: %s had a torn tail; cut to %zu bytes", path, size);
}

void gfx_shader_record_at(const char *keys_path) {
    if (!keys_path || !keys_path[0] || RC.on) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
    const char *slash = strrchr(keys_path, '\\'), *fs = strrchr(keys_path, '/');
    if (fs > slash) slash = fs;
    int dir = slash ? (int)(slash + 1 - keys_path) : 0;
    snprintf(RC.ans_path, sizeof RC.ans_path, "%.*sshader-answers.bin", dir, keys_path);
    snprintf(RC.prg_path, sizeof RC.prg_path, "%.*sshader-programs.bin", dir, keys_path);
    uint8_t *b;
    size_t n;
    if (rec_read(RC.ans_path, "TOTKSANS", ANS_VERSION, ANS_REC, &b, &n)) {
        for (size_t o = 0; o + ANS_REC <= n; o += ANS_REC) set_add(&RC.pairs, hash8(b + o + 36));
        if (n % ANS_REC) truncate_to(RC.ans_path, sizeof(RecHeader) + n / ANS_REC * ANS_REC);
    }
    free(b);
    if (rec_read(RC.prg_path, "TOTKSPRG", PRG_VERSION, 0, &b, &n)) {
        size_t whole = prg_walk(b, n, prg_seen, &RC.progs);
        if (whole != n) truncate_to(RC.prg_path, sizeof(RecHeader) + whole);
    }
    free(b);
    rt_log("gfx_shader: recording answers met in play to %s (%u records, %u programs recorded before)", RC.ans_path,
           RC.pairs.n, RC.progs.n);
    InterlockedExchange(&RC.on, 1);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
}

// A get resolved (r, a) to s: queue the record when its input id is new, and its program when new. Cost: a set
// lookup under a lock per call; gets happen per (program, answers) change in vk_exec_draw's shader table, not per draw.
static void ans_note(const Req *r, int stage, const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code, const GfxShaderAnswers *a,
                     const GfxShader *s) {
    if (!RC.on) return;
    uint32_t st = (uint32_t)stage;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
    if (set_add(&RC.pairs, hash8(s->iid))) {
        uint8_t rec[ANS_REC] = {0};
        memcpy(rec, &st, 4), memcpy(rec + 4, r->code_hash, 32), memcpy(rec + 36, s->iid, 32);
        pack_answers(rec + 68, a);
        if (set_add(&RC.progs, hash8(r->code_hash))) {
            uint32_t head[3] = {st, r->length, r->c1_len};
            bytes_put(&RC.prg, head, 12), bytes_put(&RC.prg, r->code_hash, 32);
            bytes_put(&RC.prg, control, CONTROL_SIZE), bytes_put(&RC.prg, code, r->length);
            bytes_put(&RC.prg, r->c1, r->c1_len);
        }
        bytes_put(&RC.ans, rec, sizeof rec);
        RC.pairs_new++;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
}

static int rec_append(const char *path, const char *magic, uint32_t version, uint32_t rec_size, const Bytes *b) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "ab");
    if (!f) return 0;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    int ok = 1;
    if (ftell(f) == 0) {
        RecHeader h = {{0}, version, rec_size};
        memcpy(h.magic, magic, 8);
        ok = fwrite(&h, sizeof h, 1, f) == 1;
    }
    ok = ok && fwrite(b->p, 1, b->n, f) == b->n;
    return !fclose(f) && ok;
}

static SRWLOCK rec_io = SRWLOCK_INIT;   // the record files: appends in order, no read during an append

void gfx_shader_record_flush(int force) {
    static volatile LONG64 last;
    LONG64 now = (LONG64)GetTickCount64();
    if (!RC.on || (!force && now - last < 2000)) return;
    last = now;
    // The files are written outside RC.lock, which the render thread takes to record a new answer.
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rec_io);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
    Bytes ans = RC.ans, prg = RC.prg;
    RC.ans = (Bytes){0}, RC.prg = (Bytes){0};
    uint64_t total = RC.pairs.n, added = RC.pairs_new;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&RC.lock);
    if (prg.n && !rec_append(RC.prg_path, "TOTKSPRG", PRG_VERSION, 0, &prg)) rt_log("gfx_shader: cannot write %s", RC.prg_path);
    if (ans.n && !rec_append(RC.ans_path, "TOTKSANS", ANS_VERSION, ANS_REC, &ans)) rt_log("gfx_shader: cannot write %s", RC.ans_path);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rec_io);
    if (ans.n) rt_log("gfx_shader: answers: %zu new records appended (%llu new this run, %llu recorded)", ans.n / ANS_REC,
                      (unsigned long long)added, (unsigned long long)total);
    free(ans.p), free(prg.p);
}

// ---- preparation from record files: the answers met in play (TOTK_TEST_PREPARE_SHADERS=1) or the seed that
// tools/prepare_shaders.py writes from the MacNativeGames shader list (totk.exe --prepare-shaders). Both use the record
// layouts above; a seed record has a zero input id (the use mask, hence the id, is the translator's to find) and its
// pad byte holds the list priority (0 title, 1 warm-up, 2 rest).
typedef struct { const uint8_t *rec; } PrgIdx;
typedef struct { PrgIdx *idx; size_t n; } PrgList;
typedef struct {
    PrgList progs;
    const uint8_t *ans;
    size_t n_ans;
    uint8_t (*iid)[32];                                    // per answers record: the resolved input id, zero on failure
    volatile LONG64 next, done, missing, failed;
} Prep;

static int prg_cmp(const void *x, const void *y) { return memcmp(((const PrgIdx *)x)->rec + 12, ((const PrgIdx *)y)->rec + 12, 32); }

static void prg_collect(const uint8_t *rec, void *ctx) {
    PrgList *l = ctx;
    l->idx[l->n++].rec = rec;
}

static DWORD WINAPI prep_worker(void *arg) {
    Prep *p = arg;
    for (;;) {
        size_t i = (size_t)InterlockedIncrement64(&p->next) - 1;
        if (i >= p->n_ans) return 0;
        const uint8_t *r = p->ans + i * ANS_REC;
        uint8_t key_rec[12 + 32];
        memcpy(key_rec + 12, r + 4, 32);
        PrgIdx k = {key_rec}, *e = bsearch(&k, p->progs.idx, p->progs.n, sizeof k, prg_cmp);
        if (!e) {
            InterlockedIncrement64(&p->missing), InterlockedIncrement64(&p->done);
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t st, len;
        memcpy(&st, e->rec, 4), memcpy(&len, e->rec + 4, 4);
        const uint8_t *control = e->rec + 44, *code = control + CONTROL_SIZE, *c1 = code + len;
        GfxShaderAnswers a;
        unpack_answers(r + 68, &a);
        const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get((int)st, control, code, len, c1, &a);
        if (!s) InterlockedIncrement64(&p->failed);
        else if (p->iid) memcpy(p->iid[i], s->iid, 32);
        InterlockedIncrement64(&p->done);
    }
}

// Translates every record of ans_path whose program is in prg_path on `threads` threads with up to `procs` translators.
// *ans_out, *iid_out (optional; free them): the answers records and the input id each resolved to (zero: failed).
// Returns the record count, -1 without the files.
static long long prepare_files(const char *ans_path, const char *prg_path, int threads, int procs, const char *what,
                               uint8_t **ans_out, uint8_t (**iid_out)[32]) {
    paths();
    double t0 = (double)GetTickCount64();
    uint8_t *ab = NULL, *pb = NULL;
    size_t an = 0, pn = 0;
    if (!rec_read(ans_path, "TOTKSANS", ANS_VERSION, ANS_REC, &ab, &an) ||
        !rec_read(prg_path, "TOTKSPRG", PRG_VERSION, 0, &pb, &pn)) {
        rt_log("gfx_shader: prepare: no %s (%s)", what, ans_path);
        free(ab), free(pb);
        return -1;
    }
    Prep p = {.progs = {calloc(pn / PRG_HEAD + 1, sizeof(PrgIdx)), 0}, .ans = ab, .n_ans = an / ANS_REC};
    if (iid_out) p.iid = calloc(p.n_ans + 1, 32);
    if (!p.progs.idx || (iid_out && !p.iid)) return free(p.progs.idx), free(p.iid), free(ab), free(pb), -1;
    prg_walk(pb, pn, prg_collect, &p.progs);
    qsort(p.progs.idx, p.progs.n, sizeof *p.progs.idx, prg_cmp);
    uint64_t xl0 = (uint64_t)n_xlated;
    threads = threads < 1 ? 1 : threads > 64 ? 64 : threads;
    svc_set_limit(procs);
    HANDLE t[64];
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < threads; i++)
        if ((t[k] = CreateThread(NULL, 0, prep_worker, &p, 0, NULL))) k++;
    if (!k) prep_worker(&p);
    for (int m = 0; k && m < k; m += MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS) {
        int c = k - m < MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS ? k - m : MAXIMUM_WAIT_OBJECTS;
        while (WaitForMultipleObjects((DWORD)c, t + m, TRUE, 5000) == WAIT_TIMEOUT)
            rt_log("gfx_shader: prepare: %lld of %zu pairs, %llu translated, %.0f ms", (long long)p.done, p.n_ans,
                   (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_xlated - xl0), (double)GetTickCount64() - t0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) CloseHandle(t[i]);
    svc_set_limit(svc_runtime_limit());
    rt_log("gfx_shader: prepare: %zu %s of %zu programs: %llu translated, %lld failed, %lld without a program, the rest "
           "cached; %.0f ms", p.n_ans, what, p.progs.n, (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_xlated - xl0), (long long)p.failed,
           (long long)p.missing, (double)GetTickCount64() - t0);
    free(p.progs.idx), free(pb);
    if (ans_out) *ans_out = ab;
    else free(ab);
    if (iid_out) *iid_out = p.iid;
    return (long long)p.n_ans;
}

void gfx_shader_prepare_recorded(int threads, int procs) {
    if (!RC.on) {
        rt_log("gfx_shader: prepare: no recorded answers (not recording)");
        return;
    }
    prepare_files(RC.ans_path, RC.prg_path, threads, procs, "recorded pairs", NULL, NULL);
}

// ---- prepared variants (shader-prepared.bin next to pipeline-keys.bin)
// "TOTKSPRP", version, record size; records: stage, priority, 2 zero bytes, input id. gfx_shader_prepare_seed writes
// them in priority order, one per input id; gfx_shader_warm_list reads them at boot.
#define PRP_VERSION 1
#define PRP_REC 36

int gfx_shader_prepare_seed(const char *dir, int threads, int procs) {
    char ans[PATH_CAP + 32], prg[PATH_CAP + 32], out[PATH_CAP + 32];
    snprintf(ans, sizeof ans, "%s\\seed-answers.bin", dir);
    snprintf(prg, sizeof prg, "%s\\seed-programs.bin", dir);
    snprintf(out, sizeof out, "%s\\shader-prepared.bin", dir);
    double t0 = (double)GetTickCount64();
    uint64_t fail0 = (uint64_t)n_failures;
    uint8_t *ab = NULL, (*iid)[32] = NULL;
    long long n = prepare_files(ans, prg, threads, procs, "seed variants", &ab, &iid);
    if (n < 0) return 1;
    uint8_t *recs = calloc((size_t)n + 1, PRP_REC);
    static const uint8_t zero[32];
    size_t u = 0, by[3] = {0}, stages[6] = {0};
    Set64 seen = {0};
    for (long long i = 0; recs && i < n; i++) {           // seed records come in priority order: the first id wins
        if (!memcmp(iid[i], zero, 32) || !set_add(&seen, hash8(iid[i]))) continue;
        uint8_t *r = recs + u * PRP_REC;
        const uint8_t *a = ab + (size_t)i * ANS_REC;
        r[0] = a[0] < 6 ? a[0] : 0, r[1] = a[ANS_REC - 1] > 2 ? 2 : a[ANS_REC - 1];
        memcpy(r + 4, iid[i], 32);
        by[r[1]]++, stages[r[0]]++, u++;
    }
    free(seen.v);
    RecHeader h = {{'T', 'O', 'T', 'K', 'S', 'P', 'R', 'P'}, PRP_VERSION, PRP_REC};
    uint8_t *file = recs ? malloc(sizeof h + u * PRP_REC + 1) : NULL;
    int ok = file != NULL;
    if (ok) {
        memcpy(file, &h, sizeof h), memcpy(file + sizeof h, recs, u * PRP_REC);
        ok = plat_file_write_atomic(out, file, sizeof h + u * PRP_REC);
    }
    char msg[640];
    snprintf(msg, sizeof msg, "gfx_shader: prepared %zu shader variants (vertex %zu, fragment %zu, compute %zu; title %zu, "
             "warm-up %zu, other %zu) from %lld seed records, %llu translations failed, in %.0f ms; %s %s", u,
             stages[GFX_STAGE_VS], stages[GFX_STAGE_FS], stages[GFX_STAGE_CS], by[0], by[1], by[2], n,
             (unsigned long long)((uint64_t)n_failures - fail0), (double)GetTickCount64() - t0,
             ok ? "wrote" : "cannot write", out);
    rt_log("%s", msg);
    printf("%s\n", msg);
    free(file), free(recs), free(iid), free(ab);
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

// The variants the boot prebuild warms, most likely first: every input id play recorded (shader-answers.bin, priority
// 0), then the prepared ones (shader-prepared.bin, priority 1 + their list priority). One entry per input id.
size_t gfx_shader_warm_list(GfxWarmEnt **out) {
    *out = NULL;
    if (!RC.on) return 0;
    char prp[PATH_CAP + 32];
    snprintf(prp, sizeof prp, "%.*sshader-prepared.bin", (int)(strlen(RC.ans_path) - strlen("shader-answers.bin")),
             RC.ans_path);
    uint8_t *ab = NULL, *pb = NULL;
    size_t an = 0, pn = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rec_io);                      // no append meanwhile
    rec_read(RC.ans_path, "TOTKSANS", ANS_VERSION, ANS_REC, &ab, &an);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rec_io);
    rec_read(prp, "TOTKSPRP", PRP_VERSION, PRP_REC, &pb, &pn);
    size_t na = an / ANS_REC, np = pn / PRP_REC, n = 0;
    GfxWarmEnt *e = calloc(na + np + 1, sizeof *e);
    Set64 seen = {0};
    for (size_t i = 0; e && i < na; i++) {
        const uint8_t *r = ab + i * ANS_REC;
        if (!set_add(&seen, hash8(r + 36))) continue;
        memcpy(e[n].iid, r + 36, 32), e[n].stage = r[0], e[n].prio = 0, n++;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; e && i < np; i++) {
        const uint8_t *r = pb + i * PRP_REC;
        if (!set_add(&seen, hash8(r + 4))) continue;
        memcpy(e[n].iid, r + 4, 32), e[n].stage = r[0], e[n].prio = (uint8_t)(1 + r[1]), n++;
    }
    free(seen.v), free(ab), free(pb);
    rt_log("gfx_shader: warm list: %zu variants (%zu met in play, %zu prepared)", n, na, np);
    *out = e;
    return n;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_shader_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-shader: the shader service client (gfx_shader.c) against 32 census shaders. Needs build/xlate/totk_xlate.exe and
// build/v121/shaders/ (tools/shader_census.py); uses a throwaway cache directory.
//   1. Translate 32 shaders (mixed stages) through gfx_shader_get; each SPIR-V starts with the magic 0x07230203.
//   2. Drop the memory cache and ask again: 32 hits from disk, 0 service requests. A third pass returns the same pointers.
//   3. Send a malformed line straight to the service: it answers with an error line and still serves a valid request.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include "gfx.h"

int gfx_shader_raw_request(const char *line, char *reply, size_t reply_size);
uint64_t gfx_shader_requests(void);
uint64_t gfx_shader_cache_hits(void);
void gfx_shader_drop_memory(void);

#define WANT 32
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { printf("probe-shader: FAILED: " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); return 1; } } while (0)

typedef struct { char key[65]; int stage; const char *c1; size_t c1_len; uint32_t local[3]; } Entry;

static char *slurp(const char *path, size_t *size) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    char *b = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (b && fread(b, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) free(b), b = NULL;
    fclose(f);
    if (b) b[n] = 0, *size = (size_t)n;
    return b;
}

// Value of `"name": "` inside [from, to), NULL when absent; *len is the value length.
static const char *str_field(const char *from, const char *to, const char *name, size_t *len) {
    char pat[32];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "\"%s\": \"", name);
    const char *p = strstr(from, pat);
    if (!p || p >= to) return NULL;
    p += strlen(pat);
    const char *e = memchr(p, '"', (size_t)(to - p));
    if (!e) return NULL;
    *len = (size_t)(e - p);
    return p;
}

static int hexval(char c) { return c <= '9' ? c - '0' : (c | 32) - 'a' + 10; }

// The repository root: the nearest parent of totk.exe holding build/v121/shaders/jobs.json.
static int find_root(char *root, size_t n) {
    char exe[MAX_PATH * 2];
    DWORD len = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe);
    if (!len || len >= sizeof exe) return 0;
    for (char *cut = strrchr(exe, '\\'); cut; cut = strrchr(exe, '\\')) {
        *cut = 0;
        char p[MAX_PATH * 2 + 40];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s\\build\\v121\\shaders\\jobs.json", exe);
        if (GetFileAttributesA(p) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return snprintf(root, n, "%s", exe) < (int)n;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int pick_entries(const char *jobs, Entry *out) {
    enum { MAXN = 20000 };
    Entry *all = malloc(sizeof(Entry) * MAXN);
    int n = 0, per_stage[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    for (const char *p = jobs; n < MAXN && (p = strstr(p, "\"job\": {")); p += 8) {
        const char *end = strstr(p, "\"source\": ");
        if (!end) break;
        size_t kl, sl, cl;
        const char *k = str_field(p, end, "key", &kl), *s = str_field(p, end, "stage", &sl), *c = str_field(p, end, "c1", &cl);
        if (!k || !s || !c || kl != 64) continue;
        Entry *e = &all[n];
        memcpy(e->key, k, 64), e->key[64] = 0;
        e->stage = !strncmp(s, "vs", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_VS : !strncmp(s, "ps", sl) ? GFX_STAGE_FS : GFX_STAGE_CS;
        e->c1 = c, e->c1_len = cl / 2;
        e->local[0] = e->local[1] = e->local[2] = 1;
        const char *l = strstr(p, "\"local\": [");
        if (l && l < end) sscanf(l + 10, "%u , %u , %u", &e->local[0], &e->local[1], &e->local[2]);
        if (l && l < end && e->local[1] == 1 && e->local[2] == 1) sscanf(l + 10, "%u,%u,%u", &e->local[0], &e->local[1], &e->local[2]);
        per_stage[e->stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? 0 : e->stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? 1 : 2]++;
        n++;
    }
    // 11 vertex, 11 fragment, 10 compute shaders, spread evenly over each stage's list
    int want[3] = {11, 11, 10}, taken[3] = {0, 0, 0}, seen[3] = {0, 0, 0}, got = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int s = all[i].stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? 0 : all[i].stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? 1 : 2;
        if (per_stage[s] < want[s]) want[s] = per_stage[s];
        if (taken[s] < want[s] && seen[s] == (int)((long long)taken[s] * per_stage[s] / want[s])) out[got++] = all[i], taken[s]++;
        seen[s]++;
    }
    free(all);
    return got;
}

static char root[MAX_PATH * 2];

// Builds the program the game would hand NVN for a census entry and translates it.
static const GfxShader *translate(const Entry *e, int *err) {
    char path[MAX_PATH * 2 + 64];
    uint8_t c1[8192], control[0x880] = {0};
    if (e->c1_len > sizeof c1) return *err = 1, NULL;
    for (size_t b = 0; b < e->c1_len; b++) c1[b] = (uint8_t)(hexval(e->c1[b * 2]) << 4 | hexval(e->c1[b * 2 + 1]));
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\build\\v121\\shaders\\code\\%s.code", root, e->key);
    size_t body_size;
    char *body = slurp(path, &body_size);
    if (!body) return *err = 1, NULL;
    size_t skip = e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS ? 0 : 0x30, total = skip + body_size;
    uint8_t *code = calloc(1, total);
    memcpy(code + skip, body, body_size);
    free(body);
    uint32_t c1_off = (uint32_t)(total - e->c1_len), length = (uint32_t)total;
    memcpy(control + 0x700, &c1_off, 4), memcpy(control + 0x704, &length, 4);
    GfxShaderAnswers a = {0};
    if (e->stage == GFX_STAGE_CS) for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) a.local[k] = (uint16_t)e->local[k];
    const GfxShader *s = gfx_shader_get(e->stage, control, code, total, c1, &a);
    free(code);
    return s;
}

static void remove_dir(const char *dir) {
    char pat[MAX_PATH * 2];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "%s\\*", dir);
    WIN32_FIND_DATAA fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileA(pat, &fd);
    if (h != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        do {
            char f[MAX_PATH * 2];
            snprintf(f, sizeof f, "%s\\%s", dir, fd.cFileName);
            if (!(fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) DeleteFileA(f);
        } while (FindNextFileA(h, &fd));
        FindClose(h);
    }
    RemoveDirectoryA(dir);
}

#define FAIL_IF(cond, ...) do { if (cond) { printf("probe-shader: FAILED: " __VA_ARGS__); printf("\n"); remove_dir(dir); return 1; } } while (0)

int probe_shader(void) {
    char path[MAX_PATH * 2 + 64];
    CHECK(find_root(root, sizeof root), "build/v121/shaders/jobs.json not found (run tools/shader_census.py)");
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s\\build\\v121\\shaders\\jobs.json", root);
    size_t jobs_size;
    char *jobs = slurp(path, &jobs_size);
    CHECK(jobs, "cannot read %s", path);
    static Entry entries[WANT];
    int count = pick_entries(jobs, entries);
    CHECK(count == WANT, "only %d census shaders usable", count);

    char dir[MAX_PATH];
    snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s\\totk-shader-probe-%lu", getenv("TEMP") ? getenv("TEMP") : ".", GetCurrentProcessId());
    CHECK(_putenv_s("TOTK_SHADER_CACHE", dir) == 0, "cannot set TOTK_SHADER_CACHE");

    // pass 1: translate through the service
    const GfxShader *first[WANT];
    uint64_t req0 = gfx_shader_requests();
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        first[i] = translate(&entries[i], &err);
        FAIL_IF(!first[i], "shader %s did not translate", entries[i].key);
        uint64_t words;
        const uint32_t *w = gfx_shader_spirv(first[i], &words);
        FAIL_IF(words < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203, "shader %s: bad SPIR-V magic", entries[i].key);
    }
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() - req0 != WANT, "pass 1 sent %llu requests, expected %d",
            (unsigned long long)(gfx_shader_requests() - req0), WANT);

    // pass 2: memory cache dropped, so every answer comes from the disk cache
    gfx_shader_drop_memory();
    req0 = gfx_shader_requests();
    uint64_t hits0 = gfx_shader_cache_hits();
    const GfxShader *second[WANT];
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        second[i] = translate(&entries[i], &err);
        FAIL_IF(!second[i], "shader %s missing from the disk cache", entries[i].key);
        uint64_t words;
        const uint32_t *w = gfx_shader_spirv(second[i], &words);
        FAIL_IF(words < 5 || w[0] != 0x07230203, "shader %s: bad SPIR-V magic from disk", entries[i].key);
    }
    int hits = (int)(gfx_shader_cache_hits() - hits0);
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() != req0, "pass 2 contacted the service");
    FAIL_IF(hits != WANT, "pass 2 had %d cache hits", hits);

    // pass 3: memory hits return the same pointer
    for (int i = 0; i < WANT; i++) {
        int err = 0;
        FAIL_IF(translate(&entries[i], &err) != second[i], "repeat call for %s returned another pointer", entries[i].key);
    }
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_requests() != req0, "pass 3 contacted the service");
    FAIL_IF(gfx_shader_failures() != 0, "%llu translation failures", (unsigned long long)gfx_shader_failures());

    // the service survives a malformed line and still translates a valid one
    char reply[4096];
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request("this is not json", reply, sizeof reply), "service gone after the malformed line");
    FAIL_IF(strncmp(reply, "fail ", 5), "malformed line answered with \"%s\"", reply);
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request("{\"job\":{\"stage\":\"ps\"},\"out\":\"x\"}", reply, sizeof reply) || strncmp(reply, "fail ", 5),
            "job without key not rejected");
    char dir_json[MAX_PATH * 2], line[MAX_PATH * 4 + 1024], *o = dir_json;
    for (const char *s = dir; *s; s++) { if (*s == '\\') *o++ = '\\'; *o++ = *s; }
    *o = 0;
    char esc_root[MAX_PATH * 2];
    o = esc_root;
    for (const char *s = root; *s; s++) { if (*s == '\\') *o++ = '\\'; *o++ = *s; }
    *o = 0;
    const Entry *e = &entries[0];
    snprintf(line, sizeof line,
             "{\"job\":{\"key\":\"%.64sa\",\"stage\":\"%s\",\"debug\":false,\"c1\":\"%.*s\",\"code\":\"%s\\\\build\\\\v121\\\\shaders\\\\code\\\\%.64s.code\"},\"out\":\"%s\"}",
             e->key, e->stage == GFX_STAGE_VS ? "vs" : e->stage == GFX_STAGE_FS ? "ps" : "cs", (int)(e->c1_len * 2), e->c1,
             esc_root, e->key, dir_json);
    FAIL_IF(!gfx_shader_raw_request(line, reply, sizeof reply), "service did not answer a valid request after the malformed one");
    FAIL_IF(strncmp(reply, "ok ", 3), "valid request after the malformed one answered \"%s\"", reply);

    remove_dir(dir);
    printf("probe-shader: passed (%d shaders, %d cache hits, service survived malformed request)\n", count, hits);
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/gfx_window.c`:

```c
// Win32 window, Vulkan surface and swapchain, present blit, 60 Hz vsync thread, focus.
// Swapchain set-up ported from LAS Recomp, runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c:254-330 (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @
// da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai), SDL replaced by Win32. Focus and vsync
// behaviour from MacNativeGames, games/totk/runtime/frontend.m:88-97, 175-176, 350-352 (https://github.com/ly05010419/
// MacNativeGames @ b75be8cfa704df3701e86130c8ced268e79d6b11, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors).
//
// Threads: the window thread owns the HWND and its message loop and never runs guest code. The vsync thread signals the
// bound system events. Presents come from any host thread (the back end's present worker) and take g_pl; every queue
// submission takes the recursive queue lock (vk_queue_lock). The swapchain is rebuilt lazily: WM_SIZE only marks it
// dirty, the next present (or gfx_window_resize) rebuilds it.
//
// The in-game menu (ui/menu.h) draws over the game image in the present's command buffer, after the blit; its keyboard
// and mouse come from the window procedure (ui/menu_win.cpp). The window's size and fullscreen state are the settings
// TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE and TOTK_FULLSCREEN, applied at start and whenever a cfg_set changes them (window_settings_live).
//
// The process is per-monitor DPI aware (totk.manifest): every size here is physical pixels, TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE included,
// and the swapchain matches the screen pixel for pixel. A window moved to a monitor at another display scale keeps its
// client size (WM_GETDPISCALEDSIZE); the menu takes its text size floor from the window's DPI (gfx_window_dpi).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "ui/menu.h"
#include "vk.h"

#define FRAMES 2
#define MAX_IMAGES 16
#define VSYNC_NS 1000000000ull
#define VSYNC_HZ 60

// ---- queue lock
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_ql;
__attribute__((constructor)) static void window_init_locks(void);
void vk_queue_lock(void) { EnterCriticalSection(&g_ql); }
void vk_queue_unlock(void) { LeaveCriticalSection(&g_ql); }

// ---- window state
static HWND g_hwnd;
static HANDLE g_wnd_ready;
static VkSurfaceKHR g_surface;
static volatile LONG g_dirty;               // WM_SIZE seen; swapchain stale
static volatile LONG g_focused = 1;
static volatile LONG g_focus_msgs;
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_start_lock;       // gfx_window_start / vsync start
static int g_started, g_wnd_failed;
static int g_background;                   // TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW: the window stays behind the user's windows
static int g_fs_pending;                   // window thread: TOTK_FULLSCREEN waits for the first activation
static volatile LONG g_dpi = USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI;   // the window's DPI, set by the window thread

// ---- swapchain and present state (g_pl)
static CRITICAL_SECTION g_pl;
static VkSwapchainKHR g_sc;
static VkFormat g_sc_fmt;
static VkExtent2D g_sc_ext;
static int g_scaler;                        // the last present: 0 the game image 1:1, 1 scaled by the blit, 2 by FSR
static uint32_t g_sc_n;
static VkImage g_sc_img[MAX_IMAGES];
static VkImageView g_sc_view[MAX_IMAGES];   // colour attachment views for the menu overlay
static VkSemaphore g_render_done[MAX_IMAGES];
static VkCommandPool g_pool;
static VkCommandBuffer g_cb[FRAMES];
static VkFence g_fence[FRAMES];
static VkSemaphore g_acquire[FRAMES];
static unsigned g_frame;
static int g_capture;
static VkBuffer g_cap_buf;
static VmaAllocation g_cap_alloc;
static uint8_t *g_cap_ptr;
static VkDeviceSize g_cap_size;
static int g_cap_w, g_cap_h, g_cap_valid;
static int g_flip_on;            // vk_present_blit submitted the blit of swapchain image g_flip_idx; vk_present_flip presents it
static uint32_t g_flip_idx;

// ---- TOTK_FLIGHT thumbnails (flight.c; g_pl): each present also blits the swapchain image down into slot frame % g_th_n
// of a host-visible ring. A slot's tag names the frame it holds complete; recording a new frame clears the tag first,
// and the tag is set once the fence of that present has signalled.
#define TH_BYTES ((VkDeviceSize)FLIGHT_THUMB_W * FLIGHT_THUMB_H * 4)
static int g_th_n, g_th_failed;
static uint64_t g_th_frame;                // frame of the next vk_present_image call (vk_thumbs_frame)
static uint64_t *g_th_tag;                 // per ring slot
static uint64_t g_th_pending[FRAMES];      // per fence slot: the frame whose thumbnail its submission writes
static VkImage g_th_img;
static VmaAllocation g_th_img_alloc;
static VkFormat g_th_fmt;
static VkBuffer g_th_buf;
static VmaAllocation g_th_alloc;
static uint8_t *g_th_ptr;

static void window_init_locks(void) {
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_ql);
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_pl);
    InitializeCriticalSection(&g_start_lock);
}

// ---- vsync
static SRWLOCK g_vs_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static uint64_t g_vs_ev[16];
static int g_vs_nev;
static volatile long *g_vs_ctr[4];
static int g_vs_nctr;
static volatile LONGLONG g_ticks;
static volatile LONGLONG g_vs_start_ns;
static int g_vs_started;

static DWORD WINAPI vsync_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_HIGHEST);
    HANDLE t = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    if (!t) { rt_log("gfx: no high-resolution timer; vsync falls back to the system timer tick"); t = CreateWaitableTimerW(NULL, TRUE, NULL); }
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (;;) {
        uint64_t start = (uint64_t)g_vs_start_ns;
        uint64_t due = start + (n + 1) * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ;
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        if (now > due + 100000000ull) {                  // the process stalled: restart the schedule, no catch-up burst
            g_vs_start_ns = (LONGLONG)(now - (n + 1) * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ);
        } else if (due > now) {
            LARGE_INTEGER d;
            d.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)((due - now) / 100);
            if (d.QuadPart == 0) d.QuadPart = -1;
            SetWaitableTimer(t, &d, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE);
            WaitForSingleObject(t, INFINITE);
        }
        n++;
        InterlockedExchange64(&g_ticks, (LONGLONG)n);
        uint64_t ev[16];
        volatile long *ctr[4];
        int ne, nc;
        AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_vs_lock);
        ne = g_vs_nev;
        nc = g_vs_nctr;
        memcpy(ev, g_vs_ev, sizeof ev);
        memcpy(ctr, g_vs_ctr, sizeof ctr);
        ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_vs_lock);
        for (int i = 0; i < nc; i++) InterlockedIncrement(ctr[i]);
        for (int i = 0; i < ne; i++) kern_signal_system_event(ev[i]);
    }
    return 0;
}

static void vsync_ensure(void) {
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_start_lock);
    if (!g_vs_started) {
        g_vs_started = 1;
        g_vs_start_ns = (LONGLONG)kern_now_ns();
        HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, vsync_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
        if (!h) rt_fatal("gfx: cannot start the vsync thread (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        CloseHandle(h);
    }
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_start_lock);
}

void gfx_vsync_bind(uint64_t system_event) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_vs_lock);
    int have = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_vs_nev; i++) have |= g_vs_ev[i] == system_event;
    if (!have) {
        if (g_vs_nev == 16) rt_fatal("gfx: more than 16 vsync events");
        g_vs_ev[g_vs_nev++] = system_event;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vs_lock);
    vsync_ensure();
}

void gfx_vsync_bind_counter(volatile long *counter) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_vs_lock);
    if (g_vs_nctr == 4) rt_fatal("gfx: more than 4 vsync counters");
    g_vs_ctr[g_vs_nctr++] = counter;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_vs_lock);
    vsync_ensure();
}

uint64_t gfx_vsync_ticks(void) { return (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&g_ticks, 0, 0); }
uint64_t gfx_vsync_time_ns(uint64_t tick) { return (uint64_t)g_vs_start_ns + tick * VSYNC_NS / VSYNC_HZ; }

// ---- focus
int gfx_window_focused(void) { return g_focused; }
unsigned gfx_window_focus_messages(void) { return (unsigned)g_focus_msgs; }
HWND gfx_window_handle(void) { return g_hwnd; }

// ---- window thread
#define WND_STYLE WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW
#define WM_APP_SETTINGS (WM_APP + 1)
#define WM_APP_FULLSCREEN (WM_APP + 2)   // the fullscreen setting, held back until the window is first activated

static WINDOWPLACEMENT g_saved_place = {sizeof g_saved_place};   // the window behind fullscreen (window thread)

static int is_fullscreen(HWND h) { return !(GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE) & WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW); }

unsigned gfx_window_dpi(void) { return (unsigned)InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_dpi, 0, 0); }

// The outer size of a framed window whose client area is cw x ch. The frame is measured at the window's DPI, or the
// system DPI before the window exists: plain AdjustWindowRect always takes the system DPI, which is wrong on a monitor
// at another display scale.
static void outer_size(HWND h, int cw, int ch, int *ow, int *oh) {
    RECT r = {0, 0, cw, ch};
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WND_STYLE, FALSE, 0, h ? GetDpiForWindow(h) : GetDpiForSystem());
    *ow = r.right - r.left;
    *oh = r.bottom - r.top;
}

// TOTK_FULLSCREEN=1: borderless window over the monitor. TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE=<w>x<h>: client area of the window (the
// swapchain follows the window; the game image is scaled to it).
static int cfg_fullscreen(void) {
    return cfg_bool("TOTK_FULLSCREEN");
}

static void cfg_window_size(int *w, int *h) {
    int x = 0, y = 0;
    if (sscanf(cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"), "%dx%d", &x, &y) != 2 || x < 640 || y < 360 || x > 7680 || y > 4320)
        sscanf(cfg_meta("WINDOW_SIZE")->def, "%dx%d", &x, &y);   // unparsable or out of range: the default
    *w = x;
    *h = y;
}

// Windows turns the display off and sleeps after the idle timeout, and gamepad input does not count as activity. While
// the window is up and not minimized it holds the display and the system on, as other games do. The state belongs to
// the calling thread, so only the window thread (window_main and wnd_proc) calls this; the process exit releases it.
static void keep_awake(int on) {
    static int cur = -1;
    if (on == cur) return;
    cur = on;
    SetThreadExecutionState(on ? ES_CONTINUOUS | ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED | ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED : ES_CONTINUOUS);
}

// F11: borderless window over the whole monitor, and back to the saved window. The swapchain follows through WM_SIZE.
// Not Alt+Enter: Enter is the Plus button (input_win.c). A background window (test runs) keeps its place behind the
// user's windows and takes no focus.
static void toggle_fullscreen(HWND h) {
    LONG style = GetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE);
    if (style & WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW) {
        MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
        if (!GetWindowPlacement(h, &g_saved_place) || !GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(h, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi))
            return;
        SetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE, (style & ~WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW) | WS_POPUP);
        SetWindowPos(h, HWND_TOP, mi.rcMonitor.left, mi.rcMonitor.top, mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left,
                     mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top,
                     SWP_NOOWNERZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED | (g_background ? SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE : 0));
    } else {
        SetWindowLongW(h, GWL_STYLE, (style & ~WS_POPUP) | WND_STYLE);
        if (g_background) g_saved_place.showCmd = SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE;
        SetWindowPlacement(h, &g_saved_place);
        SetWindowPos(h, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                     SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOOWNERZORDER | SWP_FRAMECHANGED |
                         (g_background ? SWP_NOACTIVATE : 0));
    }
}

// The window size and fullscreen state last taken from the settings (window thread). apply_settings acts on a change of
// either value only, so a window resized by hand keeps its size when another setting changes.
static char g_applied_size[32];
static int g_applied_fs;

static void note_applied(void) {
    snprintf(g_applied_size, sizeof g_applied_size, "%s", cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"));
    g_applied_fs = cfg_fullscreen();
}

// Window thread: the window takes the size and fullscreen state of the settings when they changed. In fullscreen the
// size goes into the placement restored when fullscreen ends.
static void apply_settings(HWND h) {
    int size_changed = strcmp(cfg_value("TOTK_WINDOW_SIZE"), g_applied_size) != 0, fs = cfg_fullscreen(), fs_changed = fs != g_applied_fs;
    note_applied();
    if (size_changed) {
        int cw, ch, ow, oh;
        cfg_window_size(&cw, &ch);
        outer_size(h, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
        if (is_fullscreen(h)) {
            RECT *n = &g_saved_place.rcNormalPosition;
            n->right = n->left + ow;
            n->bottom = n->top + oh;
        } else {
            RECT have;
            if (GetClientRect(h, &have) && (have.right != cw || have.bottom != ch)) {
                if (IsZoomed(h)) ShowWindow(h, SW_RESTORE);
                SetWindowPos(h, NULL, 0, 0, ow, oh, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
            }
        }
    }
    if (fs_changed && fs != is_fullscreen(h)) {
        input_cursor_suspend(1);
        toggle_fullscreen(h);
        input_cursor_suspend(0);
    }
}

void gfx_window_apply_settings(void) {
    if (g_hwnd) PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_APP_SETTINGS, 0, 0);
}

// Present path (g_pl held): a settings change (cfg_version) reaches the window thread, which applies a changed size or
// fullscreen; a changed TOTK_VK_PRESENT rebuilds the swapchain at this present.
static void window_settings_live(void) {
    static unsigned seen;
    static int started;
    static char present[16];   // the TOTK_VK_PRESENT the swapchain was made with
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (started && v == seen) return;
    seen = v;
    const char *e = cfg_value("TOTK_VK_PRESENT");
    if (!started || strncmp(e, present, sizeof present - 1)) {
        snprintf(present, sizeof present, "%s", e);
        if (started) InterlockedExchange(&g_dirty, 1);
    }
    if (started) gfx_window_apply_settings();
    started = 1;
}

void gfx_window_request_close(void) {
    if (g_hwnd) PostMessageW(g_hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0);
}

// ---- refresh rate of the window's monitor (TOTK_FPS_LIMIT=display). The window thread measures it when the window
// opens, lands on another monitor or the display mode changes; readers take the stored value. QueryDisplayConfig gives
// the exact rational rate (59.94, 143.998); EnumDisplaySettings' whole hertz is the fallback.
static HMONITOR g_rate_mon;
static volatile LONG g_rate_mhz;   // millihertz, 0 unknown

static double monitor_rate_hz(HMONITOR mon) {
    MONITORINFOEXW mi = {.cbSize = sizeof mi};
    if (!GetMonitorInfoW(mon, (MONITORINFO *)&mi)) return 0;
    double hz = 0;
    UINT32 np = 0, nm = 0;
    if (GetDisplayConfigBufferSizes(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, &nm) == ERROR_SUCCESS && np && nm) {
        DISPLAYCONFIG_PATH_INFO *paths = calloc(np, sizeof *paths);
        DISPLAYCONFIG_MODE_INFO *modes = calloc(nm, sizeof *modes);
        if (paths && modes && QueryDisplayConfig(QDC_ONLY_ACTIVE_PATHS, &np, paths, &nm, modes, NULL) == ERROR_SUCCESS)
            for (UINT32 i = 0; i < np && !hz; i++) {
                DISPLAYCONFIG_SOURCE_DEVICE_NAME src = {.header = {.type = DISPLAYCONFIG_DEVICE_INFO_GET_SOURCE_NAME,
                                                                   .size = sizeof src,
                                                                   .adapterId = paths[i].sourceInfo.adapterId,
                                                                   .id = paths[i].sourceInfo.id}};
                DISPLAYCONFIG_RATIONAL r = paths[i].targetInfo.refreshRate;
                if (DisplayConfigGetDeviceInfo(&src.header) == ERROR_SUCCESS && !wcscmp(src.viewGdiDeviceName, mi.szDevice) &&
                    r.Denominator)
                    hz = (double)r.Numerator / r.Denominator;
            }
        free(paths);
        free(modes);
    }
    DEVMODEW dm = {.dmSize = sizeof dm};
    if (!hz && EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_CURRENT_SETTINGS, &dm) && dm.dmDisplayFrequency > 1)
        hz = dm.dmDisplayFrequency;   // 0 and 1 mean the hardware default
    return hz;
}

// Window thread. force: the display mode changed, measure even on the same monitor.
static void refresh_rate_update(HWND h, int force) {
    HMONITOR mon = MonitorFromWindow(h, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    if (!force && mon == g_rate_mon) return;
    g_rate_mon = mon;
    double hz = monitor_rate_hz(mon);
    LONG mhz = (LONG)(hz * 1000 + 0.5);
    if (InterlockedExchange(&g_rate_mhz, mhz) != mhz) rt_log("gfx: monitor refresh rate %.3f Hz", hz);
}

double gfx_window_refresh_hz(void) { return InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_rate_mhz, 0, 0) / 1000.0; }

int gfx_window_monitor_size(int *w, int *h) {
    MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
    if (!g_hwnd || !GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromWindow(g_hwnd, MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY), &mi)) return 0;
    *w = mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left;
    *h = mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top;
    return 1;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK wnd_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    LRESULT input_res;
    if (input_window_msg(h, m, w, l, &input_res)) return input_res;
    if (menu_window_msg(h, m, w, l, &input_res)) return input_res;
    switch (m) {
    case WM_KEYDOWN:
        if (w == VK_F11 && !(l & (1 << 30))) {   // bit 30: auto-repeat
            input_cursor_suspend(1);
            toggle_fullscreen(h);
            input_cursor_suspend(0);
            cfg_set("TOTK_FULLSCREEN", is_fullscreen(h) ? "1" : "0");   // the menu shows it; the next start keeps it
            cfg_save();
            note_applied();   // what cfg_get reads now (the environment may still override it)
        }
        break;
    case WM_APP_SETTINGS:
        apply_settings(h);
        return 0;
    case WM_APP_FULLSCREEN:
        if (cfg_fullscreen() && !is_fullscreen(h)) {
            input_cursor_suspend(1);
            toggle_fullscreen(h);
            input_cursor_suspend(0);
        }
        return 0;
    case WM_SIZE:
        keep_awake(w != SIZE_MINIMIZED);
        if (w != SIZE_MINIMIZED) InterlockedExchange(&g_dirty, 1);
        refresh_rate_update(h, 0);
        return 0;
    case WM_EXITSIZEMOVE:   // dragged onto another monitor
        refresh_rate_update(h, 0);
        break;
    case WM_DISPLAYCHANGE:
        refresh_rate_update(h, 1);
        break;
    case WM_GETDPISCALEDSIZE:   // a framed window keeps its client size in pixels on a monitor at another scale
        if (!is_fullscreen(h) && !IsZoomed(h)) {
            RECT c, r;
            if (GetClientRect(h, &c)) {
                r = (RECT){0, 0, c.right, c.bottom};
                if (AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&r, WND_STYLE, FALSE, 0, LOWORD(w))) {
                    *(SIZE *)l = (SIZE){r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top};
                    return TRUE;
                }
            }
        }
        break;   // DefWindowProc: Windows scales the size with the DPI
    case WM_DPICHANGED: {   // display scale changed, or the window reached a monitor at another scale
        const RECT *s = (const RECT *)l;
        InterlockedExchange(&g_dpi, LOWORD(w));
        rt_log("gfx: window DPI %u (%u%%)", LOWORD(w), LOWORD(w) * 100u / USER_DEFAULT_SCREEN_DPI);
        if (is_fullscreen(h)) {   // keep covering the monitor the suggested rect lies on
            MONITORINFO mi = {sizeof mi};
            if (GetMonitorInfoW(MonitorFromRect(s, MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST), &mi))
                SetWindowPos(h, NULL, mi.rcMonitor.left, mi.rcMonitor.top, mi.rcMonitor.right - mi.rcMonitor.left,
                             mi.rcMonitor.bottom - mi.rcMonitor.top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        } else {
            SetWindowPos(h, NULL, s->left, s->top, s->right - s->left, s->bottom - s->top, SWP_NOZORDER | SWP_NOACTIVATE);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_ACTIVATEAPP: {
        int in = w != 0;
        InterlockedExchange(&g_focused, in);
        oe_set_focus(in);                          // pinned to 1 by TOTK_ASSUME_FOCUS inside
        oe_push_message(OE_MSG_FOCUS_STATE_CHANGED);
        InterlockedIncrement(&g_focus_msgs);
        if (in && g_fs_pending) {
            g_fs_pending = 0;
            PostMessageW(h, WM_APP_FULLSCREEN, 0, 0);
        }
        return 0;
    }
    case WM_CLOSE:
        // The process ends with the window, as in MNG, once a save Commit still running in the background is done.
        rt_log("gfx: window closed; exiting");
        fs_save_flush();
        vk_pipeline_save();
        prof_write();   // ExitProcess runs no atexit handlers
        ExitProcess(0);
    case WM_ERASEBKGND:
        return 1;
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

static DWORD WINAPI window_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    // Icon resource 1 of totk.rc (runtime/totk.ico): the title bar, the taskbar button and Alt+Tab.
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = {.cbSize = sizeof wc, .lpfnWndProc = wnd_proc, .hInstance = inst,
                      .hIcon = LoadImageW(inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1), IMAGE_ICON, GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXICON),
                                          GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYICON), LR_SHARED),
                      .hIconSm = LoadImageW(inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1), IMAGE_ICON, GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSMICON),
                                            GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSMICON), LR_SHARED),
                      .hCursor = LoadCursorW(NULL, (LPCWSTR)IDC_ARROW), .lpszClassName = L"TotKRecompWindow"};
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    int cw, ch, ow, oh;
    cfg_window_size(&cw, &ch);
    outer_size(NULL, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
    // The window opens behind the user's windows without taking focus: it shows the game's blank loading frames for a
    // while, and must not cover what the player works on meanwhile. The game still counts itself in focus until the
    // first WM_ACTIVATEAPP, so loading goes on, and keyboard input waits for the foreground (input_win.c). Its taskbar
    // button flashes until it is brought up, and TOTK_FULLSCREEN waits for that first activation.
    // TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW=1 (test runs): no flashing, never fullscreen at start, and F11 keeps the window's place.
    int background = g_background = cfg_get("TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW") && atoi(cfg_get("TOTK_BACKGROUND_WINDOW"));
    g_hwnd = CreateWindowExW(0, wc.lpszClassName, L"TotK Recomp", WND_STYLE, CW_USEDEFAULT, CW_USEDEFAULT, ow, oh, NULL,
                             NULL, inst, NULL);
    if (!g_hwnd) {
        rt_log("gfx: CreateWindowEx failed (%lu)", GetLastError());
        g_wnd_failed = 1;
    } else {
        // The frame was measured at the system DPI; the window may have opened on a monitor at another scale.
        InterlockedExchange(&g_dpi, (LONG)GetDpiForWindow(g_hwnd));
        outer_size(g_hwnd, cw, ch, &ow, &oh);
        SetWindowPos(g_hwnd, HWND_BOTTOM, 0, 0, ow, oh, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOACTIVATE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
        if (!background) {
            FLASHWINFO fw = {.cbSize = sizeof fw, .hwnd = g_hwnd, .dwFlags = FLASHW_TRAY | FLASHW_TIMERNOFG};
            FlashWindowEx(&fw);
            g_fs_pending = cfg_fullscreen();
        }
        note_applied();
        refresh_rate_update(g_hwnd, 1);
        keep_awake(1);
    }
    SetEvent(g_wnd_ready);
    if (g_wnd_failed) return 1;
    MSG msg;
    while (GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0) > 0) {
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- swapchain
static const char *g_present_got = "";   // the TOTK_VK_PRESENT value of the mode the swapchain got; "" before one

static VkPresentModeKHR pick_present_mode(VkPhysicalDevice pd) {
    const char *e = cfg_value("TOTK_VK_PRESENT");
    VkPresentModeKHR want = !strcmp(e, "mailbox") ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR
                          : !strcmp(e, "immediate") ? VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR : VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, g_surface, &n, NULL);
    VkPresentModeKHR m[16];
    if (n > 16) n = 16;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfacePresentModesKHR(pd, g_surface, &n, m);
    VkPresentModeKHR got = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (m[i] == want) got = want;
    const char *name = got == VK_PRESENT_MODE_MAILBOX_KHR ? "mailbox" : got == VK_PRESENT_MODE_IMMEDIATE_KHR ? "immediate" : "fifo";
    __atomic_store_n(&g_present_got, name, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    static int logged = -1;   // the mode last logged: a change from the menu shows in the log
    if ((int)got != logged) {
        logged = (int)got;
        rt_log("gfx: present mode %s (TOTK_VK_PRESENT=%s)", name, e);
    }
    return got;
}

const char *gfx_window_present_mode(void) { return __atomic_load_n(&g_present_got, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

// Queues the present of a blit vk_present_blit left waiting (g_pl held). A swapchain rebuild and the next blit flush it
// first; the device release drops it.
static void flip_locked(void) {
    if (!g_flip_on) return;
    g_flip_on = 0;
    if (!g_sc) return;
    VkPresentInfoKHR pi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR, .waitSemaphoreCount = 1,
                           .pWaitSemaphores = &g_render_done[g_flip_idx], .swapchainCount = 1, .pSwapchains = &g_sc,
                           .pImageIndices = &g_flip_idx};
    vk_queue_lock();
    VkResult r = vkQueuePresentKHR(vk_ctx()->gfx_queue, &pi);
    vk_queue_unlock();
    vk_device_fault_report(r);
    if (r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) InterlockedExchange(&g_dirty, 1);
}

static void free_capture(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (g_cap_buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_cap_buf, g_cap_alloc);
    g_cap_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    g_cap_ptr = NULL;
    g_cap_size = 0;
    g_cap_valid = 0;
}

// Returns 1 with a usable swapchain, 0 when the window has no area (minimised). Called with g_pl held.
static int create_swapchain(void) {
    flip_locked();   // the acquired image goes out before its swapchain is replaced
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR caps;
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &caps) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    RECT rc = {0};
    GetClientRect(g_hwnd, &rc);
    VkExtent2D ext = caps.currentExtent.width != UINT32_MAX ? caps.currentExtent
                                                            : (VkExtent2D){(uint32_t)rc.right, (uint32_t)rc.bottom};
    if (!ext.width || !ext.height) return 0;
    uint32_t nf = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &nf, NULL);
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR fmts[64];
    if (nf > 64) nf = 64;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(c->phys, g_surface, &nf, fmts);
    if (!nf) return 0;
    // UNORM: the blit writes the bytes the game wrote (no sRGB encode).
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR sf = fmts[0];
    int found = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf && !found; i++)
        if (fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM && fmts[i].colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR) { sf = fmts[i]; found = 1; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf && !found; i++)
        if (fmts[i].format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM && fmts[i].colorSpace == VK_COLOR_SPACE_SRGB_NONLINEAR_KHR) { sf = fmts[i]; found = 1; }
    uint32_t count = caps.minImageCount + 1;
    if (caps.maxImageCount && count > caps.maxImageCount) count = caps.maxImageCount;
    if (count > 8) count = 8;

    vk_queue_lock();
    vkDeviceWaitIdle(c->device);
    VkSwapchainKHR old = g_sc;
    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR ci = {
        .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR, .surface = g_surface, .minImageCount = count,
        .imageFormat = sf.format, .imageColorSpace = sf.colorSpace, .imageExtent = ext, .imageArrayLayers = 1,
        .imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT |
                      VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT,   // every surface supports it (the menu overlay draws into it)
        .imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE, .preTransform = caps.currentTransform,
        .compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR, .presentMode = pick_present_mode(c->phys), .clipped = VK_TRUE,
        .oldSwapchain = old};
    VkResult r = vkCreateSwapchainKHR(c->device, &ci, NULL, &g_sc);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("gfx: vkCreateSwapchainKHR failed (%d)", (int)r);
        g_sc = old;
        vk_queue_unlock();
        return 0;
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        vkDestroySemaphore(c->device, g_render_done[i], NULL);
        if (g_sc_view[i]) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, g_sc_view[i], NULL);
        g_sc_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (old) vkDestroySwapchainKHR(c->device, old, NULL);
    g_sc_fmt = sf.format;
    g_sc_ext = ext;
    g_sc_n = MAX_IMAGES;
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(c->device, g_sc, &g_sc_n, g_sc_img);
    VkSemaphoreCreateInfo semi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        vkCreateSemaphore(c->device, &semi, NULL, &g_render_done[i]);
        VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = g_sc_img[i],
                                    .viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, .format = sf.format,
                                    .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
        if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, &g_sc_view[i]) != VK_SUCCESS) g_sc_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    free_capture();
    vk_queue_unlock();
    InterlockedExchange(&g_dirty, 0);
    return 1;
}

static void sync_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage img, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s0,
                         VkAccessFlags2 a0, VkPipelineStageFlags2 s1, VkAccessFlags2 a1) {
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 b = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = s0, .srcAccessMask = a0,
                               .dstStageMask = s1, .dstAccessMask = a1, .oldLayout = from, .newLayout = to,
                               .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                               .image = img, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1}};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &b};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
}

static int ensure_capture_buffer(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkDeviceSize need = (VkDeviceSize)g_sc_ext.width * g_sc_ext.height * 4;
    if (g_cap_buf && g_cap_size == need) return 1;
    free_capture();
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = need, .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &g_cap_buf, &g_cap_alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_cap_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return 0; }
    g_cap_ptr = info.pMappedData;
    g_cap_size = need;
    return g_cap_ptr != NULL;
}

void vk_thumbs_enable(int n) {
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_pl);
    if (!g_th_n && n > 0 && (g_th_tag = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *g_th_tag))) g_th_n = n;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_pl);
}

void vk_thumbs_frame(uint64_t frame) {
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_pl);
    g_th_frame = frame;
    LeaveCriticalSection(&g_pl);
}

static void free_thumbs(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (g_th_img && c) vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, g_th_img, g_th_img_alloc);
    if (g_th_buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_th_buf, g_th_alloc);
    g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE, g_th_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE, g_th_ptr = NULL;
    if (g_th_tag) memset(g_th_tag, 0, sizeof *g_th_tag * (size_t)g_th_n);
    memset(g_th_pending, 0, sizeof g_th_pending);
}

// The ring and the blit target in the swapchain's format; allocated on the first present, the image again when the
// swapchain format changes. A failure turns the thumbnails off for the session.
static int ensure_thumbs(void) {
    if (!g_th_n || g_th_failed || !g_th_frame) return 0;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!g_th_buf) {
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = TH_BYTES * (VkDeviceSize)g_th_n,
                                 .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                      .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
        VmaAllocationInfo info;
        if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &g_th_buf, &g_th_alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS || !info.pMappedData) {
            if (g_th_buf) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, g_th_buf, g_th_alloc);
            g_th_buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            g_th_failed = 1;
            rt_log("gfx: flight thumbnails off: no host-visible ring of %llu MB", (unsigned long long)(bi.size >> 20));
            return 0;
        }
        g_th_ptr = info.pMappedData;
    }
    if (g_th_img && g_th_fmt != g_sc_fmt) {
        vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, g_th_img, g_th_img_alloc);   // the previous present's fence was waited for: idle
        g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (!g_th_img) {
        VkImageCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, .format = g_sc_fmt,
                                .extent = {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = 1,
                                .samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                                .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                                .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
        if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ci, &ai, &g_th_img, &g_th_img_alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            g_th_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            g_th_failed = 1;
            rt_log("gfx: flight thumbnails off: no %ux%u image", FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H);
            return 0;
        }
        g_th_fmt = g_sc_fmt;
    }
    return 1;
}

// dst (TRANSFER_SRC, the swapchain image just written) -> thumbnail image -> ring slot of g_th_frame.
static void record_thumb(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkImage dst, unsigned fence_slot) {
    uint64_t f = g_th_frame;
    unsigned ring = (unsigned)(f % (uint64_t)g_th_n);
    g_th_tag[ring] = 0;   // under g_pl: vk_thumbs_read no longer hands this slot out
    sync_barrier(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                 0, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT);
    VkImageBlit region = {
        .srcSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .srcOffsets = {{0, 0, 0}, {(int)g_sc_ext.width, (int)g_sc_ext.height, 1}},
        .dstSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, .dstOffsets = {{0, 0, 0}, {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}}};
    vkCmdBlitImage(cb, dst, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &region,
                   VK_FILTER_LINEAR);
    sync_barrier(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                 VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT);
    VkBufferImageCopy bc = {.bufferOffset = TH_BYTES * ring, .imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                            .imageExtent = {FLIGHT_THUMB_W, FLIGHT_THUMB_H, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, g_th_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_th_buf, 1, &bc);
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo d = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &d);
    g_th_pending[fence_slot] = f;
    g_th_frame = 0;
}

int vk_thumbs_read(uint64_t frame, uint8_t *rgba) {
    int ok = 0;
    EnterCriticalSection(&g_pl);
    if (g_th_n && g_th_ptr && frame) {
        unsigned ring = (unsigned)(frame % (uint64_t)g_th_n);
        if (g_th_tag[ring] == frame) {
            VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
```
