```c
        if (now < e->at || (now >= e->at + e->hold && (e->logged || !e->timed))) continue;
        if (!e->logged) {
            e->logged = 1;
            if (e->timed) rt_log("input: script frame %llu at %.1f ms: %s", (unsigned long long)fr, w / 1000.0, e->text);
            else rt_log("input: script frame %llu tick %llu: %s", (unsigned long long)fr, (unsigned long long)tick, e->text);
        }
        if (e->stick) { int32_t *s = e->stick == 1 ? sl : sr; s[0] = e->x; s[1] = e->y; }
        else *b |= 1ull << e->bit;
    }
}

// TOTK_INPUT_RECORD=<file>: writes the merged input as TOTK_INPUT_SCRIPT lines, one per button press and per stick
// segment, so a played session replays as a script. A stick segment ends when an axis moves by more than REC_STICK_STEP.
// An event that begins on the world clock is written timed ("@<ms>", hold in ms), one before it in ticks
// (frame_step_ticks). When the world clock starts, held buttons and sticks are cut there and go on as timed events.
enum { REC_STICK_STEP = 2048 };
static FILE *rec;
static int rec_state;                // 0 not opened, 1 recording, -1 off
static uint64_t rec_down[16];        // tick + 1 at which each button went down, 0 while up
static int64_t rec_down_w[16];       // the world clock then, -1 before it started
static uint64_t rec_stick_from[2];   // tick + 1 at which the current non-zero stick segment began
static int64_t rec_stick_w[2];
static int32_t rec_stick[2][2];
static int64_t rec_last_w = -1;      // the world clock at the previous apply

// "<tick> <what> <hold>" or "@<ms> <what> <hold ms>": from tick from and world clock from_w to now.
static void rec_line(uint64_t from, int64_t from_w, uint64_t fr, int64_t w, const char *what) {
    if (from_w >= 0 && w >= from_w)
        fprintf(rec, "@%.1f %s %.1f\n", from_w / 1000.0, what, (w > from_w ? w - from_w : 1000) / 1000.0);
    else
        fprintf(rec, "%llu %s %llu\n", (unsigned long long)from, what, (unsigned long long)(fr > from ? fr - from : 1));
}

static void rec_close_stick(int s, uint64_t fr, int64_t w) {
    if (!rec_stick_from[s]) return;
    char what[48];
    snprintf(what, sizeof what, "%s %d %d", s ? "RSTICK" : "LSTICK", rec_stick[s][0], rec_stick[s][1]);
    rec_line(rec_stick_from[s] - 1, rec_stick_w[s], fr, w, what);
    rec_stick_from[s] = 0;
}

static void rec_flush_all(void) {
    if (rec_state != 1) return;
    uint64_t fr = frame_step_ticks() + 1;
    int64_t w = frame_step_world_us();
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        if (rec_down[i]) { rec_line(rec_down[i] - 1, rec_down_w[i], fr, w, script_buttons[i].name); rec_down[i] = 0; }
    rec_close_stick(0, fr, w);
    rec_close_stick(1, fr, w);
    fflush(rec);
}

static void rec_apply(uint64_t b, const int32_t sl[2], const int32_t sr[2]) {
    if (!rec_state) {
        const char *path = cfg_get("TOTK_INPUT_RECORD");   // no default: not recording when unset
        rec = path && *path ? fopen(path, "w") : NULL;
        rec_state = rec ? 1 : -1;
        if (path && *path && !rec) rt_log("input: cannot open TOTK_INPUT_RECORD %s", path);
        if (rec) { fprintf(rec, "# Recorded input (TOTK_INPUT_RECORD); frame = 60 Hz ticks of game time, @ms = world clock.\n"); atexit(rec_flush_all);
                   rt_log("input: recording to %s", path); }
    }
    if (rec_state != 1) return;
    uint64_t fr = frame_step_ticks();
    int64_t w = frame_step_world_us();
    int wrote = 0;
    if (w >= 0 && rec_last_w < 0) {   // the world clock starts: what is held goes on as timed events from @0
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
            if (rec_down[i]) {
                rec_line(rec_down[i] - 1, -1, fr, -1, script_buttons[i].name);
                rec_down[i] = fr + 1, rec_down_w[i] = w;
                wrote = 1;
            }
        for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++)
            if (rec_stick_from[s]) {
                rec_close_stick(s, fr, -1);
                rec_stick_from[s] = fr + 1, rec_stick_w[s] = w;
                wrote = 1;
            }
    }
    rec_last_w = w;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        int bit = script_buttons[i].bit, down = (b >> bit & 1) != 0;
        if (down && !rec_down[i]) rec_down[i] = fr + 1, rec_down_w[i] = w;
        else if (!down && rec_down[i]) {
            rec_line(rec_down[i] - 1, rec_down_w[i], fr, w, script_buttons[i].name);
            rec_down[i] = 0;
            wrote = 1;
        }
    }
    const int32_t *st[2] = {sl, sr};
    for (int s = 0; s < 2; s++) {
        int moved = abs(st[s][0] - rec_stick[s][0]) > REC_STICK_STEP || abs(st[s][1] - rec_stick[s][1]) > REC_STICK_STEP ||
                    ((st[s][0] || st[s][1]) != (rec_stick[s][0] || rec_stick[s][1]));
        if (!moved) continue;
        if (rec_stick_from[s]) { rec_close_stick(s, fr, w); wrote = 1; }
        rec_stick[s][0] = st[s][0]; rec_stick[s][1] = st[s][1];
        if (st[s][0] || st[s][1]) rec_stick_from[s] = fr + 1, rec_stick_w[s] = w;
    }
    if (wrote) fflush(rec);
}

// Win32 virtual key of a key id (the one place that knows them), 0 for an id without a key.
static int key_vk(int key) {
    if (key >= KEY_A && key <= KEY_Z) return 'A' + (key - KEY_A);
    if (key >= KEY_0 && key <= KEY_9) return '0' + (key - KEY_0);
    if (key >= KEY_NUM0 && key <= KEY_NUM9) return VK_NUMPAD0 + (key - KEY_NUM0);
    switch (key) {
    case KEY_SPACE: return VK_SPACE;
    case KEY_TAB: return VK_TAB;
    case KEY_LSHIFT: return VK_LSHIFT;
    case KEY_LCTRL: return VK_LCONTROL;
    case KEY_UP: return VK_UP;
    case KEY_DOWN: return VK_DOWN;
    case KEY_LEFT: return VK_LEFT;
    case KEY_RIGHT: return VK_RIGHT;
    case KEY_MOUSE_L: return VK_LBUTTON;
    case KEY_MOUSE_R: return VK_RBUTTON;
    case KEY_MOUSE_M: return VK_MBUTTON;
    case KEY_MOUSE_X1: return VK_XBUTTON1;
    case KEY_MOUSE_X2: return VK_XBUTTON2;
    case KEY_ENTER: return VK_RETURN;
    case KEY_BACKSPACE: return VK_BACK;
    case KEY_RSHIFT: return VK_RSHIFT;
    case KEY_RCTRL: return VK_RCONTROL;
    case KEY_LALT: return VK_LMENU;
    case KEY_CAPSLOCK: return VK_CAPITAL;
    case KEY_INSERT: return VK_INSERT;
    case KEY_DELETE: return VK_DELETE;
    case KEY_HOME: return VK_HOME;
    case KEY_END: return VK_END;
    case KEY_PAGEUP: return VK_PRIOR;
    case KEY_PAGEDOWN: return VK_NEXT;
    case KEY_F2: return VK_F2;
    case KEY_F3: return VK_F3;
    case KEY_F4: return VK_F4;
    case KEY_F5: return VK_F5;
    case KEY_F6: return VK_F6;
    case KEY_F7: return VK_F7;
    case KEY_F9: return VK_F9;
    case KEY_F12: return VK_F12;
    case KEY_NUM_ADD: return VK_ADD;
    case KEY_NUM_SUB: return VK_SUBTRACT;
    case KEY_NUM_MUL: return VK_MULTIPLY;
    case KEY_NUM_DIV: return VK_DIVIDE;
    case KEY_NUM_DECIMAL: return VK_DECIMAL;
    case KEY_MINUS: return VK_OEM_MINUS;
    case KEY_EQUALS: return VK_OEM_PLUS;
    case KEY_LBRACKET: return VK_OEM_4;
    case KEY_RBRACKET: return VK_OEM_6;
    case KEY_SEMICOLON: return VK_OEM_1;
    case KEY_APOSTROPHE: return VK_OEM_7;
    case KEY_COMMA: return VK_OEM_COMMA;
    case KEY_PERIOD: return VK_OEM_PERIOD;
    case KEY_SLASH: return VK_OEM_2;
    case KEY_BACKSLASH: return VK_OEM_5;
    case KEY_GRAVE: return VK_OEM_3;
    }
    return 0;
}

uint32_t input_key_char(int key) {
    if (key < KEY_MINUS || key > KEY_GRAVE) return 0;
    return MapVirtualKeyW((UINT)key_vk(key), MAPVK_VK_TO_CHAR) & 0x7fffffffu;   // the top bit marks a dead key
}

// ---- mouse camera: raw motion accumulated by the window thread, one stick sample per presented frame
static volatile LONG mouse_dx, mouse_dy;   // raw counts since the last frame sample
static volatile LONG cur_captured;         // cursor hidden and confined to the client area
static volatile LONG cur_active;           // WM_ACTIVATEAPP: the window's application is active
// Bits: CUR_REL, Esc or activation by a click on the title bar or border: until a client click; CUR_ESC, set with CUR_REL
// by Esc (not when it was already set): closing the menu gives the capture back. One word, changed by one CAS.
enum { CUR_REL = 1, CUR_ESC = 2 };
static volatile LONG cur_rel;
static void cur_rel_update(LONG (*f)(LONG)) {
    LONG o, n;
    do { o = cur_rel; n = f(o); } while (n != o && InterlockedCompareExchange(&cur_rel, n, o) != o);
}
static LONG rel_esc(LONG o) { return o & CUR_REL ? o : CUR_REL | CUR_ESC; }
static LONG rel_title(LONG o) { (void)o; return CUR_REL; }
static LONG rel_clear(LONG o) { (void)o; return 0; }
static LONG rel_menu_closed(LONG o) { return o & CUR_ESC ? 0 : o; }
static volatile LONG cur_suspend;          // F11 or a modal size or move loop under way
static SRWLOCK cur_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;    // serialises cursor_update (window thread, input_block callers)
static volatile LONG g_block;              // text entry state, see input_block
static volatile LONG g_menu;               // in-game menu state, see input_menu
static float mouse_sens = -1;              // TOTK_MOUSE_SENS, 0 = mouse camera off; live (cfg_version)
static unsigned mouse_sens_seen;

static float mouse_sens_get(void) {
    unsigned ver = cfg_version();
    if (mouse_sens >= 0 && ver == mouse_sens_seen) return mouse_sens;
    mouse_sens_seen = ver;
    double v = cfg_double("TOTK_MOUSE_SENS");
    mouse_sens = (float)(v < 0 ? 0 : v > 10 ? 10 : v);
    return mouse_sens;
}

// Hide the cursor and confine it to the client area while the window is focused, not suspended, not behind a text entry
// or the menu, and the mouse camera is on; release it otherwise. Safe from any thread.
static void cursor_update(HWND h) {
    const char *in = cfg_get("TOTK_INPUT");
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&cur_lock);
    int want = h && cur_active && !(cur_rel & CUR_REL) && !cur_suspend && g_block != 1 && g_menu != 1 && mouse_sens_get() > 0 &&
               !(in && !strcmp(in, "none")) && GetForegroundWindow() == h && !IsIconic(h);
    RECT r;
    POINT tl = {0, 0};
    if (want && GetClientRect(h, &r) && ClientToScreen(h, &tl)) {
        RECT clip = {tl.x, tl.y, tl.x + r.right, tl.y + r.bottom};
        ClipCursor(&clip);
        if (!cur_captured) { InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dx, 0); InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dy, 0); }
        InterlockedExchange(&cur_captured, 1);
    } else {
        if (cur_captured) ClipCursor(NULL);
        InterlockedExchange(&cur_captured, 0);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&cur_lock);
}

int input_cursor_released(void) { return (cur_rel & CUR_REL) != 0; }

void input_cursor_suspend(int on) {
    InterlockedExchange(&cur_suspend, on != 0);
    cursor_update(gfx_window_handle());
}

// Window procedure hook (gfx_window.c calls it first). Returns 1 with *res set when the message is fully handled.
int input_window_msg(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l, LRESULT *res) {
    switch (m) {
    case WM_CREATE: {
        RAWINPUTDEVICE rid = {.usUsagePage = 1, .usUsage = 2, .dwFlags = 0, .hwndTarget = h};   // generic mouse
        if (!RegisterRawInputDevices(&rid, 1, sizeof rid)) rt_log("input: raw mouse registration failed (%lu)", GetLastError());
        break;
    }
    case WM_INPUT: {
        RAWINPUT ri;
        UINT sz = sizeof ri;
        if (cur_captured && GetRawInputData((HRAWINPUT)l, RID_INPUT, &ri, &sz, sizeof(RAWINPUTHEADER)) != (UINT)-1 &&
            ri.header.dwType == RIM_TYPEMOUSE && !(ri.data.mouse.usFlags & MOUSE_MOVE_ABSOLUTE)) {
            InterlockedAdd(&mouse_dx, ri.data.mouse.lLastX);
            InterlockedAdd(&mouse_dy, ri.data.mouse.lLastY);
        }
        break;   // DefWindowProc must see WM_INPUT for cleanup
    }
    case WM_SETCURSOR:
        if (cur_captured && LOWORD(l) == HTCLIENT) { SetCursor(NULL); *res = TRUE; return 1; }
        break;
    case WM_SYSCOMMAND:   // Alt pressed alone would enter the window menu loop, which stalls the game: Alt is a game key
        if ((w & 0xFFF0) == SC_KEYMENU && l == 0) { *res = 0; return 1; }
        break;
    case WM_KEYDOWN:   // Esc is unbound in the game layout: it releases the cursor and opens the menu (menu_window_msg)
        if (w == VK_ESCAPE && !(cur_rel & CUR_REL)) { cur_rel_update(rel_esc); cursor_update(h); }
        break;
    case WM_LBUTTONDOWN: case WM_RBUTTONDOWN: case WM_MBUTTONDOWN:   // client area only; poll_merged drops the click
        if (cur_rel & CUR_REL) { cur_rel_update(rel_clear); cursor_update(h); }
        break;
    case WM_MOUSEACTIVATE:   // sent before WM_ACTIVATEAPP: a title bar or border click must not capture
        if (LOWORD(l) != HTCLIENT) cur_rel_update(rel_title);
        break;
    case WM_ACTIVATEAPP:
        if (!w) cur_rel_update(rel_clear);   // Alt+Tab back in captures again
        InterlockedExchange(&cur_active, w != 0);
        cursor_update(h);
        break;
    case WM_SETFOCUS: case WM_KILLFOCUS: case WM_SIZE: case WM_MOVE:
        cursor_update(h);
        break;
    case WM_ENTERSIZEMOVE:
        input_cursor_suspend(1);
        break;
    case WM_EXITSIZEMOVE:
        input_cursor_suspend(0);
        break;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        InterlockedExchange(&cur_active, 0);
        cursor_update(h);
        break;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int key_down(int vk) { return (GetAsyncKeyState(vk) & 0x8000) != 0; }

// The mouse camera as a right-stick sample, held for the whole presented frame. Under `lock`.
static void mouse_camera(int32_t out[2]) {
    static uint64_t frame = ~0ull;
    static LARGE_INTEGER t0;
    static int32_t held[2];
    LARGE_INTEGER now, f;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&now);
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    if (!cur_captured) {
        InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dx, 0);
        InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dy, 0);
        held[0] = held[1] = 0;
        frame = ~0ull;
    } else {
        uint64_t fr = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        double age = frame == ~0ull ? 0 : (double)(now.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / (double)f.QuadPart;
        if (fr != frame) {
            double dt = age < 0.004 ? 0.004 : age > 0.1 ? 0.1 : age;
            input_mouse_stick(InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dx, 0), InterlockedExchange(&mouse_dy, 0), dt, mouse_sens_get(), held);
            frame = fr;
            t0 = now;
        } else if (age > 0.1) {
            held[0] = held[1] = 0;   // frames stopped: do not hold a deflection
        }
    }
    out[0] = held[0];
    out[1] = held[1];
}

static float stick_dead = -1;              // TOTK_STICK_DEADZONE as a fraction of full deflection; live (cfg_version)
static unsigned stick_dead_seen;

static float stick_dead_get(void) {
    unsigned ver = cfg_version();
    if (stick_dead >= 0 && ver == stick_dead_seen) return stick_dead;
    stick_dead_seen = ver;
    double v = cfg_double("TOTK_STICK_DEADZONE");
    stick_dead = (float)(v < 0 ? 0 : v > 50 ? 50 : v) / 100.f;
    return stick_dead;
}

// One gamepad stick through the dead zone; SDL's Y grows downwards, the Switch's upwards.
static void stick(SDL_GamepadAxis ax, SDL_GamepadAxis ay, float dead, int32_t out[2]) {
    input_pad_stick(SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, ax), -(int32_t)SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, ay), dead, out);
}

// Open the first gamepad when none is open or the open one went away; logs once per change.
static void scan_pads(void) {
    if (pad && SDL_GamepadConnected(pad)) return;
    if (pad) {
        SDL_CloseGamepad(pad); pad = NULL; sensor_pad = 0; sensor_ok = 0;
        InterlockedExchange(&pad_layout_shown, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) InterlockedExchange(&pad_labels[i], PAD_LABEL_NONE);
        rt_log("input: gamepad disconnected");
    }
    int n = 0;
    SDL_JoystickID *ids = SDL_GetGamepads(&n);
    for (int i = 0; ids && i < n && !pad; i++) pad = SDL_OpenGamepad(ids[i]);
    SDL_free(ids);
    if (!pad) return;
    pad_rumble = SDL_GetBooleanProperty(SDL_GetGamepadProperties(pad), SDL_PROP_GAMEPAD_CAP_RUMBLE_BOOLEAN, false);
    pad_east_a = SDL_GetGamepadButtonLabel(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST) == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_A;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        SDL_GamepadButtonLabel lb = SDL_GetGamepadButtonLabel(pad, pad_sdl[PAD_SOUTH + i]);
        InterlockedExchange(&pad_labels[i], lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_A          ? PAD_LABEL_A
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_B        ? PAD_LABEL_B
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_X        ? PAD_LABEL_X
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_Y        ? PAD_LABEL_Y
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_CROSS    ? PAD_LABEL_CROSS
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_CIRCLE   ? PAD_LABEL_CIRCLE
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_SQUARE   ? PAD_LABEL_SQUARE
                                            : lb == SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LABEL_TRIANGLE ? PAD_LABEL_TRIANGLE
                                                                                      : PAD_LABEL_NONE);
    }
    pad_layout = -1;
    int motion = SDL_GamepadHasSensor(pad, SDL_SENSOR_GYRO) && SDL_GamepadHasSensor(pad, SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL);
    rt_log("input: gamepad \"%s\" (%s, %s, east button %s)", SDL_GetGamepadName(pad), pad_rumble ? "rumble" : "no rumble",
           motion ? "gyro and accelerometer" : "no motion sensors", pad_east_a ? "labelled A" : "not labelled A");
}

// Under lock: the layout of the open gamepad, picked again when a setting or the gamepad changed; logs each change.
static int pad_layout_get(void) {
    unsigned ver = cfg_version();
    if (pad_layout >= 0 && ver == pad_layout_seen) return pad_layout;
    pad_layout_seen = ver;
    int was = pad_layout;
    const char *set = cfg_value("TOTK_PAD_LAYOUT");
    pad_layout = input_pad_layout_pick(set, pad_east_a);
    if (pad_layout != was)
        rt_log("input: gamepad layout %s (pad_layout = %s)", pad_layout == PAD_LAYOUT_XBOX ? "xbox" : "nintendo", set);
    InterlockedExchange(&pad_layout_shown, pad_layout);
    return pad_layout;
}

// The TOTK_BIND_* values last applied, one per line; the tables are built again when one changes (the menu's remapping rows write
// them while the game runs). Under lock.
static unsigned binds_seen = ~0u;
static char binds_applied[4096];

static void binds_refresh(void) {
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (v == binds_seen) return;
    binds_seen = v;
    char now[sizeof binds_applied];
    size_t len = 0;
    for (int a = 0; a < ACTION_COUNT; a++) {
        char var[32];
        snprintf(var, sizeof var, "TOTK_BIND_%s", input_action_name(a));
        const char *s = cfg_get(var);
        len += (size_t)snprintf(now + len, len < sizeof now ? sizeof now - len : 0, "%s\n", s ? s : "");
    }
    if (!strcmp(now, binds_applied)) return;
    memcpy(binds_applied, now, sizeof now);
    input_map_configure();
}

// TOTK_TEST_PAD=<lx>,<ly>,<rx>,<ry> (test runs): an SDL virtual gamepad whose sticks rest at these raw SDL axis values
// (-32768..32767, down is +y), attached before the first scan so it is the gamepad the game reads: drift and full
// deflection go through the same mapping and dead zone as a real pad.
static void test_pad_attach(void) {
    static SDL_Joystick *joy;   // kept open: a virtual joystick's axes are set through an open handle
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_TEST_PAD");
    int v[4];
    if (!e || !*e) return;
    if (sscanf(e, "%d,%d,%d,%d", &v[0], &v[1], &v[2], &v[3]) != 4) {
        rt_log("input: TOTK_TEST_PAD=%s is not <lx>,<ly>,<rx>,<ry>; no test gamepad", e);
        return;
    }
    SDL_VirtualJoystickDesc d;
    SDL_INIT_INTERFACE(&d);
    d.type = SDL_JOYSTICK_TYPE_GAMEPAD;
    d.naxes = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_COUNT;
    d.nbuttons = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_COUNT;
    d.name = "TotK test gamepad";
    SDL_JoystickID id = SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(&d);
    joy = id ? SDL_OpenJoystick(id) : NULL;
    if (!joy) {
        rt_log("input: test gamepad not attached (%s)", SDL_GetError());
        return;
    }
    static const SDL_GamepadAxis axes[4] = {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX,
                                            SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(joy, axes[i], (Sint16)(v[i] < -32768 ? -32768 : v[i] > 32767 ? 32767 : v[i]));
    rt_log("input: test gamepad attached, sticks at %d,%d %d,%d", v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]);
}

static void start(void) {
    binds_refresh();
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_INPUT");
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "none")) { state = -1; rt_log("input: disabled (TOTK_INPUT=none)"); return; }
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD)) { state = -1; rt_log("input: SDL gamepad init failed (%s), keyboard only", SDL_GetError()); }
    else state = 1;
    if (state == 1) test_pad_attach();
    if (state == 1) {
        scan_pads();
        if (!pad) rt_log("input: no gamepad (keyboard only until one is connected)");
    }
    if (state == -1) state = 2;   // keyboard only
}

static void stick_bits(uint64_t *b, int32_t x, int32_t y, int first) {
    if (x < -STICK_DIR) *b |= 1ull << (first + 0);
    if (y > STICK_DIR) *b |= 1ull << (first + 1);
    if (x > STICK_DIR) *b |= 1ull << (first + 2);
    if (y < -STICK_DIR) *b |= 1ull << (first + 3);
}

static void pick(int32_t *x, int32_t *y, int32_t kx, int32_t ky) {
    int64_t a = (int64_t)*x * *x + (int64_t)*y * *y, b = (int64_t)kx * kx + (int64_t)ky * ky;
    if (b > a) { *x = kx; *y = ky; }
}

// Under lock, state 1: the open gamepad's inputs by position (pd[PAD_*] != 0 held); 0 without a connected gamepad.
static int pad_physical(uint8_t pd[PAD_COUNT]) {
    if ((!pad || !SDL_GamepadConnected(pad)) && GetTickCount64() >= next_scan) { next_scan = GetTickCount64() + RESCAN_MS; scan_pads(); }
    SDL_UpdateGamepads();
    if (!pad || !SDL_GamepadConnected(pad)) return 0;
    for (int p = PAD_SOUTH; p < PAD_ZL; p++) pd[p] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, pad_sdl[p]);
    pd[PAD_ZL] = SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER) > TRIGGER_ON;
    pd[PAD_ZR] = SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER) > TRIGGER_ON;
    for (int p = PAD_ZR + 1; p < PAD_COUNT; p++) pd[p] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, pad_sdl[p]);   // false without paddles
    return 1;
}

// Under lock, state 1: the open gamepad's buttons (Switch bits after TOTK_PAD_LAYOUT and the TOTK_BIND_* lines) and
// sticks; 0 without a connected gamepad.
static int pad_read(uint64_t *b, int32_t sl[2], int32_t sr[2]) {
    uint8_t pd[PAD_COUNT] = {0};
    if (!pad_physical(pd)) return 0;
    *b |= input_map_pad_buttons(pd, pad_layout_get());
    float dead = stick_dead_get();
    stick(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, dead, sl);
    stick(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY, dead, sr);
    return 1;
}

static void poll_merged(uint64_t *buttons, int32_t *lx, int32_t *ly, int32_t *rx, int32_t *ry) {
    uint64_t b = 0;
    int32_t sl[2] = {0, 0}, sr[2] = {0, 0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!state) start();
    if (state > 0) {
        binds_refresh();
        if (state == 1) pad_read(&b, sl, sr);
        HWND w = gfx_window_handle();
        if (w && w == GetForegroundWindow()) {
            uint8_t down[KEY_COUNT] = {0};
            // Mouse buttons count only while the cursor is captured, and a button already held when the capture began
            // (the click that refocused the window) is ignored until it is released.
            static int was_captured;
            static uint8_t mouse_ignore[KEY_COUNT];
            int cap = cur_captured != 0;
            for (int k = 1; k < KEY_COUNT; k++) {
                int vk = key_vk(k);
                down[k] = vk && key_down(vk);
                if (k < KEY_MOUSE_L || k > KEY_MOUSE_X2) continue;
                if (cap && !was_captured) mouse_ignore[k] = down[k];
                if (!down[k]) mouse_ignore[k] = 0;
                if (!cap || mouse_ignore[k]) down[k] = 0;
            }
            was_captured = cap;
            b |= input_map_buttons(down);
            int32_t k[2];
            input_map_stick(down, 0, k);
            pick(&sl[0], &sl[1], k[0], k[1]);
            input_map_stick(down, 1, k);
            pick(&sr[0], &sr[1], k[0], k[1]);
            mouse_camera(k);
            pick(&sr[0], &sr[1], k[0], k[1]);
        }
    }
    script_apply(&b, sl, sr);
    rec_apply(b, sl, sr);
    // Minus and Plus held together (gamepad or keys) open or close the menu and never reach the game
    static int combo_held;
    int32_t st[4] = {sl[0], sl[1], sr[0], sr[1]};
    int toggle = input_menu_gate(&combo_held, menu_is_open(), &b, st);
    sl[0] = st[0], sl[1] = st[1], sr[0] = st[2], sr[1] = st[3];
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (toggle) menu_toggle();
    stick_bits(&b, sl[0], sl[1], B_SL_LEFT);
    stick_bits(&b, sr[0], sr[1], B_SR_LEFT);
    *buttons = b; *lx = sl[0]; *ly = sl[1]; *rx = sr[0]; *ry = sr[1];
}

// Text entry (swkbd_win.c): while it is open the game reads no input, as behind the keyboard applet; after it closes
// the game reads none until every button and stick direction is released, so the press that closed it stays there.
// g_block (above): 0 off, 1 text entry open, 2 closed, waiting for the release. The cursor is released while it is open.
void input_block(int on) {
    InterlockedExchange(&g_block, on ? 1 : 2);
    cursor_update(gfx_window_handle());
}

// The in-game menu (ui/menu.cpp) blocks the game's input the same way: g_menu 0 closed, 1 open, 2 closed, waiting for
// the release. The cursor is released while it is open, for the menu's mouse.
void input_menu(int open) {
    InterlockedExchange(&g_menu, open ? 1 : 2);
    if (!open) cur_rel_update(rel_menu_closed);   // the capture before Esc comes back
    cursor_update(gfx_window_handle());
}

// 1 while flag (g_block, g_menu) blocks the game's input; state 2 ends at the first poll with nothing held.
static int blocked(volatile LONG *flag, uint64_t buttons) {
    LONG k = *flag;
    return k && !(k == 2 && !buttons && InterlockedCompareExchange(flag, 0, 2) == 2);
}

void input_poll(uint64_t *buttons, int32_t *lx, int32_t *ly, int32_t *rx, int32_t *ry) {
    poll_merged(buttons, lx, ly, rx, ry);
    int text = blocked(&g_block, *buttons), menu = blocked(&g_menu, *buttons);
    if (!text && !menu) return;
    *buttons = 0; *lx = *ly = *rx = *ry = 0;
}

void input_poll_ui(uint64_t *buttons, int32_t *lx, int32_t *ly, int32_t *rx, int32_t *ry) {
    poll_merged(buttons, lx, ly, rx, ry);
}

int input_pad_read(uint64_t *buttons, int32_t *lx, int32_t *ly) {
    uint64_t b = 0;
    int32_t sl[2] = {0, 0}, sr[2] = {0, 0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!state) start();
    if (state > 0) binds_refresh();
    int ok = state == 1 && pad_read(&b, sl, sr);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    *buttons = b;
    *lx = sl[0];
    *ly = sl[1];
    return ok;
}

uint16_t rumble_motor(float a, float curve, float strength) {
    if (!(a > 0) || !(strength > 0)) return 0;
    float v = powf(a > 1 ? 1 : a, curve) * strength * 65535.0f + 0.5f;
    return v >= 65535.0f ? 65535 : (uint16_t)v;
}

int input_pad_layout(void) {
    return (int)InterlockedCompareExchange(&pad_layout_shown, 0, 0);
}

int input_pad_label(int pad_id) {
    if (pad_id < PAD_SOUTH || pad_id > PAD_NORTH) return PAD_LABEL_NONE;
    return (int)InterlockedCompareExchange(&pad_labels[pad_id - PAD_SOUTH], 0, 0);
}

void input_map_snapshot(InputMap *m) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!state) start();
    if (state > 0) binds_refresh();
    *m = input_map;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

int input_capture(int reset, int *id) {
    static uint8_t prev_k[KEY_COUNT], prev_p[PAD_COUNT];
    static int prev_esc;
    uint8_t k[KEY_COUNT] = {0}, p[PAD_COUNT] = {0};
    HWND w = gfx_window_handle();
    int fg = w && w == GetForegroundWindow();
    for (int i = 1; i < KEY_COUNT; i++) k[i] = fg && key_down(key_vk(i));
    int esc = fg && key_down(VK_ESCAPE);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!state) start();
    if (state == 1) pad_physical(p);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    int got = INPUT_CAPTURE_NONE;
    if (!reset) {
        if (esc && !prev_esc) got = INPUT_CAPTURE_CANCEL;
        for (int i = 1; i < KEY_COUNT && !got; i++)
            if (k[i] && !prev_k[i]) got = INPUT_CAPTURE_KEY, *id = i;
        for (int i = 1; i < PAD_COUNT && !got; i++)
            if (p[i] && !prev_p[i]) got = INPUT_CAPTURE_PAD, *id = i;
    }
    memcpy(prev_k, k, sizeof k);
    memcpy(prev_p, p, sizeof p);
    prev_esc = esc;
    return got;
}

int input_rumble_triggers_enabled(void) {
    return cfg_bool("TOTK_RUMBLE_TRIGGERS");
}

int input_rumble(uint16_t low, uint16_t high, uint32_t ms) {
    int ok = 0;
    static int triggers = -1;
    static unsigned seen;
    if (triggers < 0 || seen != cfg_version()) seen = cfg_version(), triggers = input_rumble_triggers_enabled();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (state == 1 && pad && pad_rumble) {
        ok = SDL_RumbleGamepad(pad, low, high, ms);
        if (triggers) SDL_RumbleGamepadTriggers(pad, high, high, ms);   // unsupported pads return false: ignored
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    return ok;
}

// SDL gamepad sensor axes (SDL_sensor.h, a gamepad held in front of you): x to the right, y up out of the face (lying
// flat face up, +y points at the ceiling), z toward the player (out of the bottom edge). The accelerometer reads the
// push against gravity in m/s^2 (lying flat: y = +9.81); the gyro reads rad/s, counter-clockwise positive (right hand).
// Switch six-axis axes (nn::hid, as MacNativeGames' GCMotion feed and its Pro Controller HID path use them): x to the
// right, y toward the top edge (away from the player), z out of the face; acceleration as gravity reads (lying flat:
// z = -1 G). So Switch x = SDL x, Switch y = -SDL z, Switch z = SDL y: a rotation (right-handed to right-handed), so the
// gyro keeps its sense, while the acceleration is also negated (push -> gravity) and scaled to G.
void input_motion_axes(const float a[3], const float g[3], double acc[3], double gyro[3]) {
    acc[0] = -a[0] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    acc[1] = a[2] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    acc[2] = -a[1] / SDL_STANDARD_GRAVITY;
    gyro[0] = g[0];
    gyro[1] = -g[2];
    gyro[2] = g[1];
}

// Under lock: (re)enable the sensors when the open gamepad changed; 1 if it has both and they are on.
static int sensors_ready(void) {
    SDL_JoystickID id = SDL_GetGamepadID(pad);
    if (id == sensor_pad) return sensor_ok;
    sensor_pad = id;
    // Nothing drains the SDL event queue: no event per sample (the data still updates, SDL_SendJoystickSensor)
    SDL_SetEventEnabled(SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_SENSOR_UPDATE, false);
    sensor_ok =SDL_GamepadHasSensor(pad, SDL_SENSOR_GYRO) && SDL_GamepadHasSensor(pad, SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL) &&
                SDL_SetGamepadSensorEnabled(pad, SDL_SENSOR_GYRO, true) &&
                SDL_SetGamepadSensorEnabled(pad, SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL, true);
    if (sensor_ok) rt_log("input: motion sensors on (gyro %.0f Hz, accelerometer %.0f Hz)",
                          (double)SDL_GetGamepadSensorDataRate(pad, SDL_SENSOR_GYRO),
                          (double)SDL_GetGamepadSensorDataRate(pad, SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL));
    else rt_log("input: \"%s\" has no gyro and accelerometer: the six-axis sensor reads a controller at rest",
                SDL_GetGamepadName(pad));
    return sensor_ok;
}

int input_motion_enabled(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    static unsigned seen;
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (on < 0 || v != seen) {
        seen = v;
        on = cfg_bool("TOTK_MOTION");
    }
    return on;
}

// 250 Hz: the gamepads update (reports read, rumble expiry) and the newest gyro and accelerometer sample goes into the
// fusion. Without a gamepad with sensors, or with motion off (TOTK_MOTION=0, live), nothing is fed and the six-axis
// sensor reads at rest.
static DWORD WINAPI motion_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    for (;;) {
        if (timer) {
            LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -40000};   // 4 ms
            SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE);
            WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
        } else Sleep(4);
        float a[3], g[3];
        int have = 0;
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        if (pad && SDL_GamepadConnected(pad)) {
            SDL_UpdateGamepads();
            have = sensors_ready() && SDL_GetGamepadSensorData(pad, SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL, a, 3) &&
                   SDL_GetGamepadSensorData(pad, SDL_SENSOR_GYRO, g, 3);
        }
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        if (!have || !input_motion_enabled()) continue;
        double acc[3], gyro[3];
        input_motion_axes(a, g, acc, gyro);
        motion_feed(motion_global(), acc, gyro, kern_now_ns());
    }
    return 0;
}

void input_motion_start(void) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!state) start();
    if (!motion_thread) {
        if (!input_motion_enabled()) rt_log("input: motion off (TOTK_MOTION=0); it can be turned on while the game runs");
        if (state != 1) motion_thread = -1;
        else {
            HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, motion_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
            if (!h) rt_fatal("input: motion thread CreateThread failed (error %lu)", GetLastError());
            CloseHandle(h);
            motion_thread = 1;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

```

`runtime/ipc.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/ipc.c @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors). Message framing per libnx sf/hipc.h, cmif.h, tipc.h (ISC), read for the layout only.
// In-process Horizon IPC: SVCs 0x15, 0x1F, 0x21, 0x22, the sm: service manager
// and the service table. The SDK client code runs unchanged: requests are read from the calling thread's message
// buffer (TLR, or the user buffer of 0x22) and answered in place. Unknown ports, services and commands stop with their
// name and id instead of returning a fake success. Also --probe-ipc.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "audren.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "ipc.h"

#define CMIF_IN_MAGIC 0x49434653u    // "SFCI"
#define CMIF_OUT_MAGIC 0x4f434653u   // "SFCO"
#define POINTER_BUFFER_SIZE 0x8000
#define R_INVALID_SIZE 0xCA01u
#define R_INVALID_ADDRESS 0xCC01u

enum { T_CLOSE = 2, T_REQUEST = 4, T_CONTROL = 5, T_REQUEST_CTX = 6, T_CONTROL_CTX = 7, T_TIPC_CLOSE = 15,
       T_TIPC_BASE = 16 };

// Services sm: hands out. Anything else is a named fatal.
static const struct { const char *name; IpcHandler handler; } services[] = {
    {"audren:u", audren_manager_handler},
};

static volatile long g_live;
static volatile long long g_released, g_requests;
static _Thread_local const Cpu *t_req;   // guest context of the request being served

long ipc_sessions_live(void) { return InterlockedCompareExchange(&g_live, 0, 0); }
uint64_t ipc_sessions_released(void) { return (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&g_released, 0, 0); }

// ---- sessions
uint32_t ipc_session_new(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, void *state, void (*close)(void *state)) {
    IpcSession *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s);
    if (!s) rt_fatal("ipc: session allocation");
    *s = (IpcSession){name, handler, state, close, 1};
    InterlockedIncrement(&g_live);
    return kern_handle_new(KERN_SESSION, s);
}

static uint32_t session_clone(IpcSession *s) {
    InterlockedIncrement(&s->refs);
    return kern_handle_new(KERN_SESSION, s);
}

void ipc_handle_closed(int kind, void *obj) {
    if (kind == KERN_TMEM) {
        free(obj);
        return;
    }
    if (kind != KERN_SESSION) rt_fatal("ipc_handle_closed: handle kind %d", kind);
    IpcSession *s = obj;
    if (InterlockedDecrement(&s->refs)) return;
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_IPC) rt_log("ipc: %s closed", s->name);
    if (s->close) s->close(s->state);
    free(s);
    InterlockedDecrement(&g_live);
    InterlockedIncrement64(&g_released);
}

// ---- helpers for services
static int readable(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) return 0;
    if (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) return 0;
    return a + n <= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
}

void ipc_backtrace(void) {
    const Cpu *c = t_req;
    if (!c) return;
    char d[160];
    rt_logf("  ipc request from %s\n", ldr_describe(c->x[30], d, sizeof d));
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    for (int n = 0; n < 24 && fp && !(fp & 7) && readable(fp, 16); n++) {
        uint64_t next = LD64(fp), lr = LD64(fp + 8);
        rt_logf("  guest frame %2d: %s\n", n, ldr_describe(lr, d, sizeof d));
        if (next <= fp || next - fp > (64u << 20)) break;
        fp = next;
    }
}

void *ipc_guest(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if ((!addr && size) || addr + size < addr || addr + size > RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT) {
        ipc_backtrace();
        rt_fatal("ipc: client buffer %#llx+%#llx", (unsigned long long)addr, (unsigned long long)size);
    }
    return (void *)(uintptr_t)addr;
}

const void *ipc_arg(const IpcRequest *rq, uint32_t off, uint32_t n) {
    if (off + n > rq->data_size) {
        ipc_backtrace();
        rt_fatal("ipc: command %u argument %u+%u beyond %u bytes", rq->cmd, off, n, rq->data_size);
    }
    return rq->data + off;
}

void ipc_out(IpcResponse *rs, const void *p, uint32_t n) {
    if (rs->data_size + n > sizeof rs->data) rt_fatal("ipc: response larger than %u bytes", (unsigned)sizeof rs->data);
    memcpy(rs->data + rs->data_size, p, n);
    rs->data_size += n;
}

void ipc_unimplemented(const IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq) {
    fflush(stdout);
    rt_logf("ipc: %s command %u (type %u, data %u bytes, x%u a%u b%u w%u c%u, copy %u move %u)\n", s->name,
            rq->cmd, rq->type, rq->data_size, rq->nx, rq->na, rq->nb, rq->nw, rq->nc, rq->ncopy, rq->nmove);
    ipc_backtrace();
    rt_fatal("ipc: %s command %u is not implemented", s->name, rq->cmd);
}

// ---- HIPC framing
static uint64_t static_addr(const uint32_t *d) {
    return d[1] | ((uint64_t)((d[0] >> 12) & 0xf) << 32) | ((uint64_t)((d[0] >> 6) & 0x3f) << 36);
}
static uint64_t buffer_addr(const uint32_t *d) {
    return d[1] | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 28) & 0xf) << 32) | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 2) & 0x3fffff) << 36);
}
static uint64_t buffer_size(const uint32_t *d) { return d[0] | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 24) & 0xf) << 32); }

static void parse(const uint32_t *m, IpcRequest *rq, const uint32_t **data_words, unsigned *ndata) {
    memset(rq, 0, sizeof *rq);
    rq->type = m[0] & 0xffff;
    rq->nx = (m[0] >> 16) & 0xf;
    rq->na = (m[0] >> 20) & 0xf;
    rq->nb = (m[0] >> 24) & 0xf;
    rq->nw = (m[0] >> 28) & 0xf;
    *ndata = m[1] & 0x3ff;
    unsigned recv_mode = (m[1] >> 10) & 0xf, special = m[1] >> 31;
    if (rq->nx > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->na > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->nb > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->nw > IPC_MAX_BUF)
        rt_fatal("ipc: too many buffers (x%u a%u b%u w%u)", rq->nx, rq->na, rq->nb, rq->nw);
    const uint32_t *p = m + 2;
    if (special) {
        uint32_t h = *p++;
        rq->has_pid = h & 1;
        rq->ncopy = (h >> 1) & 0xf;
        rq->nmove = (h >> 5) & 0xf;
        if (rq->ncopy > 8 || rq->nmove > 8) rt_fatal("ipc: too many handles (copy %u move %u)", rq->ncopy, rq->nmove);
        if (rq->has_pid) {
            memcpy(&rq->pid, p, 8);
            p += 2;
        }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->ncopy; i++) rq->copy[i] = *p++;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nmove; i++) rq->move[i] = *p++;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nx; i++, p += 2) rq->x[i] = (IpcBuffer){static_addr(p), p[0] >> 16, p[0] & 0x3f};
    IpcBuffer *lists[3] = {rq->a, rq->b, rq->w};
    unsigned counts[3] = {rq->na, rq->nb, rq->nw};
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < counts[k]; i++, p += 3) lists[k][i] = (IpcBuffer){buffer_addr(p), buffer_size(p), i};
    *data_words = p;
    const uint32_t *recv = p + *ndata;
    rq->nc = recv_mode == 2 ? 1 : recv_mode > 2 ? recv_mode - 2 : 0;
    if (rq->nc > IPC_MAX_BUF) rt_fatal("ipc: %u receive buffers", rq->nc);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nc; i++, recv += 2)
        rq->c[i] = (IpcBuffer){recv[0] | ((uint64_t)(recv[1] & 0xffff) << 32), recv[1] >> 16, i};
    if ((const uint8_t *)recv - (const uint8_t *)m > IPC_MSG_BYTES) rt_fatal("ipc: request exceeds the message buffer");
}

static void respond(uint32_t *m, int tipc, const IpcResponse *rs) {
    uint32_t out[IPC_MSG_BYTES / 4];
    memset(out, 0, sizeof out);
    unsigned special = rs->ncopy || rs->nmove;
    uint32_t *p = out + 2;
    if (special) {
        *p++ = (rs->ncopy << 1) | (rs->nmove << 5);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->ncopy; i++) *p++ = rs->copy[i];
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->nmove; i++) *p++ = rs->move[i];
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->nxout; i++, p += 2) {
        uint64_t a = rs->xout[i].addr;
        p[0] = (rs->xout[i].index & 0x3f) | (uint32_t)(((a >> 36) & 0x3f) << 6) | (uint32_t)(((a >> 32) & 0xf) << 12) |
               (uint32_t)(rs->xout[i].size << 16);
        p[1] = (uint32_t)a;
    }
    uint8_t *words = (uint8_t *)p, *payload;
    unsigned header = tipc ? 4 : 16;
    payload = tipc ? words : (uint8_t *)out + (((words - (uint8_t *)out) + 15) & ~15);
    unsigned used = (unsigned)(payload - words) + header + rs->data_size;
    unsigned nwords = tipc ? (used + 3) / 4 : (used + 16 + 3) / 4;   // CMIF keeps alignment slack like libnx
    if ((size_t)(words - (uint8_t *)out) + nwords * 4 > IPC_MSG_BYTES) rt_fatal("ipc: response exceeds the message buffer");
    if (tipc) memcpy(payload, &rs->result, 4);
    else {
        uint32_t h[4] = {CMIF_OUT_MAGIC, 0, rs->result, 0};
        memcpy(payload, h, 16);
    }
    memcpy(payload + header, rs->data, rs->data_size);
    out[0] = (rs->nxout & 0xf) << 16;
    out[1] = (nwords & 0x3ff) | (special ? 1u << 31 : 0);
    memcpy(m, out, IPC_MSG_BYTES);
}

// CMIF control requests. Domains are not implemented: MNG boots 1.2.1 without them.
static void control(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 3: { uint16_t n = POINTER_BUFFER_SIZE; IPC_OUT(rs, n); return; }   // QueryPointerBufferSize
    case 2: case 4: rs->move[rs->nmove++] = session_clone(s); return;          // CloneCurrentObject(Ex)
    default:
        ipc_backtrace();
        rt_fatal("ipc: %s control command %u is not implemented (domains are not served)", s->name, rq->cmd);
    }
}

static void dispatch(IpcSession *s, uint32_t *m) {
    IpcRequest rq;
    const uint32_t *words;
    unsigned ndata;
    parse(m, &rq, &words, &ndata);
    if (rq.type == T_CLOSE || rq.type == T_TIPC_CLOSE) return;
    InterlockedIncrement64(&g_requests);
    IpcResponse rs;
    memset(&rs, 0, sizeof rs);
    int tipc = rq.type >= T_TIPC_BASE;
    const uint8_t *bytes = (const uint8_t *)words, *end = bytes + ndata * 4;
    if (tipc) {
        rq.cmd = rq.type - T_TIPC_BASE;
        rq.data = bytes;
        rq.data_size = (uint32_t)(end - bytes);
    } else if (rq.type == T_REQUEST || rq.type == T_REQUEST_CTX || rq.type == T_CONTROL || rq.type == T_CONTROL_CTX) {
        const uint8_t *payload = (const uint8_t *)m + (((bytes - (const uint8_t *)m) + 15) & ~15);
        uint32_t h[4];
        memcpy(h, payload, 16);
        if (h[0] != CMIF_IN_MAGIC) {
            ipc_backtrace();
            rt_fatal("ipc: %s: CMIF magic %#x (domain sessions are not served)", s->name, h[0]);
        }
        rq.cmd = h[2];
        rq.data = payload + 16;
        rq.data_size = payload + 16 <= end ? (uint32_t)(end - payload - 16) : 0;
    } else {
        fflush(stdout);
        rt_logf("ipc: %s message type %u:", s->name, rq.type);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; i++) rt_logf(" %08x", m[i]);
        rt_log_raw("\n", 1);
        ipc_backtrace();
        rt_fatal("ipc: %s message type %u is not implemented", s->name, rq.type);
    }
    if (rq.type == T_CONTROL || rq.type == T_CONTROL_CTX) control(s, &rq, &rs);
    else s->handler(s, &rq, &rs);
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_IPC) {
        char d[160];
        rt_log("ipc: %s %s %u -> %#x (copy %u move %u) from %s", s->name,
               tipc ? "tipc" : rq.type == T_CONTROL || rq.type == T_CONTROL_CTX ? "control" : "cmd", rq.cmd,
               rs.result, rs.ncopy, rs.nmove, t_req ? ldr_describe(t_req->x[30], d, sizeof d) : "host");
    }
    respond(m, tipc, &rs);
}

// ---- sm: service manager (CMIF, and TIPC as the SDK's sm client speaks it since 12.0.0)
static void sm_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: return;   // RegisterClient / Initialize (pid)
    case 1: {         // GetServiceHandle(name)
        char name[9] = {0};
        memcpy(name, ipc_arg(rq, 0, 8), 8);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof services / sizeof *services; i++)
            if (!strcmp(services[i].name, name)) {
                rs->move[rs->nmove++] = ipc_session_new(services[i].name, services[i].handler, NULL, NULL);
                rt_log("ipc: opened service %s", services[i].name);
                return;
            }
        fflush(stdout);
        ipc_backtrace();
        rt_fatal("sm: service \"%s\" is not implemented", name);
    }
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}

// ---- SVCs
int ipc_svc(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm) {
    uint64_t *x = c->x;
    switch (imm) {
    case 0x1F: {   // ConnectToNamedPort(x1 name -> w1 handle)
        char name[13] = {0};
        const char *p = (const char *)(uintptr_t)x[1];
        if (!p || !readable(x[1], 1)) rt_fatal("ConnectToNamedPort: name at %#llx", (unsigned long long)x[1]);
        for (int i = 0; i < 12 && p[i]; i++) name[i] = p[i];
        if (strcmp(name, "sm:")) {
            t_req = c;
            ipc_backtrace();
            rt_fatal("ConnectToNamedPort(\"%s\"): only sm: is served", name);
        }
        x[0] = 0;
        x[1] = ipc_session_new("sm:", sm_handler, NULL, NULL);
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x21: case 0x22: {   // SendSyncRequest(w0 handle) / WithUserBuffer(x0 buffer, x1 size, w2 handle)
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(imm == 0x21 ? x[0] : x[2]);
        IpcSession *s = kern_handle_get(h, KERN_SESSION);
        if (!s) {
            rt_log("ipc: svc %#x on %#x, not a session handle", imm, h);
            x[0] = IPC_R_BAD_HANDLE;
            return 1;
        }
        uint32_t *m = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)(imm == 0x21 ? c->tpidrro : x[0]);
        if (!m || (imm == 0x22 && x[1] < IPC_MSG_BYTES))
            rt_fatal("ipc: svc %#x message buffer %p size %#llx", imm, (void *)m, (unsigned long long)x[1]);
        const Cpu *outer = t_req;
        t_req = c;
        dispatch(s, m);
        t_req = outer;
        x[0] = 0;
        return 1;
    }
    case 0x15: {   // CreateTransferMemory(x1 address, x2 size, w3 permission -> w1 handle)
        if ((x[1] & 0xfff) || x[1] + x[2] < x[1] || x[1] + x[2] > RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT) {
            x[0] = R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
            return 1;
        }
        if (!x[2] || (x[2] & 0xfff)) {
            x[0] = R_INVALID_SIZE;
            return 1;
        }
        IpcTransferMemory *t = malloc(sizeof *t);
        if (!t) rt_fatal("ipc: transfer memory allocation");
        *t = (IpcTransferMemory){x[1], x[2], (uint32_t)x[3]};
        x[0] = 0;
        x[1] = kern_handle_new(KERN_TMEM, t);
        return 1;
    }
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- --probe-ipc
// Hand-built CMIF/TIPC requests in the guest main thread's TLR go through rt_svc, the entry the lifted SVC wrappers
// use: sm: -> audren:u -> GetWorkBufferSize -> an audio renderer with the null mixer, whose frame event the probe
// times while it sends RequestUpdate every frame. A child process checks the unknown-service fatal.
#define PROBE_FRAMES 200
#define PROBE_CHILD_ENV "TOTK_PROBE_IPC_CHILD"
#define PROBE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE "lm"
#define H_CURRENT_PROCESS 0xFFFF8001u

static int failures;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("  FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } } while (0)

typedef struct {
    unsigned type, cmd, pid, ncopy, na, nb;
    uint32_t copy[4];
    IpcBuffer a[2], b[2];
    const void *data;
    uint32_t size;
} Msg;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t result, copy[8], move[8];
    unsigned ncopy, nmove;
    const uint8_t *data;
} Reply;

static uint32_t sv(Cpu *c, uint32_t imm, uint64_t a0, uint64_t a1, uint64_t a2, uint64_t a3) {
    c->x[0] = a0;
    c->x[1] = a1;
    c->x[2] = a2;
    c->x[3] = a3;
    rt_svc(c, imm, 0);
    return (uint32_t)c->x[0];
}

static uint32_t *put_buffer(uint32_t *p, IpcBuffer b) {
    p[0] = (uint32_t)b.size;
    p[1] = (uint32_t)b.addr;
    p[2] = (uint32_t)(((b.addr >> 36) & 0x3fffff) << 2) | (uint32_t)(((b.size >> 32) & 0xf) << 24) |
           (uint32_t)(((b.addr >> 32) & 0xf) << 28);
    return p + 3;
}

static void msg_build(uint32_t *m, const Msg *q) {
    memset(m, 0, IPC_MSG_BYTES);
    int tipc = q->type >= T_TIPC_BASE, special = q->pid || q->ncopy;
    m[0] = q->type | q->na << 20 | q->nb << 24;
    uint32_t *p = m + 2;
    if (special) {
        *p++ = (q->pid ? 1u : 0u) | q->ncopy << 1;
        if (q->pid) p += 2;   // the kernel fills the process id in
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < q->ncopy; i++) *p++ = q->copy[i];
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < q->na; i++) p = put_buffer(p, q->a[i]);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < q->nb; i++) p = put_buffer(p, q->b[i]);
    uint8_t *words = (uint8_t *)p;
    unsigned ndata;
    if (tipc) {
        memcpy(words, q->data, q->size);
        ndata = (q->size + 3) / 4;
    } else {
        uint8_t *payload = (uint8_t *)m + (((words - (uint8_t *)m) + 15) & ~15);
        uint32_t h[4] = {CMIF_IN_MAGIC, 0, q->cmd, 0};
        memcpy(payload, h, 16);
        if (q->size) memcpy(payload + 16, q->data, q->size);
        ndata = (16 + 16 + q->size + 3) / 4;   // libnx reserves the 16-byte alignment pad in the data size
    }
    m[1] = ndata | (special ? 1u << 31 : 0);
}

static void msg_parse(const uint32_t *m, int tipc, Reply *r) {
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    unsigned nx = (m[0] >> 16) & 0xf;
    const uint32_t *p = m + 2;
    if (m[1] >> 31) {
        uint32_t h = *p++;
        if (h & 1) p += 2;
        r->ncopy = (h >> 1) & 0xf;
        r->nmove = (h >> 5) & 0xf;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < r->ncopy; i++) r->copy[i] = *p++;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < r->nmove; i++) r->move[i] = *p++;
    }
    p += 2 * nx;
    if (tipc) {
        r->result = p[0];
        r->data = (const uint8_t *)(p + 1);
        return;
    }
    const uint8_t *payload = (const uint8_t *)m + ((((const uint8_t *)p - (const uint8_t *)m) + 15) & ~15);
    uint32_t h[4];
    memcpy(h, payload, 16);
    r->result = h[0] == CMIF_OUT_MAGIC ? h[2] : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    r->data = payload + 16;
}

// One request on the TLR message buffer; the kernel result of SendSyncRequest, the service result in r->result.
static uint32_t call(Cpu *c, uint32_t h, const Msg *q, Reply *r) {
    uint32_t *m = (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)c->tpidrro;
    msg_build(m, q);
    uint32_t k = sv(c, 0x21, h, 0, 0, 0);
    if (k) return k;
    msg_parse(m, q->type >= T_TIPC_BASE, r);
    return 0;
}

static uint32_t cmd(Cpu *c, uint32_t h, unsigned id, const void *data, uint32_t size, Reply *r) {
    Msg q = {.type = T_REQUEST, .cmd = id, .data = data, .size = size};
    uint32_t k = call(c, h, &q, r);
    return k ? k : r->result;
}

static uint32_t close_handle(Cpu *c, uint32_t h) { return sv(c, 0x16, h, 0, 0, 0); }

static uint32_t connect_sm(Cpu *c) {
    static const char port[] = "sm:";
    uint32_t r = sv(c, 0x1F, 0, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)port, 0, 0);
    CHECK(r == 0 && c->x[1], "ConnectToNamedPort(sm:) %#x", r);
    return (uint32_t)c->x[1];
}

static uint32_t get_service(Cpu *c, uint32_t sm, const char *name, int tipc) {
    char n[8] = {0};
    memcpy(n, name, strlen(name));
    Msg q = {.type = tipc ? T_TIPC_BASE + 1 : T_REQUEST, .cmd = 1, .data = n, .size = 8};
    Reply r;
    uint32_t k = call(c, sm, &q, &r);
    CHECK(!k && !r.result && r.nmove == 1, "%s GetServiceHandle(%s): kernel %#x result %#x move %u",
          tipc ? "TIPC" : "CMIF", name, k, r.result, r.nmove);
    return r.nmove ? r.move[0] : 0;
}

// A TotK-like renderer: 48 kHz, 240-sample (5 ms) frames, final mix plus submixes, two sinks, REV11.
static const AudrenParameter g_param = {
    .sample_rate = 48000, .sample_count = 240, .mix_buffer_count = 24, .submix_count = 8, .voice_count = 192,
    .sink_count = 2, .effect_count = 12, .revision = AUDREN_REV(11)};

typedef struct {
    uint8_t *in, *out, *perf;
    uint32_t in_size, out_total, voices_out;
    int16_t *pcm;
} Update;

static void update_build(Update *u, int first) {
    const AudrenParameter *p = &g_param;
    uint32_t npools = (uint32_t)p->effect_count + 4u * (uint32_t)p->voice_count, mc = (uint32_t)p->submix_count + 1;
    AudrenHeader h = {.revision = p->revision, .behavior = 0x10, .memory_pools = npools * sizeof(AudrenPoolIn),
                      .voices = (uint32_t)p->voice_count * sizeof(AudrenVoiceIn),
                      .effects = (uint32_t)p->effect_count * sizeof(AudrenEffectIn), .mixes = mc * sizeof(AudrenMixIn),
                      .sinks = (uint32_t)p->sink_count * sizeof(AudrenSinkIn), .performance = 0x10};
    h.total = sizeof h + h.behavior + h.memory_pools + h.voice_resources + h.voices + h.effects + h.splitters +
              h.mixes + h.sinks + h.performance + h.render_info;
    u->in_size = h.total;
    memset(u->in, 0, h.total);
    uint8_t *w = u->in;
    memcpy(w, &h, sizeof h);
    w += sizeof h + h.behavior + h.memory_pools + h.voice_resources;
    for (int i = 0; i < p->voice_count; i++) {
        AudrenVoiceIn v = {.id = (uint32_t)i};
        if (i == 0) {   // one PCM16 voice with a 100 ms buffer: consumed after 20 frames
            v = (AudrenVoiceIn){.id = 0, .is_new = (uint8_t)first, .in_use = 1, .play_state = PLAY_STARTED,
                                .sample_format = FMT_PCM16, .sample_rate = 48000, .channel_count = 1, .pitch = 1,
                                .volume = 1, .mix_id = 0, .splitter_id = 0xffffffffu, .wave_buffer_count = 1};
            v.wave_buffers[0] = (AudrenWaveBuffer){.address = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)u->pcm, .size = 4800 * 2,
                                                   .end = 4800, .sent = (uint8_t)!first};
            for (int k = 1; k < 4; k++) v.wave_buffers[k].sent = 1;
        }
        memcpy(w, &v, sizeof v);
        w += sizeof v;
    }
    w += h.effects + h.splitters;
    AudrenMixIn mix = {.volume = 1, .sample_rate = 48000, .buffer_count = 6, .in_use = 1, .dest_mix_id = 0x7fffffff,
                       .dest_splitter_id = 0xffffffffu};
    memcpy(w, &mix, sizeof mix);
    w += h.mixes;
    AudrenSinkIn sink = {.type = SINK_DEVICE, .in_use = 1, .input_count = 2, .inputs = {0, 1}};
    memcpy(w, &sink, sizeof sink);
    u->out_total = (uint32_t)sizeof h + npools * sizeof(AudrenPoolOut) + (uint32_t)p->voice_count * sizeof(AudrenVoiceOut) +
                   (uint32_t)p->effect_count * 0x90u + (uint32_t)p->sink_count * sizeof(AudrenSinkOut) + 0x10 +
                   AUDREN_BEHAVIOR_OUT + AUDREN_RENDER_INFO_OUT;
    u->voices_out = (uint32_t)sizeof h + npools * sizeof(AudrenPoolOut);
}

static uint32_t request_update(Cpu *c, uint32_t ren, Update *u, uint64_t *frames, AudrenVoiceOut *voice0) {
    Msg q = {.type = T_REQUEST, .cmd = 4, .na = 1, .nb = 2};
    q.a[0] = (IpcBuffer){(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)u->in, u->in_size, 0};
    q.b[0] = (IpcBuffer){(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)u->out, 0x8000, 0};
    q.b[1] = (IpcBuffer){(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)u->perf, 0x100, 1};
    Reply r;
    uint32_t k = call(c, ren, &q, &r);
    if (k || r.result) return k ? k : r.result;
    AudrenHeader o;
    memcpy(&o, u->out, sizeof o);
    if (o.revision != g_param.revision || o.total != u->out_total) return 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    memcpy(frames, u->out + o.total - AUDREN_RENDER_INFO_OUT, 8);
    memcpy(voice0, u->out + u->voices_out, sizeof *voice0);
    return 0;
}

static void probe_renderer(Cpu *c, uint32_t audren) {
    Reply r;
    // GetWorkBufferSize(AudioRendererParameterInternal) -> u64
    uint32_t res = cmd(c, audren, 1, &g_param, sizeof g_param, &r);
    uint64_t work = 0;
    if (!res) memcpy(&work, r.data, 8);
    printf("audren:u GetWorkBufferSize(48000 Hz x240, %d voices, %d submixes, %d effects, REV11) -> result %#x, "
           "%#llx bytes\n", g_param.voice_count, g_param.submix_count, g_param.effect_count, res,
           (unsigned long long)work);
    CHECK(!res && work >= 0x1000 && work < (256u << 20) && !(work & 0xfff), "GetWorkBufferSize");
    if (res || !work) return;

    // OpenAudioRenderer(param, pad, work size, aruid; pid; copy transfer memory, current process)
    uint8_t *wb = mem_kernel_alloc(work, 0x1000);
    uint32_t tm = 0;
    res = sv(c, 0x15, 0, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)wb, work, 0);
    tm = (uint32_t)c->x[1];
    CHECK(!res, "CreateTransferMemory %#x", res);
    struct { AudrenParameter p; uint32_t pad; uint64_t work, aruid; } open = {g_param, 0, work, 0};
    Msg q = {.type = T_REQUEST, .cmd = 0, .pid = 1, .ncopy = 2, .copy = {tm, H_CURRENT_PROCESS}, .data = &open,
             .size = sizeof open};
    long live0 = ipc_sessions_live();
    uint64_t released0 = ipc_sessions_released();
    uint32_t k = call(c, audren, &q, &r);
    CHECK(!k && !r.result && r.nmove == 1 && audren_renderers_live() == 1, "OpenAudioRenderer: kernel %#x result %#x",
          k, r.result);
    if (k || r.result || !r.nmove) return;
    uint32_t ren = r.move[0];
    int32_t rate = 0, count = 0;
    if (!cmd(c, ren, 0, NULL, 0, &r)) memcpy(&rate, r.data, 4);
    if (!cmd(c, ren, 1, NULL, 0, &r)) memcpy(&count, r.data, 4);
    CHECK(rate == 48000 && count == 240, "GetSampleRate %d, GetSampleCount %d", rate, count);
    res = cmd(c, ren, 7, NULL, 0, &r);   // QuerySystemEvent
    uint32_t ev = !res && r.ncopy == 1 ? r.copy[0] : 0;
    CHECK(ev, "QuerySystemEvent: result %#x, %u copy handles", res, r.ncopy);

    Update u = {mem_kernel_alloc(0x40000, 64), mem_kernel_alloc(0x8000, 64), mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 64), 0, 0, 0,
                mem_kernel_alloc(4800 * 2, 64)};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4800; i++) u.pcm[i] = (int16_t)(i * 7);
    uint64_t frames = ~0ull;
    AudrenVoiceOut v0 = {0};
    update_build(&u, 1);
    res = request_update(c, ren, &u, &frames, &v0);
    CHECK(!res && frames == 0, "RequestUpdate before Start: %#x, %llu frames", res, (unsigned long long)frames);
    update_build(&u, 0);
    CHECK(!cmd(c, ren, 5, NULL, 0, &r), "Start");
    uint32_t state = 1;
    if (!cmd(c, ren, 3, NULL, 0, &r)) memcpy(&state, r.data, 4);
    CHECK(state == 0, "GetState after Start: %u", state);

    // Every frame, as the game's audio thread does: wait for the event, clear it, RequestUpdate.
    uint32_t hs[1] = {ev};
    sv(c, 0x17, ev, 0, 0, 0);
    uint64_t t0 = 0, t1 = 0, f0 = 0, f1 = 0, worst = 0, prev = 0;
    int waits_ok = 0, updates_ok = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PROBE_FRAMES; i++) {
        uint32_t w = sv(c, 0x18, 0, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)hs, 1, 1000000000ull);
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        waits_ok += w == 0;
        sv(c, 0x17, ev, 0, 0, 0);
        uint64_t f = 0;
        updates_ok += request_update(c, ren, &u, &f, &v0) == 0;
        if (i == 0) t0 = now, f0 = f;
        if (i && now - prev > worst) worst = now - prev;
        prev = t1 = now;
        f1 = f;
    }
    double period = (double)(t1 - t0) / (PROBE_FRAMES - 1) / 1e6, expect = 1e3 * g_param.sample_count / g_param.sample_rate;
    double rendered = (double)(f1 - f0), elapsed = (double)(t1 - t0) / 1e6 / expect;
    printf("render tick: %d waits on the frame event (%d ok), %d RequestUpdate (%d ok); mean period %.3f ms (expect "
           "%.3f), worst gap %.3f ms; frames rendered %llu over %.1f periods\n", PROBE_FRAMES, waits_ok, PROBE_FRAMES,
           updates_ok, period, expect, (double)worst / 1e6, (unsigned long long)(f1 - f0), elapsed);
    CHECK(waits_ok == PROBE_FRAMES && updates_ok == PROBE_FRAMES, "event waits / updates");
    CHECK(period > expect * 0.9 && period < expect * 1.1, "frame event period %.3f ms", period);
    CHECK(rendered > elapsed - 3 && rendered < elapsed + 3, "frames rendered %.0f vs elapsed %.1f", rendered, elapsed);
    printf("voice 0 (PCM16, 4800 samples): played %llu, wave buffers consumed %u\n",
           (unsigned long long)v0.played_samples, v0.wave_buffers_consumed);
    CHECK(v0.played_samples == 4800 && v0.wave_buffers_consumed == 1, "voice clock with the null mixer");

    CHECK(!cmd(c, ren, 6, NULL, 0, &r), "Stop");
    if (!cmd(c, ren, 3, NULL, 0, &r)) memcpy(&state, r.data, 4);
    CHECK(state == 1, "GetState after Stop: %u", state);
    res = close_handle(c, ren);
    long live1 = ipc_sessions_live();
    uint64_t released1 = ipc_sessions_released();
    printf("CloseHandle(IAudioRenderer) -> %#x: sessions %ld -> %ld, released +%llu, renderers running %ld\n", res,
           live0 + 1, live1, (unsigned long long)(released1 - released0), audren_renderers_live());
    CHECK(!res && live1 == live0 && released1 == released0 + 1 && audren_renderers_live() == 0, "renderer close");
    CHECK(!close_handle(c, ev) && !close_handle(c, tm), "close event and transfer memory");
    mem_kernel_free(u.in, 0x40000);
    mem_kernel_free(u.out, 0x8000);
    mem_kernel_free(u.perf, 0x100);
    mem_kernel_free(u.pcm, 4800 * 2);
    mem_kernel_free(wb, work);
}

static void probe_main(Cpu *c) {
    Reply r;
    uint32_t sm = connect_sm(c);
    Msg reg = {.type = T_REQUEST, .cmd = 0, .pid = 1, .data = (const uint64_t[]){0}, .size = 8};
    uint32_t k = call(c, sm, &reg, &r);
    CHECK(!k && !r.result, "sm: RegisterClient: kernel %#x result %#x", k, r.result);
    uint32_t audren = get_service(c, sm, "audren:u", 0);
    uint32_t dup = get_service(c, sm, "audren:u", 1);
    printf("sm: connected, RegisterClient ok, GetServiceHandle(audren:u) -> %#x (CMIF), %#x (TIPC)\n", audren, dup);
    uint64_t released0 = ipc_sessions_released();
    CHECK(!close_handle(c, dup) && ipc_sessions_released() == released0 + 1, "CloseHandle(TIPC audren:u)");
    Msg qpb = {.type = T_CONTROL, .cmd = 3};
    k = call(c, audren, &qpb, &r);
    uint16_t pbs = 0;
    if (!k && !r.result) memcpy(&pbs, r.data, 2);
    CHECK(pbs == POINTER_BUFFER_SIZE, "QueryPointerBufferSize %#x", pbs);
    CHECK(sv(c, 0x21, 0x0fff, 0, 0, 0) == IPC_R_BAD_HANDLE, "SendSyncRequest on a bad handle");
    if (audren) probe_renderer(c, audren);
    CHECK(!close_handle(c, audren) && !close_handle(c, sm), "close audren:u and sm:");
    printf("sessions alive at the end: %ld, released %llu\n", ipc_sessions_live(),
           (unsigned long long)ipc_sessions_released());
    CHECK(ipc_sessions_live() == 0, "sessions leaked");
}

static void child_main(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t sm = connect_sm(c);
    get_service(c, sm, PROBE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE, 0);
    printf("child: GetServiceHandle(%s) returned\n", PROBE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE);
}

// Re-run this executable with the same arguments and PROBE_CHILD_ENV set; it must stop with the named fatal.
static void probe_unknown_service(void) {
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa = {sizeof sa, NULL, TRUE};
    HANDLE rd, wr;
    if (!CreatePipe(&rd, &wr, &sa, 0)) rt_fatal("probe-ipc: CreatePipe failed (error %lu)", GetLastError());
    SetHandleInformation(rd, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si, .dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, .hStdInput = GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE),
                       .hStdOutput = wr, .hStdError = wr};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    wchar_t *cmdline = _wcsdup(GetCommandLineW());
    SetEnvironmentVariableA(PROBE_CHILD_ENV, "1");
    BOOL ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, cmdline, NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    SetEnvironmentVariableA(PROBE_CHILD_ENV, NULL);
    free(cmdline);
    CloseHandle(wr);
    if (!ok) rt_fatal("probe-ipc: CreateProcessW failed (error %lu)", GetLastError());
    static char out[65536];
    DWORD n, len = 0;
    while (len < sizeof out - 1 && ReadFile(rd, out + len, (DWORD)(sizeof out - 1 - len), &n, NULL) && n) len += n;
    out[len] = 0;
    CloseHandle(rd);
    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, 30000);
    DWORD code = 0;
    GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code);
    CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    const char *want = "FATAL: sm: service \"" PROBE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE "\" is not implemented";
    const char *line = strstr(out, want);
    printf("child GetServiceHandle(%s): exit code %lu, %s\n", PROBE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE, (unsigned long)code,
           line ? "named fatal seen" : "named fatal MISSING");
    if (line) printf("  child: %.*s\n", (int)strcspn(line, "\r\n"), line);
    CHECK(code == 70 && line, "unknown service fatal (child output: %s)", out);
}

// ---- the game's own nn::audio client: main's PLT stubs -> lifted sdk -> SVCs -> this file
#define SYM_INIT_PARAM "_ZN2nn5audio32InitializeAudioRendererParameterEPNS0_22AudioRendererParameterE"
#define SYM_WORK_SIZE "_ZN2nn5audio30GetAudioRendererWorkBufferSizeERKNS0_22AudioRendererParameterE"
#define SYM_OPEN "_ZN2nn5audio17OpenAudioRendererEPNS0_19AudioRendererHandleEPNS_2os11SystemEventERKNS0_22AudioRendererParameterEPvm"
#define SYM_CONFIG_SIZE "_ZN2nn5audio36GetAudioRendererConfigWorkBufferSizeERKNS0_22AudioRendererParameterE"
#define SYM_CONFIG_INIT "_ZN2nn5audio29InitializeAudioRendererConfigEPNS0_19AudioRendererConfigERKNS0_22AudioRendererParameterEPvm"
#define SYM_START "_ZN2nn5audio18StartAudioRendererENS0_19AudioRendererHandleE"
#define SYM_STOP "_ZN2nn5audio17StopAudioRendererENS0_19AudioRendererHandleE"
#define SYM_UPDATE "_ZN2nn5audio26RequestUpdateAudioRendererENS0_19AudioRendererHandleEPKNS0_19AudioRendererConfigE"
#define SYM_FRAMES "_ZN2nn5audio33GetAudioRendererElapsedFrameCountEPKNS0_19AudioRendererConfigE"
#define SYM_CLOSE "_ZN2nn5audio18CloseAudioRendererENS0_19AudioRendererHandleE"
#define SYM_WAIT_EVENT "_ZN2nn2os15WaitSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeE"

static int revision_number_of(uint32_t rev) { return (int)(rev >> 24) - '0'; }

static uint64_t stub(const char *sym) {
    uint64_t a = ldr_plt_stub("main", sym);
    if (!a) rt_fatal("probe-ipc: no PLT stub for %s in main", sym);
    return a;
}

// Without nn::init::Start the SDK's own initialisation has not run; the probe sets up the two things the audio client
// path reads (found by running it):
// - the "current thread object" at TLR+0x1F8 is the kernel's zeroed placeholder. SdkMutex compares its lock tag with
//   ThreadType+0x1B0 (sdk+0x13186c), which nnosInitialize sets to the thread's handle; a zero there makes every free
//   mutex look owned by the caller (__cxa_guard_acquire in nn::sm::Initialize aborts);
// - sdk's full DT_INIT needs nn::os initialised (its TLS slot constructor reaches ThreadManager), which is the boot
//   sequence's job. The audio client only needs its two sf heap constructors: 16 KiB ExpHeaps on static buffers,
//   stored at sdk+0xd37e90 and sdk+0xd3bec0 (CreateAudioRendererManagerByHipc reads the second). The 1.4.3 SDK creates
//   that heap lazily; its OpenAudioRenderer takes nn::audio::detail::g_RendererResourceSemaphore first, which the
//   constructor at sdk+0x221fb0 initializes (two renderers).
static void sdk_prepare(Cpu *c) {
    Cpu *again;
    ST32(LD64(c->tpidrro + 0x1F8) + 0x1B0, kern_main_thread(&again));
    const RtLoaded *sdk = ldr_module(2);
    static const uint64_t ctors_121[] = {0x1dcbd0, 0x1de8a0}, ctors_143[] = {0x221fb0};
    const uint64_t *heap_ctors = RT_V143 ? ctors_143 : ctors_121;
    unsigned nctors = RT_V143 ? sizeof ctors_143 / sizeof *ctors_143 : sizeof ctors_121 / sizeof *ctors_121;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < nctors; k++) {
        int found = 0;
        for (uint64_t e = 0; e < sdk->init_array_size; e += 8)
            found |= LD64(sdk->init_array + e) == sdk->base + heap_ctors[k];
        if (!found) rt_fatal("probe-ipc: sdk+%#llx is not an sdk constructor", (unsigned long long)heap_ctors[k]);
        rt_call(c, sdk->base + heap_ctors[k], 0);
    }
}

static void probe_sdk_client(Cpu *c) {
    unsigned trace = rt_trace;
    rt_trace |= RT_TRACE_IPC;   // log the requests the SDK sends during set-up
    sdk_prepare(c);
    uint64_t requests0 = (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&g_requests, 0, 0);
    uint64_t released0 = ipc_sessions_released();
    int32_t *param = mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 64);
    rt_call(c, stub(SYM_INIT_PARAM), 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)param);
    printf("sdk: InitializeAudioRendererParameter -> %d Hz x%d, mix buffers %d, revision word %#x (REV%d)\n", param[0],
           param[1], param[2], (uint32_t)param[13], revision_number_of((uint32_t)param[13]));
    CHECK(param[0] == 48000 && param[1] == 240 && (uint32_t)param[13] == AUDREN_REV(RT_V143 ? 15 : 11),
          "SDK default parameter (TotK 1.2.1 builds REV11 requests, 1.4.3 REV15)");
    param[2] = g_param.mix_buffer_count, param[3] = g_param.submix_count, param[4] = g_param.voice_count;
    param[5] = g_param.sink_count, param[6] = g_param.effect_count;
    uint64_t work = rt_call(c, stub(SYM_WORK_SIZE), 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)param);
    printf("sdk: GetAudioRendererWorkBufferSize -> %#llx (service %#x + client part)\n", (unsigned long long)work,
           AUDREN_WORK_BUFFER_BYTES);
    CHECK(work >= AUDREN_WORK_BUFFER_BYTES && work < (64u << 20), "SDK GetAudioRendererWorkBufferSize %#llx",
          (unsigned long long)work);
    uint8_t *wb = mem_kernel_alloc(work, 0x1000), *event = mem_kernel_alloc(0x100, 64);
    uint64_t *handle = mem_kernel_alloc(0x40, 64);   // AudioRendererHandle: 16 bytes, passed in x0 and x1
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)rt_call(c, stub(SYM_OPEN), 5, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)handle, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)event,
                                   (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)param, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)wb, work);
    printf("sdk: OpenAudioRenderer -> %#x, renderers running %ld\n", r, audren_renderers_live());
    CHECK(!r && handle[0] && audren_renderers_live() == 1, "SDK OpenAudioRenderer %#x", r);
    if (r) return;
    uint64_t csize = rt_call(c, stub(SYM_CONFIG_SIZE), 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)param);
    uint8_t *cbuf = mem_kernel_alloc(csize, 0x1000), *config = mem_kernel_alloc(0x200, 64);
    rt_call(c, stub(SYM_CONFIG_INIT), 4, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)config, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)param,
            (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cbuf, csize);
    rt_call(c, stub(SYM_START), 2, handle[0], handle[1]);
    uint64_t t0 = 0, t1 = 0;
    int bad = 0, f0 = 0, f1 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PROBE_FRAMES; i++) {
        rt_call(c, stub(SYM_WAIT_EVENT), 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)event);
        uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
        bad += rt_call(c, stub(SYM_UPDATE), 3, handle[0], handle[1], (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)config) != 0;
        int f = (int)rt_call(c, stub(SYM_FRAMES), 1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)config);
        if (!i) t0 = now, f0 = f;
        t1 = now, f1 = f;
        rt_trace = trace;   // the first update is logged, the rest is quiet
    }
    double period = (double)(t1 - t0) / (PROBE_FRAMES - 1) / 1e6;
    printf("sdk: %d x WaitSystemEvent + RequestUpdateAudioRenderer: %d failed, mean period %.3f ms, elapsed frames "
           "%d -> %d\n", PROBE_FRAMES, bad, period, f0, f1);
    CHECK(!bad && period > 4.5 && period < 5.5 && f1 - f0 >= PROBE_FRAMES - 4 && f1 - f0 <= PROBE_FRAMES + 2,
          "SDK render loop");
    rt_call(c, stub(SYM_STOP), 2, handle[0], handle[1]);
    rt_call(c, stub(SYM_CLOSE), 2, handle[0], handle[1]);
    uint64_t requests = (uint64_t)InterlockedCompareExchange64(&g_requests, 0, 0) - requests0;
    printf("sdk: CloseAudioRenderer: renderers running %ld, sessions released +%llu; %llu requests served for the "
           "lifted client (sm: kept open by the SDK: %ld session)\n", audren_renderers_live(),
           (unsigned long long)(ipc_sessions_released() - released0), (unsigned long long)requests,
           ipc_sessions_live());
    // The 1.2.1 SDK closes the renderer, device and manager sessions and keeps sm; the 1.4.3 SDK keeps the
    // audren:u manager it created lazily, beside sm.
    CHECK(audren_renderers_live() == 0 && ipc_sessions_released() - released0 >= (RT_V143 ? 1u : 3u) &&
              ipc_sessions_live() == (RT_V143 ? 2 : 1),
          "SDK CloseAudioRenderer");
    rt_trace = trace;
}

static void guest_main(Cpu *c) {
    probe_main(c);
    probe_sdk_client(c);
}

int probe_ipc(void) {
    if (getenv(PROBE_CHILD_ENV)) {
        kern_run_on_guest_main(child_main);
        return 0;
    }
    ldr_load(rt_config()->exefs);
    kern_run_on_guest_main(guest_main);
    probe_unknown_service();
    RtStats s = rt_stats();
    printf("stats: %llu SVCs, %llu threads, %llu host calls\n", (unsigned long long)s.svcs,
           (unsigned long long)s.threads, (unsigned long long)s.host_calls);
    if (failures) {
        printf("probe-ipc: FAILED (%d failures)\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("probe-ipc: passed\n");
    return 0;
}

```

`runtime/ipc.h`:

```h
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/ipc.h @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors). Message framing per libnx sf/hipc.h, cmif.h, tipc.h (ISC), read for the layout only.
// In-process Horizon IPC: HIPC messages with CMIF or TIPC payloads, answered in
// place in the caller's message buffer. Services are host implementations looked up by name through sm:.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#include "host.h"

#define IPC_MAX_BUF 8
#define IPC_MSG_BYTES 0x100
#define IPC_R_BAD_HANDLE 0xE401u           // kernel: invalid handle
#define IPC_R_UNKNOWN_COMMAND 0xF601u      // sf: unknown command (module 10, description 123)

typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; unsigned index; } IpcBuffer;

typedef struct {
    unsigned type, cmd;                    // HIPC type (4/5/6/7 CMIF, >= 16 TIPC) and command id
    int has_pid;
    uint64_t pid;
    uint32_t copy[8], move[8];
    unsigned ncopy, nmove;
    IpcBuffer x[IPC_MAX_BUF], a[IPC_MAX_BUF], b[IPC_MAX_BUF], w[IPC_MAX_BUF], c[IPC_MAX_BUF];
    unsigned nx, na, nb, nw, nc;
    const uint8_t *data;                   // command arguments after the CMIF header (TIPC: after the HIPC header)
    uint32_t data_size;
} IpcRequest;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t result;
    uint8_t data[0x100];
    uint32_t data_size;
    uint32_t copy[8], move[8];
    unsigned ncopy, nmove;
    IpcBuffer xout[IPC_MAX_BUF];           // pointer data the service placed into the client's C buffers
    unsigned nxout;
} IpcResponse;

typedef struct IpcSession IpcSession;
typedef void (*IpcHandler)(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs);

// One server object. Every kernel handle to it (the first one, CloneCurrentObject copies) holds a reference; the
// last CloseHandle calls close(state).
struct IpcSession {
    const char *name;
    IpcHandler handler;
    void *state;
    void (*close)(void *state);
    long refs;
};

uint32_t ipc_session_new(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, void *state, void (*close)(void *state));   // handle
void ipc_out(IpcResponse *rs, const void *p, uint32_t n);
const void *ipc_arg(const IpcRequest *rq, uint32_t off, uint32_t n);
void *ipc_guest(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);   // a client buffer as a host pointer (identity map), range checked
__attribute__((noreturn)) void ipc_unimplemented(const IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq);
#define IPC_OUT(rs, v) ipc_out((rs), &(v), sizeof(v))
#define IPC_ARG(rq, T, off) (*(const T *)ipc_arg((rq), (off), sizeof(T)))

// Transfer memory from svcCreateTransferMemory (0x15), a KERN_TMEM handle object.
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; uint32_t perm; } IpcTransferMemory;

// Server objects alive now and closed so far (the probe checks CloseHandle releases them).
long ipc_sessions_live(void);
uint64_t ipc_sessions_released(void);

// The guest frame chain of the request being served, for fatal reports from services.
void ipc_backtrace(void);

```

`runtime/kernel.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/threads.c @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors; itself from d2r-mobile dm/host/hle_thread.c), d2r-mobile dm/host/thread.c @ 53e7c5b (MIT, Copyright
// (c) 2026 jhaizhou) and LAS Recomp runtime/kernel.c @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai); the preemption of
// virtual cores from MacNativeGames threads.c @ 33e8fa8 (MIT, as above).
// Threads, synchronization, virtual cores and fibers of the Horizon kernel.
//
// One guest thread = one Windows thread with a 256 MiB reserved host stack (every guest BL is a host call) and its own
// Cpu. The SDK's nn::os runs as lifted code; only the kernel under it is the host. Every wait hangs on one global lock
// G with one condition variable per thread; wake order is the kernel's: lower priority value first, then first come.
// Semantics follow the public Horizon kernel (KConditionVariable, KAddressArbiter, KSynchronization).
#include <windows.h>
#define __USE_MINGW_SETJMP_NON_SEH   // setjmp(b) = _setjmp(b, NULL): longjmp restores registers, no SEH unwinding
#include <setjmp.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#define R_OK 0u
#define R_TIMEOUT KERN_R_TIMEOUT
#define R_CANCELLED KERN_R_CANCELLED
#define R_BAD_HANDLE KERN_R_BAD_HANDLE
#define R_BAD_STATE KERN_R_BAD_STATE
#define R_INVALID_ENUM KERN_R_INVALID_ENUM
#define WAITERS_BIT KERN_WAITERS_BIT
#define H_CUR_THREAD KERN_H_CURRENT_THREAD

#define MAX_H 4096
#define NCORE 3
#define HOST_STACK (256ull << 20)        // reserved, committed on demand
#define TLR_SIZE 0x200
#define THREAD_OBJ_SIZE 0x400            // "current thread object" at TLR+0x1F8 (d2r-mobile thread.c)
#define TLS_SIZE 0x2000
#define MAIN_STACK (1ull << 20)          // main.npdm META+0x1C
#define MAIN_PRIO 44                     // META+0xE
#define MAIN_CORE 0                      // META+0xF
#define FIBER_MAX 1024

enum { O_FREE, O_THREAD, O_EVENT_R, O_EVENT_W, O_SESSION = KERN_SESSION, O_TMEM = KERN_TMEM };
_Static_assert(O_EVENT_W < O_SESSION, "handle kinds");
enum { W_NONE = KERN_WAIT_NONE, W_LOCK = KERN_WAIT_LOCK, W_CONDVAR = KERN_WAIT_CONDVAR, W_ADDRESS = KERN_WAIT_ADDRESS,
       W_SYNC = KERN_WAIT_SYNC };

// Scheduler accounting states (TOTK_TRACE=sched).
enum { S_OFF, S_RUN, S_CORE, S_HOST, S_SLEEP, S_SYNC, S_CV, S_LOCK, S_ADDR, S_N };
static const char *const s_name[S_N] = {"off", "run", "core", "host", "sleep", "sync", "cv", "lock", "addr"};

typedef struct Event { int signaled, refs; } Event;
typedef struct Fiber Fiber;

struct RtThread {
    int preempt;               // first member: rt_dispatch reads it (host.h kern_preempt_pending)
    int host_depth;            // second member: host calls and SVCs in progress, while kern_host_track (host.h)
    uint32_t handle;
    uint64_t id;
    Cpu *cpu;                  // the thread's own context
    Cpu *cur;                  // the context running now: cpu, or the current fiber's
    uint64_t entry, arg, stack_top;
    int prio, core;
    uint64_t mask;
    int started, exited, closed, cancel, is_main;
    CONDITION_VARIABLE cv;
    // current wait
    int wkind, woke;
    uint64_t waddr, wkey;
    uint32_t wtag, wres;
    uint64_t wseq;             // registration order: equal priority wakes first come first
    RtThread *next;            // wait list
    RtThread *all;             // every thread
    // virtual core
    int cur_core;              // core held while running guest code, -1 while blocked
    uint64_t cseq;
    RtThread *cnext;
    uint8_t *tlr, *tls;
    jmp_buf exit_jmp;          // the thread start; ExitThread longjmps to it
    // fibers
    void *base_fiber;          // the host thread as a host fiber, after the first switch
    Fiber *fiber;              // current guest fiber, NULL on the thread's own context
```
