```c
static int by_host(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uintptr_t x = ((const FnRev *)a)->host, y = ((const FnRev *)b)->host;
    return x < y ? -1 : x > y;
}

// The lifted function that contains a host code address, by the nearest function start below it.
static uint64_t lifted_function(uintptr_t rip) {
    if (!fn_rev) {
        static RtModule mods[MAX_MODULES];
        int n = rt_linked_modules(mods, MAX_MODULES);
        uint64_t total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) total += mods[i].count;
        fn_rev = malloc((total ? total : 1) * sizeof *fn_rev);
        if (!fn_rev) return 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (uint64_t k = 0; k < mods[i].count; k++)
                fn_rev[fn_rev_n++] = (FnRev){(uintptr_t)mods[i].fns[k], mods[i].addrs[k]};
        qsort(fn_rev, fn_rev_n, sizeof *fn_rev, by_host);
    }
    uint64_t lo = 0, hi = fn_rev_n;
    while (lo < hi) {
        uint64_t mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (fn_rev[mid].host <= rip) lo = mid + 1;
        else hi = mid;
    }
    return lo ? fn_rev[lo - 1].guest : 0;
}

static int readable(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mbi, sizeof mbi) || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT) return 0;
    if (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD)) return 0;
    return a + n <= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
}

static LONG CALLBACK crash_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    static volatile LONG busy;
    DWORD code = ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionCode;
    if (code != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && code != EXCEPTION_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION &&
        code != EXCEPTION_INT_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO && code != EXCEPTION_PRIV_INSTRUCTION && code != EXCEPTION_STACK_OVERFLOW &&
        code != EXCEPTION_IN_PAGE_ERROR)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uintptr_t rip = (uintptr_t)ep->ContextRecord->Rip;
    HMODULE self = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    MODULEINFO mi;
    if (!GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), self, &mi, sizeof mi) || rip - (uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll >= mi.SizeOfImage)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;   // not our code: leave it to the handler that expects it
    if (InterlockedExchange(&busy, 1)) ExitProcess(71);
    char d[160];
    rt_logf("FATAL: exception %#lx at host %p (totk.exe+%#llx)", code, (void *)rip,
            (unsigned long long)(rip - (uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll));
    if (code == EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION && ep->ExceptionRecord->NumberParameters >= 2)
        rt_logf(", %s address %#llx",
                ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] == 1 ? "writing" : ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[0] == 8 ? "executing" : "reading",
                (unsigned long long)ep->ExceptionRecord->ExceptionInformation[1]);
    rt_log_raw("\n", 1);
    uint64_t f = lifted_function(rip);
    if (f) rt_logf("  in lifted function f_%llx = %s\n", (unsigned long long)f, ldr_describe(f, d, sizeof d));
    Cpu *c = kern_cpu();
    if (c) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++)
            rt_logf("  x%-2d %016llx%s", i, (unsigned long long)c->x[i], i % 4 == 3 ? "\n" : "");
        rt_logf("  sp  %016llx\n  pc  %016llx  lr %s\n", (unsigned long long)c->sp, (unsigned long long)c->pc,
                ldr_describe(c->x[30], d, sizeof d));
        uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
        for (int n = 0; n < 32 && fp && !(fp & 7) && readable(fp, 16); n++) {
            uint64_t next = LD64(fp), lr = LD64(fp + 8);
            rt_logf("  guest frame %2d: %s\n", n, ldr_describe(lr, d, sizeof d));
            if (next <= fp || next - fp > (64u << 20)) break;
            fp = next;
        }
    } else {
        rt_logf("  not on a guest thread\n");
    }
    fflush(stderr);
    ExitProcess(71);
}

// ---- self-test: layout, dispatch table, host-function registry, without game files
static int failures;
#define CHECK(cond, ...) do { if (!(cond)) { failures++; printf("  FAIL: " __VA_ARGS__); putchar('\n'); } } while (0)

static double now_s(void) {
    LARGE_INTEGER t, f;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    return (double)t.QuadPart / (double)f.QuadPart;
}

static volatile int host_probe_hits;
static void host_probe(Cpu *c) { host_probe_hits++; c->x[0] = 42; }

static void check_cpu(void) {
    __builtin_cpu_init();
    int ok = __builtin_cpu_supports("avx2") && __builtin_cpu_supports("fma") && __builtin_cpu_supports("bmi2");
    printf("cpu: x86-64-v3 (AVX2, FMA, BMI2) %s\n", ok ? "present" : "MISSING");
    CHECK(ok, "the lifted code is built for x86-64-v3");
}

// Layout: ascending, no overlap, below 2^39, and inside the window mem_init reserved.
static void check_layout(void) {
    const RtLayoutEntry *lay = rt_layout;
    int n = rt_layout_count;
    printf("layout: %d modules\n", n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        printf("  %-8s base %#llx  size %#10llx  end %#llx\n", lay[i].name, (unsigned long long)lay[i].base,
               (unsigned long long)lay[i].size, (unsigned long long)(lay[i].base + lay[i].size));
        CHECK(lay[i].size > 0, "%s has size 0", lay[i].name);
        CHECK(lay[i].base % 0x10000 == 0, "%s base is not 64 KiB aligned", lay[i].name);
        CHECK(lay[i].base + lay[i].size <= RT_KERNEL_BASE, "%s reaches into the kernel region", lay[i].name);
        if (i) {
            CHECK(lay[i].base > lay[i - 1].base, "%s base is not above %s", lay[i].name, lay[i - 1].name);
            CHECK(lay[i - 1].base + lay[i - 1].size <= lay[i].base, "%s overlaps %s", lay[i - 1].name, lay[i].name);
        }
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        int ours = VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)lay[i].base, &mbi, sizeof mbi) && mbi.State == MEM_RESERVE &&
                   (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.AllocationBase <= lay[i].base;
        CHECK(ours, "%s is not inside the reserved module window", lay[i].name);
    }
    const RtGuestLayout *g = mem_layout();
    printf("guest memory: aslr %#llx+%#llx stack %#llx heap %#llx alias %#llx+%#llx kernel %#llx host functions %#llx\n",
           (unsigned long long)g->aslr.base, (unsigned long long)g->aslr.size, (unsigned long long)g->stack.base,
           (unsigned long long)g->heap.base, (unsigned long long)g->alias.base, (unsigned long long)g->alias.size,
           (unsigned long long)g->kernel.base, (unsigned long long)g->hostfn.base);
    CHECK(g->alias.base + g->alias.size <= lay[0].base && g->heap.base + g->heap.size <= g->alias.base,
          "guest regions overlap");
}

// Every function start dispatches to its own function. The word after a start (unless that is a start too), a
// misaligned address and the word below the module dispatch to nothing.
static void check_modules(const RtModule *mods, int n) {
    uint64_t total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const RtModule *m = &mods[i];
        const RtLayoutEntry *l = NULL;
        for (int k = 0; k < rt_layout_count; k++)
            if (!strcmp(rt_layout[k].name, m->name)) l = &rt_layout[k];
        CHECK(l && l->base == m->base && l->size == m->size, "%s: linked base/size differ from the layout", m->name);

        uint64_t bad = 0, bad_neg = 0;
        for (uint64_t k = 0; k < m->count; k++) {
            uint64_t a = m->addrs[k];
            if (rt_dispatch_lookup(a) != m->fns[k] && bad++ < 5)
                printf("  FAIL: %s_fn_addrs[%llu] %#llx does not dispatch to its function\n", m->name,
                       (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)a);
            int next_is_start = k + 1 < m->count && m->addrs[k + 1] == a + 4;
            if ((!next_is_start && rt_dispatch_lookup(a + 4)) || rt_dispatch_lookup(a + 2)) bad_neg++;
        }
        if (rt_dispatch_lookup(m->base - 4)) bad_neg++;
        failures += bad > 0;
        CHECK(!bad_neg, "%s: %llu addresses that are not function starts dispatch to a function", m->name,
              (unsigned long long)bad_neg);
        uint64_t lo = m->count ? m->addrs[0] : 0, hi = m->count ? m->addrs[m->count - 1] : 0;
        printf("  %-8s %8llu functions, first %#llx, last %#llx: %s\n", m->name, (unsigned long long)m->count,
               (unsigned long long)lo, (unsigned long long)hi, bad || bad_neg ? "FAIL" : "ok");
        total += m->count;
    }
    printf("  total    %8llu functions\n", (unsigned long long)total);
}

static void bench(const RtModule *mods, int n) {
    uint64_t total = 0, sink = 0;
    double t0 = now_s();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (uint64_t k = 0; k < mods[i].count; k++) sink += (uintptr_t)rt_dispatch_lookup(mods[i].addrs[k]);
        total += mods[i].count;
    }
    double dt = now_s() - t0;
    __asm__ volatile("" ::"r"(sink));
    if (total) printf("lookup: %.1f ns per function start (address order)\n", dt * 1e9 / (double)total);
}

// Memory SVCs without modules: heap, physical memory in the alias region, a stack move, QueryMemory, GetInfo.
static void check_memory(void) {
    const RtGuestLayout *g = mem_layout();
    RtMemoryInfo q;
    uint64_t heap = 0, v = 0;
    int before = failures;
    CHECK(mem_set_heap_size(0x400000, &heap) == 0 && heap == g->heap.base, "SetHeapSize 4 MiB");
    memset((void *)(uintptr_t)heap, 0xAB, 0x400000);
    mem_query(heap + 0x1000, &q);
    CHECK(q.base == heap && q.size == 0x400000 && q.state == 5 && q.perm == 3, "QueryMemory on the heap");
    CHECK(mem_set_heap_size(0x300000, &heap) != 0, "SetHeapSize accepts a size that is not a 2 MiB multiple");

    uint64_t a = g->alias.base + 0x100000;
    CHECK(mem_map_physical(a, 0x10000) == 0, "MapPhysicalMemory");
    ST64(a + 0x8000, 0x1234);
    CHECK(mem_map_physical(a - 0x4000, 0x20000) == 0 && LD64(a + 0x8000) == 0x1234,
          "MapPhysicalMemory over a mapped range lost its contents");
    mem_query(a, &q);
    CHECK(q.base == a - 0x4000 && q.size == 0x20000 && q.state == 5, "QueryMemory on mapped alias pages");
    mem_info(7, &v);
    CHECK(v == 0x400000 + 0x20000, "GetInfo 7 (used memory) %#llx", (unsigned long long)v);

    uint64_t stack = g->stack.base + 0x100000;
    ST64(a + 8, 0x99);
    CHECK(mem_map(stack, a, 0x4000) == 0 && LD64(stack + 8) == 0x99, "MapMemory alias -> stack did not copy");
    ST64(stack + 0x10, 0x5678);
    mem_query(stack, &q);
    CHECK(q.base == stack && q.size == 0x4000 && q.state == 0xB, "QueryMemory on a moved stack");
    mem_query(a, &q);
    CHECK(q.base == a && q.state == 5 && q.perm == 0, "QueryMemory on a moved stack's source");
    CHECK(mem_unmap_physical(a, 0x4000) != 0, "UnmapPhysicalMemory under a moved stack");
    CHECK(mem_unmap(stack, a, 0x4000) == 0 && LD64(a + 0x10) == 0x5678, "UnmapMemory did not copy the stack back");

    CHECK(mem_unmap_physical(a - 0x4000, 0x20000) == 0, "UnmapPhysicalMemory");
    mem_query(a, &q);
    CHECK(q.state == 0 && q.base == g->alias.base && q.size == g->alias.size, "QueryMemory on the free alias region");
    CHECK(mem_map_physical(a, 0x1000) == 0 && LD64(a + 0x10) == 0 && mem_unmap_physical(a, 0x1000) == 0,
          "remapped physical memory is not zeroed");
    CHECK(mem_map_physical(a, 0x100000000ull) == 0x10801, "MapPhysicalMemory beyond the pool is not LimitReached");
    mem_query(RT_HOSTFN_BASE + 0x40, &q);
    CHECK(q.state == 0x10 && q.base == RT_HOSTFN_BASE, "QueryMemory on the host-function window");
    mem_query(g->alias.base + g->alias.size + 0x1000, &q);
    CHECK(q.state == 3 && q.base == g->alias.base + g->alias.size, "QueryMemory on host memory");
    CHECK(mem_set_heap_size(0, &heap) == 0, "SetHeapSize 0");
    printf("memory: heap, physical memory, stack move, QueryMemory, GetInfo: %s\n", failures > before ? "FAIL" : "ok");
}

static int selftest(void) {
    static RtModule mods[MAX_MODULES];
    int n = rt_linked_modules(mods, MAX_MODULES);

    check_cpu();
    check_layout();
    uint64_t probe = hostfn_register("<selftest probe>", host_probe);

    double t0 = now_s();
    hostfn_seal();
    double dt = now_s() - t0;
    RtDispatchStats s = rt_dispatch_stats();
    printf("dispatch: %d modules linked, table covers %#llx-%#llx: %llu slots, %.1f MiB reserved, built in %.0f ms\n",
           n, (unsigned long long)s.lo, (unsigned long long)s.hi, (unsigned long long)s.slots,
           (double)s.table_bytes / (1 << 20), dt * 1e3);
    check_modules(mods, n);
    CHECK(s.functions > 0, "no functions linked");
    Cpu *c = _aligned_malloc(sizeof(Cpu), 64);
    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
    uint64_t r = rt_call(c, probe, 1, (uint64_t)7);
    CHECK(rt_dispatch_lookup(probe) && r == 42 && host_probe_hits == 1 && c->x[30] == 0,
          "a registered host function does not dispatch through rt_call");
    CHECK(!rt_dispatch_lookup(probe + 16), "an unregistered host-function address dispatches");
    CHECK(rt_dispatch_lookup(RT_RET_HOST), "the rt_call return sentinel is not registered");
    _aligned_free(c);
    bench(mods, n);

    void *k1 = mem_kernel_alloc(0x200, 16), *k2 = mem_kernel_alloc(0x2000, 0x1000);
    CHECK((uintptr_t)k1 - RT_KERNEL_BASE < RT_KERNEL_SIZE && !((uintptr_t)k2 & 0xFFF) && k1 != k2,
          "kernel-region allocation");
    mem_kernel_free(k1, 0x200);
    CHECK(mem_kernel_alloc(0x200, 16) == k1, "a freed kernel-region block is not reused");
    check_memory();

    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS pmc = {.cb = sizeof pmc};
    if (GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &pmc, sizeof pmc))
        printf("process: peak working set %.1f MiB\n", (double)pmc.PeakWorkingSetSize / (1 << 20));
    printf("selftest: %s (%d failures)\n", failures ? "FAILED" : "passed", failures);
    return failures ? 1 : 0;
}

static int usage(const char *argv0) {
    fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s [--exefs DIR] [--romfs DIR] [--profile DIR] [--selftest | --probe-loader | "
                    "--probe-cfg | --probe-dpi | --probe-kernel | --probe-ipc | --probe-services | --probe-fs | --probe-gfx-abi | "
                    "--probe-nvn | --probe-nvn-tex | --probe-window | --probe-shader | --probe-vkmem | "
                    "--probe-vkexec | --probe-astc | --probe-movie | --prepare-shaders | --warm-shaders | --boot |--seconds S [--shot PNG]]\n", argv0);
    return 2;
}

// Paths for a copied folder (tools/package_build.py). Per path: TOTK_EXEFS, TOTK_ROMFS, TOTK_PROFILE_DIR, else the
// folder next to totk.exe (exefs, romfs, profile) if it exists, else the path baked in at build time. A relative
// value is relative to totk.exe's folder.
static char pp_exefs[MAX_PATH * 2], pp_romfs[MAX_PATH * 2], pp_profile[MAX_PATH * 2];

static const char *portable_path(const char *dir, const char *var, const char *sub, const char *must, char *out, size_t cap,
                                 const char *fallback) {
    const char *e = cfg_get(var);
    if (e && *e) {
        int abs_path = e[0] == '\\' || e[0] == '/' || e[1] == ':';
        if (abs_path) snprintf(out, cap, "%s", e);
        else snprintf(out, cap, "%s\\%s", dir, e);
        return out;
    }
    char probe[MAX_PATH * 3];
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s\\%s", dir, sub);
    snprintf(probe, sizeof probe, "%s\\%s", out, must);
    return GetFileAttributesA(probe) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES ? out : fallback;
}

static void portable_paths(RtConfig *c) {
    char exe[MAX_PATH * 2];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameA(NULL, exe, sizeof exe);
    char *cut = n && n < sizeof exe ? strrchr(exe, '\\') : NULL;
    if (!cut) return;
    *cut = 0;
    c->exefs = portable_path(exe, "TOTK_EXEFS", "exefs", "main.npdm", pp_exefs, sizeof pp_exefs, c->exefs);
    c->romfs = portable_path(exe, "TOTK_ROMFS", "romfs", "romfs.bin", pp_romfs, sizeof pp_romfs, c->romfs);
    c->profile = portable_path(exe, "TOTK_PROFILE_DIR", "profile", ".", pp_profile, sizeof pp_profile, c->profile);
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    mem_init();   // first: claim the guest address space before anything else can land there; reads totk.ini
    setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    setvbuf(stderr, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(0, crash_handler);
    parse_trace();
    prof_start();
    // Timed guest waits (kernel.c block_inner) sleep in whole milliseconds; at the default 15.6 ms tick a 1 ms wait
    // costs a full tick. TOTK_TIMER_1MS=0 keeps the default for comparison.
    if (cfg_bool("TOTK_TIMER_1MS")) timeBeginPeriod(1);
    cfg = (RtConfig){.exefs = rt_default_exefs, .romfs = rt_default_romfs, .profile = rt_default_profile,
                     .gpu = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU")};
    portable_paths(&cfg);   // command-line paths below still win
    if (cfg.gpu && strcmp(cfg.gpu, "null") && strcmp(cfg.gpu, "vulkan")) {
        rt_logf("TOTK_GPU must be null or vulkan, not '%s'\n", cfg.gpu);
        return 2;
    }
    const char *mode = NULL;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        const char **path = !strcmp(argv[i], "--exefs") ? &cfg.exefs : !strcmp(argv[i], "--romfs") ? &cfg.romfs
                          : !strcmp(argv[i], "--profile") ? &cfg.profile : NULL;
        if (path) {
            if (++i == argc) return usage(argv[0]);
            *path = argv[i];
        } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--seconds")) {
            char *end;
            if (++i == argc) return usage(argv[0]);
            double s = strtod(argv[i], &end);
            if (*end || !(s > 0) || s > 1e6) return usage(argv[0]);
            cfg.seconds = s;
        } else if (!strcmp(argv[i], "--shot")) {
            if (++i == argc) return usage(argv[0]);
            cfg.shot = argv[i];
        } else if (!mode && !strncmp(argv[i], "--", 2)) {
            mode = argv[i];
        } else {
            return usage(argv[0]);
        }
    }
    if (cfg.shot && !cfg.seconds) return usage(argv[0]);
    if (cfg.seconds && mode) return usage(argv[0]);
    log_open(!mode);
    if (!mode) {
        cfg.boot = cfg.seconds > 0;   // --seconds starts the game like --boot, with its checkpoints
        rt_boot();
        return 0;
    }
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--selftest")) return selftest();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-loader")) return probe_loader();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-cfg")) return probe_cfg();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-dpi")) return probe_dpi();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-kernel")) return probe_kernel();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-ipc")) return probe_ipc();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-services")) return probe_services();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-fs")) return probe_fs();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-gfx-abi")) return probe_gfx_abi();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-nvn")) return probe_nvn();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-nvn-tex")) return probe_nvn_tex();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-window")) return probe_window();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-shader")) return probe_shader();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-vkmem")) return probe_vkmem();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-vkexec")) return probe_vkexec();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-astc")) return probe_astc();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-vkdevice")) return probe_vkdevice();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--probe-movie")) return probe_movie();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--prepare-shaders")) return vk_pipeline_prepare_shaders();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--warm-shaders")) return vk_pipeline_warm_shaders();
    if (!strcmp(mode, "--boot")) { cfg.boot = 1; rt_boot(); return 0; }
    return usage(argv[0]);
}

```

`runtime/memory.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/services.c and loader.c @ b75be8c (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// MacNativeGames contributors), and LAS Recomp runtime/main.c and platform/windows.c @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c)
// 2026 Peiikai).
// Guest address space and the memory SVCs: heap, module data permissions, stack moves,
// QueryMemory, physical memory in the alias region, GetInfo memory ids, and the kernel-region allocator.
//
// Every region is a plain reservation; pages are committed and decommitted at 4 KiB granularity. Decommitted pages
// come back zeroed, so no stale-page bookkeeping is needed. The stack and heap block and the alias region are
// reserved with MEM_WRITE_WATCH: mem_written_pages reports the pages the CPU wrote, which
// the Vulkan back end uploads again.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "layout.h"

#define PAGE 0x1000ull
#define GiB (1ull << 30)
#define LOW_SEARCH_FROM 0x100000000ull
#define LOW_SIZE (6 * GiB)
#define STACK_OFF 0x10000000ull
#define STACK_SIZE 0x10000000ull
#define HEAP_OFF (STACK_OFF + STACK_SIZE + 0x10000000ull)
#define HEAP_CAP (4 * GiB)
#define ALIAS_SIZE (64 * GiB)
#define ALIAS_ALIGN (4 * GiB)
#define ALIAS_PAGES (ALIAS_SIZE / PAGE)
#define DEFAULT_POOL 0xCD500000ull       // retail application pool
#define SYSTEM_RESOURCE_BUDGET (32ull << 20)
#define MAX_STACK_MAPS 4096
#define REEXEC_LIMIT 20

// Horizon memory states, permissions, attributes and results used here.
enum { ST_FREE = 0, ST_CODE = 3, ST_CODEDATA = 4, ST_NORMAL = 5, ST_STACK = 0xB, ST_THREADLOCAL = 0xC,
       ST_INACCESSIBLE = 0x10 };
enum { PERM_NONE = 0, PERM_R = 1, PERM_RW = 3, PERM_RX = 5 };
enum { ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED = 16 };
#define R_OK 0u
#define R_INVALID_ADDRESS 0xcc01u   // misaligned address
#define R_INVALID_SIZE 0xca01u
#define R_INVALID_NEW_PERM 0xd801u
#define R_INVALID_STATE 0xd401u     // InvalidCurrentMemory
#define R_INVALID_REGION 0xdc01u
#define R_LIMIT_REACHED 0x10801u

static RtGuestLayout L;
static uint64_t mods_lo, mods_hi;   // fixed module window
static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static uint64_t heap_size, alias_bytes;
static uint8_t *alias_pages;        // 1 per mapped 4 KiB page of the alias region
typedef struct { uint64_t dst, src, size; } StackMap;
static StackMap stack_maps[MAX_STACK_MAPS];
static unsigned nstack_maps;
static uint8_t *module_perm[MOD_COUNT];   // per data page of each module: perm | ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED

static uint64_t align_up(uint64_t v, uint64_t a) { return (v + a - 1) & ~(a - 1); }

static void *reserve_at(uint64_t at, uint64_t size, DWORD extra) {
    void *p = VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)at, size, MEM_RESERVE | extra, PAGE_NOACCESS);
    if (p && p != (void *)(uintptr_t)at) {
        VirtualFree(p, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        p = NULL;
    }
    return p;
}

// ---- frozen regions
// A 2 MiB region of the watched reservations that nothing wrote for a while can be made read-only (mem_freeze), so the
// back end's write-watch queries skip it: no page of a frozen region changes before a thaw. The first write faults and
// thaw_handler makes the region writable again before the write retries. A kernel write into guest memory (a file
// read) fails on a read-only page instead of faulting, so file reads thaw their buffer first (mem_thaw), and so does
// every commit, decommit and protection change here. A region stays thawed for FRZ_HOLD_MS after a mem_thaw: a file
// read still in flight writes its buffer later. frz_lock is a leaf lock: nothing writes guest memory under it.
#define FRZ_SHIFT 21
#define FRZ_SIZE (1ull << FRZ_SHIFT)
#define FRZ_HOLD_MS 5000u
static volatile uint8_t frz[RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT >> FRZ_SHIFT];
static uint32_t thaw_ms[RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT >> FRZ_SHIFT];   // frz_lock: GetTickCount of the last thaw request, 0 never
static volatile LONG nfrz;
static SRWLOCK frz_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static volatile LONG64 frz_count[4];   // freezes; thaws by a write fault, by mem_thaw, by a mapping change

static int watched(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    const RtGuestLayout *g = &L;
    return (addr >= g->aslr.base && size <= LOW_SIZE && addr - g->aslr.base <= LOW_SIZE - size) ||
           (addr >= g->alias.base && size <= ALIAS_SIZE && addr - g->alias.base <= ALIAS_SIZE - size);
}

// frz_lock held exclusively. why: 1 a write fault, 2 mem_thaw (holds the region thawed), 3 a mapping change here.
static void thaw_locked(uint64_t r, int why) {
    if (why == 2) thaw_ms[r] = (uint32_t)GetTickCount64() | 1;
    if (!frz[r]) return;
    DWORD old;
    uint64_t a = r << FRZ_SHIFT, end = a + FRZ_SIZE;
    if (!VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)a, FRZ_SIZE, PAGE_READWRITE, &old)) {
        // Not all committed (freeze_locked left reserved holes): the read-only runs only. Every committed page of a
        // frozen region was read-write at the freeze, and mapping changes thaw before they run, so these are all ours.
        MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
        while (a < end && VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) {
            uint64_t b = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
            if (b > end) b = end;
            if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && mbi.Protect == PAGE_READONLY &&
                !VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)a, b - a, PAGE_READWRITE, &old))
                rt_fatal("memory: thawing %#llx+%#llx failed (error %lu)", (unsigned long long)a,
                         (unsigned long long)(b - a), GetLastError());
            a = b;
        }
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&frz[r], 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    InterlockedDecrement(&nfrz);
    InterlockedIncrement64(&frz_count[why]);
}

// frz_lock held exclusively.
static void thaw_range_locked(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, int why) {
    if (!n || a >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT) return;
    uint64_t r0 = a >> FRZ_SHIFT, r1 = (a + n - 1 < RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT ? a + n - 1 : RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT - 1) >> FRZ_SHIFT;
    for (uint64_t r = r0; r <= r1; r++) thaw_locked(r, why);
}

void mem_thaw(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);   // also when nothing is frozen: the hold keeps a read's buffer writable
    thaw_range_locked(a, n, 2);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
}

// frz_lock held exclusively. Makes the committed pages of region r read-only when every one of them is read-write;
// reserved holes (heap pages given back) stay as they are, and thaw_locked finds the read-only runs again.
static int freeze_locked(uint64_t r) {
    uint64_t a = r << FRZ_SHIFT, end = a + FRZ_SIZE, run[16][2];
    int n = 0;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    for (uint64_t x = a; x < end; ) {
        if (!VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)x, &mbi, sizeof mbi)) return 0;
        uint64_t y = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mbi.BaseAddress + mbi.RegionSize;
        if (y > end) y = end;
        if (mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT) {
            if (mbi.Protect != PAGE_READWRITE || n == 16) return 0;
            run[n][0] = x, run[n][1] = y, n++;
        } else if (mbi.State != MEM_RESERVE) return 0;
        x = y;
    }
    DWORD old;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)run[i][0], run[i][1] - run[i][0], PAGE_READONLY, &old)) {
            while (i--) VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)run[i][0], run[i][1] - run[i][0], PAGE_READWRITE, &old);
            return 0;
        }
    return n > 0;
}

int mem_freeze(uint64_t a) {
    if ((a & (FRZ_SIZE - 1)) || !watched(a, FRZ_SIZE)) return 0;
    uint64_t r = a >> FRZ_SHIFT;
    int ok = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    if (frz[r]) ok = 1;
    else if (thaw_ms[r] && (int32_t)((uint32_t)GetTickCount64() - thaw_ms[r]) < (int32_t)FRZ_HOLD_MS) ok = 0;   // |1 may be ahead
    else if (freeze_locked(r)) {
        __atomic_store_n(&frz[r], 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        InterlockedIncrement(&nfrz);
        InterlockedIncrement64(&frz_count[0]);
        ok = 1;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    return ok;
}

int mem_frozen(uint64_t a) { return a < RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT && __atomic_load_n(&frz[a >> FRZ_SHIFT], __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); }

void mem_freeze_stats(uint64_t *frozen, uint64_t *freezes, uint64_t *fault_thaws, uint64_t *other_thaws) {
    *frozen = (uint64_t)__atomic_load_n(&nfrz, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    *freezes = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64(&frz_count[0], 0);
    *fault_thaws = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64(&frz_count[1], 0);
    *other_thaws = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64(&frz_count[2], 0) + (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64(&frz_count[3], 0);
}

// The first write into a frozen region thaws it and retries. A fault in a region another thread thawed meanwhile
// retries too; any other fault goes on to the crash handler.
static LONG CALLBACK thaw_handler(EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ep) {
    const EXCEPTION_RECORD *er = ep->ExceptionRecord;
    if (er->ExceptionCode != EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION || er->NumberParameters < 2 || er->ExceptionInformation[0] != 1)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    uint64_t a = er->ExceptionInformation[1];
    if (a >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT || !watched(a, 1)) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    int was = frz[a >> FRZ_SHIFT];
    thaw_locked(a >> FRZ_SHIFT, 1);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    if (was) return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mbi;
    if (VirtualQuery((void *)(uintptr_t)a, &mbi, sizeof mbi) && mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && mbi.Protect == PAGE_READWRITE)
        return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION;
    return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_SEARCH;
}

// Mapping changes thaw the regions they touch and run under frz_lock, so no freeze sees them half done.
static void commit(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, const char *what) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    thaw_range_locked(a, n, 3);
    int ok = !n || VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    if (!ok)
        rt_fatal("memory: commit %s %#llx+%#llx failed (error %lu)", what, (unsigned long long)a,
                 (unsigned long long)n, GetLastError());
}

static void decommit(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, const char *what) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    thaw_range_locked(a, n, 3);
    int ok = !n || VirtualFree((void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, MEM_DECOMMIT);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    if (!ok)
        rt_fatal("memory: decommit %s %#llx+%#llx failed (error %lu)", what, (unsigned long long)a,
                 (unsigned long long)n, GetLastError());
}

static void protect(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, DWORD prot, const char *what) {
    DWORD old;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    thaw_range_locked(a, n, 3);
    int ok = !n || VirtualProtect((void *)(uintptr_t)a, n, prot, &old);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&frz_lock);
    if (!ok)
        rt_fatal("memory: protect %s %#llx+%#llx failed (error %lu)", what, (unsigned long long)a,
                 (unsigned long long)n, GetLastError());
}

// The process is re-run when a region is taken: Windows places DLLs, heaps and thread stacks at random addresses,
// and a fresh process gets a fresh layout. The parent waits and exits with the child's code.
static void reexec_or_fail(const char *what) {
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_REEXEC");
    int n = e ? atoi(e) : 0;
    if (n >= REEXEC_LIMIT) rt_fatal("memory: %s is not free after %d attempts", what, n);
    char buf[16];
    snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%d", n + 1);
    SetEnvironmentVariableA("TOTK_REEXEC", buf);
    fflush(stdout);
    fflush(stderr);
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    wchar_t *cmd = _wcsdup(GetCommandLineW());   // CreateProcessW may write its command line
    if (!cmd || !CreateProcessW(NULL, cmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, 0, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi))
        rt_fatal("memory: %s is not free and re-running the process failed (error %lu)", what, GetLastError());
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    WaitForSingleObject(pi.hProcess, INFINITE);
    DWORD code = 70;
    GetExitCodeProcess(pi.hProcess, &code);
    ExitProcess(code);
}

void mem_init(void) {
    if (L.pool) return;
    // Fixed window: modules, kernel region, host-function addresses.
    mods_lo = MOD_MAIN_BASE;
    mods_hi = align_up(rt_layout[rt_layout_count - 1].base + rt_layout[rt_layout_count - 1].size, 0x10000);
    if (mods_hi > RT_KERNEL_BASE) rt_fatal("memory: modules end at %#llx, inside the kernel region",
                                           (unsigned long long)mods_hi);
    if (!reserve_at(mods_lo, mods_hi - mods_lo, 0)) reexec_or_fail("the module window");
    if (!reserve_at(RT_KERNEL_BASE, RT_KERNEL_SIZE, 0)) reexec_or_fail("the kernel region");
    if (!reserve_at(RT_HOSTFN_BASE, RT_HOSTFN_SIZE, 0)) reexec_or_fail("the host-function window");

    // Stack and heap block, then the alias region above it, both searched below the module window.
    uint64_t low = 0, alias = 0;
    for (uint64_t at = LOW_SEARCH_FROM; at + LOW_SIZE <= mods_lo && !low; at += GiB)
        if (reserve_at(at, LOW_SIZE, MEM_WRITE_WATCH)) low = at;
    if (!low) reexec_or_fail("a 6 GiB stack and heap block below 2^39");
    for (uint64_t at = align_up(low + LOW_SIZE, ALIAS_ALIGN); at + ALIAS_SIZE <= mods_lo && !alias; at += ALIAS_ALIGN)
        if (reserve_at(at, ALIAS_SIZE, MEM_WRITE_WATCH)) alias = at;
    if (!alias) reexec_or_fail("a 64 GiB alias region below 2^39");

    AddVectoredExceptionHandler(1, thaw_handler);   // before the crash handler
    alias_pages = VirtualAlloc(NULL, ALIAS_PAGES, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
    if (!alias_pages) rt_fatal("memory: cannot allocate the alias page map");
    // totk.ini is read here, once the address space is claimed and before the first setting: the pool size below
    // depends on TOTK_APP_POOL and on the resolution settings (resolution.c decides them once, on this first call).
    cfg_init();
    const char *pool = cfg_get("TOTK_APP_POOL");
    L = (RtGuestLayout){
        .aslr = {low, RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT - low},
        .stack = {low + STACK_OFF, STACK_SIZE},
        .heap = {low + HEAP_OFF, HEAP_CAP},
        .alias = {alias, ALIAS_SIZE},
        .kernel = {RT_KERNEL_BASE, RT_KERNEL_SIZE},
        .hostfn = {RT_HOSTFN_BASE, RT_HOSTFN_SIZE},
        .pool = pool ? strtoull(pool, NULL, 0) : DEFAULT_POOL + res_heap_extra_bytes(),   // resolution.c
    };
    if (!L.pool) rt_fatal("memory: TOTK_APP_POOL is 0");
}

const RtGuestLayout *mem_layout(void) { return &L; }

// Adapted from LAS Recomp runtime/platform/windows.c:40-63 @ da35b83 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai): GetWriteWatch
// with the reset flag. A range inside one watched reservation (stack and heap block, or alias region) only.
static uint64_t written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t max, DWORD flags) {
    if (!max || !size) return 0;
    if (!watched(addr, size)) return UINT64_MAX;
    ULONG_PTR n = (ULONG_PTR)max;
    DWORD gran;
    _Static_assert(sizeof(PVOID) == sizeof(uint64_t), "page addresses are written straight into a uint64_t array");
    if (GetWriteWatch(flags, (void *)(uintptr_t)addr, (SIZE_T)size, (PVOID *)pages, &n, &gran)) return UINT64_MAX;
    return n;
}

uint64_t mem_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t max) {
    return written_pages(addr, size, pages, max, WRITE_WATCH_FLAG_RESET);
}

uint64_t mem_written_peek(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t max) {
    return written_pages(addr, size, pages, max, 0);
}

static uint64_t image_bytes(void) {
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ldr_count(); i++) n += ldr_module(i)->size;
    return align_up(n, PAGE);
}

static int overlaps(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, uint64_t b, uint64_t m) { return a < b + m && b < a + n; }
static int inside(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, RtRange r) { return a >= r.base && n <= r.size && a - r.base <= r.size - n; }

// ---- 0x01 SetHeapSize
uint32_t mem_set_heap_size(uint64_t size, uint64_t *addr) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (size > HEAP_CAP || size % 0x200000 || size + image_bytes() > L.pool) {
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        return R_INVALID_STATE;
    }
    if (size > heap_size) commit(L.heap.base + heap_size, size - heap_size, "heap");
    if (size < heap_size) decommit(L.heap.base + size, heap_size - size, "heap");
    heap_size = size;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (addr) *addr = L.heap.base;
    return R_OK;
}

// ---- module data permissions (0x02, 0x03) and module pages for QueryMemory
static int module_index(uint64_t a) {
    for (int i = 0; i < ldr_count(); i++) {
        const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
        if (a - m->base < m->size) return i;
    }
    return -1;
}

static uint8_t *perm_table(int i) {   // under lock
    if (!module_perm[i]) {
        const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
        size_t n = (m->size - m->data_off) / PAGE;
        module_perm[i] = malloc(n);
        if (!module_perm[i]) rt_fatal("memory: module permission table");
        memset(module_perm[i], PERM_RW, n);
    }
    return module_perm[i];
}

static unsigned module_page_perm(int i, uint64_t off) {   // under lock
    const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
    if (off < m->data_off) return off < align_up(m->text_end, PAGE) ? PERM_RX : PERM_R;
    return module_perm[i] ? module_perm[i][(off - m->data_off) / PAGE] : PERM_RW;
}

// The module whose data segment holds [a, a+n), or -1.
static int module_data(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    int i = module_index(a);
    if (i < 0) return -1;
    const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
    uint64_t off = a - m->base;
    return off >= m->data_off && n <= m->size - off ? i : -1;
}

uint32_t mem_set_permission(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, uint32_t perm) {
    if (a & (PAGE - 1)) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    if (!n || (n & (PAGE - 1))) return R_INVALID_SIZE;
    if (perm != PERM_NONE && perm != PERM_R && perm != PERM_RW) return R_INVALID_NEW_PERM;
    int i = module_data(a, n);
    if (i < 0) return R_INVALID_STATE;
    const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    uint8_t *t = perm_table(i) + (a - m->base - m->data_off) / PAGE;
    for (uint64_t p = 0; p < n / PAGE; p++)
        if (t[p] & ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED) {
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
            return R_INVALID_STATE;
        }
    memset(t, (int)perm, n / PAGE);
    protect(a, n, perm == PERM_RW ? PAGE_READWRITE : perm == PERM_R ? PAGE_READONLY : PAGE_NOACCESS, "module data");
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    rt_log("%s data permission +%#llx size %#llx perm %u", m->name, (unsigned long long)(a - m->base),
           (unsigned long long)n, perm);
    return R_OK;
}

// The only module attribute the SDK sets is the irreversible RELRO lock.
uint32_t mem_set_attribute(uint64_t a, uint64_t n, uint32_t mask, uint32_t at) {
    if (a & (PAGE - 1)) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    if (!n || (n & (PAGE - 1))) return R_INVALID_SIZE;
    if (mask != ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED || at != ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED) return R_INVALID_NEW_PERM;
    int i = module_data(a, n);
    if (i < 0) return R_INVALID_STATE;
    const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(i);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    uint8_t *t = perm_table(i) + (a - m->base - m->data_off) / PAGE;
    for (uint64_t p = 0; p < n / PAGE; p++) t[p] |= ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    return R_OK;
}

// ---- 0x04/0x05 MapMemory, UnmapMemory: thread stacks move from heap or alias into the stack region by copy; the
// source is inaccessible while moved and gets the contents back on unmap.
static int alias_all_mapped(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {   // under lock
    uint64_t first = (a - L.alias.base) / PAGE;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n / PAGE; i++)
        if (!alias_pages[first + i]) return 0;
    return 1;
}

static uint32_t stack_move(int unmap, uint64_t dst, uint64_t src, uint64_t n) {
    if (!n || ((dst | src | n) & (PAGE - 1))) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    if (!inside(dst, n, L.stack)) return R_INVALID_REGION;
    int in_heap = inside(src, n, (RtRange){L.heap.base, heap_size});
    int in_alias = inside(src, n, L.alias);
    if (!in_heap && !in_alias) return R_INVALID_REGION;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    uint32_t r = R_OK;
    if (in_alias && !alias_all_mapped(src, n)) {
        r = R_INVALID_REGION;
        goto out;
    }
    unsigned found = nstack_maps;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nstack_maps; i++)
        if (stack_maps[i].dst == dst && stack_maps[i].src == src && stack_maps[i].size == n) found = i;
    if (unmap) {
        if (found == nstack_maps) {
            r = R_INVALID_STATE;
            goto out;
        }
        protect(src, n, PAGE_READWRITE, "moved stack source");
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)src, (const void *)(uintptr_t)dst, n);
        decommit(dst, n, "moved stack");
        stack_maps[found] = stack_maps[--nstack_maps];
    } else {
        if (nstack_maps == MAX_STACK_MAPS) {
            r = R_INVALID_STATE;
            goto out;
        }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nstack_maps; i++)
            if (overlaps(dst, n, stack_maps[i].dst, stack_maps[i].size) ||
                overlaps(src, n, stack_maps[i].src, stack_maps[i].size)) {
                r = R_INVALID_REGION;
                goto out;
            }
        commit(dst, n, "moved stack");
        memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)dst, (const void *)(uintptr_t)src, n);
        protect(src, n, PAGE_NOACCESS, "moved stack source");
        stack_maps[nstack_maps++] = (StackMap){dst, src, n};
    }
out:
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    return r;
}

uint32_t mem_map(uint64_t dst, uint64_t src, uint64_t n) { return stack_move(0, dst, src, n); }
uint32_t mem_unmap(uint64_t dst, uint64_t src, uint64_t n) { return stack_move(1, dst, src, n); }

// ---- 0x2C/0x2D MapPhysicalMemory, UnmapPhysicalMemory. Horizon maps only the still-unmapped pages of the range and
// leaves mapped pages and their contents alone; TotK's heaps grow by re-mapping ranges they partly own.
static void alias_runs(uint64_t first, uint64_t count, uint8_t want, int do_commit) {   // under lock
    uint64_t i = 0;
    while (i < count) {
        if (alias_pages[first + i] != want) { i++; continue; }
        uint64_t j = i;
        while (j < count && alias_pages[first + j] == want) j++;
        uint64_t a = L.alias.base + (first + i) * PAGE, n = (j - i) * PAGE;
        if (do_commit) commit(a, n, "physical memory");
        else decommit(a, n, "physical memory");
        memset(alias_pages + first + i, !want, j - i);
        i = j;
    }
}

static uint32_t alias_map(int unmap, uint64_t a, uint64_t n) {
    if (!n || ((a | n) & (PAGE - 1))) return R_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    if (!inside(a, n, L.alias)) return R_INVALID_REGION;
    uint64_t first = (a - L.alias.base) / PAGE, count = n / PAGE;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    uint32_t r = R_OK;
    if (unmap) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nstack_maps; i++)
            if (overlaps(a, n, stack_maps[i].src, stack_maps[i].size)) {
                r = R_INVALID_REGION;
                goto out;
            }
        uint64_t released = 0;
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < count; i++) released += alias_pages[first + i];
        alias_runs(first, count, 1, 0);
        alias_bytes -= released * PAGE;
    } else {
        uint64_t fresh = 0;
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < count; i++) fresh += !alias_pages[first + i];
        if (fresh * PAGE + alias_bytes + heap_size + image_bytes() > L.pool) {
            r = R_LIMIT_REACHED;   // the SDK maps LimitReached to its recoverable out-of-memory result
            goto out;
        }
        alias_runs(first, count, 0, 1);
        alias_bytes += fresh * PAGE;
    }
out:
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (r) rt_log("%sMapPhysicalMemory %#llx+%#llx failed %#x (alias %#llx used, heap %#llx)", unmap ? "Un" : "",
                  (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)n, r, (unsigned long long)alias_bytes,
                  (unsigned long long)heap_size);
    return r;
}

uint32_t mem_map_physical(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) { return alias_map(0, a, n); }
uint32_t mem_unmap_physical(uint64_t a, uint64_t n) { return alias_map(1, a, n); }

// ---- 0x06 QueryMemory
// The region around a that no known region covers: everything else below 2^39 belongs to the host and is reported
// as taken (Code, RX), so the SDK never picks it.
static void taken_gap(uint64_t a, uint64_t *base, uint64_t *size) {
    uint64_t lo = 0, hi = RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT;
    RtRange known[3 + MOD_COUNT + 2];
    int n = 0;
    known[n++] = (RtRange){L.aslr.base, LOW_SIZE};
    known[n++] = L.alias;
    known[n++] = L.kernel;
    known[n++] = L.hostfn;
    for (int i = 0; i < ldr_count(); i++) known[n++] = (RtRange){ldr_module(i)->base, ldr_module(i)->size};
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t e = known[i].base + known[i].size;
        if (e <= a && e > lo) lo = e;
        if (known[i].base > a && known[i].base < hi) hi = known[i].base;
    }
    *base = lo;
    *size = hi - lo;
}

static uint64_t run_end(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t i, uint64_t n, uint8_t v) {
    while (i < n && (i & 7)) { if (p[i] != v) return i; i++; }
    uint64_t w = v ? 0x0101010101010101ull : 0;
    while (i + 8 <= n && *(const uint64_t *)(p + i) == w) i += 8;
    while (i < n && p[i] == v) i++;
    return i;
}

static uint64_t run_start(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t i, uint8_t v) {   // first index of the run that ends at i
    while (i > 0 && (i & 7)) { if (p[i - 1] != v) return i; i--; }
    uint64_t w = v ? 0x0101010101010101ull : 0;
    while (i >= 8 && *(const uint64_t *)(p + i - 8) == w) i -= 8;
    while (i > 0 && p[i - 1] == v) i--;
    return i;
}

uint32_t mem_query(uint64_t a, RtMemoryInfo *out) {
    RtMemoryInfo r = {.base = a & ~(PAGE - 1), .size = PAGE};
    uint64_t low = L.aslr.base;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&lock);
    int mi;
    if (a >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT) {
        r.base = RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT;
        r.size = 0 - RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT;
        r.state = ST_INACCESSIBLE;
    } else if (a < low) {
        r.base = 0;
        r.size = low;
        r.state = ST_FREE;
    } else if (a < low + LOW_SIZE) {
        uint64_t heap = L.heap.base;
        if (a >= heap && a < heap + heap_size) {
            r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = heap, .size = heap_size, .state = ST_NORMAL, .perm = PERM_RW};
        } else if (a < heap) {
            r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = low, .size = heap - low, .state = ST_FREE};
        } else {
            r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = heap + heap_size, .size = low + LOW_SIZE - heap - heap_size, .state = ST_FREE};
        }
    } else if (a - L.alias.base < L.alias.size) {
        uint64_t p = (a - L.alias.base) / PAGE;
        uint8_t v = alias_pages[p];
        uint64_t s = run_start(alias_pages, p, v), e = run_end(alias_pages, p, ALIAS_PAGES, v);
        r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = L.alias.base + s * PAGE, .size = (e - s) * PAGE, .state = v ? ST_NORMAL : ST_FREE,
                           .perm = v ? PERM_RW : PERM_NONE};
    } else if ((mi = module_index(a)) >= 0) {
        const RtLoaded *m = ldr_module(mi);
        uint64_t off = (a - m->base) & ~(PAGE - 1), lo = off, hi = off + PAGE;
        unsigned perm = module_page_perm(mi, off);
        int data = off >= m->data_off;
        uint64_t limit = data ? m->data_off : 0, end = data ? m->size : m->data_off;
        while (lo > limit && module_page_perm(mi, lo - PAGE) == perm) lo -= PAGE;
        while (hi < end && module_page_perm(mi, hi) == perm) hi += PAGE;
        r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = m->base + lo, .size = hi - lo, .state = data ? ST_CODEDATA : ST_CODE,
                           .perm = perm & 7, .attr = perm & ATTR_PERMISSION_LOCKED};
    } else if (a - L.kernel.base < L.kernel.size) {
        r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = L.kernel.base, .size = L.kernel.size, .state = ST_THREADLOCAL, .perm = PERM_RW};
    } else if (a - L.hostfn.base < L.hostfn.size) {
        r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = L.hostfn.base, .size = L.hostfn.size, .state = ST_INACCESSIBLE};
    } else {
        taken_gap(a, &r.base, &r.size);
        r.state = ST_CODE;
        r.perm = PERM_RX;
    }
    // Moved stacks: the destination is Stack, the source Normal without access; free and normal regions around them
    // are clipped (MNG services.c).
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < nstack_maps; i++) {
        const StackMap *m = &stack_maps[i];
        uint64_t end = m->dst + m->size, send = m->src + m->size;
        if (a >= m->dst && a < end) {
            r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = m->dst, .size = m->size, .state = ST_STACK, .perm = PERM_RW};
            break;
        }
        if (a >= m->src && a < send) {
            r = (RtMemoryInfo){.base = m->src, .size = m->size, .state = ST_NORMAL, .perm = PERM_NONE, .attr = 4};
            break;
        }
        uint64_t lo = r.base, hi = r.base + r.size;
        uint64_t b = r.state == ST_FREE ? m->dst : r.state == ST_NORMAL ? m->src : 0;
        uint64_t e = b + m->size;
        if (!b) continue;
        if (e <= a && e > lo) lo = e;
        if (b > a && b < hi) hi = b;
        r.base = lo;
        r.size = hi - lo;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&lock);
    if (out) *out = r;
    return R_OK;
}

// ---- GetInfo memory ids
int mem_info(uint32_t id, uint64_t *out) {
    uint64_t v;
    switch (id) {
    case 2: v = L.alias.base; break;
    case 3: v = L.alias.size; break;
    case 4: v = L.heap.base; break;
    case 5: v = L.heap.size; break;
    case 6: case 21: v = L.pool; break;
    case 7: case 22:
        AcquireSRWLockShared(&lock);
        v = image_bytes() + heap_size + alias_bytes;
        ReleaseSRWLockShared(&lock);
        break;
    case 12: v = L.aslr.base; break;
    case 13: v = L.aslr.size; break;
    case 14: v = L.stack.base; break;
    case 15: v = L.stack.size; break;
    case 16: v = SYSTEM_RESOURCE_BUDGET; break;
    case 17: v = sizeof stack_maps + ALIAS_PAGES; break;   // system resource in use: our bookkeeping
    case 28: v = 0; break;   // AliasRegionExtraSize: no kernel-owned extension
    default: return 0;
    }
    *out = v;
    return 1;
}

// ---- kernel region: power-of-two blocks, a free list per size, bump allocation with lazy commit.
#define KCLASSES 29          // 64 B .. 256 MiB
#define KMIN_SHIFT 6
#define KCOMMIT 0x10000ull
typedef struct KFree { struct KFree *next; } KFree;
static KFree *kfree_list[KCLASSES];
static uint64_t kbump, kcommitted;
static SRWLOCK klock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static int kclass(uint64_t size) {
    int s = KMIN_SHIFT;
    while ((1ull << s) < size) s++;
    return s - KMIN_SHIFT;
}

void *mem_kernel_alloc(uint64_t size, uint64_t align) {
    if (!L.pool) rt_fatal("mem_kernel_alloc before mem_init");
    if (align > KCOMMIT || (align & (align - 1))) rt_fatal("mem_kernel_alloc: alignment %#llx", (unsigned long long)align);
    uint64_t want = size > align ? size : align;
    int k = kclass(want ? want : 1);
    if (k >= KCLASSES) rt_fatal("mem_kernel_alloc: %#llx bytes", (unsigned long long)size);
    uint64_t bytes = 1ull << (k + KMIN_SHIFT), al = bytes < KCOMMIT ? bytes : KCOMMIT;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&klock);
    KFree *f = kfree_list[k];
    void *p;
    if (f) {
        kfree_list[k] = f->next;
        p = f;
    } else {
        uint64_t a = align_up(kbump ? kbump : RT_KERNEL_BASE, al);
        if (a + bytes > RT_KERNEL_BASE + RT_KERNEL_SIZE) rt_fatal("kernel region exhausted (%#llx bytes)",
                                                                  (unsigned long long)bytes);
        uint64_t need = align_up(a + bytes, KCOMMIT);
        if (!kcommitted) kcommitted = RT_KERNEL_BASE;
        if (need > kcommitted) {
            commit(kcommitted, need - kcommitted, "kernel region");
            kcommitted = need;
        }
        kbump = a + bytes;
        p = (void *)(uintptr_t)a;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&klock);
    memset(p, 0, size ? size : 1);
    return p;
}

void mem_kernel_free(void *p, uint64_t size) {
    if (!p) return;
    uint64_t a = (uintptr_t)p;
    if (a - RT_KERNEL_BASE >= RT_KERNEL_SIZE) rt_fatal("mem_kernel_free(%p): not in the kernel region", p);
    int k = kclass(size ? size : 1);
    // A block allocated with a larger alignment sits in a larger class; freeing it into the smaller class only
    // wastes the rest.
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&klock);
    KFree *f = p;
    f->next = kfree_list[k];
    kfree_list[k] = f;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&klock);
}
```

`runtime/motion_fusion.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/motion_fusion.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors).
// Six-axis sensor states (nn::hid::SixAxisSensorState) from gyro and accelerometer samples. Input per sample, in the
// Switch controller frame (x to the right, y toward the top edge, z out of the face): acceleration in G including
// gravity, as gravity reads (lying face up z = -1 G), and rotation rate in rad/s. Output per sample, as the Switch
// reports it: acceleration in G, angular velocity in revolutions per second, angle = the integrated revolutions per
// axis, direction = the controller's three axes in a reference frame whose z is up. The orientation is integrated from
// the gyro and, while the controller is not being accelerated (|a| within 15 % of 1 G), pulled toward the measured
// gravity (Mahony, gain 0.5/s: about 2 s), as the Switch's sensor fusion does; yaw has no reference and drifts with the
// gyro's bias. The newest MOTION_RING samples are kept; reads are newest first. A restart (StartSixAxisSensor) drops
// the samples before it: reads return nothing until the next sample, which starts a fresh frame and angle; sampling
// numbers go on. The feeding thread writes, guest threads read, both under the instance's SRW lock.
#include <windows.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"

enum { MOTION_RING = 64 };
#define STALE_NS 200000000ull   // no sample for 200 ms: no motion

struct MotionFusion {
    SRWLOCK lock;
    MotionState ring[MOTION_RING];
    uint64_t produced, last_ns;
    uint64_t first;   // produced at the last restart: older samples are not read
    double R[3][3];   // controller -> reference; row i = reference axis i in controller coordinates
    double angle[3];
    int restart;
};

MotionFusion *motion_new(void) {
    MotionFusion *m = calloc(1, sizeof *m);
    if (!m) rt_fatal("motion: out of memory");
    InitializeSRWLock(&m->lock);
    m->restart = 1;
    return m;
}

MotionFusion *motion_global(void) {
    static MotionFusion *g;
    static INIT_ONCE once = INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT;
    BOOL pending;
    if (InitOnceBeginInitialize(&once, 0, &pending, NULL) && pending) {
        g = motion_new();
        InitOnceComplete(&once, 0, NULL);
    }
    return g;
}

static double norm3(const double v[3]) { return sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]); }
static void cross3(const double a[3], const double b[3], double out[3]) {
    out[0] = a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1];
    out[1] = a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2];
    out[2] = a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0];
}
// Rows, from the up row (the one the gravity correction keeps right).
static void orthonormalize(double R[3][3]) {
    double n = norm3(R[2]);
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[2][j] /= n;
    double d = R[0][0] * R[2][0] + R[0][1] * R[2][1] + R[0][2] * R[2][2];
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[0][j] -= d * R[2][j];
    n = norm3(R[0]);
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[0][j] /= n;
    cross3(R[2], R[0], R[1]);
}
// A fresh orientation: z up against the measured gravity, x as close to the controller's x as that allows.
static void align_to(double R[3][3], const double acc[3]) {
    double n = norm3(acc), up[3] = {0, 0, 1}, x[3] = {1, 0, 0};
    if (n > 0.5)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) up[j] = -acc[j] / n;
    if (fabs(up[0]) > 0.9) { x[0] = 0; x[1] = 1; }
    memcpy(R[2], up, sizeof up);
    memcpy(R[0], x, sizeof x);
    orthonormalize(R);
}
// Body-frame rate: R = R * exp([w] dt), the rate plus the gravity pull.
static void integrate(double R[3][3], const double gyro[3], const double acc[3], double dt) {
    double w[3] = {gyro[0], gyro[1], gyro[2]}, n = norm3(acc);
    if (fabs(n - 1) < 0.15) {   // not being accelerated: turn the estimated down toward the measured one
        const double kp = 0.5;
        double measured[3] = {acc[0] / n, acc[1] / n, acc[2] / n}, estimated[3] = {-R[2][0], -R[2][1], -R[2][2]}, e[3];
        cross3(measured, estimated, e);
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) w[j] += kp * e[j];
    }
    double rate = norm3(w), theta = rate * dt;
    if (theta < 1e-12) return;
    double k[3] = {w[0] / rate, w[1] / rate, w[2] / rate}, s = sin(theta), c = 1 - cos(theta);
    double K[3][3] = {{0, -k[2], k[1]}, {k[2], 0, -k[0]}, {-k[1], k[0], 0}}, E[3][3], out[3][3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            double kk = 0;
            for (int q = 0; q < 3; q++) kk += K[i][q] * K[q][j];
            E[i][j] = (i == j) + s * K[i][j] + c * kk;
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
            double v = 0;
            for (int q = 0; q < 3; q++) v += R[i][q] * E[q][j];
            out[i][j] = v;
        }
    memcpy(R, out, sizeof out);
    orthonormalize(R);
}

void motion_feed(MotionFusion *m, const double acc[3], const double gyro[3], uint64_t now) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->lock);
    double dt = m->last_ns && now > m->last_ns ? (double)(now - m->last_ns) / 1e9 : 0.004;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.004;   // a gap (no controller, sensors were off): no integration across it
    m->last_ns = now;
    if (m->restart) {
        align_to(m->R, acc);
        memset(m->angle, 0, sizeof m->angle);
        m->restart = 0;
    } else integrate(m->R, gyro, acc, dt);
    MotionState *s = &m->ring[m->produced % MOTION_RING];
    *s = (MotionState){.delta_ns = (int64_t)(dt * 1e9), .sampling = (int64_t)m->produced + 1, .attributes = 1};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        double rps = gyro[i] / (2 * M_PI);
        m->angle[i] += rps * dt;
        s->acc[i] = (float)acc[i];
        s->gyro[i] = (float)rps;
        s->angle[i] = (float)m->angle[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) s->dir[i * 3 + j] = (float)m->R[j][i];   // direction i = controller axis i in the reference frame
    }
    m->produced++;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->lock);
}

int motion_read(MotionFusion *m, MotionState *out, int max, uint64_t now) {
    if (max <= 0) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->lock);
    if (m->produced > m->first && (now < m->last_ns || now - m->last_ns < STALE_NS)) {
        uint64_t have = m->produced - m->first < MOTION_RING ? m->produced - m->first : MOTION_RING;
        n = (int)(have < (uint64_t)max ? have : (uint64_t)max);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = m->ring[(m->produced - 1 - (uint64_t)i) % MOTION_RING];
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->lock);
    return n;
}

void motion_restart(MotionFusion *m) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->lock);
    m->restart = 1;
    m->first = m->produced;
    m->last_ns = 0;   // the first sample after the restart integrates nothing across the stop
    memset(m->angle, 0, sizeof m->angle);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->lock);
}
```

```h
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/movie_host.h @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors).
// What ov_movie.c (the host movie::Decoder) and movie_probe.c share. The game reaches the decoder through the
// HOST_OVERRIDE entries named in movie_symbols; the probe calls the same entries with a Cpu of its own and stand-ins for
// the guest functions the decoder calls.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#include "host.h"

// Entries in the order of movie_symbols[]: the imported constructor, then the 19 slots of the vtable for movie::Decoder
// (subsdk0+0x560700..0x560790, each an ABS64 relocation by name).
enum { MOVIE_CTOR, MOVIE_D2, MOVIE_D0, MOVIE_CONFIGURE, MOVIE_REGISTER_EVENTS, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_FORMAT, MOVIE_START,
       MOVIE_STOP, MOVIE_RESET, MOVIE_FLUSH, MOVIE_ACQUIRE_INPUT, MOVIE_GET_INPUT, MOVIE_SEND_INPUT, MOVIE_ACQUIRE_OUTPUT,
       MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_SIZE, MOVIE_RELEASE_OUTPUT, MOVIE_GET_LAST_ERROR, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_MD,
       MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_BUFFER_FORMAT, MOVIE_ENTRIES };
extern const char *const movie_symbols[MOVIE_ENTRIES];

// Guest addresses of the functions the decoder calls with rt_call: nn::os::SignalEvent, movie::Buffer and
// movie::MediaData methods, the vtable address the constructor stores (vtable + 0x10), and the original code of every
// entry for decoders left to the library. Filled from the loaded modules at the first entry call, or by the probe.
typedef struct {
    uint64_t signal_event, buf_set_range, buf_set_data, buf_base, buf_capacity;
    uint64_t md_find_int32, md_find_string, md_set_int32, md_set_rect, md_set_string;
    uint64_t vptr;
    uint64_t orig[MOVIE_ENTRIES];
} MovieGuest;

enum { MOVIE_EV_INPUT, MOVIE_EV_OUTPUT, MOVIE_EV_FORMAT, MOVIE_EV_ERROR };   // DecoderEvents: EventType * per event
enum { MOVIE_TYPE_VP9 = 3, MOVIE_MODE_BUFFER = 1, MOVIE_FORMAT_NV12 = 4, MOVIE_FLAG_EOS = 4 };

typedef struct { uint64_t frames, decode_ns, max_ns, errors, dropped, handed; } MovieStats;

void movie_set_guest(const MovieGuest *g);                 // probe: stand-ins instead of the modules
void movie_set_clock(uint64_t (*clock)(void));             // probe: a fake clock (ns) for the pacing; NULL = real
void movie_set_pace(int on);                               // probe: 0 hands every decoded frame over at the next tick
int movie_stats(uint64_t obj, MovieStats *out);            // counters of the decoder at guest object obj; 0 if none
int movie_quiet(uint64_t obj);                             // 1 when its worker is idle and cannot take more input now
```
