```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/frontend.m (nn::vi, lines 345-359) and gfx_bridge.c (nv, lines
// 74-86) @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames contributors). The nvnBootstrapLoader stop takes the place
// of MacNativeGames' NVN entry (third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c:115-118); no code of it is copied.
// Graphics bring-up:
//   nv::*        record the game's allocator callbacks and graphics work memory (guest addresses) for the NVN layer
//   nn::vi::*    display, layer and native window identities; the vsync event is bound here
//   nvnBootstrapLoader   the end of --boot (rt_boot_event "nvn"); otherwise the synthetic address of an NVN proc (nvn_procs.c)
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "ov.h"

#define VI_R_INVALID 0xf601u   // MacNativeGames' result for a call on an unknown display or layer

static OvNvState nv;
static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

const OvNvState *ov_nv_state(void) { return &nv; }

static void set_allocator(Cpu *c, OvNvAllocator *a) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    *a = (OvNvAllocator){arg_x(c, 0), arg_x(c, 1), arg_x(c, 2), arg_x(c, 3)};
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// void nv::SetGraphicsAllocator(AllocateFunction, FreeFunction, ReallocateFunction, void *user)
static void ov_graphics_allocator(Cpu *c) { set_allocator(c, &nv.graphics); }
// void nv::SetGraphicsDevtoolsAllocator(AllocateFunction, FreeFunction, ReallocateFunction, void *user)
static void ov_devtools_allocator(Cpu *c) { set_allocator(c, &nv.devtools); }

// void nv::InitializeGraphics(void *memory, size_t size)
static void ov_initialize_graphics(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t mem = arg_x(c, 0), size = arg_x(c, 1);
    if (!mem || !size) rt_fatal("nv::InitializeGraphics: no graphics work memory (%#llx, %#llx)", (unsigned long long)mem,
                                (unsigned long long)size);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    nv.memory = mem;
    nv.memory_size = size;
    nv.initialized = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    rt_log("nv: graphics work memory %#llx+%#llx recorded", (unsigned long long)mem,
           (unsigned long long)size);
}

// ---- nn::vi: the identities are small zeroed blocks in the guest-visible kernel region, in case SDK code reads them
static int vi_ready;
static void *display, *layer, *window;

// void nn::vi::Initialize()
static void ov_vi_initialize(Cpu *c) {
    (void)c;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!display) {
        display = mem_kernel_alloc(64, 16);
        layer = mem_kernel_alloc(64, 16);
        window = mem_kernel_alloc(64, 16);
    }
    vi_ready = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

static int vi_up(void) {
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&lock);
    int r = vi_ready;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&lock);
    return r;
}

// Result nn::vi::OpenDefaultDisplay(Display **out)
static void ov_open_display(Cpu *c) {
    void **out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out || !vi_up()) { ret_x(c, VI_R_INVALID); return; }
    *out = display;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result nn::vi::CreateLayer(Layer **out, Display *display)
static void ov_create_layer(Cpu *c) {
    void **out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out || !vi_up() || arg_p(c, 1) != display) { ret_x(c, VI_R_INVALID); return; }
    *out = layer;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result nn::vi::GetNativeWindow(void **out, Layer *layer): a placeholder the NVN layer recognises
static void ov_native_window(Cpu *c) {
    void **out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out || !vi_up() || arg_p(c, 1) != layer) { ret_x(c, VI_R_INVALID); return; }
    *out = window;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result nn::vi::GetDisplayVsyncEvent(os::SystemEventType *event, Display *display): auto-clear system event
static void ov_vsync_event(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t ev = arg_x(c, 0);
    if (!ev || !vi_up() || arg_p(c, 1) != display) { ret_x(c, VI_R_INVALID); return; }
    kern_bind_system_event(c, ev, 1);
    gfx_vsync_bind(ev);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// void *nvnBootstrapLoader(const char *name): the first NVN call
static void ov_nvn_bootstrap(Cpu *c) {
    const char *name = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!name) name = "(null)";
    static LONG first = 1;
    if (rt_config()->boot && InterlockedExchange(&first, 0)) rt_boot_event("nvn", c, name);   // ends --boot; returns
                                                                                                // when --seconds goes on
    ret_x(c, nvn_proc_address(name));
}

// The NVN procs need their synthetic addresses before hostfn_seal; the loader seals at the end of rt_boot, so the
// registration runs at start-up instead of through boot.c.
__attribute__((constructor)) static void ov_nvn_procs_register(void) { nvn_procs_register(); }

HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nv20SetGraphicsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", ov_graphics_allocator);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nv18InitializeGraphicsEPvm", ov_initialize_graphics);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nv28SetGraphicsDevtoolsAllocatorEPFPvmmS0_EPFvS0_S0_EPFS0_S0_mS0_ES0_", ov_devtools_allocator);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn2vi10InitializeEv", ov_vi_initialize);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn2vi18OpenDefaultDisplayEPPNS0_7DisplayE", ov_open_display);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn2vi11CreateLayerEPPNS0_5LayerEPNS0_7DisplayE", ov_create_layer);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn2vi15GetNativeWindowEPPvPNS0_5LayerE", ov_native_window);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn2vi20GetDisplayVsyncEventEPNS_2os15SystemEventTypeEPNS0_7DisplayE", ov_vsync_event);
HOST_OVERRIDE("nvnBootstrapLoader", ov_nvn_bootstrap);
```

`runtime/ov_input.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/input.c and hid_feedback.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026
// MacNativeGames contributors).
// nn::hid overrides: one connected controller fed by input_poll (gamepad and keyboard,
// runtime/input_win.c; nothing pressed with TOTK_INPUT=none). Docked (default) it is a full-key controller as player 1 (id 0, style bit 0); with
// TOTK_OPERATION_MODE=handheld it is the handheld controller (id 0x20, style bit 1) and player 1 is not connected,
// which is the controller the game reads in that mode. Mouse and keyboard report no input. The controller has two
// vibration devices (left, right) played on the gamepad's motors (TOTK_RUMBLE=0: none) and a six-axis sensor fed by
// the gamepad's gyro and accelerometer (TOTK_MOTION=0, live: reads at rest). State layouts follow libnx HID.
#include <windows.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "ov.h"

typedef struct { int64_t sampling; uint64_t buttons; int32_t lx, ly, rx, ry; uint32_t attributes, pad; } NpadState;
typedef struct { int64_t sampling; int32_t x, y, dx, dy, wx, wy; uint32_t buttons, attributes; } MouseState;
typedef struct { int64_t sampling; uint32_t modifiers, attributes; uint64_t keys[4]; } KeyboardState;
typedef struct { int8_t players; uint8_t pad[3]; uint32_t selected; } ControllerSupportResult;
_Static_assert(sizeof(NpadState) == 40 && sizeof(MouseState) == 40 && sizeof(KeyboardState) == 48, "hid state ABI");
_Static_assert(sizeof(ControllerSupportResult) == 8, "controller support result ABI");

enum { STYLE_FULL_KEY = 1, STYLE_HANDHELD = 2, ATTR_CONNECTED = 1 };

static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static uint32_t styles = STYLE_FULL_KEY;
static int enabled, allowed = 1, mouse_ready, keyboard_ready;
static int64_t sample;

static uint32_t pad_id(void) { return ov_handheld() ? 0x20u : 0u; }
static uint32_t pad_style(void) { return ov_handheld() ? STYLE_HANDHELD : STYLE_FULL_KEY; }

static const uint32_t *need_id(Cpu *c, int i, const char *fn) {
    const uint32_t *id = arg_p(c, i);
    if (!id) rt_fatal("nn::hid::%s: null controller id", fn);
    return id;
}

// void InitializeNpad()
static void ov_initialize_npad(Cpu *c) {
    (void)c;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    enabled = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    rt_log("hid: controllers initialized (one connected %s controller)",
           ov_handheld() ? "handheld" : "full-key");
}

// void SetSupportedNpadIdType(const NpadIdType *ids, size_t count)
static void ov_supported_ids(Cpu *c) {
    const uint32_t *ids = arg_p(c, 0);
    uint64_t n = arg_x(c, 1);
    if (n > 10 || (!ids && n)) rt_fatal("nn::hid::SetSupportedNpadIdType: invalid id list (%llu ids)", (unsigned long long)n);
    int ok = 0;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) ok |= ids[i] == pad_id();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    allowed = ok;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// void SetSupportedNpadStyleSet(NpadStyleSet styles)
static void ov_supported_styles(Cpu *c) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    styles = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 0);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// NpadStyleSet GetNpadStyleSet(const NpadIdType &id)
static void ov_style_set(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t id = *need_id(c, 0, "GetNpadStyleSet");
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&lock);
    uint32_t v = enabled && allowed && id == pad_id() ? styles & pad_style() : 0;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&lock);
    ret_x(c, v);
}

// int GetNpadStates(<State> *out, int count, const NpadIdType &id): the newest state only. want: the style of the
// overload, 0 for the Joy-Con overloads (never connected).
static void npad_states(Cpu *c, uint32_t want) {
    NpadState *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    int max = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint32_t id = *need_id(c, 2, "GetNpadStates");
    if (max <= 0) { ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetNpadStates: null output");
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    NpadState s = {.sampling = ++sample};
    int live = want && enabled && allowed && id == pad_id() && want == pad_style() && (styles & want);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (live) {
        s.attributes = ATTR_CONNECTED;
        input_poll(&s.buttons, &s.lx, &s.ly, &s.rx, &s.ry);
    }
    *out = s;
    ret_x(c, 1);
}
static void ov_states_full_key(Cpu *c) { npad_states(c, STYLE_FULL_KEY); }
static void ov_states_handheld(Cpu *c) { npad_states(c, STYLE_HANDHELD); }
static void ov_states_joycon(Cpu *c) { npad_states(c, 0); }

// void SetNpadJoyHoldType(NpadJoyHoldType type)
static void ov_hold_type(Cpu *c) {
    int64_t t = (int32_t)arg_x(c, 0);
    if (t < 0 || t > 1) rt_fatal("nn::hid::SetNpadJoyHoldType: invalid hold type %lld", (long long)t);
}

// void DisconnectNpad(const NpadIdType &id): only the controller in use (handheld mode disconnects player 1)
static void ov_disconnect(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t id = *need_id(c, 0, "DisconnectNpad");
    if (id != pad_id()) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    allowed = 0;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// Result ShowControllerSupport(ControllerSupportResultInfo *out, const ControllerSupportArg &arg): the one controller
// is already connected, so the applet returns at once with one player on it.
static void ov_controller_support(Cpu *c) {
    ControllerSupportResult *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (out) *out = (ControllerSupportResult){.players = 1, .selected = pad_id()};
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

static void ov_initialize_mouse(Cpu *c) {
    (void)c;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    mouse_ready = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

static void ov_initialize_keyboard(Cpu *c) {
    (void)c;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    keyboard_ready = 1;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// int GetMouseStates(MouseState *out, int count): a mouse that is not connected
static void ov_mouse_states(Cpu *c) {
    MouseState *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    int max = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    if (max <= 0) { ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetMouseStates: null output");
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!mouse_ready) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetMouseStates before InitializeMouse");
    *out = (MouseState){.sampling = ++sample};
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    ret_x(c, 1);
}

// void GetKeyboardState(KeyboardState *out): a keyboard with no key down
static void ov_keyboard_state(Cpu *c) {
    KeyboardState *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetKeyboardState: null output");
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    if (!keyboard_ready) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetKeyboardState before InitializeKeyboard");
    *out = (KeyboardState){.sampling = ++sample};
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
}

// ---- vibration and six-axis sensor (MacNativeGames hid_feedback.c)
// Handles are the SDK's (nn::hid::utility, sdk+0x4a6e00 and sdk+0x4a6ab0): byte 0 the style index (3 full-key,
// 4 handheld), byte 1 the controller id, byte 2 the device (vibration 0 left / 1 right, six-axis 2). Every call under
// the public functions goes through nn::hid::detail (sdk's PLT), answered here instead of by the hid service, including
// the batches VibrationTarget queues through detail::EnqueueVibrationValue into detail::SendVibrationValues.
// VibrationValue {amplitude low, frequency low, amplitude high, frequency high}: 0..1 and Hz, neutral 0/160/0/320.
typedef struct { float amp_low, freq_low, amp_high, freq_high; } VibrationValue;
typedef struct { uint32_t type, position; } VibrationDeviceInfo;   // type 1 linear resonant actuator; position 1 left, 2 right
_Static_assert(sizeof(VibrationValue) == 16 && sizeof(VibrationDeviceInfo) == 8, "vibration ABI");

enum { STYLE_INDEX_FULL_KEY = 3, STYLE_INDEX_HANDHELD = 4, SIX_AXIS_DEVICE = 2, RUMBLE_MS = 250 };
#define RUMBLE_STALE_NS 250000000ull     // a side the game has not updated for 250 ms is silent
#define RUMBLE_REFRESH_NS 50000000ull    // an unchanged value is sent again every 50 ms (its 250 ms start over)
#define RUMBLE_MIN_GAP_NS 10000000ull    // a changed value at most every 10 ms (the game streams every few ms)
static const VibrationValue vib_neutral = {0, 160, 0, 320};

static int env_zero(const char *name) {
    const char *e = cfg_get(name);
    return e && !strcmp(e, "0");
}

static void once(volatile long *flag, const char *fmt, uint32_t v) {
    if (!InterlockedExchange(flag, 1)) rt_log(fmt, v);
}

// TOTK_RUMBLE_STRENGTH (percent, 0..300, default 130; 0 = off) and TOTK_RUMBLE_CURVE (exponent on the amplitude, 0.2..1.5,
// default 0.6). HD rumble is strong at low amplitude, an ERM motor hardly turns there, so weak values are lifted by the
// curve (0.1 -> 0.25) and the strength scales the result (saturating at 65535; 0.66 and up reach full drive at 130 %).
// Both are live settings (the menu): read again whenever cfg_version changes.
static float rumble_strength = 1.3f, rumble_curve = 0.6f;
static volatile long rumble_cfg_logged;
static unsigned rumble_cfg_seen = ~0u;
static float cfg_float(const char *name, float lo, float hi) {
    double v = cfg_double(name);
    return (float)(v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v);
}
static void rumble_cfg(void) {
    unsigned v = cfg_version();
    if (v == rumble_cfg_seen) return;
    rumble_cfg_seen = v;
    rumble_strength = cfg_float("TOTK_RUMBLE_STRENGTH", 0, 300) / 100;
    rumble_curve = cfg_float("TOTK_RUMBLE_CURVE", 0.2f, 1.5f);
    int trig = input_rumble_triggers_enabled();
    if (!InterlockedExchange(&rumble_cfg_logged, 1))
        rt_log("hid: rumble strength %.0f%%, curve %.2f, triggers %s", rumble_strength * 100, rumble_curve, trig ? "on" : "off");
}
static uint16_t motor(float a) { return rumble_motor(a, rumble_curve, rumble_strength); }

static uint32_t pad_style_index(void) { return ov_handheld() ? STYLE_INDEX_HANDHELD : STYLE_INDEX_FULL_KEY; }

// The SDK's id check (utility functions): players 1-8, other (0x10) and handheld (0x20); the public functions abort
// on another id.
static uint32_t handle_id(Cpu *c, const char *fn) {
    uint32_t id = *need_id(c, 2, fn);
    if (id >= 8 && id != 0x10 && id != 0x20) rt_fatal("nn::hid::%s: invalid controller id %#x", fn, id);
    return id;
}

// int GetVibrationDeviceHandles(VibrationDeviceHandle *out, int count, const NpadIdType &id, NpadStyleSet style):
// utility::GetVibrationDeviceHandles' table, the first style bit in its order; none with TOTK_RUMBLE=0.
static void ov_vibration_handles(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t *out = arg_p(c, 0), style = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 3);
    int max = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint32_t id = handle_id(c, "GetVibrationDeviceHandles");
    if (!out || max <= 0 || __builtin_popcount(style) != 1)
        rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetVibrationDeviceHandles: invalid arguments (count %d, styles %#x)", max, style);
    static volatile long asked;
    rumble_cfg();
    // strength 0 keeps the devices (silent), so the menu can turn rumble up again
    if (env_zero("TOTK_RUMBLE")) { once(&asked, "hid: no vibration devices (TOTK_RUMBLE=%u)", 0); ret_x(c, 0); return; }
    static const struct { uint8_t bit, n; uint32_t base; } t[] = {
        {0, 2, 0x3}, {1, 2, 0x4}, {2, 2, 0x5}, {3, 1, 0x6}, {4, 1, 0x10007}, {5, 1, 0x8}, {10, 1, 0xd}, {8, 2, 0x4},
        {30, 2, 0x21}, {29, 2, 0x20}};
    int n = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof t / sizeof *t && !n; i++) {
        if (!(style >> t[i].bit & 1)) continue;
        n = t[i].n < max ? t[i].n : max;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) out[k] = (t[i].base | id << 8) + ((uint32_t)k << 16);
    }
    once(&asked, "hid: the game asked for its vibration devices (first handle %#x)", n ? out[0] : 0);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)n);
}

// int GetSixAxisSensorHandles(SixAxisSensorHandle *out, int count, const NpadIdType &id, NpadStyleSet style):
// utility::GetSixAxisSensorHandle's order (one sensor per style, two for the Joy-Con pair). Also with TOTK_MOTION=0: the
// sensor then reads at rest (six_fill), so the menu can turn motion on while the game runs.
static void ov_six_axis_handles(Cpu *c) {
    uint32_t *out = arg_p(c, 0), style = (uint32_t)arg_x(c, 3);
    int max = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint32_t id = handle_id(c, "GetSixAxisSensorHandles");
    if (!out || max <= 0) rt_fatal("nn::hid::GetSixAxisSensorHandles: invalid arguments (count %d)", max);
    static volatile long asked;
    uint32_t base = 0, n = 1;
    if (style & 1) base = 0x20003;
    else if (style & 2) base = 0x20004;
    else if (style & 4) base = 0x5, n = 2;
    else if (style & 8) base = 0x6;
    else if (style & 0x10) base = 0x10007;
    else if (style & 0x20) base = 0x20003;
    else if (style & 0xe80) n = 0;
    else if (style & 0x100) base = 0x20004;
    else if ((style & 0x60000040) == 0x40) base = 0x20003;
    else n = 0;
    if (n > (uint32_t)max) n = (uint32_t)max;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n; k++) out[k] = (base | id << 8) + (k << 16);
    once(&asked, "hid: the game asked for its six-axis sensor (first handle %#x)", n ? out[0] : 0);
    ret_x(c, n);
}

static const uint32_t *need_handle(const void *p, const char *fn) {
    if (!p) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::%s: null handle", fn);
    return p;
}

// The vibration device (0 left, 1 right) a handle names on the connected controller, or -1 (logged once).
static int vibration_side(const uint32_t *h, const char *fn) {
    uint32_t v = *need_handle(h, fn), dev = v >> 16 & 0xff;
    if ((v & 0xff) == pad_style_index() && (v >> 8 & 0xff) == pad_id() && dev < 2) return (int)dev;
    static volatile long warned;
    once(&warned, "hid: vibration call for handle %#x, not a device of the connected controller: ignored", v);
    return -1;
}

static SRWLOCK vib_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static VibrationValue vib_last[2] = {{0, 160, 0, 320}, {0, 160, 0, 320}};   // vib_lock
static uint64_t vib_at[2], sent_at;                                          // vib_lock
static uint16_t sent_low, sent_high;                                         // vib_lock
static int vib_allowed = 1;                                                  // vib_lock: PermitVibration

static float clamp01(float v) { return v > 0 ? (v < 1 ? v : 1) : 0; }   // NaN -> 0
// Share of a band at f Hz that goes to the light (high-frequency, right) motor: none at 160 Hz and below (the low band's
// neutral frequency), all at 320 Hz and above (the high band's), log scale between.
static float light_share(float f) { return f > 160 ? (f < 320 ? log2f(f / 160) : 1) : 0; }

// Switch HD rumble -> SDL_RumbleGamepad. Each side's two bands split by frequency between the heavy (low) and the light
// (high) motor (light_share) and add up as energy per motor (root of the summed squares); the stronger side drives each
// motor. A side the game has not updated for 250 ms is silent. Each send lasts 250 ms and is renewed every 50 ms while
// the game streams, so the pad stops by itself when the game stops sending (pause, freeze). Under vib_lock.
static void rumble_update(uint64_t now) {
    float heavy = 0, light = 0;
    rumble_cfg();
    for (int s = 0; s < 2 && vib_allowed; s++) {
        if (!vib_at[s] || now - vib_at[s] > RUMBLE_STALE_NS) continue;
        const VibrationValue *v = &vib_last[s];
        float al = clamp01(v->amp_low), ah = clamp01(v->amp_high), sl = light_share(v->freq_low), sh = light_share(v->freq_high);
        float h = sqrtf(al * (1 - sl) * al * (1 - sl) + ah * (1 - sh) * ah * (1 - sh));
        float l = sqrtf(al * sl * al * sl + ah * sh * ah * sh);
        if (h > heavy) heavy = h;
        if (l > light) light = l;
    }
    uint16_t lo = motor(clamp01(heavy)), hi = motor(clamp01(light));
    int changed = lo != sent_low || hi != sent_high, on = lo || hi;
    if (changed ? on && now - sent_at < RUMBLE_MIN_GAP_NS : !on || now - sent_at < RUMBLE_REFRESH_NS) return;
    input_rumble(lo, hi, on ? RUMBLE_MS : 0);
    sent_low = lo, sent_high = hi, sent_at = now;
}

static void play(int side, const VibrationValue *v) {
    if (!v) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::SendVibrationValue: null value");
    if (side < 0) return;
    VibrationValue c = *v;
    if (!isfinite(c.amp_low) || !isfinite(c.amp_high) || !isfinite(c.freq_low) || !isfinite(c.freq_high)) c = vib_neutral;
    static volatile long first, first_on;
    if (!InterlockedExchange(&first, 1))
        rt_log("hid: first vibration value from the game: %s %.2f@%.0f Hz %.2f@%.0f Hz", side ? "right" : "left",
               (double)c.amp_low, (double)c.freq_low, (double)c.amp_high, (double)c.freq_high);
    if ((c.amp_low > 0.01f || c.amp_high > 0.01f) && !InterlockedExchange(&first_on, 1))
        rt_log("hid: first non-zero vibration from the game: %s %.2f@%.0f Hz %.2f@%.0f Hz", side ? "right" : "left",
               (double)c.amp_low, (double)c.freq_low, (double)c.amp_high, (double)c.freq_high);
    uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&vib_lock);
    vib_last[side] = c;
    vib_at[side] = now;
    rumble_update(now);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&vib_lock);
}

// Result detail::InitializeVibrationDevice(const VibrationDeviceHandle &)
static void ov_vib_init(Cpu *c) {
    static volatile long logged;
    const uint32_t *h = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (vibration_side(h, "InitializeVibrationDevice") >= 0)
        once(&logged, "hid: the game initialized its vibration devices (handle %#x)", *h);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::SendVibrationValue(const VibrationDeviceHandle &, const VibrationValue &)
static void ov_vib_send(Cpu *c) {
    play(vibration_side(arg_p(c, 0), "SendVibrationValue"), arg_p(c, 1));
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::SendVibrationValues(const VibrationDeviceHandle *, const VibrationValue *, int count)
static void ov_vib_send_many(Cpu *c) {
    const uint32_t *h = arg_p(c, 0);
    const VibrationValue *v = arg_p(c, 1);
    int n = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    if (n < 0 || (n && (!h || !v))) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::SendVibrationValues: invalid batch (%d values)", n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) play(vibration_side(&h[i], "SendVibrationValues"), &v[i]);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::GetActualVibrationValue(VibrationValue *out, const VibrationDeviceHandle &): the last value sent
static void ov_vib_actual(Cpu *c) {
    VibrationValue *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::GetActualVibrationValue: null output");
    int side = vibration_side(arg_p(c, 1), "GetActualVibrationValue");
    VibrationValue v = vib_neutral;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&vib_lock);
    if (side >= 0) v = vib_last[side];
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&vib_lock);
    *out = v;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::GetVibrationDeviceInfo(VibrationDeviceInfo *out, const VibrationDeviceHandle &)
static void ov_vib_info(Cpu *c) {
    VibrationDeviceInfo *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::GetVibrationDeviceInfo: null output");
    int side = vibration_side(arg_p(c, 1), "GetVibrationDeviceInfo");
    *out = side >= 0 ? (VibrationDeviceInfo){1, (uint32_t)side + 1} : (VibrationDeviceInfo){0, 0};
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::IsVibrationDeviceMounted(bool *out, const VibrationDeviceHandle &)
static void ov_vib_mounted(Cpu *c) {
    uint8_t *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::IsVibrationDeviceMounted: null output");
    *out = vibration_side(arg_p(c, 1), "IsVibrationDeviceMounted") >= 0;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::IsVibrationPermitted(bool *out)
static void ov_vib_permitted(Cpu *c) {
    uint8_t *out = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!out) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::IsVibrationPermitted: null output");
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&vib_lock);
    *out = (uint8_t)vib_allowed;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&vib_lock);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::PermitVibration(bool): off silences the gamepad at once
static void ov_vib_permit(Cpu *c) {
    int on = (arg_x(c, 0) & 0xff) != 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&vib_lock);
    vib_allowed = on;
    rumble_update(kern_now_ns());
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&vib_lock);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

static volatile long six_running;   // StartSixAxisSensor .. StopSixAxisSensor

static int six_axis_ours(const uint32_t *h, const char *fn) {
    uint32_t v = *need_handle(h, fn);
    if ((v & 0xff) == pad_style_index() && (v >> 8 & 0xff) == pad_id() && (v >> 16 & 0xff) == SIX_AXIS_DEVICE) return 1;
    static volatile long warned;
    once(&warned, "hid: six-axis call for handle %#x, not the connected controller's sensor: reads at rest", v);
    return 0;
}

// Result detail::StartSixAxisSensor(const SixAxisSensorHandle &): angle and direction start over
static void ov_six_start(Cpu *c) {
    const uint32_t *h = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (six_axis_ours(h, "StartSixAxisSensor")) {
        static volatile long logged;
        once(&logged, "hid: the game started the six-axis sensor (handle %#x)", *h);
        motion_restart(motion_global());
        input_motion_start();
        InterlockedExchange(&six_running, 1);
    }
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::StopSixAxisSensor(const SixAxisSensorHandle &)
static void ov_six_stop(Cpu *c) {
    if (six_axis_ours(arg_p(c, 0), "StopSixAxisSensor")) InterlockedExchange(&six_running, 0);
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// All max entries, newest first: the game reads all 16 it asks for and ignores the count (main+0x2a268e0). A short
// history repeats its oldest sample. No motion (sensor not started, no gamepad, one without a gyro, TOTK_MOTION=0):
// a controller lying still, not marked connected.
static int six_fill(MotionState *s, int max, const uint32_t *h, const char *fn) {
    if (max <= 0) return 0;
    if (!s) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::%s: null output", fn);
    int live = six_axis_ours(h, fn) && six_running && input_motion_enabled();
    int n = live ? motion_read(motion_global(), s, max, kern_now_ns()) : 0;
    if (!n) {
        static const MotionState rest = {.acc = {0, 0, -1}, .dir = {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}};
        for (int i = 0; i < max; i++) s[i] = rest;
    } else
        for (int i = n; i < max; i++) s[i] = s[n - 1];
    static volatile long first_rest, first_live;
    if (!n && six_running) once(&first_rest, "hid: six-axis read with no motion samples: at rest (%u states)", (uint32_t)max);
    if (n) once(&first_live, "hid: first six-axis read with live motion (%u samples)", (uint32_t)n);
    return max;
}

// Result detail::GetSixAxisSensorStates(int *count, SixAxisSensorState *out, int max, const SixAxisSensorHandle &)
static void ov_six_states(Cpu *c) {
    int32_t *count = arg_p(c, 0);
    if (!count) rt_fatal("nn::hid::detail::GetSixAxisSensorStates: null count");
    *count = six_fill(arg_p(c, 1), (int)arg_x(c, 2), arg_p(c, 3), "GetSixAxisSensorStates");
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// Result detail::GetSixAxisSensorState(SixAxisSensorState *out, const SixAxisSensorHandle &)
static void ov_six_state(Cpu *c) {
    six_fill(arg_p(c, 0), 1, arg_p(c, 1), "GetSixAxisSensorState");
    ret_x(c, 0);
}
```

`runtime/ov_media.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/opus_codec.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors).
// The hardware Opus decoder (nn::codec), decoded with libopus on the host. The software keyboard (nn::swkbd) is
// in swkbd_win.c.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#include <opus/opus.h>

#include "host.h"

#define CODEC_R_INVALID 0x1fcd1u   // MacNativeGames' "invalid argument" result for nn::codec
#define OPUS_WORK_SIZE 0x9000u     // what the game is told to reserve: libopus stereo decoder state (about 26 KiB) plus 4 KiB

// One record per initialised decoder object (the guest's HardwareOpusDecoderType). The registry lock only guards the
// list; a decoder's own lock serialises its libopus state, so different streams decode in parallel. Lock order:
// registry, then decoder (a caller takes the decoder lock before it drops the registry lock, so Finalize cannot free a
// decoder another thread is using).
typedef struct Decoder {
    uint64_t guest;
    OpusDecoder *dec;
    int rate, channels;
    SRWLOCK use;
    struct Decoder *next;
} Decoder;
static Decoder *decoders;
static SRWLOCK lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static int valid_format(int rate, int channels) {
    return (rate == 48000 || rate == 24000 || rate == 16000 || rate == 12000 || rate == 8000) &&
           (channels == 1 || channels == 2);
}

// Returns the decoder with its use lock held.
static Decoder *acquire(uint64_t guest, const char *fn) {
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&lock);
    Decoder *d = decoders;
    while (d && d->guest != guest) d = d->next;
    if (d) AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&d->use);
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&lock);
    if (!d) rt_fatal("nn::codec::%s: unknown hardware Opus decoder %#llx", fn, (unsigned long long)guest);
    return d;
}

static void release(Decoder *d) { ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&d->use); }

static OpusDecoder *opus_new(int rate, int channels) {
    int err = 0;
    OpusDecoder *o = opus_decoder_create(rate, channels, &err);
    if (!o || err != OPUS_OK) rt_fatal("nn::codec: opus_decoder_create(%d, %d): %s", rate, channels, opus_strerror(err));
    return o;
}

// size_t GetHardwareOpusDecoderWorkBufferSize(int rate, int channels, int option)
static void ov_work_size(Cpu *c) {
    ret_x(c, valid_format((int)arg_x(c, 0), (int)arg_x(c, 1)) ? OPUS_WORK_SIZE : 0);
}

// Result InitializeHardwareOpusDecoder(HardwareOpusDecoderType *d, int rate, int channels, void *work, size_t size,
// int option). The state lives in libopus on the host; the guest's work buffer is reserved but unused. Initialising
// the same object again without Finalize replaces its decoder.
static void ov_initialize(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t guest = arg_x(c, 0), size = arg_x(c, 4);
    int rate = (int)arg_x(c, 1), channels = (int)arg_x(c, 2);
    if (!guest || !valid_format(rate, channels) || size < OPUS_WORK_SIZE) { ret_x(c, CODEC_R_INVALID); return; }
    OpusDecoder *fresh = opus_new(rate, channels);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    Decoder *d = decoders;
    while (d && d->guest != guest) d = d->next;
    if (d) {
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&d->use);   // waits for a decode in flight
        OpusDecoder *old = d->dec;
        d->dec = fresh;
        d->rate = rate;
        d->channels = channels;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&d->use);
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
        opus_decoder_destroy(old);
    } else {
        d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
        if (!d) rt_fatal("nn::codec: decoder allocation");
        InitializeSRWLock(&d->use);
        d->guest = guest;
        d->dec = fresh;
        d->rate = rate;
        d->channels = channels;
        d->next = decoders;
        decoders = d;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    }
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

// void FinalizeHardwareOpusDecoder(HardwareOpusDecoderType *d)
static void ov_finalize(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t guest = arg_x(c, 0);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    Decoder **p = &decoders;
    while (*p && (*p)->guest != guest) p = &(*p)->next;
    if (!*p) rt_fatal("nn::codec::FinalizeHardwareOpusDecoder: unknown decoder %#llx", (unsigned long long)guest);
    Decoder *d = *p;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&d->use);   // a decode in flight finishes first; the registry lock keeps new ones out
    *p = d->next;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&lock);
    opus_decoder_destroy(d->dec);
    free(d);
}

// int GetHardwareOpusDecoderSampleRate / GetHardwareOpusDecoderChannelCount(const HardwareOpusDecoderType *d)
static void ov_sample_rate(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = acquire(arg_x(c, 0), "GetHardwareOpusDecoderSampleRate");
    int v = d->rate;
    release(d);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)v);
}

static void ov_channel_count(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = acquire(arg_x(c, 0), "GetHardwareOpusDecoderChannelCount");
    int v = d->channels;
    release(d);
    ret_x(c, (uint64_t)v);
}

// Result ResetHardwareOpusDecoder(HardwareOpusDecoderType *d)
static void ov_reset(Cpu *c) {
    Decoder *d = acquire(arg_x(c, 0), "ResetHardwareOpusDecoder");
    int ok = opus_decoder_ctl(d->dec, OPUS_RESET_STATE);
    release(d);
    ret_x(c, ok == OPUS_OK ? 0 : CODEC_R_INVALID);
}

static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 8 | p[3]; }

// Result DecodeOpusInterleavedWithHardware(HardwareOpusDecoderType *d, size_t *consumed, int *samples, int16_t *out,
// size_t out_size, const void *in, size_t in_size). The input is Nintendo's frame: an 8-byte big-endian header
// {payload size, final range} and the Opus packet. A header range of 0 is not a recorded value (some encoders write 0
// into every packet), so it is not checked. A range mismatch is logged once and the samples are kept.
static void ov_decode(Cpu *c) {
    static LONG warned;
    uint64_t guest = arg_x(c, 0), out_size = arg_x(c, 4), in_size = arg_x(c, 6);
    size_t *consumed = arg_p(c, 1);
    int *samples = arg_p(c, 2);
    int16_t *out = arg_p(c, 3);
    const uint8_t *in = arg_p(c, 5);
    if (!consumed || !samples || !out || !in || in_size < 8) { ret_x(c, CODEC_R_INVALID); return; }
    uint32_t n = be32(in), range = be32(in + 4);
    if (n > in_size - 8 || n > INT_MAX) { ret_x(c, CODEC_R_INVALID); return; }
    Decoder *d = acquire(guest, "DecodeOpusInterleavedWithHardware");
    size_t capacity = out_size / (sizeof(int16_t) * (size_t)d->channels);
    if (capacity > INT_MAX) { release(d); ret_x(c, CODEC_R_INVALID); return; }
    int got = opus_decode(d->dec, in + 8, (opus_int32)n, out, (int)capacity, 0);
    opus_uint32 final = 0;
    if (got >= 0) opus_decoder_ctl(d->dec, OPUS_GET_FINAL_RANGE(&final));
    release(d);
    if (got < 0) {
        rt_log("nn::codec: opus_decode: %s", opus_strerror(got));
        ret_x(c, CODEC_R_INVALID);
        return;
    }
    if (n && range && final != range && !InterlockedExchange(&warned, 1))
        rt_log("nn::codec: Opus final range %#x != stream %#x (logged once)", (unsigned)final, (unsigned)range);
    *consumed = 8 + n;
    *samples = got;
    ret_x(c, 0);
}

HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec36GetHardwareOpusDecoderWorkBufferSizeEiii", ov_work_size);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec29InitializeHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeEiiPvmi", ov_initialize);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec27FinalizeHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", ov_finalize);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec32GetHardwareOpusDecoderSampleRateEPKNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", ov_sample_rate);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec34GetHardwareOpusDecoderChannelCountEPKNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", ov_channel_count);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec24ResetHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", ov_reset);
HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5codec33DecodeOpusInterleavedWithHardwareEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeEPmPiPsmPKvm", ov_decode);

```

`runtime/ov_movie.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/movie_host.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors).
// movie::Decoder for VP9 on the host with libvpx (BSD-3-Clause, linked statically).
// TotK's pre-rendered movies (Event/Movie/*.webm, 28 files: VP9 profile 0, 1920x1080, 30 fps, video only) play through
// the SDK movie library in subsdk0, Android's MediaCodec over NVIDIA NvMM. Its decoder opens NVDEC through NvRm, whose
// first NvOsDrvOpen (sdk+0x3f9050) aborts with "Use of nv::InitializeGraphics is required." because ov_gfx.c takes
// nv::InitializeGraphics over; nvdrv and mm:u are not served either. The game's own demuxer (movie::Extractor) runs as
// guest code; only the decoder is replaced.
// main imports the constructor and calls the decoder through the vtable for movie::Decoder, whose slots are ABS64
// relocations by name: the HOST_OVERRIDE entries below replace them. A VP9 buffer-mode decoder (type 3, mode 1) is a host
// object, +0 the library's vtable, +8 the host Movie (where the library keeps its DecoderImpl); any other decoder runs
// the original code. Behaviour follows DecoderImpl:
// - output format 4 is packed NV12 (Y plane, then interleaved UV; stride = width), copied into the client's Buffer;
// - input and output buffers are indices handed out FIFO, as MediaCodec does; input flag 4 / output flag 4 = end of stream;
// - client events {input available, output available, format changed, error} (DecoderEvents, 4 EventType pointers) are
//   signalled with nn::os::SignalEvent on a guest thread.
// Decoding runs on one host worker thread per decoder (libvpx adds its own tile threads), never on the game's threads:
// SendInputBufferForDecode queues the input and returns. Events the worker owes (input free, format changed, error) are
// signalled at the next entry call or present, whichever comes first.
// Pacing: the game shows one decoded frame per game frame, which plays a 30 fps movie at 30 fps only at 30 fps. So
// decoded frames are handed over when their presentation time is due, counted from the first frame (movie_tick, at every
// present on the presenting guest thread), at most one per present. When the game falls behind, a frame more than 1.5
// periods late is dropped if the next one is due too, so the picture keeps time with the movie's sound.
// TOTK_MOVIE_PACE=0 hands every decoded frame over at the next present; TOTK_MOVIE_HOST=0 leaves every decoder to the
// library (which aborts at the first movie).
#include <windows.h>
#include <emmintrin.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <vpx/vp8dx.h>
#include <vpx/vpx_decoder.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "movie.h"

enum { IN_BUFS = 4, IN_CAP = 2 << 20, OUT_BUFS = 8, MAX_MOVIES = 16, VPX_THREADS = 4 };
enum { ST_OK = 0, ST_ERROR = 0x1000, ST_NULL = 0x100b, ST_NO_OUTPUT = 0x100e, ST_NO_INPUT = 0x1011,
       ST_UNSUPPORTED = 0x2001, ST_NOT_CONFIGURED = 0x2002 };

const char *const movie_symbols[MOVIE_ENTRIES] = {
    "_ZN5movie7DecoderC1ENS_11DecoderTypeENS_19DecoderOutputFormatENS_11DecoderModeEi", "_ZN5movie7DecoderD2Ev",
    "_ZN5movie7DecoderD0Ev", "_ZN5movie7Decoder9ConfigureEPNS_9MediaDataE",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder20RegisterClientEventsEPNS_13DecoderEventsE", "_ZN5movie7Decoder15GetOutputFormatEPNS_9MediaDataE",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder5StartEv", "_ZN5movie7Decoder4StopEv", "_ZN5movie7Decoder5ResetEv", "_ZN5movie7Decoder5FlushEv",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder23AcquireInputBufferIndexEPiS1_", "_ZN5movie7Decoder14GetInputBufferEiPNS_6BufferE",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder24SendInputBufferForDecodeEiiilj", "_ZN5movie7Decoder24AcquireOutputBufferIndexEPiPlPjS1_",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder15GetOutputBufferEiPNS_6BufferE", "_ZN5movie7Decoder19GetOutputBufferSizeEPiS1_",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder24ReleaseOutputBufferIndexEi", "_ZN5movie7Decoder12GetLastErrorEv",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder15GetOutputBufferEiPNS_6BufferEPNS_9MediaDataE",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder21GetOutputBufferFormatEiPNS_9MediaDataE"};

typedef struct { int index; unsigned flags; int64_t time; } Ready;
typedef struct { int index, offset, size; int64_t time; unsigned flags; } Pending;
typedef struct {
    uint64_t guest;                          // the movie::Decoder object
    int format, configured, started, w, h, eos_in, format_sent, last_error;
    uint64_t events;                         // guest DecoderEvents *: EventType * per MOVIE_EV_*
    vpx_codec_ctx_t vpx;
    int vpx_live;
    uint8_t *in[IN_BUFS];                    // kernel region: the game writes the compressed frames here
    int in_free[IN_BUFS], nin_free;
    Pending pending[IN_BUFS];                // sent, not decoded yet (the worker takes them in order)
    int npending;
    uint8_t *out[OUT_BUFS];                  // NV12 frames
    int out_bytes[OUT_BUFS], out_held[OUT_BUFS];
    Ready decoded[OUT_BUFS];                 // decoded, not due yet
    int ndecoded;
    Ready ready[OUT_BUFS];                   // handed over: AcquireOutputBufferIndex returns these
    int nready;
    unsigned owed;                           // events to signal on the next guest thread (bit per MOVIE_EV_*)
    uint64_t t0;                             // host time of the first frame handed over (pacing)
    int64_t pts0;                            // its presentation time (us)
    MovieStats st;
    SRWLOCK mu;
    CONDITION_VARIABLE work, idle;
    HANDLE thread;
    int busy, quit;
    uint64_t gen;                            // bumped by Flush, Stop, Reset, destruction: a decode in flight is dropped
} Movie;

static MovieGuest G;
static volatile LONG g_ready;
static SRWLOCK g_init = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static Movie *g_movies[MAX_MOVIES];
static volatile LONG g_count;                // live host decoders: movie_tick returns at once when 0
static SRWLOCK g_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;        // lock order: g_lock, then Movie.mu
static uint64_t (*g_clock)(void) = kern_now_ns;
static int g_pace = -1;

void movie_set_clock(uint64_t (*clock)(void)) { g_clock = clock ? clock : kern_now_ns; }
void movie_set_pace(int on) { g_pace = on; }
static int pace_on(void) {
    if (g_pace < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_MOVIE_PACE");
        g_pace = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0"));
    }
    return g_pace;
}
static int host_off(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_MOVIE_HOST");
        v = e && !strcmp(e, "0");
    }
    return v;
}

static uint64_t need(const char *name) {
    uint64_t a = ldr_symbol(name);
    if (!a) rt_fatal("movie: guest symbol %s is not loaded", name);
    return a;
}

// The guest functions, resolved the first time any entry runs (the modules are loaded and relocated by then).
static void guest_init(void) {
    if (g_ready) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_init);
    if (!g_ready) {
        G.signal_event = need("_ZN2nn2os11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE");
        G.buf_set_range = need("_ZN5movie6Buffer8SetRangeEii");
        G.buf_set_data = need("_ZN5movie6Buffer18SetDataAndCapacityEPvm");
        G.buf_base = need("_ZNK5movie6Buffer4BaseEv");
        G.buf_capacity = need("_ZNK5movie6Buffer8CapacityEv");
        G.md_find_int32 = need("_ZNK5movie9MediaData9FindInt32EPKcPi");
        G.md_find_string = need("_ZNK5movie9MediaData10FindStringEPKcPS2_");
        G.md_set_int32 = need("_ZN5movie9MediaData8SetInt32EPKci");
        G.md_set_rect = need("_ZN5movie9MediaData7SetRectEPKciiii");
        G.md_set_string = need("_ZN5movie9MediaData9SetStringEPKcS2_");
        G.vptr = need("_ZTVN5movie7DecoderE") + 0x10;
        for (int i = 0; i < MOVIE_ENTRIES; i++) G.orig[i] = need(movie_symbols[i]);
        InterlockedExchange(&g_ready, 1);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_init);
}

void movie_set_guest(const MovieGuest *g) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_init);
    G = *g;
    InterlockedExchange(&g_ready, 1);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_init);
}

#define U(x) ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(x))
static void buf_set_range(Cpu *c, uint64_t b, int off, int n) { rt_call(c, G.buf_set_range, 3, b, (uint64_t)off, (uint64_t)n); }
static void buf_set_data(Cpu *c, uint64_t b, uint64_t p, uint64_t n) { rt_call(c, G.buf_set_data, 3, b, p, n); }
static int md_find_int32(Cpu *c, uint64_t md, const char *k, int *v) {
    return (uint8_t)rt_call(c, G.md_find_int32, 3, md, U(k), U(v));
}
static void md_set_int32(Cpu *c, uint64_t md, const char *k, int v) { rt_call(c, G.md_set_int32, 3, md, U(k), (uint64_t)(uint32_t)v); }

// The original code of an entry with the caller's arguments; its result stays in x0.
static void pass(Cpu *c, int which) {
    uint64_t a[8];
    memcpy(a, c->x, sizeof a);
    if (!G.orig[which]) rt_fatal("movie: no original code for %s", movie_symbols[which]);
    rt_call(c, G.orig[which], 8, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]);
}

static Movie *find(uint64_t guest) {
    Movie *m = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES && !m; i++)
        if (g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest == guest) m = g_movies[i];
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    return m;
}

// Events are signalled after the locks are released: the woken game thread calls straight back in.
typedef struct { uint64_t ev[4 * MAX_MOVIES]; int n; } Signals;
static void collect(Movie *m, Signals *s) {   // m->mu held
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
        if (m->owed & (1u << k) && m->events && s->n < (int)(sizeof s->ev / sizeof *s->ev)) {
            uint64_t ev = LD64(m->events + 8 * (uint64_t)k);
            if (ev) s->ev[s->n++] = ev;
        }
    m->owed = 0;
}
static void fire(Cpu *c, const Signals *s) {
    for (int i = 0; i < s->n; i++) rt_call(c, G.signal_event, 1, s->ev[i]);
}

static int frame_bytes(const Movie *m) { return m->w * m->h + (m->w / 2) * (m->h / 2) * 2; }

// I420 (libvpx) -> packed NV12: Y rows, then rows of interleaved U, V.
static void to_nv12(const vpx_image_t *img, uint8_t *dst, int w, int h) {
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
        memcpy(dst + (size_t)y * w, img->planes[VPX_PLANE_Y] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_Y], (size_t)w);
    uint8_t *uv = dst + (size_t)w * h;
    int cw = w / 2;
    for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) {
        const uint8_t *u = img->planes[VPX_PLANE_U] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_U];
        const uint8_t *v = img->planes[VPX_PLANE_V] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_V];
        uint8_t *o = uv + (size_t)y * w;
        int x = 0;
        for (; x + 16 <= cw; x += 16) {
            __m128i a = _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i *)(u + x)), b = _mm_loadu_si128((const __m128i *)(v + x));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i *)(o + 2 * x), _mm_unpacklo_epi8(a, b));
            _mm_storeu_si128((__m128i *)(o + 2 * x + 16), _mm_unpackhi_epi8(a, b));
        }
        for (; x < cw; x++) {
            o[2 * x] = u[x];
            o[2 * x + 1] = v[x];
        }
    }
}

static int free_out(const Movie *m) {
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++)
        if (!m->out_held[i]) return i;
    return -1;
}
static int free_outs(const Movie *m) {
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) n += !m->out_held[i];
    return n;
}
static int can_take(const Movie *m, const Pending *p) {
    int want = (p->size > 0) + ((p->flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS) && !m->eos_in);
    return free_outs(m) >= want;
}
static void push_decoded(Movie *m, int slot, unsigned flags, int64_t time, int bytes) {
    m->out_held[slot] = 1;
    m->out_bytes[slot] = bytes;
    m->decoded[m->ndecoded++] = (Ready){slot, flags, time};
}

static int vpx_open(Movie *m) {
    vpx_codec_dec_cfg_t cfg = {.threads = VPX_THREADS, .w = (unsigned)m->w, .h = (unsigned)m->h};
    if (vpx_codec_dec_init(&m->vpx, vpx_codec_vp9_dx(), &cfg, 0) != VPX_CODEC_OK) return 0;
    vpx_codec_control(&m->vpx, VP9D_SET_ROW_MT, 1);
    m->vpx_live = 1;
    return 1;
}

// The worker: takes inputs in order, decodes them outside the lock into a reserved output slot, publishes the frame.
static DWORD WINAPI worker(void *arg) {
    Movie *m = arg;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    for (;;) {
        while (!m->quit && !(m->started && m->vpx_live && m->npending && can_take(m, &m->pending[0])))
            SleepConditionVariableSRW(&m->work, &m->mu, INFINITE, 0);
        if (m->quit) break;
        Pending p = m->pending[0];
        memmove(m->pending, m->pending + 1, (size_t)--m->npending * sizeof *m->pending);
        int slot = -1;
        if (p.size > 0) {
            slot = free_out(m);
            m->out_held[slot] = 1;   // reserved: in no queue, so the game cannot release it
        }
        uint64_t gen = m->gen, dt = 0;
        int got = 0, w = m->w, h = m->h;
        uint8_t *dst = slot >= 0 ? m->out[slot] : NULL;
        vpx_codec_err_t e = VPX_CODEC_OK;
        const char *bad = NULL;
        m->busy = 1;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
        if (p.size > 0) {
            uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
            e = vpx_codec_decode(&m->vpx, m->in[p.index] + p.offset, (unsigned)p.size, NULL, 0);
            if (e == VPX_CODEC_OK) {
                vpx_codec_iter_t it = NULL;
                const vpx_image_t *img;
                while ((img = vpx_codec_get_frame(&m->vpx, &it)) != NULL) {
                    if (img->fmt != VPX_IMG_FMT_I420 || (int)img->d_w != w || (int)img->d_h != h) bad = "layout";
                    else if (!got) to_nv12(img, dst, w, h);
                    got++;
                }
            }
            dt = kern_now_ns() - t0;
        }
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
        m->busy = 0;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&m->idle);
        if (m->gen != gen) continue;   // flushed, stopped or reset meanwhile: the queues were reset after this
        m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = p.index;
        m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_INPUT;
        if (p.size > 0) {
            m->st.decode_ns += dt;
            if (dt > m->st.max_ns) m->st.max_ns = dt;
            if (bad) rt_fatal("movie: VP9 frame layout differs from the configured %dx%d I420", w, h);
            if (e != VPX_CODEC_OK || !got) {
                m->out_held[slot] = 0;
                if (e != VPX_CODEC_OK) {
                    m->st.errors++;
                    m->last_error = ST_ERROR;
                    m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_ERROR;
                    if (m->st.errors <= 4) {
                        const char *d = vpx_codec_error_detail(&m->vpx);
                        rt_log("movie: VP9 decode error on a %d-byte frame at %lld us: %s", p.size, (long long)p.time,
                               d ? d : vpx_codec_err_to_string(e));
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (got > 1) rt_log("movie: %d frames from one input at %lld us, the first kept", got, (long long)p.time);
                if (!m->format_sent) {
                    m->format_sent = 1;
                    m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_FORMAT;
                }
                push_decoded(m, slot, 0, p.time, frame_bytes(m));
                m->st.frames++;
                if (m->st.frames % 600 == 0)
                    rt_log("movie: %llu frames, decode %.2f ms per frame (max %.2f)", (unsigned long long)m->st.frames,
                           m->st.decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->st.frames, m->st.max_ns / 1e6);
            }
        }
        if (p.flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS && !m->eos_in) {
            m->eos_in = 1;
            push_decoded(m, free_out(m), MOVIE_FLAG_EOS, p.time, 0);
            rt_log("movie: end of stream after %llu frames (decode %.2f ms per frame, max %.2f, %llu errors)",
                   (unsigned long long)m->st.frames, m->st.frames ? m->st.decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->st.frames : 0.0,
                   m->st.max_ns / 1e6, (unsigned long long)m->st.errors);
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    return 0;
}

// With m->mu held: invalidate a decode in flight and wait for the worker to leave it. Returns whether the calling guest
// thread gave its core up; the caller calls kern_core_back after releasing m->mu.
static int quiesce(Movie *m) {
    int away = 0;
    m->gen++;
    while (m->busy) {
        if (!away) away = kern_core_away();
        SleepConditionVariableSRW(&m->idle, &m->mu, INFINITE, 0);
    }
    return away;
}
static void unlock_back(Movie *m, int away) {
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    kern_core_back(&away);
}

static void reset_queues(Movie *m) {
    m->nin_free = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = i;
    memset(m->out_held, 0, sizeof m->out_held);
    m->npending = m->nready = m->ndecoded = 0;
    m->eos_in = 0;
    m->t0 = 0;
}
static void release_codec(Movie *m) {   // m->mu held, worker quiesced
    if (m->vpx_live) {
        vpx_codec_destroy(&m->vpx);
        m->vpx_live = 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) {
        if (m->in[i]) mem_kernel_free(m->in[i], IN_CAP);
        m->in[i] = NULL;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) {
        free(m->out[i]);
        m->out[i] = NULL;
    }
    m->configured = m->started = 0;
    reset_queues(m);
}

// Host time a decoded frame is due (ns); end of stream is due as soon as it is first in line.
static uint64_t due_at(const Movie *m, const Ready *d) {
    int64_t ahead = d->time - m->pts0;
    if (ahead < 0) ahead = 0;
    return m->t0 + (uint64_t)ahead * 1000;
}
// One present: drop leading frames more than 1.5 periods late while the next one is due too, then hand over at most one
// due frame (end of stream right after the last frame).
static void release_due(Movie *m, uint64_t now) {
    if (!m->ndecoded) return;
    if (!pace_on()) {
        for (int i = 0; i < m->ndecoded; i++) m->ready[m->nready++] = m->decoded[i];
        m->st.handed += m->ndecoded;
        m->ndecoded = 0;
        m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_OUTPUT;
        return;
    }
    while (m->ndecoded > 1 && m->t0 && !(m->decoded[0].flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS) &&
           !(m->decoded[1].flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS)) {
        uint64_t due = due_at(m, &m->decoded[0]), next = due_at(m, &m->decoded[1]);
        if (now < next || now - due <= (next - due) * 3 / 2) break;
        m->out_held[m->decoded[0].index] = 0;
        m->st.dropped++;
        memmove(m->decoded, m->decoded + 1, (size_t)--m->ndecoded * sizeof *m->decoded);
        WakeConditionVariable(&m->work);
    }
    Ready d = m->decoded[0];
    if (!(d.flags & MOVIE_FLAG_EOS)) {
        if (!m->t0) {
            m->t0 = now;
            m->pts0 = d.time;
        }
        if (now < due_at(m, &d)) return;
    }
    memmove(m->decoded, m->decoded + 1, (size_t)--m->ndecoded * sizeof *m->decoded);
    m->ready[m->nready++] = d;
    m->st.handed++;
    m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_OUTPUT;
}

void movie_tick(Cpu *c) {
    if (!g_count) return;
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES; i++) {
        Movie *m = g_movies[i];
        if (!m) continue;
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
        if (m->started) release_due(m, g_clock());
        collect(m, &s);
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    fire(c, &s);
}

int movie_stats(uint64_t obj, MovieStats *out) {
    Movie *m = find(obj);
    if (!m) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    *out = m->st;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    return 1;
}

int movie_quiet(uint64_t obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj);
    if (!m) return 1;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    int q = !m->busy && !(m->started && m->vpx_live && m->npending && can_take(m, &m->pending[0]));
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    return q;
}

// ---- entries
// Decoder(DecoderType type, DecoderOutputFormat format, DecoderMode mode, int priority)
static void ov_ctor(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t obj = arg_x(c, 0);
    int type = (int)arg_x(c, 1), format = (int)arg_x(c, 2), mode = (int)arg_x(c, 3);
    guest_init();
    if (type != MOVIE_TYPE_VP9 || mode != MOVIE_MODE_BUFFER || host_off()) {
        rt_log("movie: decoder type %d mode %d format %d left to the library%s", type, mode, format,
               host_off() ? " (TOTK_MOVIE_HOST=0)" : " (only VP9 in buffer mode runs on the host)");
        pass(c, MOVIE_CTOR);
        return;
    }
    Movie *m = calloc(1, sizeof *m);
    if (!m) rt_fatal("movie: decoder allocation");
    m->guest = obj;
    m->format = format;
    InitializeSRWLock(&m->mu);
    InitializeConditionVariable(&m->work);
    InitializeConditionVariable(&m->idle);
    m->thread = CreateThread(NULL, 0, worker, m, 0, NULL);
    if (!m->thread) rt_fatal("movie: worker thread (error %lu)", GetLastError());
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    int i = 0;
    while (i < MAX_MOVIES && g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest != obj) i++;
    if (i == MAX_MOVIES) rt_fatal("movie: more than %d live decoders", MAX_MOVIES);
    if (g_movies[i]) rt_fatal("movie: decoder object %#llx constructed twice", (unsigned long long)obj);
    g_movies[i] = m;
    InterlockedIncrement(&g_count);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    ST64(obj, G.vptr);
    ST64(obj + 8, U(m));
    rt_log("movie: VP9 decoder %#llx on the host (libvpx %s), output format %d", (unsigned long long)obj,
           vpx_codec_version_str(), format);
}

static void destroy(Cpu *c, uint64_t obj) {
    (void)c;
    Movie *m = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES; i++)
        if (g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest == obj) {
            m = g_movies[i];
            g_movies[i] = NULL;
            InterlockedDecrement(&g_count);
        }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    if (!m) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    m->quit = 1;
    m->gen++;
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&m->work);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int away = kern_core_away();
    WaitForSingleObject(m->thread, INFINITE);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    CloseHandle(m->thread);
    rt_log("movie: decoder %#llx destroyed after %llu frames (%llu dropped to keep time)", (unsigned long long)obj,
           (unsigned long long)m->st.frames, (unsigned long long)m->st.dropped);
    release_codec(m);
    free(m);
    ST64(obj, G.vptr);   // what the library's destructor leaves (no DecoderImpl)
    ST64(obj + 8, 0);
}

static void ov_d2(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t obj = arg_x(c, 0);
    if (!find(obj)) { pass(c, MOVIE_D2); return; }
    destroy(c, obj);
}
// Deleting destructor: free the host state, then the library's deleting destructor frees the object (impl now 0).
static void ov_d0(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t obj = arg_x(c, 0);
    if (find(obj)) destroy(c, obj);
    pass(c, MOVIE_D0);
}

// Status Configure(MediaData *format)
static void ov_configure(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t obj = arg_x(c, 0), md = arg_x(c, 1);
    Movie *m = find(obj);
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_CONFIGURE); return; }
    if (!md) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    if (m->format != MOVIE_FORMAT_NV12) {
        rt_log("movie: output format %d not implemented on the host (NV12 = 4 only)", m->format);
        ret_x(c, ST_UNSUPPORTED);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t mime_p = 0;
    int w = 0, h = 0;
    rt_call(c, G.md_find_string, 3, md, U("mime"), U(&mime_p));
    md_find_int32(c, md, "width", &w);
    md_find_int32(c, md, "height", &h);
    const char *mime = (const char *)(uintptr_t)mime_p;
    if (!mime || strcmp(mime, "video/x-vnd.on2.vp9") || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 8192 || h > 8192 || (w | h) & 1) {
        rt_log("movie: configure: mime %s %dx%d not supported", mime ? mime : "(none)", w, h);
        ret_x(c, ST_UNSUPPORTED);
        return;
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int away = quiesce(m);
    release_codec(m);
    m->w = w;
    m->h = h;
    if (!vpx_open(m)) rt_fatal("movie: libvpx VP9 decoder initialisation");
    for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) m->in[i] = mem_kernel_alloc(IN_CAP, 0x1000);
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++)
        if (!(m->out[i] = malloc((size_t)frame_bytes(m)))) rt_fatal("movie: output buffers");
    reset_queues(m);
    m->format_sent = 0;
    m->configured = 1;
    m->last_error = 0;
    unlock_back(m, away);
    rt_log("movie: configured %dx%d VP9, %d input buffers of %d KiB, %d output frames of %d bytes", w, h, IN_BUFS,
           IN_CAP >> 10, OUT_BUFS, frame_bytes(m));
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

// Status RegisterClientEvents(DecoderEvents *events)
static void ov_register_events(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_REGISTER_EVENTS); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    m->events = arg_x(c, 1);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

static void set_format(Cpu *c, int w, int h, uint64_t md) {
    rt_call(c, G.md_set_string, 3, md, U("mime"), U("video/raw"));
    md_set_int32(c, md, "width", w);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "height", h);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "stride", w);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "slice-height", h);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "color-format", 21);   // COLOR_FormatYUV420SemiPlanar
    rt_call(c, G.md_set_rect, 6, md, U("crop"), (uint64_t)0, (uint64_t)0, (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(w - 1),
            (uint64_t)(uint32_t)(h - 1));
    md_set_int32(c, md, "crop-width", w);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "crop-height", h);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "nv12-y-stride", w);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "nv12-uv-stride", w);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "nv12-y-offset", 0);
    md_set_int32(c, md, "nv12-uv-offset", w * h);
}

// Status GetOutputFormat(MediaData *format)
static void ov_get_output_format(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t md = arg_x(c, 1);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_FORMAT); return; }
    if (!md) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    int ok = m->configured, w = m->w, h = m->h;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    if (!ok) { ret_x(c, ST_ERROR); return; }
    set_format(c, w, h, md);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

static void ov_start(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_START); return; }
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int st = ST_NOT_CONFIGURED;
    if (m->configured) {
        m->started = 1;
        m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_INPUT;
        WakeConditionVariable(&m->work);
        st = ST_OK;
    }
    collect(m, &s);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    fire(c, &s);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

static void ov_stop(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_STOP); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int away = quiesce(m);
    rt_log("movie: stop after %llu frames (%llu dropped to keep time; decode %.2f ms per frame, max %.2f)",
           (unsigned long long)m->st.frames, (unsigned long long)m->st.dropped,
           m->st.frames ? m->st.decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->st.frames : 0.0, m->st.max_ns / 1e6);
    release_codec(m);
    unlock_back(m, away);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

static void ov_reset(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_RESET); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int away = quiesce(m);
    release_codec(m);
    m->last_error = 0;
    unlock_back(m, away);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

// Drop queued work; the next input starts a new decode (after a seek: a key frame).
static void ov_flush(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_FLUSH); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int away = quiesce(m);
    if (m->configured) {
        vpx_codec_destroy(&m->vpx);
        m->vpx_live = 0;
        if (!vpx_open(m)) rt_fatal("movie: libvpx VP9 decoder re-initialisation");
        reset_queues(m);
    }
    unlock_back(m, away);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

// Status AcquireInputBufferIndex(int *index, int *remaining)
static void ov_acquire_input(Cpu *c) {
    int *index = arg_p(c, 1), *remaining = arg_p(c, 2);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_ACQUIRE_INPUT); return; }
    if (!index || !remaining) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    *index = -1;
    *remaining = 0;
    int st = ST_NO_INPUT;
    if (m->started && m->nin_free > 0) {
        *index = m->in_free[0];
        memmove(m->in_free, m->in_free + 1, (size_t)--m->nin_free * sizeof *m->in_free);
        *remaining = m->nin_free;
        st = ST_OK;
    }
    collect(m, &s);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    fire(c, &s);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

// Status GetInputBuffer(int index, Buffer *buffer)
static void ov_get_input(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t buf = arg_x(c, 2);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_INPUT); return; }
    if (!buf) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    uint8_t *p = index >= 0 && index < IN_BUFS ? m->in[index] : NULL;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    buf_set_range(c, buf, 0, p ? IN_CAP : 0);
    buf_set_data(c, buf, U(p), p ? IN_CAP : 0);
    ret_x(c, p ? ST_OK : ST_ERROR);
}

// Status SendInputBufferForDecode(int index, int offset, int size, long time, unsigned flags)
static void ov_send_input(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1), offset = (int)arg_x(c, 2), size = (int)arg_x(c, 3);
    int64_t time = (int64_t)arg_x(c, 4);
    unsigned flags = (unsigned)arg_x(c, 5);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_SEND_INPUT); return; }
    if (index < 0 || index >= IN_BUFS || offset < 0 || size < 0 || (int64_t)offset + size > IN_CAP) {
        ret_x(c, ST_ERROR);
        return;
    }
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int st = ST_OK;
    if (!m->started || m->npending == IN_BUFS) st = ST_ERROR;
    else if (m->eos_in) {   // after end of stream: hand the buffer back
        m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = index;
        m->owed |= 1u << MOVIE_EV_INPUT;
    } else {
        m->pending[m->npending++] = (Pending){index, offset, size, time, flags};
        WakeConditionVariable(&m->work);
    }
    collect(m, &s);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    fire(c, &s);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

// Status AcquireOutputBufferIndex(int *index, long *time, unsigned *flags, int *remaining)
static void ov_acquire_output(Cpu *c) {
    int *index = arg_p(c, 1), *remaining = arg_p(c, 4);
    int64_t *time = arg_p(c, 2);
    unsigned *flags = arg_p(c, 3);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_ACQUIRE_OUTPUT); return; }
    if (!index || !time || !flags || !remaining) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);   // paced frames become ready only at presents (movie_tick)
    *index = -1;
    *time = 0;
    *flags = 0;
    *remaining = 0;
    int st = ST_NO_OUTPUT;
    if (m->nready > 0) {
        Ready r = m->ready[0];
        memmove(m->ready, m->ready + 1, (size_t)--m->nready * sizeof *m->ready);
        *index = r.index;
        *time = r.time;
        *flags = r.flags;
        *remaining = m->nready;
        st = ST_OK;
    }
    collect(m, &s);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    fire(c, &s);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

static int get_output(Cpu *c, Movie *m, int index, uint64_t buf) {
    buf_set_range(c, buf, 0, 0);
    uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)rt_call(c, G.buf_base, 1, buf);
    uint64_t cap = rt_call(c, G.buf_capacity, 1, buf);
    int st = ST_ERROR, bytes = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    if (index >= 0 && index < OUT_BUFS && m->out_held[index]) {
        bytes = m->out_bytes[index];
        if (!bytes) st = ST_OK;
        else if (dst && cap >= (uint64_t)bytes) {
            memcpy(dst, m->out[index], (size_t)bytes);
            st = ST_OK;
        } else {
            rt_log("movie: output buffer of %llu bytes for a %d-byte frame", (unsigned long long)cap, bytes);
            bytes = 0;
        }
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    if (st == ST_OK && bytes) buf_set_range(c, buf, 0, bytes);
    return st;
}

// Status GetOutputBuffer(int index, Buffer *buffer)
static void ov_get_output(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t buf = arg_x(c, 2);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT); return; }
    ret_x(c, buf ? (uint32_t)get_output(c, m, index, buf) : ST_NULL);
}

// Status GetOutputBufferSize(int *size, int *count)
static void ov_get_output_size(Cpu *c) {
    int *size = arg_p(c, 1), *count = arg_p(c, 2);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_SIZE); return; }
    if (!size || !count) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    *count = 1;
    *size = m->configured ? frame_bytes(m) : 0;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    ret_x(c, ST_OK);
}

// Status ReleaseOutputBufferIndex(int index)
static void ov_release_output(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_RELEASE_OUTPUT); return; }
    Signals s = {0};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    int st = ST_ERROR;
    if (index >= 0 && index < OUT_BUFS && m->out_held[index]) {
        int queued = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m->nready; i++) queued |= m->ready[i].index == index;
        for (int i = 0; i < m->ndecoded; i++) queued |= m->decoded[i].index == index;
        if (!queued) {
            m->out_held[index] = 0;
            WakeConditionVariable(&m->work);
            st = ST_OK;
        }
    }
    collect(m, &s);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&m->mu);
    fire(c, &s);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

static void ov_get_last_error(Cpu *c) {
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_LAST_ERROR); return; }
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    int e = m->last_error;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)e);
}

static int output_format(Cpu *c, Movie *m, int index, uint64_t md) {
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    int ok = index >= 0 && index < OUT_BUFS && m->out_held[index], w = m->w, h = m->h;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&m->mu);
    if (!ok) return ST_ERROR;
    set_format(c, w, h, md);
    return ST_OK;
}

// Status GetOutputBufferFormat(int index, MediaData *format)
static void ov_get_output_buffer_format(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t md = arg_x(c, 2);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_BUFFER_FORMAT); return; }
    ret_x(c, md ? (uint32_t)output_format(c, m, index, md) : ST_NULL);
}

// Status GetOutputBuffer(int index, Buffer *buffer, MediaData *format)
static void ov_get_output_md(Cpu *c) {
    int index = (int)arg_x(c, 1);
    uint64_t buf = arg_x(c, 2), md = arg_x(c, 3);
    Movie *m = find(arg_x(c, 0));
    if (!m) { pass(c, MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_MD); return; }
    if (!buf && !md) { ret_x(c, ST_NULL); return; }
    int st = md ? output_format(c, m, index, md) : ST_OK;
    if (st == ST_OK && buf) st = get_output(c, m, index, buf);
    ret_x(c, (uint32_t)st);
}

HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN5movie7DecoderC1ENS_11DecoderTypeENS_19DecoderOutputFormatENS_11DecoderModeEi", ov_ctor);
```

`runtime/ov_probe.c`:

```c
// --probe-services: every override of ov_system.c, ov_input.c, ov_media.c, swkbd_win.c and
// ov_gfx.c called the way guest code calls it: by its synthetic address through rt_call / rt_dispatch, with AAPCS64
// arguments, on the guest main thread. Checks that each one matches a relocation of the loaded modules, then the
// values: language, operation mode, notification messages, account, time round trips, controllers, codec state,
// graphics records, the system events behind nfp and vi, the software keyboard with arguments built by the guest SDK
// (answers from TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER, then the window pressed by TOTK_SWKBD_TEST) and the shared fonts when
// tools/extract_fonts.py has written them. The named fatal stubs, and the account UID of a second run, are checked in
// child processes (this executable again, TOTK_PROBE_SERVICES_CHILD=<case>).

#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "fs.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "kernel.h"
#include "ov.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "ui_text.h"

#define CHILD_ENV "TOTK_PROBE_SERVICES_CHILD"
#define TRY_WAIT_SYSTEM_EVENT "_ZN2nn2os18TryWaitSystemEventEPNS0_15SystemEventTypeE"

typedef struct { const char *key, *name; int fatal; uint64_t addr; int bound, calls; } Ov;
static Ov ovs[] = {
    // ov_system.c: nn::oe
    {"oe.Initialize", "_ZN2nn2oe10InitializeEv"},
    {"oe.GetDesiredLanguage", "_ZN2nn2oe18GetDesiredLanguageEv"},
    {"oe.SetPerformanceConfiguration", "_ZN2nn2oe27SetPerformanceConfigurationENS0_15PerformanceModeEi"},
    {"oe.SetCpuBoostMode", "_ZN2nn2oe15SetCpuBoostModeENS0_12CpuBoostModeE"},
    {"oe.GetOperationMode", "_ZN2nn2oe16GetOperationModeEv"},
    {"oe.GetPerformanceMode", "_ZN2nn2oe18GetPerformanceModeEv"},
    {"oe.SetFocusHandlingMode", "_ZN2nn2oe20SetFocusHandlingModeENS0_17FocusHandlingModeE"},
    {"oe.GetCurrentFocusState", "_ZN2nn2oe20GetCurrentFocusStateEv"},
    {"oe.SetResumeNotificationEnabled", "_ZN2nn2oe28SetResumeNotificationEnabledEb"},
    {"oe.SetOperationModeChangedNotificationEnabled", "_ZN2nn2oe42SetOperationModeChangedNotificationEnabledEb"},
    {"oe.SetPerformanceModeChangedNotificationEnabled", "_ZN2nn2oe44SetPerformanceModeChangedNotificationEnabledEb"},
    // applet, am, oe (applet_host.c)
    {"applet.GetPreviousProgramIndex", "_ZN2nn6applet23GetPreviousProgramIndexEv"},
    {"applet.GetAppletResourceUserId", "_ZN2nn6applet23GetAppletResourceUserIdEv"},
    {"am.GetAppletResourceUserId", "_ZN2nn2am23GetAppletResourceUserIdEv"},
    {"oe.TryPopLaunchParameter", "_ZN2nn2oe21TryPopLaunchParameterEPmPvm"},
    {"oe.GetExpectedVolumeBalance", "_ZN2nn2oe24GetExpectedVolumeBalanceEPfS1_"},
    {"oe.SetExpectedVolumeBalance", "_ZN2nn2oe24SetExpectedVolumeBalanceEff"},
    {"oe.GetProgramTotalActiveTime", "_ZN2nn2oe25GetProgramTotalActiveTimeEv"},
    {"oe.SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtended", "_ZN2nn2oe38SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtendedEb"},
    {"oe.SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtendedUnsafe", "_ZN2nn2oe44SetUserInactivityDetectionTimeExtendedUnsafeEb"},
```
