`runtime/ov_zstd.c`:

```c
// The game's zstd decoder on the host's libzstd. Most RomFS files of TotK 1.4.3 are zstd frames, many with a
// dictionary from Pack/ZsDic.pack.zs; the decoder is BSD zstd linked into main. The patch set "zstd"
// (recomp/patches-v143.txt) sends every call of ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame (main+0x3a1f0) and of ZSTD_decompress_usingDDict
// (main+0x3a1e0) to the two host functions below, on the patch page. Lifted, the decoder ran its literal and match
// copies as chains of small functions with the registers in Cpu; here the same frames decode in native code.
//
// - Results match the guest's: libzstd decodes the same format, and every result that is an error goes to the guest
//   decoder again (it writes its own error code; a frame libzstd rejects may still be one the game's version accepts).
// - A guest ZSTD_DDict (zstd's struct: dictBuffer, dictContent, dictSize first) becomes a host ZSTD_DDict made from a
//   copy of its content, cached by guest address, content address, size and a fingerprint of the content.
// - Inputs of at least AWAY_BYTES give the virtual core up while they decode (other guest threads run on it).
// TOTK_ZSTD_NATIVE=0 keeps the guest decoder (the patch set switch); TOTK_ZSTD_CHECK=1 decodes each call both ways,
// keeps the guest's result and logs every call where the two differ.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define ZSTD_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY
#include <zstd.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"

#if __has_include("patches.h")
#include "patches.h"
#endif

#ifdef RT_PATCH_PAGE

#define GUEST_MULTIFRAME 0x700003a1f0ull   // 1.4.3 main: ZSTD_decompressMultiFrame (only 1.4.3 has the patch sites)
#define GUEST_USING_DDICT 0x700003a1e0ull  // ZSTD_decompress_usingDDict
#define HOST_MULTIFRAME (RT_PATCH_PAGE + 0xff0)
#define HOST_USING_DDICT (RT_PATCH_PAGE + 0xfe0)
#define AWAY_BYTES (64u << 10)
#define MAX_DICT (64u << 20)
#define NDICT 32

static void *gp(uint64_t a) { return (void *)(uintptr_t)a; }

typedef struct {
    uint64_t guest, content, size, print;
    ZSTD_DDict *dd;
} Dict;
static Dict dicts[NDICT];
static int ndicts;
static SRWLOCK dict_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static struct {
    uint64_t calls, in, out, ns, guest_ns, fallbacks, away, inplace;
} S;

static int check_mode(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) v = cfg_bool("TOTK_ZSTD_CHECK");
    return v;
}

// Size, both ends and a sample of the middle: what tells a new dictionary at a reused address from the old one.
static uint64_t fingerprint(const uint8_t *p, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t h = n * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    uint64_t at[3] = {0, n / 2, n > 64 ? n - 64 : 0};
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++)
        for (uint64_t i = at[k]; i < at[k] + 64 && i < n; i += 8) {
            uint64_t v = 0;
            memcpy(&v, p + i, n - i < 8 ? n - i : 8);
            h = (h ^ v) * 0xC2B2AE3D27D4EB4Full;
            h ^= h >> 29;
        }
    return h;
}

// The host dictionary for a guest ZSTD_DDict or raw dictionary bytes (guest == 0); NULL when its fields look wrong.
static ZSTD_DDict *dict_for(uint64_t guest, uint64_t content, uint64_t size) {
    if (!content || !size || size > MAX_DICT || content >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT || content + size > RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT)
        return NULL;
    uint64_t print = fingerprint(gp(content), size);
    ZSTD_DDict *dd = NULL;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&dict_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < ndicts && !dd; i++)
        if (dicts[i].guest == guest && dicts[i].content == content && dicts[i].size == size && dicts[i].print == print)
            dd = dicts[i].dd;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&dict_lock);
    if (dd) return dd;
    // A copy: the guest may free or reuse its buffer. Entries are never freed (another thread may be decoding with
    // one); a full table sends further dictionaries to the guest decoder.
    ZSTD_DDict *made = ZSTD_createDDict(gp(content), (size_t)size);
    if (!made) return NULL;
    int slot = -1;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&dict_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < ndicts && !dd; i++)   // another thread may have made it meanwhile
        if (dicts[i].guest == guest && dicts[i].content == content && dicts[i].size == size && dicts[i].print == print)
            dd = dicts[i].dd;
    if (!dd && ndicts < NDICT) slot = ndicts, dicts[ndicts++] = (Dict){guest, content, size, print, made}, dd = made;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&dict_lock);
    if (dd != made) {
        ZSTD_freeDDict(made);
        if (!dd) rt_log("zstd: more than %d dictionaries: further ones decode in the guest", NDICT);
        return dd;
    }
    rt_log("zstd: host dictionary %d for %s %#llx: %llu bytes at %#llx, id %u", slot, guest ? "DDict" : "raw dict",
           (unsigned long long)(guest ? guest : content), (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)content,
           ZSTD_getDictID_fromDDict(dd));
    return dd;
}

// Decodes on this thread's host context. Returns libzstd's result; *ok 0 when the inputs cannot be taken.
static size_t host_decode(uint64_t dst, uint64_t cap, uint64_t src, uint64_t size, uint64_t dict, uint64_t dict_size,
                          uint64_t ddict, int *ok) {
    static __thread ZSTD_DCtx *dctx;
    *ok = 0;
    if ((cap && !dst) || !src || src + size > RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT) return 0;   // dst: decode() checks a guest one
    ZSTD_DDict *dd = NULL;
    if (ddict) {
        if (ddict >= RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT - 24) return 0;
        uint64_t f[3];   // ZSTD_DDict: dictBuffer, dictContent, dictSize
        memcpy(f, gp(ddict), sizeof f);
        if (!(dd = dict_for(ddict, f[1], f[2]))) {
            static int logged;
            if (logged < 4) {
                uint64_t w[8];
                memcpy(w, gp(ddict), sizeof w);
                logged++;
                rt_log("zstd: DDict %#llx not taken: %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx %llx", (unsigned long long)ddict,
                       (unsigned long long)w[0], (unsigned long long)w[1], (unsigned long long)w[2], (unsigned long long)w[3],
                       (unsigned long long)w[4], (unsigned long long)w[5], (unsigned long long)w[6], (unsigned long long)w[7]);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    } else if (dict && dict_size) {
        if (!(dd = dict_for(0, dict, dict_size))) return 0;
    }
    if (!dctx && !(dctx = ZSTD_createDCtx())) return 0;
    *ok = 1;
    return dd ? ZSTD_decompress_usingDDict(dctx, gp(dst), (size_t)cap, gp(src), (size_t)size, dd)
              : ZSTD_decompressDCtx(dctx, gp(dst), (size_t)cap, gp(src), (size_t)size);
}

// The host call inside the thread's host depth, as hostfn.c counts it for asynchronous preemption.
static size_t tracked_decode(Cpu *c, uint64_t dst, uint64_t cap, uint64_t src, uint64_t size, uint64_t dict,
                             uint64_t dict_size, uint64_t ddict, int *ok) {
    int *d = kern_host_track && c->thread ? kern_host_depth(c->thread) : NULL;
    if (d) __atomic_store_n(d, *d + 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    int away = size >= AWAY_BYTES ? kern_core_away() : 0;
    if (away) __atomic_add_fetch(&S.away, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    size_t r = host_decode(dst, cap, src, size, dict, dict_size, ddict, ok);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    if (d) {
        int n = *d - 1;
        __atomic_store_n(d, n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        if (!n && kern_preempt_pending(c->thread)) kern_host_left(c->thread);
    }
    return r;
}

static void count(uint64_t in, uint64_t out, uint64_t ns) {
    uint64_t n = __atomic_add_fetch(&S.calls, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&S.in, in, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&S.out, out, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&S.ns, ns, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (n == 1 || !(n & 0x3fff))
        rt_log("zstd: %llu calls on the host, %.1f MiB in, %.1f MiB out, %.0f ms (check mode: the guest decoder %.0f ms); "
               "%llu to the guest decoder, %llu in place in the guest, %llu with the core given up", (unsigned long long)n,
               S.in / 1048576.0, S.out / 1048576.0, S.ns / 1e6, S.guest_ns / 1e6, (unsigned long long)S.fallbacks,
               (unsigned long long)S.inplace, (unsigned long long)S.away);
}

// x0 dctx, x1 dst, x2 capacity, x3 src, x4 size, then (dict, dict size, ddict) as the entry has them. guest: the
// guest function with the same arguments, n of them.
static void decode(Cpu *c, uint64_t dict, uint64_t dict_size, uint64_t ddict, uint64_t guest, int n) {
    uint64_t a[8];
    memcpy(a, c->x, sizeof a);
    uint64_t dst = a[1], cap = a[2], src = a[3], size = a[4];
    // In place (the input inside the output buffer): the result depends on how the decoder's writes overtake its
    // reads, which libzstd does not promise to do as the game's version does, and a host decode that failed half way
    // would leave the guest decoder a damaged input. Such calls stay in the guest.
    if (cap && src < dst + cap && dst < src + size) {
        __atomic_add_fetch(&S.inplace, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        rt_call(c, guest, n, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]);
        return;
    }
    if (check_mode()) {
        uint8_t *mine = cap ? malloc((size_t)cap) : NULL;
        int ok = 0;
        uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
        size_t r = cap && !mine ? 0 : tracked_decode(c, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mine, cap, src, size, dict, dict_size, ddict, &ok);
        uint64_t t1 = kern_now_ns();
        uint64_t g = rt_call(c, guest, n, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&S.guest_ns, kern_now_ns() - t1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&S.ns, t1 - t0, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        static int logged;
        if (logged < 6 && (!ok || ZSTD_isError(r))) {
            logged++;
            rt_log("zstd check: host %s, guest %llu; dctx %#llx dst %#llx cap %llu src %#llx size %llu dict %#llx/%llu "
                   "ddict %#llx", !ok ? "inputs not taken" : ZSTD_getErrorName(r), (unsigned long long)g,
                   (unsigned long long)a[0], (unsigned long long)dst, (unsigned long long)cap, (unsigned long long)src,
                   (unsigned long long)size, (unsigned long long)dict, (unsigned long long)dict_size,
                   (unsigned long long)ddict);
        }
        if (ok && !ZSTD_isError(r) && (g != r || (r && memcmp(mine, gp(dst), r)))) {
            const uint8_t *p = gp(src);
            size_t fs = ZSTD_findFrameCompressedSize(p, (size_t)size);
            unsigned long long cs = ZSTD_getFrameContentSize(p, (size_t)size);
            ZSTD_DCtx *fresh = ZSTD_createDCtx();
            size_t r2 = ZSTD_decompressDCtx(fresh, mine, (size_t)cap, p, (size_t)size);
            ZSTD_freeDCtx(fresh);
            static int nlog;
            if (nlog++ < 8)
                rt_log("zstd check: MISMATCH %llu bytes from %#llx (cap %llu, first frame %lld bytes, content %lld, magic "
                       "%02x%02x%02x%02x, header %02x, dict %#llx/%llu, ddict %#llx, entry %s, lr %#llx): the host decoded "
                       "%llu bytes, the guest %lld%s; a fresh context without a dictionary: %s", (unsigned long long)size,
                       (unsigned long long)src, (unsigned long long)cap, ZSTD_isError(fs) ? -1ll : (long long)fs,
                       (long long)cs, p[3], p[2], p[1], p[0], p[4], (unsigned long long)dict,
                       (unsigned long long)dict_size, (unsigned long long)ddict, n == 8 ? "MultiFrame" : "usingDDict",
                       (unsigned long long)c->x[30], (unsigned long long)r, (long long)g, g == r ? " (other contents)" : "",
                       ZSTD_isError(r2) ? ZSTD_getErrorName(r2) : "decodes");
        }
        free(mine);
        count(size, ok && !ZSTD_isError(r) ? r : 0, 0);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
    int ok = 0;
    size_t r = dst + cap > RT_ADDRESS_LIMIT ? 0 : tracked_decode(c, dst, cap, src, size, dict, dict_size, ddict, &ok);
    if (!ok || ZSTD_isError(r)) {   // the guest decoder decides (and writes its own error code)
        __atomic_add_fetch(&S.fallbacks, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        static int logged;
        if (logged < 8) {
            logged++;
            rt_log("zstd: %llu bytes at %#llx go to the guest decoder: %s", (unsigned long long)size,
                   (unsigned long long)src, !ok ? "inputs not taken" : ZSTD_getErrorName(r));
        }
        rt_call(c, guest, n, a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]);
        return;
    }
    c->x[0] = r;
    count(size, r, kern_now_ns() - t0);
}

static void host_multiframe(Cpu *c) { decode(c, c->x[5], c->x[6], c->x[7], GUEST_MULTIFRAME, 8); }
static void host_using_ddict(Cpu *c) { decode(c, 0, 0, c->x[5], GUEST_USING_DDICT, 6); }

__attribute__((constructor)) static void zstd_register(void) {
    rt_register_host(HOST_MULTIFRAME, host_multiframe);
    rt_register_host(HOST_USING_DDICT, host_using_ddict);
}

#endif
```

`runtime/patches.c`:

```c
// Code patch sets (recomp/patches.py, gen.py --patches). The generator lifts both the original and the replacement
// instructions of every patched site, and rt_patch_on[set] picks one when the site runs, so a set is switched at start
// without touching code, and also while the game runs (rt_patch_switch: the frame-limit setting of the menu). The sets,
// their environment switches and defaults, and the patch page come from the generated patches.h; without it (C
// generated without --patches) there are no sets and every site runs the original.
//
// The patch page is the first 4 KiB page after main's image, inside the module window memory.c reserved: replacement
// code reaches it with one adrp, as MacNativeGames' data page after main (games/totk/runtime/game_patches.c). Its
// layout belongs to the sets that use it (frame_rate.c: +0 the 30 Hz ratio, +4 the frame step in seconds, +8 the
// step in 60 Hz ticks).
// Probe modes never call rt_patches_init: every set stays off.
#include "cfg.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"

#if __has_include("patches.h")
#include "patches.h"
#endif
#ifndef RT_PATCH_COUNT
#define RT_PATCH_COUNT 0
#endif

uint8_t rt_patch_on[RT_PATCH_COUNT > 0 ? RT_PATCH_COUNT : 1];   // read by the generated C at every patched site

#if RT_PATCH_COUNT
static const struct { const char *name, *env; int on; } sets[] = {
#define X(i, n, e, d) {#n, e, d},
    RT_PATCH_SETS(X)
#undef X
};
static void *page;
#endif

void rt_patches_init(void) {
#if RT_PATCH_COUNT
    if (!plat_mem_commit(RT_PATCH_PAGE, 0x1000))
        rt_fatal("patches: cannot commit the patch page at %#llx", RT_PATCH_PAGE);
    page = (void *)(uintptr_t)RT_PATCH_PAGE;
    char list[512];
    size_t n = 0;
    list[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < RT_PATCH_COUNT; i++) {
        const char *e = cfg_get(sets[i].env);
        // a set with a row in the settings table takes its default from there; the generated default serves the rest
        rt_patch_on[i] = (uint8_t)(cfg_meta(sets[i].env) ? cfg_bool(sets[i].env) : e && *e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : sets[i].on);
        n += (size_t)snprintf(list + n, sizeof list - n, "%s%s %s", i ? ", " : "", sets[i].name,
                              rt_patch_on[i] ? "on" : "off");
        if (n >= sizeof list) n = sizeof list - 1;
    }
    rt_log("patches: %s (page %#llx)", list, RT_PATCH_PAGE);
#endif
}

int rt_patch_set(const char *name) {
#if RT_PATCH_COUNT
    for (int i = 0; i < RT_PATCH_COUNT; i++)
        if (!strcmp(sets[i].name, name)) return i;
#endif
    (void)name;
    return -1;
}

int rt_patch_enabled(int set) { return set >= 0 && set < RT_PATCH_COUNT && rt_patch_on[set]; }

void rt_patch_disable(int set) {
    if (set >= 0 && set < RT_PATCH_COUNT) rt_patch_on[set] = 0;
}

void rt_patch_switch(int set, int on) {
    if (set >= 0 && set < RT_PATCH_COUNT) __atomic_store_n(&rt_patch_on[set], (uint8_t)(on != 0), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

void *rt_patch_page(void) {
#if RT_PATCH_COUNT
    return page;
#else
    return NULL;
#endif
}
```

`runtime/perfmon.c`:

```c
// Performance overlay numbers (runtime/perfmon.h). Frame times come from the game's presents (perf_present, only while
// the overlay is on); the per-frame waits from the perf counters prof_win.c keeps. The machine's numbers are sampled
// twice a second on a thread of their own (some calls take milliseconds), which runs only while the overlay is full.
// The OS calls sit behind platform.h (plat_cpu_load, plat_mem_info, plat_gpu_load). Temperature, power and clock come
// from the GPU vendor's driver library, loaded at run time: NVML on NVIDIA, ADL's PM log on AMD; on a machine without
// either their numbers stay -1.
//
// Adapted from SavageWindRecomp's runtime/perfmon.c (https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp @
// 575ad88e02f9a89a9a885d90039d48af33c982f4, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Revivedx and the Savage Wind Recomp contributors,
// Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai): the frame ring and its one-second summary, the NVML calls, the sampler loop. The
// Windows, Linux and macOS sampling moved behind platform.h, GPU load and video memory come from the system's counters
// for every vendor, and the sampler stops when the overlay leaves full.
//
// The ADL declarations (AdapterInfo, ADLSingleSensorData, ADLPMLogDataOutput, the ADL_PMLOG_* sensor numbers and the
// ADL2_* signatures) are copied from AMD's display-library include/adl_structures.h, adl_defines.h and adl_sdk.h
// (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/display-library @ 84c881cb2136f04287eb3af12de00a9e2867aa9e, MIT,
// Copyright (c) 2016 - 2022 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "perfmon.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "sysinfo.h"

static PlatMutex g_lock = PLAT_MUTEX_INIT;   // everything below
static PerfStats g_stats;                    // the machine numbers the sampler wrote; the rest is made per snapshot

// ---- frames
static float g_ring[PERF_HISTORY];
static uint64_t g_ring_at[PERF_HISTORY];   // when each frame ended
static int g_ring_n, g_ring_pos;

// The per-frame counters, summed since t0 (the overlay's lines are averages over half a second).
static struct {
    uint64_t t0, frames, gpu0;
    double replay, pipe, xlate, tex;
    int64_t up0, up;
} g_win;

void perfmon_frame(uint64_t now, uint64_t interval_ns, const uint64_t *wait_ns, uint64_t replay_ns,
                   int64_t tex_uploads) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (interval_ns) {
        g_ring[g_ring_pos] = (float)(interval_ns / 1e6);
        g_ring_at[g_ring_pos] = now;
        g_ring_pos = (g_ring_pos + 1) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (g_ring_n < PERF_HISTORY) g_ring_n++;
    }
    g_win.frames++;
    g_win.replay += replay_ns / 1e6;
    g_win.pipe += wait_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6;
    g_win.xlate += wait_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6;
    g_win.tex += wait_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6;
    g_win.up = tex_uploads;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void frames_summary(PerfStats *s, uint64_t now) {   // (lock held)
    double sum = 0, mx = 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ring_n; i++) {
        int k = (g_ring_pos - 1 - i + PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY;
        if (now - g_ring_at[k] > 1000000000ull) break;   // the last second
        sum += g_ring[k];
        if (g_ring[k] > mx) mx = g_ring[k];
        n++;
    }
    s->fps = n && sum > 0 ? (float)(n * 1000.0 / sum) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_avg = n ? (float)(sum / n) : 0;
    s->frame_ms_max = (float)mx;
    for (int i = 0; i < PERF_HISTORY; i++) {   // oldest first; frames not seen yet read 0
        int age = PERF_HISTORY - 1 - i;
        s->frame_ms[i] = age < g_ring_n ? g_ring[(g_ring_pos - 1 - age + 2 * PERF_HISTORY) % PERF_HISTORY] : 0;
    }
}

// Every half second: the window's sums as per-frame averages into g_stats, and a new window. (lock held)
static void counters_summary(uint64_t now) {
    if (now - g_win.t0 < 500000000ull) return;
    uint64_t gpu = perf_gpu_busy_total();
    if (g_win.t0 && g_win.frames) {
        double n = (double)g_win.frames;
        g_stats.replay_ms = (float)(g_win.replay / n);
        g_stats.pipe_wait_ms = (float)(g_win.pipe / n);
        g_stats.xlate_ms = (float)(g_win.xlate / n);
        g_stats.tex_ms = (float)(g_win.tex / n);
        g_stats.tex_uploads = (float)((g_win.up - g_win.up0) / n);
        // no GPU time over a window of frames: no timestamps on this device (or not yet set up)
        g_stats.gpu_ms = gpu > g_win.gpu0 ? (float)((gpu - g_win.gpu0) / 1e6 / n) : -1;
    }
    g_win.t0 = now;
    g_win.frames = 0;
    g_win.gpu0 = gpu;
    g_win.replay = g_win.pipe = g_win.xlate = g_win.tex = 0;
    g_win.up0 = g_win.up;
}

// ---- NVML (NVIDIA): loaded once on the sampler thread, kept for the process
typedef struct { unsigned gpu, memory; } NvmlUtil;
typedef struct { unsigned long long total, free, used; } NvmlMem;
static struct {
    int tried, ok;
    void *dev;
    int (*util)(void *, NvmlUtil *);
    int (*temp)(void *, int, unsigned *);
    int (*mem)(void *, NvmlMem *);
    int (*power)(void *, unsigned *);
    int (*clock)(void *, int, unsigned *);
} nv;

static char g_gpu_name[96];
static uint8_t g_gpu_luid[8];
static int g_gpu_luid_ok;
static int g_gpu_bus = -1;
static float g_vram_total_mb = -1;

void perfmon_set_gpu(const char *name, const uint8_t *luid, int pci_bus, float vram_total_mb) {
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    snprintf(g_gpu_name, sizeof g_gpu_name, "%s", name ? name : "");
    g_gpu_luid_ok = luid != NULL;
    if (luid) memcpy(g_gpu_luid, luid, sizeof g_gpu_luid);
    g_gpu_bus = pci_bus;
    g_vram_total_mb = vram_total_mb > 0 ? vram_total_mb : -1;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

static void nvml_open(const char *hint) {
    nv.tried = 1;
#ifdef _WIN32
    static const char *const names[] = {"nvml.dll", "C:\\Program Files\\NVIDIA Corporation\\NVSMI\\nvml.dll"};
#else
    static const char *const names[] = {"libnvidia-ml.so.1"};
#endif
    void *lib = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; !lib && i < sizeof names / sizeof *names; i++) lib = plat_lib_open(names[i]);
    if (!lib) return;
    int (*init)(void) = (int (*)(void))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlInit_v2");
    int (*count)(unsigned *) = (int (*)(unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetCount_v2");
    int (*handle)(unsigned, void **) = (int (*)(unsigned, void **))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex_v2");
    int (*name)(void *, char *, unsigned) = (int (*)(void *, char *, unsigned))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetName");
    nv.util = (int (*)(void *, NvmlUtil *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetUtilizationRates");
    nv.temp = (int (*)(void *, int, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetTemperature");
    nv.mem = (int (*)(void *, NvmlMem *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo");
    nv.power = (int (*)(void *, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetPowerUsage");
    nv.clock = (int (*)(void *, int, unsigned *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "nvmlDeviceGetClockInfo");
    if (!init || !count || !handle || init() != 0) return;
    unsigned n = 0;
    if (count(&n) != 0 || !n) return;
    // the device Vulkan renders on (by name; an NVIDIA name only matches an NVIDIA GPU), else none: on a machine
    // that renders on another vendor's GPU, NVML's numbers would belong to the wrong card
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && !nv.dev; i++) {
        void *d = NULL;
        char nm[96] = "";
        if (handle(i, &d) != 0 || !name || name(d, nm, sizeof nm) != 0 || !nm[0]) continue;
        if (hint[0] && (strstr(hint, nm) || strstr(nm, hint))) nv.dev = d;
    }
    nv.ok = nv.dev != NULL;
    rt_log("perfmon: NVML %s", nv.ok ? "found the rendering GPU" : "has no device matching the rendering GPU");
}

static void nvml_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!nv.ok) return;
    NvmlUtil u;
    NvmlMem m;
    unsigned v;
    if (s->gpu_pct < 0 && nv.util && nv.util(nv.dev, &u) == 0) s->gpu_pct = (float)u.gpu;   // the system's counters first
    if (nv.mem && nv.mem(nv.dev, &m) == 0) {
        if (s->vram_used_mb < 0) s->vram_used_mb = (float)(m.used >> 20);
        s->vram_total_mb = (float)(m.total >> 20);
    }
    if (nv.temp && nv.temp(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_TEMPERATURE_GPU */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v;
    if (nv.power && nv.power(nv.dev, &v) == 0) s->gpu_power_w = v / 1000.0f;
    if (nv.clock && nv.clock(nv.dev, 0 /* NVML_CLOCK_GRAPHICS */, &v) == 0) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v;
}

// ---- ADL (AMD): loaded once on the sampler thread, kept for the process. ADL2_New_QueryPMLogData_Get reads the PM log
// the driver keeps for Radeon RX 5000 and later (the numbers Adrenalin's overlay shows); older GPUs answer with an
// error and their numbers stay -1. Windows only: the Linux driver gives these through sysfs, which this does not read.
#ifdef _WIN32
#define ADL_MAX_PATH 256
#define ADL_PMLOG_MAX_SENSORS 256
enum {
    ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK = 1,
    ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE = 8,
    ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX = 19,
    ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER = 23,
    ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT = 27,
    ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER = 73,
};
typedef struct {   // AdapterInfo, the Windows layout
    int iSize, iAdapterIndex;
    char strUDID[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iBusNumber, iDeviceNumber, iFunctionNumber, iVendorID;
    char strAdapterName[ADL_MAX_PATH], strDisplayName[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iPresent, iExist;
    char strDriverPath[ADL_MAX_PATH], strDriverPathExt[ADL_MAX_PATH], strPNPString[ADL_MAX_PATH];
    int iOSDisplayIndex;
} AdlAdapterInfo;
typedef struct { int supported, value; } AdlSensor;
typedef struct { int size; AdlSensor sensors[ADL_PMLOG_MAX_SENSORS]; } AdlPmLog;
typedef void *(__stdcall *AdlAlloc)(int);

static struct {
    int tried, ok, index;
    void *ctx;
    int (*pmlog)(void *, int, AdlPmLog *);
    AdlPmLog log;   // the sampler thread's buffer
} adl;

static void *__stdcall adl_alloc(int n) { return malloc((size_t)n); }

// The adapter Vulkan renders on: the PCI bus when the device gave one, else the name. ADL lists one index per display
// output of a GPU; the first whose PM log answers is taken.
static void adl_open(const char *hint, int bus) {
    adl.tried = 1;
    void *lib = plat_lib_open("atiadlxx.dll");
    if (!lib) return;
    int (*create)(AdlAlloc, int, void **) = (int (*)(AdlAlloc, int, void **))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Main_Control_Create");
    int (*count)(void *, int *) = (int (*)(void *, int *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_NumberOfAdapters_Get");
    int (*info)(void *, AdlAdapterInfo *, int) =
        (int (*)(void *, AdlAdapterInfo *, int))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_Adapter_AdapterInfo_Get");
    adl.pmlog = (int (*)(void *, int, AdlPmLog *))plat_lib_sym(lib, "ADL2_New_QueryPMLogData_Get");
    int n = 0;
    if (!create || !count || !info || !adl.pmlog || create(adl_alloc, 1, &adl.ctx) != 0 || count(adl.ctx, &n) != 0 ||
        n <= 0 || n > 256)
        return;
    AdlAdapterInfo *a = (AdlAdapterInfo *)calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *a);
    if (a) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i].iSize = sizeof *a;
        if (info(adl.ctx, a, n * (int)sizeof *a) == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n && !adl.ok; i++) {
                if (a[i].iVendorID != 1002) continue;   // ADL writes the PCI vendor id 0x1002 as decimal 1002
                const char *nm = a[i].strAdapterName;
                if (bus >= 0 ? a[i].iBusNumber != bus : !hint[0] || !nm[0] || !(strstr(hint, nm) || strstr(nm, hint)))
                    continue;
                memset(&adl.log, 0, sizeof adl.log);
                adl.log.size = sizeof adl.log;
                if (adl.pmlog(adl.ctx, a[i].iAdapterIndex, &adl.log) != 0) continue;
                adl.index = a[i].iAdapterIndex;
                adl.ok = 1;
            }
        }
        free(a);
    }
    rt_log("perfmon: ADL %s", adl.ok ? "found the rendering GPU" : "has no PM log for the rendering GPU");
}

static void adl_sample(PerfStats *s) {
    if (!adl.ok) return;
    memset(&adl.log, 0, sizeof adl.log);
    adl.log.size = sizeof adl.log;
    if (adl.pmlog(adl.ctx, adl.index, &adl.log) != 0) return;
    const AdlSensor *v = adl.log.sensors;
    if (s->gpu_pct < 0 && v[ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX].supported)   // the system's counters first
        s->gpu_pct = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_INFO_ACTIVITY_GFX].value;
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE].supported) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_EDGE].value;
    else if (v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT].supported) s->gpu_temp_c = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_TEMPERATURE_HOTSPOT].value;
    // the whole card's draw where the driver reports it (RDNA 4 reports no ASIC power), else the GPU chip's
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_BOARD_POWER].value;
    else if (v[ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER].supported) s->gpu_power_w = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_ASIC_POWER].value;
    if (v[ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK].supported) s->gpu_clock_mhz = (float)v[ADL_PMLOG_CLK_GFXCLK].value;
}
#else
static struct { int tried; } adl;
static void adl_open(const char *hint, int bus) { (void)hint, (void)bus, adl.tried = 1; }
static void adl_sample(PerfStats *s) { (void)s; }
#endif

// ---- the machine sampler: runs while want is set, twice a second
static struct {
    int want, alive;
    PlatCond cv;
} g_smp = {0, 0, PLAT_COND_INIT};

static void machine_clear(PerfStats *s) {
    s->cpu_total_pct = s->cpu_game_pct = s->cpu_temp_c = -1;
    s->ram_used_mb = s->ram_total_mb = s->ram_game_mb = -1;
    s->gpu_pct = s->gpu_temp_c = s->gpu_power_w = s->gpu_clock_mhz = s->vram_used_mb = s->vram_total_mb = -1;
}

static void machine_copy(PerfStats *d, const PerfStats *s) {
    memcpy(d->cpu_name, s->cpu_name, sizeof d->cpu_name);
    memcpy(d->gpu_name, s->gpu_name, sizeof d->gpu_name);
    d->cpu_total_pct = s->cpu_total_pct, d->cpu_game_pct = s->cpu_game_pct, d->cpu_temp_c = s->cpu_temp_c;
    d->ram_used_mb = s->ram_used_mb, d->ram_total_mb = s->ram_total_mb, d->ram_game_mb = s->ram_game_mb;
    d->gpu_pct = s->gpu_pct, d->gpu_temp_c = s->gpu_temp_c, d->gpu_power_w = s->gpu_power_w;
    d->gpu_clock_mhz = s->gpu_clock_mhz, d->vram_used_mb = s->vram_used_mb, d->vram_total_mb = s->vram_total_mb;
}

static void sampler(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    PerfStats s;
    memset(&s, 0, sizeof s);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    uint8_t luid[8];
    int have_luid = g_gpu_luid_ok;
    memcpy(luid, g_gpu_luid, sizeof luid);
    snprintf(s.gpu_name, sizeof s.gpu_name, "%s", g_gpu_name);
    int bus = g_gpu_bus;
    float vram_total = g_vram_total_mb;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    sysinfo_cpu_name(s.cpu_name, sizeof s.cpu_name);
    if (!nv.tried) nvml_open(s.gpu_name);
    if (!nv.ok && !adl.tried) adl_open(s.gpu_name, bus);
    PlatLoad *l = plat_load_open(have_luid ? luid : NULL);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    while (g_smp.want) {
        plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        machine_clear(&s);
        plat_cpu_load(l, &s.cpu_total_pct, &s.cpu_game_pct, &s.cpu_temp_c);
        plat_mem_info(&s.ram_used_mb, &s.ram_total_mb, &s.ram_game_mb);
        plat_gpu_load(l, &s.gpu_pct, &s.vram_used_mb);
        s.vram_total_mb = vram_total;
        nvml_sample(&s);
        adl_sample(&s);
        plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
        machine_copy(&g_stats, &s);
        if (g_smp.want) plat_cond_wait_ns(&g_smp.cv, &g_lock, 500000000ull);
    }
    g_smp.alive = 0;   // in the same locked section as the last want check: a new perfmon_mode(2) starts a new thread
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    plat_load_close(l);
}

void perfmon_mode(int mode) {
    perf_set_overlay(mode);
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (mode == 2) {
        g_smp.want = 1;
        if (!g_smp.alive) {
            machine_clear(&g_stats);   // "-" until the first sample, not the numbers of the last time
            PlatThread *t = plat_thread_new(sampler, NULL, "perfmon");
            g_smp.alive = t != NULL;
            if (t) plat_thread_detach(t);
            else rt_log("perfmon: cannot start the sampling thread; the machine numbers stay empty");
        }
    } else {
        g_smp.want = 0;
        plat_cond_signal(&g_smp.cv);
    }
    if (!mode) {   // the next start begins a new graph and a new counter window
        g_ring_n = g_ring_pos = 0;
        memset(&g_win, 0, sizeof g_win);
    }
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out) {
    uint64_t now = plat_now_ns();
    plat_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    frames_summary(&g_stats, now);
    counters_summary(now);
    *out = g_stats;
    plat_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

```

`runtime/perfmon.h`:

```h
// Performance overlay numbers (runtime/perfmon.c): the game's frame rate and frame times, the render thread's waits
// from the perf counters, and the machine's CPU, memory and GPU load and temperatures. A value the machine does not give
// is negative.
//
// Adapted from SavageWindRecomp's runtime/perfmon.h (https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp @
// 575ad88e02f9a89a9a885d90039d48af33c982f4, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Revivedx and the Savage Wind Recomp contributors,
// Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define PERF_HISTORY 120   // frame times kept for the graph

typedef struct {
    // the game's frames (presents), over the last second
    float fps, frame_ms_avg, frame_ms_max;
    float frame_ms[PERF_HISTORY];   // oldest first
    // CPU: the whole machine and this process, percent of all logical processors
    char cpu_name[64];
    float cpu_total_pct, cpu_game_pct, cpu_temp_c;
    // memory, MB
    float ram_used_mb, ram_total_mb, ram_game_mb;
    // GPU: load and dedicated memory from the system's counters, temperature, power and clock from NVML (NVIDIA) or
    // ADL (AMD)
    char gpu_name[96];
    float gpu_pct, gpu_temp_c, gpu_power_w, gpu_clock_mhz, vram_used_mb, vram_total_mb;
    // per frame, averaged over the last half second: replay (NVN to Vulkan recording), GPU busy time (timestamps; -1
    // without them), the render thread's waits for pipeline builds, shader translation and texture uploads, and the
    // textures uploaded
    float replay_ms, gpu_ms, pipe_wait_ms, xlate_ms, tex_ms, tex_uploads;
} PerfStats;

// Overlay mode 0 off, 1 fps, 2 full (TOTK_PERF_OVERLAY), from the present path when the setting changes. Full starts
// the machine sampling thread (twice a second) and turns on the event counts and GPU timestamps; leaving full stops
// them. Off: perf_present skips perfmon_frame and nothing samples.
void perfmon_mode(int mode);
// The Vulkan device the game renders on: its name, its LUID (8 bytes; NULL when the driver gives none), its PCI bus
// (-1 unknown) and its device-local memory. Before the first perfmon_mode(2).
void perfmon_set_gpu(const char *name, const uint8_t *luid, int pci_bus, float vram_total_mb);
// A game frame was presented (perf_present, the render thread, only while the overlay is on): the time since the last
// one, the render thread's waits of this frame (PERF_N entries, host.h), its replay time and the running count of
// texture uploads.
void perfmon_frame(uint64_t now_ns, uint64_t interval_ns, const uint64_t *wait_ns, uint64_t replay_ns,
                   int64_t tex_uploads);
// The latest numbers (the overlay, present path).
void perfmon_snapshot(PerfStats *out);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```h
// FP control on x86-64: MXCSR (rounding control bits 13-14, FTZ bit 15, DAZ bit 6, exception flags and masks).
// Inline on purpose: lifted FP code (simd.h) reads and writes it on every operation that depends on the guest FPCR.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <xmmintrin.h>

#define PLAT_FP_RC_MASK 0x6000u   // rounding control: 0 nearest, 0x2000 down, 0x4000 up, 0x6000 toward zero
#define PLAT_FP_FTZ 0x8000u
#define PLAT_FP_DAZ 0x0040u

static inline uint32_t plat_fp_get(void) { return _mm_getcsr(); }
```

`runtime/platform/platform.h`:

```h
// Platform layer: threads, time, locks. New runtime code calls this instead of the OS;
// one implementation per OS (win32.c). The FP control register lives in the per-architecture fp_*.h headers,
// inline, because lifted FP code touches it on every operation.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(_M_X64)
#include "fp_x86.h"
#endif

// ---- threads
typedef struct PlatThread PlatThread;
typedef void (*PlatThreadFn)(void *arg);

// Starts fn(arg) on a new thread named name (shown in debuggers and profilers; may be NULL). NULL on failure.
PlatThread *plat_thread_new(PlatThreadFn fn, void *arg, const char *name);
void plat_thread_join(PlatThread *t);     // waits for fn to return, then frees t
void plat_thread_detach(PlatThread *t);   // frees t; the thread runs on
// Restricts t (NULL: the calling thread) to the logical processors in mask (bit n = processor n of the first group).
// Returns the previous mask, 0 on failure.
uint64_t plat_thread_affinity(PlatThread *t, uint64_t mask);
uint32_t plat_cpu_count(void);            // logical processors

// ---- time
uint64_t plat_now_ns(void);               // monotonic, high resolution, arbitrary epoch
// t * num / den for a fixed num / den without a 128-bit division per call (__udivti3 took 5% of the game's running
// samples through plat_now_ns and rt_ticks): t * q + (t * f >> 64) with q = num / den and f = (num % den) * 2^64 / den.
// Monotonic in t and at most one below the exact quotient while t * (num % den) / den fits 64 bits.
typedef struct { uint64_t q, f; } PlatScale;
static inline PlatScale plat_scale(uint64_t num, uint64_t den) {
    return (PlatScale){num / den, (uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128)(num % den) << 64) / den)};
}
static inline uint64_t plat_scaled(PlatScale s, uint64_t t) {
    return t * s.q + (uint64_t)(((unsigned __int128)t * s.f) >> 64);
}
void plat_sleep_ns(uint64_t ns);          // returns no earlier than ns later; overshoot well under 1 ms

// ---- locks (not recursive) and condition variables; zero-initialised storage is a valid unlocked lock and an empty
// condition variable (PLAT_MUTEX_INIT / PLAT_COND_INIT spell it).
typedef struct { void *p; } PlatMutex;
typedef struct { void *p; } PlatCond;
#define PLAT_MUTEX_INIT {0}
#define PLAT_COND_INIT {0}
void plat_mutex_init(PlatMutex *m);
void plat_mutex_lock(PlatMutex *m);
int plat_mutex_trylock(PlatMutex *m);     // 1 when acquired
void plat_mutex_unlock(PlatMutex *m);
void plat_cond_init(PlatCond *c);
void plat_cond_wait(PlatCond *c, PlatMutex *m);
int plat_cond_wait_ns(PlatCond *c, PlatMutex *m, uint64_t ns);   // 0 on timeout (spurious wakeups return 1 too)
void plat_cond_signal(PlatCond *c);
void plat_cond_broadcast(PlatCond *c);

// ---- memory
int plat_mem_commit(uint64_t addr, size_t n);             // read-write pages inside a reserved range; 1 on success
int plat_mem_read(uint64_t addr, void *out, size_t n);    // copies n bytes, 0 instead of faulting on unmapped memory

// ---- files. Paths are UTF-8 with either separator; each implementation converts to what the OS wants.
int plat_file_exists(const char *path);                   // 1 for a file (not a directory)
void plat_file_mkdir_p(const char *path);                 // creates every missing directory of path, itself included
// Whole file into a malloc'd buffer with a NUL after the last byte; NULL when missing, empty or over 1 GiB.
uint8_t *plat_file_read(const char *path, uint64_t *size);
int plat_file_write(const char *path, const void *data, size_t n);   // create or truncate; 1 when all n bytes landed
int plat_file_replace(const char *from, const char *to);  // rename, replacing to (write-through); 1 on success
// Writes path.<pid>.<tid>.tmp, flushes it to the disk and renames it over path: a crash leaves the old file or the new
// one, never a torn or zero-filled one. 1 on success.
int plat_file_write_atomic(const char *path, const void *data, size_t n);
int plat_file_flush(const char *path);                   // flushes a written file's data to the disk; 1 on success
void plat_file_delete(const char *path);
int plat_file_truncate(const char *path, uint64_t size);  // 1 on success
int64_t plat_file_size(const char *path);                 // bytes of a file, -1 when missing or unreadable
int plat_file_set_readonly(const char *path, int on);     // sets or clears the read-only attribute; 1 on success
// A file that only grows and other processes may read meanwhile: each write lands whole at its end, from any thread,
// and reaches the file even if the process dies right after (no user-space buffer, no flush to the disk).
typedef struct PlatAppend PlatAppend;
PlatAppend *plat_append_open(const char *path);           // creates or truncates path; NULL on failure
int plat_append_write(PlatAppend *f, const void *data, size_t n);   // 1 when all n bytes landed
// Calls cb(name, ctx) for each file in dir whose name ends in ext (".in"); name has no directory part. cb returns 0 to
// stop. Returns 0 when dir cannot be listed.
int plat_file_list(const char *dir, const char *ext, int (*cb)(const char *name, void *ctx), void *ctx);
int plat_exe_path(char *out, size_t cap);                 // path of the running executable; 0 on failure
// Environment variable as UTF-8 into out; its length, or 0 when unset, empty or too long for cap.
size_t plat_getenv(const char *name, char *out, size_t cap);
// The user's UI language as a BCP-47 tag ("ru-RU", "en-US"); "" when the system gives none. Valid for the process.
const char *plat_ui_language(void);
uint32_t plat_thread_id(void);                            // id of the calling thread, for unique file names
// A system font file with the glyphs of a catalog language ("ja", "ko", "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant"): the menu shows each
// language's name in its own script. Copies the UTF-8 path into out; 0 when the system has none.
int plat_font_path(const char *lang, char *out, size_t cap);
// The operating system and its build ("Windows 10.0.28000") into out; 0 when unknown.
int plat_os_version(char *out, size_t cap);
// The file the process's stderr (the log) goes to, as a UTF-8 path; 0 when stderr is not a file (a console, a pipe).
int plat_stderr_path(char *out, size_t cap);

// ---- desktop: the in-game menu's "Copy system info" and "Open log folder"
int plat_clipboard_set(const char *utf8);                 // replaces the clipboard's text; 1 on success
int plat_open_folder(const char *path);                   // shows the folder in the file manager; 1 on success

// ---- dynamic libraries: a library some machines lack (a GPU vendor's), loaded at run time. A bare name is searched
// in the system directories only. NULL when missing.
void *plat_lib_open(const char *name);
void *plat_lib_sym(void *lib, const char *name);

// ---- machine load for the performance overlay (perfmon.c's sampling thread; each call can take milliseconds). A number
// the system does not give is -1.
typedef struct PlatLoad PlatLoad;
// Opens the counters: CPU times, the thermal zones, and the GPU engine and memory counters of the adapter whose LUID is
// gpu_luid (8 bytes, Vulkan's deviceLUID; NULL: the busiest adapter). Never NULL.
PlatLoad *plat_load_open(const uint8_t *gpu_luid);
void plat_load_close(PlatLoad *l);
// Since the previous call on l (the first call gives -1): CPU use of the machine and of this process, percent of all
// logical processors, and the hottest ACPI thermal zone in degrees Celsius.
void plat_cpu_load(PlatLoad *l, float *total_pct, float *proc_pct, float *temp_c);
// Since the previous call on l: the busiest GPU engine type in percent (as Task Manager shows it), and the adapter's
// dedicated memory in use in MB. Any GPU vendor.
void plat_gpu_load(PlatLoad *l, float *load_pct, float *vram_used_mb);
// Physical memory in MB: in use and installed on the machine, and this process's working set.
void plat_mem_info(float *used_mb, float *total_mb, float *proc_mb);
// Commit charge in MB: this process's private bytes, the system's commit in use and its limit (RAM plus page files).
// An allocation fails when the system's reaches the limit, however much physical memory is free. -1 when unknown.
void plat_commit_info(double *proc_mb, double *used_mb, double *limit_mb);

// ---- child processes: a program with stdin and stdout piped to us (stderr discarded), no console window.
typedef struct PlatChild PlatChild;
// Starts "exe" followed by arg (arg may be NULL). NULL on failure; *err (may be NULL) gets the OS error code.
// Children start one at a time so none inherits another pipe ends.
PlatChild *plat_child_start(const char *exe, const char *arg, uint32_t *err);
void plat_child_stop(PlatChild *c);                       // kills the child and frees c
int plat_child_write(PlatChild *c, const void *data, size_t n);   // 1 when all n bytes were written
long plat_child_read(PlatChild *c, void *buf, size_t cap);        // bytes read (at least 1); 0 or negative: pipe broke
```
