`runtime/platform/win32.c`:

```c
// Windows implementation of platform.h: CreateThread, QueryPerformanceCounter, high-resolution waitable timers,
// SRW locks and condition variables.
#include <stdio.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <pdh.h>
#include <pdhmsg.h>
#include <psapi.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <wchar.h>
#include <wctype.h>

#include "platform.h"

_Static_assert(sizeof(PlatMutex) == sizeof(SRWLOCK), "PlatMutex holds an SRWLOCK");
_Static_assert(sizeof(PlatCond) == sizeof(CONDITION_VARIABLE), "PlatCond holds a CONDITION_VARIABLE");

// ---- threads

struct PlatThread {
    HANDLE h;
    PlatThreadFn fn;
    void *arg;
};

static DWORD WINAPI thread_main(LPVOID p) {
    PlatThread *t = p;
    t->fn(t->arg);
    return 0;
}

PlatThread *plat_thread_new(PlatThreadFn fn, void *arg, const char *name) {
    PlatThread *t = calloc(1, sizeof *t);
    if (!t) return NULL;
    t->fn = fn;
    t->arg = arg;
    t->h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, thread_main, t, CREATE_SUSPENDED, NULL);
    if (!t->h) { free(t); return NULL; }
    if (name) {
        wchar_t w[64];
        if (MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, name, -1, w, 64)) SetThreadDescription(t->h, w);
    }
    ResumeThread(t->h);
    return t;
}

void plat_thread_join(PlatThread *t) {
    WaitForSingleObject(t->h, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(t->h);
    free(t);
}

// The thread keeps using t->fn and t->arg, so the struct stays allocated (a few bytes per detached thread).
void plat_thread_detach(PlatThread *t) {
    CloseHandle(t->h);
    t->h = NULL;
}

uint64_t plat_thread_affinity(PlatThread *t, uint64_t mask) {
    return (uint64_t)SetThreadAffinityMask(t ? t->h : GetCurrentThread(), (DWORD_PTR)mask);
}

uint32_t plat_cpu_count(void) {
    DWORD n = GetActiveProcessorCount(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS);
    return n ? (uint32_t)n : 1;
}

// ---- time

static uint64_t qpc_freq(void) {
    static uint64_t freq;
    if (!freq) {
        LARGE_INTEGER f;
        QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
        freq = (uint64_t)f.QuadPart;
    }
    return freq;
}

static PlatScale qpc_ns;   // set before main, so no thread reads it half written

__attribute__((constructor)) static void qpc_ns_init(void) { qpc_ns = plat_scale(1000000000u, qpc_freq()); }

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void) {
    LARGE_INTEGER t;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t);
    return plat_scaled(qpc_ns, (uint64_t)t.QuadPart);
}

// A high-resolution waitable timer per sleeping thread (Windows 10 1803+; one handle per thread, kept until exit)
// wakes within about 0.1-0.5 ms; the last PLAT_SPIN_NS are spent yielding so the deadline is met closely.
// Without that timer kind, Sleep(1) granularity applies.
#define PLAT_SPIN_NS 300000u

static __thread HANDLE sleep_timer;
static __thread int sleep_timer_tried;

void plat_sleep_ns(uint64_t ns) {
    uint64_t end = plat_now_ns() + ns;
    if (!sleep_timer_tried) {
        sleep_timer_tried = 1;
        sleep_timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    }
    if (ns > PLAT_SPIN_NS) {
        uint64_t coarse = ns - PLAT_SPIN_NS;
        if (sleep_timer) {
            LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)(coarse / 100)};   // relative, 100 ns units
            if (SetWaitableTimerEx(sleep_timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0))
                WaitForSingleObject(sleep_timer, INFINITE);
            else Sleep((DWORD)(coarse / 1000000));
        } else Sleep((DWORD)(coarse / 1000000));
    }
    while (plat_now_ns() < end) SwitchToThread();
}

// ---- locks and condition variables

void plat_mutex_init(PlatMutex *m) { InitializeSRWLock((PSRWLOCK)m); }
void plat_mutex_lock(PlatMutex *m) { AcquireSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)m); }
int plat_mutex_trylock(PlatMutex *m) { return TryAcquireSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)m) != 0; }
void plat_mutex_unlock(PlatMutex *m) { ReleaseSRWLockExclusive((PSRWLOCK)m); }

void plat_cond_init(PlatCond *c) { InitializeConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }
void plat_cond_wait(PlatCond *c, PlatMutex *m) { SleepConditionVariableSRW((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c, (PSRWLOCK)m, INFINITE, 0); }

int plat_cond_wait_ns(PlatCond *c, PlatMutex *m, uint64_t ns) {
    uint64_t ms = (ns + 999999) / 1000000;
    DWORD to = ms >= INFINITE ? INFINITE - 1 : (DWORD)ms;
    return SleepConditionVariableSRW((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c, (PSRWLOCK)m, to, 0) ? 1 : GetLastError() != ERROR_TIMEOUT;
}

void plat_cond_signal(PlatCond *c) { WakeConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }
void plat_cond_broadcast(PlatCond *c) { WakeAllConditionVariable((PCONDITION_VARIABLE)c); }

// ---- files

static int widen(const char *s, wchar_t *w, int cap) {
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s, -1, w, cap);
    if (!n) w[0] = 0;
    return n;
}

#define WPATH 2048

int plat_file_exists(const char *path) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return 0;
    DWORD a = GetFileAttributesW(w);
    return a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && !(a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY);
}

void plat_file_mkdir_p(const char *path) {
    wchar_t tmp[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, tmp, WPATH)) return;
    for (wchar_t *p = tmp + 1; *p; p++) {
        if (*p == L'\\' || *p == L'/') {
            wchar_t c = *p;
            *p = 0;
            CreateDirectoryW(tmp, NULL);
            *p = c;
        }
    }
    CreateDirectoryW(tmp, NULL);
}

uint8_t *plat_file_read(const char *path, uint64_t *size) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return NULL;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING,
                           FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return NULL;
    LARGE_INTEGER sz;
    uint8_t *buf = NULL;
    if (GetFileSizeEx(h, &sz) && sz.QuadPart > 0 && sz.QuadPart < (1ll << 30)) {
        buf = malloc((size_t)sz.QuadPart + 1);
        DWORD got = 0;
        if (buf && (!ReadFile(h, buf, (DWORD)sz.QuadPart, &got, NULL) || got != sz.QuadPart)) {
            free(buf);
            buf = NULL;
        }
        if (buf) {
            buf[sz.QuadPart] = 0;
            *size = (uint64_t)sz.QuadPart;
        }
    }
    CloseHandle(h);
    return buf;
}

int plat_file_write(const char *path, const void *data, size_t n) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return 0;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    DWORD put = 0;
    int ok = WriteFile(h, data, (DWORD)n, &put, NULL) && put == n;
    CloseHandle(h);
    return ok;
}

PlatAppend *plat_append_open(const char *path) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return NULL;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_DELETE, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS,
                           FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    return h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? NULL : (PlatAppend *)h;
}

int plat_append_write(PlatAppend *f, const void *data, size_t n) {
    // Offset and OffsetHigh all ones: WriteFile appends at the end of the file, atomically against other writers.
    OVERLAPPED o = {.Offset = 0xffffffff, .OffsetHigh = 0xffffffff};
    DWORD put = 0;
    return WriteFile((HANDLE)f, data, (DWORD)n, &put, &o) && put == n;
}

int plat_file_replace(const char *from, const char *to) {
    wchar_t a[WPATH], b[WPATH];
    if (!widen(from, a, WPATH) || !widen(to, b, WPATH)) return 0;
    return MoveFileExW(a, b, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH) != 0;
}

int plat_file_write_atomic(const char *path, const void *data, size_t n) {
    char tmp[WPATH + 48];
    wchar_t a[WPATH], b[WPATH];
    int len = snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.%lu.%lu.tmp", path, GetCurrentProcessId(), GetCurrentThreadId());
    if (len < 0 || len >= (int)sizeof tmp || !widen(tmp, a, WPATH) || !widen(path, b, WPATH)) return 0;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(a, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, CREATE_ALWAYS, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    DWORD put = 0;
    int ok = WriteFile(h, data, (DWORD)n, &put, NULL) && put == n && FlushFileBuffers(h);
    CloseHandle(h);
    if (ok && MoveFileExW(a, b, MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)) return 1;
    DeleteFileW(a);
    return 0;
}

int plat_file_flush(const char *path) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return 0;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_READ, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    int ok = FlushFileBuffers(h) != 0;
    CloseHandle(h);
    return ok;
}

void plat_file_delete(const char *path) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (widen(path, w, WPATH)) DeleteFileW(w);
}

int plat_file_truncate(const char *path, uint64_t size) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return 0;
    HANDLE h = CreateFileW(w, GENERIC_WRITE, 0, NULL, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER at = {.QuadPart = (LONGLONG)size};
    int ok = SetFilePointerEx(h, at, NULL, FILE_BEGIN) && SetEndOfFile(h);
    CloseHandle(h);
    return ok;
}

int64_t plat_file_size(const char *path) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    WIN32_FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DATA d;
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH) || !GetFileAttributesExW(w, GetFileExInfoStandard, &d)) return -1;
    return (int64_t)(((uint64_t)d.nFileSizeHigh << 32) | d.nFileSizeLow);
}

int plat_file_set_readonly(const char *path, int on) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(path, w, WPATH)) return 0;
    DWORD a = GetFileAttributesW(w);
    if (a == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) return 0;
    return SetFileAttributesW(w, on ? a | FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY : a & ~(DWORD)FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY) != 0;
}

int plat_file_list(const char *dir, const char *ext, int (*cb)(const char *name, void *ctx), void *ctx) {
    wchar_t wd[WPATH], we[64], pat[WPATH + 64];
    if (!widen(dir, wd, WPATH) || !widen(ext, we, 64)) return 0;
    swprintf(pat, WPATH + 64, L"%ls\\*%ls", wd, we);
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW(pat, &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return 0;
    do {
        char name[1024];
        if (!WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, fd.cFileName, -1, name, sizeof name, NULL, NULL)) continue;
        if (!cb(name, ctx)) break;
    } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
    return 1;
}

int plat_mem_commit(uint64_t addr, size_t n) {
    return VirtualAlloc((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, n, MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE) != NULL;
}

int plat_mem_read(uint64_t addr, void *out, size_t n) {
    SIZE_T got = 0;
    return ReadProcessMemory(GetCurrentProcess(), (const void *)(uintptr_t)addr, out, n, &got) && got == n;
}

int plat_exe_path(char *out, size_t cap) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, w, WPATH);
    if (!n || n >= WPATH) return 0;
    return WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, out, (int)cap, NULL, NULL) != 0;
}

size_t plat_getenv(const char *name, char *out, size_t cap) {
    wchar_t wn[256], v[WPATH];
    if (!widen(name, wn, 256)) return 0;
    DWORD n = GetEnvironmentVariableW(wn, v, WPATH);
    if (!n || n >= WPATH) return 0;
    int m = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, v, -1, out, (int)cap, NULL, NULL);
    return m ? (size_t)m - 1 : 0;
}

uint32_t plat_thread_id(void) { return GetCurrentThreadId(); }

const char *plat_ui_language(void) {
    static char tag[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH];
    static int done;
    if (!done) {
        wchar_t w[LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH];
        LCID lcid = GetUserDefaultUILanguage();
        int n = LCIDToLocaleName(lcid, w, LOCALE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH, 0);
        if (n <= 0 || !WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, tag, sizeof tag, NULL, NULL)) tag[0] = 0;
        done = 1;
    }
    return tag;
}

int plat_font_path(const char *lang, char *out, size_t cap) {
    static const struct { const char *lang; const wchar_t *files[3]; } fonts[] = {
        {"ja", {L"YuGothM.ttc", L"meiryo.ttc", L"msgothic.ttc"}},
        {"ko", {L"malgun.ttf", L"gulim.ttc", NULL}},
        {"zh-Hans", {L"msyh.ttc", L"simsun.ttc", NULL}},
        {"zh-Hant", {L"msjh.ttc", L"mingliu.ttc", NULL}},
    };
    wchar_t dir[MAX_PATH], w[WPATH];
    UINT n = GetWindowsDirectoryW(dir, MAX_PATH);
    if (!n || n >= MAX_PATH) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof fonts / sizeof *fonts; i++) {
        if (strcmp(fonts[i].lang, lang)) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < 3 && fonts[i].files[k]; k++) {
            swprintf(w, WPATH, L"%ls\\Fonts\\%ls", dir, fonts[i].files[k]);
            DWORD a = GetFileAttributesW(w);
            if (a != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES && !(a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY))
                return WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, -1, out, (int)cap, NULL, NULL) != 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int plat_os_version(char *out, size_t cap) {
    // GetVersionEx reports the version the manifest asks for; ntdll's RtlGetVersion the real one
    typedef LONG(WINAPI * RtlGetVersion_t)(OSVERSIONINFOW *);
    HMODULE nt = GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll");
    RtlGetVersion_t get = nt ? (RtlGetVersion_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(nt, "RtlGetVersion") : NULL;
    OSVERSIONINFOW v = {.dwOSVersionInfoSize = sizeof v};
    if (!get || get(&v) != 0) return 0;
    DWORD ubr = 0, size = sizeof ubr;   // the update build revision, the number after the build
    if (RegGetValueW(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, L"SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion", L"UBR", RRF_RT_REG_DWORD,
                     NULL, &ubr, &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        ubr = 0;
    snprintf(out, cap, ubr ? "Windows %lu.%lu.%lu.%lu" : "Windows %lu.%lu.%lu", v.dwMajorVersion, v.dwMinorVersion,
             v.dwBuildNumber, ubr);
    return 1;
}

int plat_stderr_path(char *out, size_t cap) {
    HANDLE h = GetStdHandle(STD_ERROR_HANDLE);
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!h || h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE || GetFileType(h) != FILE_TYPE_DISK) return 0;
    DWORD n = GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h, w, WPATH, FILE_NAME_NORMALIZED | VOLUME_NAME_DOS);
    if (!n || n >= WPATH) return 0;
    const wchar_t *p = wcsncmp(w, L"\\\\?\\", 4) ? w : w + 4;   // the \\?\ prefix
    return WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, p, -1, out, (int)cap, NULL, NULL) != 0;
}

// ---- desktop

int plat_clipboard_set(const char *utf8) {
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8, -1, NULL, 0);
    if (n <= 0) return 0;
    HGLOBAL mem = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, (SIZE_T)n * sizeof(wchar_t));
    if (!mem) return 0;
    wchar_t *w = GlobalLock(mem);
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8, -1, w, n);
    GlobalUnlock(mem);
    // A clipboard opened without a window gets no owner, and SetClipboardData may then fail: a message-only window of
    // the calling thread owns it for the call.
    HWND owner = CreateWindowExW(0, L"STATIC", NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, HWND_MESSAGE, NULL, NULL, NULL);
    int ok = 0;
    if (OpenClipboard(owner)) {
        ok = EmptyClipboard() && SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, mem) != NULL;
        CloseClipboard();
    }
    if (owner) DestroyWindow(owner);
    if (!ok) GlobalFree(mem);   // after a successful SetClipboardData the system owns it
    return ok;
}

static DWORD WINAPI open_folder_main(void *arg) {
    ShellExecuteW(NULL, L"open", arg, NULL, NULL, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
    free(arg);
    return 0;
}

int plat_open_folder(const char *path) {
    wchar_t *w = malloc(WPATH * sizeof *w);
    if (!w || !widen(path, w, WPATH)) return free(w), 0;
    DWORD a = GetFileAttributesW(w);
    if (a == INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES || !(a & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) return free(w), 0;
    // the shell can take a while to answer: not on the caller's thread (the present path)
    HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 0, open_folder_main, w, 0, NULL);
    if (!t) return free(w), 0;
    CloseHandle(t);
    return 1;
}

// ---- dynamic libraries

void *plat_lib_open(const char *name) {
    wchar_t w[WPATH];
    if (!widen(name, w, WPATH)) return NULL;
    int bare = !wcschr(w, L'\\') && !wcschr(w, L'/');
    return (void *)LoadLibraryExW(w, NULL, bare ? LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32 : 0);
}

void *plat_lib_sym(void *lib, const char *name) { return lib ? (void *)GetProcAddress((HMODULE)lib, name) : NULL; }

// ---- machine load: GetSystemTimes for the CPU, PDH (pdh.dll, loaded on first use) for the thermal zones and the GPU
// engine and adapter memory counters that Task Manager reads.

typedef PDH_STATUS(WINAPI *PdhOpenQueryW_t)(LPCWSTR, DWORD_PTR, PDH_HQUERY *);
typedef PDH_STATUS(WINAPI *PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t)(PDH_HQUERY, LPCWSTR, DWORD_PTR, PDH_HCOUNTER *);
typedef PDH_STATUS(WINAPI *PdhCollectQueryData_t)(PDH_HQUERY);
typedef PDH_STATUS(WINAPI *PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t)(PDH_HCOUNTER, DWORD, LPDWORD, LPDWORD,
                                                           PPDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W);
typedef PDH_STATUS(WINAPI *PdhCloseQuery_t)(PDH_HQUERY);
static struct {
    INIT_ONCE once;
    PdhOpenQueryW_t open;
    PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t add;
    PdhCollectQueryData_t collect;
    PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t get;
    PdhCloseQuery_t close;
} pdh = {INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT};

static BOOL CALLBACK pdh_load(INIT_ONCE *o, void *p, void **c) {
    (void)o, (void)p, (void)c;
    HMODULE l = plat_lib_open("pdh.dll");
    if (!l) return TRUE;
    pdh.add = (PdhAddEnglishCounterW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhAddEnglishCounterW");
    pdh.collect = (PdhCollectQueryData_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhCollectQueryData");
    pdh.get = (PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhGetFormattedCounterArrayW");
    pdh.close = (PdhCloseQuery_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhCloseQuery");
    PdhOpenQueryW_t open = (PdhOpenQueryW_t)(void *)GetProcAddress(l, "PdhOpenQueryW");
    if (pdh.add && pdh.collect && pdh.get && pdh.close) pdh.open = open;   // open set: all of them are there
    return TRUE;
}

// One PDH query with its wildcard counters ("\Object(*)\Counter"). A query whose open failed stays NULL.
typedef struct { PDH_HQUERY q; PDH_HCOUNTER c[2]; } PdhQuery;

static void pdh_query(PdhQuery *pq, const wchar_t *c0, const wchar_t *c1) {
    InitOnceExecuteOnce(&pdh.once, pdh_load, NULL, NULL);
    pq->q = NULL;
    if (!pdh.open || pdh.open(NULL, 0, &pq->q) != ERROR_SUCCESS) {
        pq->q = NULL;
        return;
    }
    if (pdh.add(pq->q, c0, 0, &pq->c[0]) != ERROR_SUCCESS) pq->c[0] = NULL;
    if (!c1 || pdh.add(pq->q, c1, 0, &pq->c[1]) != ERROR_SUCCESS) pq->c[1] = NULL;
    if (!pq->c[0] && !pq->c[1]) {
        pdh.close(pq->q);
        pq->q = NULL;
    }
}

// The counter's instances as a malloc'd array (free it), *count of them; NULL when there is no valid data yet (a rate
// counter needs two collections).
static PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W *pdh_items(PDH_HCOUNTER c, DWORD *count) {
    DWORD size = 0;
    *count = 0;
    if (!c || pdh.get(c, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE | PDH_FMT_NOCAP100, &size, count, NULL) != PDH_MORE_DATA || !size) return NULL;
    PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W *items = malloc(size);
    if (items && pdh.get(c, PDH_FMT_DOUBLE | PDH_FMT_NOCAP100, &size, count, items) == ERROR_SUCCESS) return items;
    free(items);
    *count = 0;
    return NULL;
}

struct PlatLoad {
    uint64_t idle, kernel, user, proc;   // the previous call's times; kernel 0 before the first
    PdhQuery thermal, gpu;               // gpu: engine utilisation, adapter dedicated memory
    wchar_t luid[40];                    // "luid_0x<high>_0x<low>" of the adapter, lower case; empty for any
};

PlatLoad *plat_load_open(const uint8_t *gpu_luid) {
    PlatLoad *l = calloc(1, sizeof *l);
    if (!l) return NULL;
    if (gpu_luid) {   // Vulkan's deviceLUID is the LUID struct's memory: LowPart, then HighPart
        uint32_t lo, hi;
        memcpy(&lo, gpu_luid, 4);
        memcpy(&hi, gpu_luid + 4, 4);
        swprintf(l->luid, sizeof l->luid / sizeof *l->luid, L"luid_0x%08x_0x%08x", hi, lo);
    }
    pdh_query(&l->thermal, L"\\Thermal Zone Information(*)\\Temperature", NULL);
    pdh_query(&l->gpu, L"\\GPU Engine(*)\\Utilization Percentage", L"\\GPU Adapter Memory(*)\\Dedicated Usage");
    return l;
}

void plat_load_close(PlatLoad *l) {
    if (!l) return;
    if (l->thermal.q) pdh.close(l->thermal.q);
    if (l->gpu.q) pdh.close(l->gpu.q);
    free(l);
}

static uint64_t ft64(FILETIME f) { return (uint64_t)f.dwHighDateTime << 32 | f.dwLowDateTime; }

void plat_cpu_load(PlatLoad *l, float *total_pct, float *proc_pct, float *temp_c) {
    *total_pct = *proc_pct = *temp_c = -1;
    if (!l) return;
    FILETIME idle, kern, user, cr, ex, pk, pu;
    if (GetSystemTimes(&idle, &kern, &user) && GetProcessTimes(GetCurrentProcess(), &cr, &ex, &pk, &pu)) {
        uint64_t i = ft64(idle), k = ft64(kern), u = ft64(user), p = ft64(pk) + ft64(pu);
        uint64_t total = (k - l->kernel) + (u - l->user);   // kernel time includes idle time
        if (l->kernel && total) {
            *total_pct = 100.0f * (float)(total - (i - l->idle)) / (float)total;
            *proc_pct = 100.0f * (float)(p - l->proc) / (float)total;
        }
        l->idle = i, l->kernel = k, l->user = u, l->proc = p;
    }
    // the firmware's ACPI zones, near the CPU on most boards; the exact package temperature needs a kernel driver
    DWORD n;
    PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W *it;
    if (l->thermal.q && pdh.collect(l->thermal.q) == ERROR_SUCCESS && (it = pdh_items(l->thermal.c[0], &n))) {
        for (DWORD i = 0; i < n; i++) {   // the hottest zone, in kelvin
            double c = it[i].FmtValue.doubleValue - 273.15;
            if (it[i].FmtValue.CStatus == PDH_CSTATUS_VALID_DATA && c > *temp_c && c < 150) *temp_c = (float)c;
        }
        free(it);
    }
}

// The adapter part of an instance name, "luid_0x..._0x...", lower case, into out (40 wide characters).
static void inst_luid(const wchar_t *name, wchar_t *out) {
    const wchar_t *p = wcsstr(name, L"luid_");
    size_t n = 0;
    while (p && p[n] && n < 26 && n < 39) out[n] = (wchar_t)towlower(p[n]), n++;   // luid_0x%08x_0x%08x: 26
    out[n] = 0;
}

void plat_gpu_load(PlatLoad *l, float *load_pct, float *vram_used_mb) {
    *load_pct = *vram_used_mb = -1;
    if (!l || !l->gpu.q || pdh.collect(l->gpu.q) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return;
    // Engine instances: "pid_<n>_luid_0x.._0x.._phys_<n>_eng_<n>_engtype_<type>". Per adapter and engine type the
    // processes' shares add up; the load is the busiest engine type.
    enum { TYPES = 32 };
    struct { wchar_t luid[40], type[32]; double sum; } t[TYPES];
    int nt = 0;
    DWORD n;
    PDH_FMT_COUNTERVALUE_ITEM_W *it = pdh_items(l->gpu.c[0], &n);
    for (DWORD i = 0; it && i < n; i++) {
        if (it[i].FmtValue.CStatus != PDH_CSTATUS_VALID_DATA) continue;
        wchar_t lu[40];
        inst_luid(it[i].szName, lu);
        if (l->luid[0] && wcscmp(lu, l->luid)) continue;
        const wchar_t *ty = wcsstr(it[i].szName, L"engtype_");
        ty = ty ? ty + 8 : L"";
        int k = 0;
        while (k < nt && (wcscmp(t[k].luid, lu) || wcsncmp(t[k].type, ty, 31))) k++;
        if (k == nt) {
            if (nt == TYPES) continue;
            wcscpy(t[k].luid, lu);
            wcsncpy(t[k].type, ty, 31);
            t[k].type[31] = 0;
            t[k].sum = 0;
            nt++;
        }
        t[k].sum += it[i].FmtValue.doubleValue;
    }
    free(it);
    for (int k = 0; k < nt; k++)
        if (t[k].sum > *load_pct) *load_pct = (float)(t[k].sum > 100 ? 100 : t[k].sum);
    // Adapter memory instances: "luid_0x.._0x.._phys_<n>", bytes. Without a LUID: the adapter that uses the most.
    it = pdh_items(l->gpu.c[1], &n);
    double sum = 0, best = -1;
    for (DWORD i = 0; it && i < n; i++) {
        if (it[i].FmtValue.CStatus != PDH_CSTATUS_VALID_DATA) continue;
        wchar_t lu[40];
        inst_luid(it[i].szName, lu);
        if (l->luid[0] ? !wcscmp(lu, l->luid) : 0) sum += it[i].FmtValue.doubleValue;
        if (it[i].FmtValue.doubleValue > best) best = it[i].FmtValue.doubleValue;
    }
    if (it && (l->luid[0] ? sum > 0 : best >= 0)) *vram_used_mb = (float)((l->luid[0] ? sum : best) / 1048576.0);
    free(it);
}

void plat_mem_info(float *used_mb, float *total_mb, float *proc_mb) {
    *used_mb = *total_mb = *proc_mb = -1;
    MEMORYSTATUSEX ms = {.dwLength = sizeof ms};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms)) {
        *total_mb = (float)(ms.ullTotalPhys >> 20);
        *used_mb = (float)((ms.ullTotalPhys - ms.ullAvailPhys) >> 20);
    }
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS pmc;
    if (K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), &pmc, sizeof pmc)) *proc_mb = (float)(pmc.WorkingSetSize >> 20);
}

void plat_commit_info(double *proc_mb, double *used_mb, double *limit_mb) {
    *proc_mb = *used_mb = *limit_mb = -1;
    MEMORYSTATUSEX ms = {.dwLength = sizeof ms};
    if (GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&ms)) {
        *limit_mb = (double)(ms.ullTotalPageFile >> 20);
        *used_mb = (double)((ms.ullTotalPageFile - ms.ullAvailPageFile) >> 20);
    }
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX pmc;
    if (K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), (PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS *)&pmc, sizeof pmc))
        *proc_mb = (double)(pmc.PrivateUsage >> 20);
}

// ---- child processes

struct PlatChild {
    HANDLE proc, in, out;                                  // in: our write end, out: our read end
};

PlatChild *plat_child_start(const char *exe, const char *arg, uint32_t *err) {
    wchar_t we[WPATH], wa[256] = L"", cmd[WPATH + 300];
    if (err) *err = 0;
    if (!widen(exe, we, WPATH) || (arg && !widen(arg, wa, 256))) return NULL;
    swprintf(cmd, WPATH + 300, arg ? L"\"%ls\" %ls" : L"\"%ls\"", we, wa);
    SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES sa = {sizeof sa, NULL, TRUE};
    HANDLE in_r, in_w, out_r, out_w;
    // Pipes are created and handed out one child at a time: a child started meanwhile would inherit the other pipe
    // ends and keep them open after their owner closed them.
    static SRWLOCK spawn = SRWLOCK_INIT;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&spawn);
    if (!CreatePipe(&in_r, &in_w, &sa, 0)) return ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spawn), NULL;
    if (!CreatePipe(&out_r, &out_w, &sa, 0)) {
        CloseHandle(in_r), CloseHandle(in_w);
        return ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spawn), NULL;
    }
    SetHandleInformation(in_w, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
    SetHandleInformation(out_r, HANDLE_FLAG_INHERIT, 0);
    HANDLE nul = CreateFileW(L"NUL", GENERIC_WRITE, FILE_SHARE_WRITE, &sa, OPEN_EXISTING, 0, NULL);
    STARTUPINFOW si = {.cb = sizeof si, .dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES, .hStdInput = in_r, .hStdOutput = out_w,
                       .hStdError = nul != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE ? nul : out_w};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi;
    BOOL ok = CreateProcessW(NULL, cmd, NULL, NULL, TRUE, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, NULL, NULL, &si, &pi);
    DWORD e = GetLastError();
    CloseHandle(in_r);
    CloseHandle(out_w);
    if (nul != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(nul);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spawn);
    if (!ok) {
        CloseHandle(in_w), CloseHandle(out_r);
        if (err) *err = e;
        return NULL;
    }
    CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
    PlatChild *c = malloc(sizeof *c);
    if (!c) {
        TerminateProcess(pi.hProcess, 1);
        CloseHandle(pi.hProcess), CloseHandle(in_w), CloseHandle(out_r);
        return NULL;
    }
    c->proc = pi.hProcess, c->in = in_w, c->out = out_r;
    return c;
}

void plat_child_stop(PlatChild *c) {
    if (!c) return;
    CloseHandle(c->in);
    CloseHandle(c->out);
    TerminateProcess(c->proc, 1);
    CloseHandle(c->proc);
    free(c);
}

int plat_child_write(PlatChild *c, const void *data, size_t n) {
    DWORD put = 0;
    return WriteFile(c->in, data, (DWORD)n, &put, NULL) && put == n;
}

long plat_child_read(PlatChild *c, void *buf, size_t cap) {
    DWORD got = 0;
    if (!ReadFile(c->out, buf, (DWORD)cap, &got, NULL)) return -1;
    return (long)got;
}

```

`runtime/prof_win.c`:

```c
// Sampling profiler (TOTK_PROFILE=<path>) and per-frame timing (TOTK_TRACE=perf). tools/prof_report.py reads the profile.
// A host thread wakes every 1 ms and, for every other thread, suspends it, reads Rip and resumes it. The sampler never
// allocates or takes a lock between SuspendThread and ResumeThread and never runs guest code. The profile is text:
//   totk-prof 1 / base <hex> / period_us / samples N / thread <tid> <samples> <in-exe samples> / module <base> <size> <path> /
//   rip <hex> <count> (the top PROF_TOP Rips) / stack <count> <rip> <caller> ... (TOTK_PROFILE_RENDER or
//   TOTK_PROFILE_CHAINS only, the top PROF_STACKS call chains)
// With TOTK_PROFILE_RENDER (the render thread) or TOTK_PROFILE_CHAINS=1 (every thread, chains of all threads summed: for
// short frame ranges, as each sample copies a stack) the sampler also copies up to STK_COPY bytes of the suspended
// thread's stack and, after
// ResumeThread, unwinds the copy with the .pdata tables (RtlVirtualUnwind), so it takes no lock while the thread is
// suspended. The unwind stops at the first frame outside the copy; deeper callers are cut.
// TOTK_PROFILE_SLOW=<ms> keeps every thread's chains of the last half second in a ring (a thread outside the exe, mostly
// waiting, copies 8 KiB of stack, one in it STK_COPY; a thread that ran no cycle since its previous sample is not
// suspended and repeats its previous chain; a sample that took over 2 ms to stop its thread, which happens while the
// thread is in a long kernel call, is written as `tstall <tid> <ms into the window> <ms stopping> <rip>...` with the
// chain where the thread stopped) and, after a present at least <ms> after the previous one, writes
// that interval's samples (plus the 20 ms before) to <TOTK_PROFILE>.f<frame>: the profile format, one `stack 1` line per
// sample, and `tstack <tid> <ms into the window> <rip>...` lines that keep the thread and the time. At most 64 dumps.
#include <windows.h>
#include <psapi.h>
#include <tlhelp32.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "perfmon.h"

#define PROF_SLOTS (1u << 16)   // Rip hash table, open addressing; a full table drops new Rips
#define PROF_TOP 4000           // more than the 200 asked for: the report sums per function
#define PROF_THREADS 512
#define STK_SLOTS (1u << 15)      // call-chain hash table, open addressing; a full table drops new chains
#define PROF_STACKS 6000
#define STK_COPY (64u << 10)      // stack bytes copied per sample
#define STK_SLACK (64u << 10)     // zeros after the copy: a frame reaching past it reads zeros, and a zero Rip ends the chain

typedef struct { uint64_t rip, n; } RipCount;
#define PROF_DEPTH 24             // frames kept per call chain, the sampled Rip first
// cycles, depth, last: TOTK_PROFILE_SLOW only, the thread's cycle count and chain at its previous sample
typedef struct { DWORD tid; HANDLE h; uint64_t n, in_exe, cycles; uint32_t depth; uint64_t last[PROF_DEPTH]; } ThreadSlot;

static RipCount table[PROF_SLOTS];
typedef struct { uint64_t hash, n; uint32_t depth; uint64_t rip[PROF_DEPTH]; } StackCount;
static StackCount stacks[STK_SLOTS];
static uint64_t stacks_dropped;
static uint8_t stk_buf[STK_COPY + STK_SLACK] __attribute__((aligned(16)));   // the slack is never written
static ThreadSlot threads[PROF_THREADS];
static int n_threads;
static uint64_t total, dropped;
static const char *out_path;
static HANDLE sampler;
static volatile LONG stop, written;
static uintptr_t exe_lo, exe_hi;
static volatile DWORD render_tid;   // the thread that presents (perf_present)
static int only_render;             // TOTK_PROFILE_RENDER=1: sample the render thread only
static volatile DWORD main_tid;     // the guest main thread (kern_main_thread)
static int only_main;               // TOTK_PROFILE_MAIN=1: sample the guest main thread only
static int chains;                  // call chains are kept: TOTK_PROFILE_RENDER or TOTK_PROFILE_CHAINS
static volatile uint64_t cur_frame; // last presented frame
static uint64_t frame_lo, frame_hi; // TOTK_PROFILE_FRAMES=<lo>-<hi>: sample only while presents lo..hi-1 are pending
static int64_t world_lo, world_hi;  // TOTK_PROFILE_FRAMES=w<lo>-<hi>: only while the world clock is in [lo, hi) s (us)

#define SLOW_RING (1u << 15)        // TOTK_PROFILE_SLOW: about 0.5 s of samples of every thread
#define SLOW_DUMPS 64
typedef struct { uint64_t t; DWORD tid; uint32_t depth; uint64_t rip[PROF_DEPTH]; } Sample;
static Sample ring[SLOW_RING];
static uint64_t ring_n;
#define STALL_RING 1024
static Sample stalls[STALL_RING];   // t: when the stop began; rip[PROF_DEPTH - 1] holds the stop's ns
static uint64_t stall_n;
static uint64_t slow_ns;            // TOTK_PROFILE_SLOW in ns, 0 off
static volatile LONG64 dump_lo, dump_hi, dump_frame;   // the render thread asks for a window, the sampler writes it
static volatile DWORD replay_tid;   // asynchronous replay (vk_backend.c): its waits hold up the frame too

static void count_rip(uint64_t rip) {
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)((rip * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull) >> 48);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 64; k++, i = (i + 1) & (PROF_SLOTS - 1)) {
        if (table[i].rip == rip || !table[i].rip) {
            table[i].rip = rip;
            table[i].n++;
            return;
        }
    }
    dropped++;
}

static void count_stack(const uint64_t *rip, uint32_t depth) {
    uint64_t h = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
    for (uint32_t d = 0; d < depth; d++) h = (h ^ rip[d]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
    h |= 1;   // 0 marks a free slot
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)(h >> 49);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < 64; k++, i = (i + 1) & (STK_SLOTS - 1)) {
        StackCount *s = &stacks[i];
        if (!s->hash) {
            s->hash = h, s->depth = depth;
            memcpy(s->rip, rip, depth * sizeof *rip);
        } else if (s->hash != h || s->depth != depth || memcmp(s->rip, rip, depth * sizeof *rip)) {
            continue;
        }
        s->n++;
        return;
    }
    stacks_dropped++;
}

// Unwinds the stack copied to stk_buf from real address lo (n bytes). Registers that point into the copied range are
// moved into the copy, so frame-pointer frames read the copy too. Returns the number of frames.
static uint32_t unwind_copy(CONTEXT *c, uintptr_t lo, size_t n, uint64_t *rip) {
    uintptr_t buf = (uintptr_t)stk_buf, end = buf + n;
    DWORD64 *regs[] = {&c->Rbx, &c->Rbp, &c->Rsi, &c->Rdi, &c->R12, &c->R13, &c->R14, &c->R15};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof regs / sizeof *regs; i++)
        if (*regs[i] >= lo && *regs[i] < lo + n) *regs[i] = *regs[i] - lo + buf;
    c->Rsp = buf;
    uint32_t d = 0;
    while (d < PROF_DEPTH && c->Rip && c->Rsp >= buf && c->Rsp + 8 <= end) {
        rip[d++] = c->Rip;
        DWORD64 base;
        PRUNTIME_FUNCTION f = RtlLookupFunctionEntry(c->Rip, &base, NULL);
        if (f) {
            void *hd;
            DWORD64 est;
            RtlVirtualUnwind(UNW_FLAG_NHANDLER, base, c->Rip, f, c, &hd, &est, NULL);
        } else {   // a leaf function: the return address is on top
            c->Rip = *(DWORD64 *)c->Rsp;
            c->Rsp += 8;
        }
    }
    return d;
}

// Re-lists the process's threads: keeps the handle of a thread seen before, opens new ones, closes the gone ones.
static void refresh_threads(DWORD self) {
    HANDLE snap = CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0);
    if (snap == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return;
    static ThreadSlot next[PROF_THREADS];
    int n = 0;
    THREADENTRY32 te = {.dwSize = sizeof te};
    DWORD pid = GetCurrentProcessId();
    for (BOOL ok = Thread32First(snap, &te); ok; ok = Thread32Next(snap, &te)) {
        if (te.th32OwnerProcessID != pid || te.th32ThreadID == self || n == PROF_THREADS) continue;
        ThreadSlot *old = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < n_threads; i++)
            if (threads[i].tid == te.th32ThreadID) old = &threads[i];
        if (old) {
            next[n++] = *old;
            old->h = NULL;
        } else {
            HANDLE h = OpenThread(THREAD_SUSPEND_RESUME | THREAD_GET_CONTEXT | THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION, FALSE, te.th32ThreadID);
            if (h) next[n++] = (ThreadSlot){.tid = te.th32ThreadID, .h = h};
        }
    }
    CloseHandle(snap);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_threads; i++)
        if (threads[i].h) CloseHandle(threads[i].h);   // exited; its counts are lost with the slot
    memcpy(threads, next, sizeof(ThreadSlot) * n);
    n_threads = n;
}

static void write_modules(FILE *f) {
    HMODULE mods[1024];
    DWORD need = 0;
    if (!EnumProcessModules(GetCurrentProcess(), mods, sizeof mods, &need)) return;
    for (DWORD i = 0; i < need / sizeof(HMODULE) && i < 1024; i++) {
        MODULEINFO mi;
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        if (GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), mods[i], &mi, sizeof mi) && GetModuleFileNameA(mods[i], path, sizeof path))
            fprintf(f, "module %llx %lx %s\n", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll, mi.SizeOfImage, path);
    }
}

// The sampler, between ticks: the samples of the window the render thread asked for.
static void slow_dump(void) {
    uint64_t lo = (uint64_t)dump_lo, hi = (uint64_t)dump_hi, frame = (uint64_t)dump_frame;
    static int dumps;
    char path[1100];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s.f%llu", out_path, (unsigned long long)frame);
    FILE *f = dumps < SLOW_DUMPS ? fopen(path, "w") : NULL;
    if (f) {
        dumps++;
        fprintf(f, "totk-prof 1\nbase %llx\nperiod_us 1000\nframe %llu interval_ms %.1f\nmain %lu render %lu replay %lu\n",
                (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleW(NULL), (unsigned long long)frame, (hi - lo) / 1e6 - 20,
                main_tid, render_tid, replay_tid);
        write_modules(f);
        uint64_t first = ring_n > SLOW_RING ? ring_n - SLOW_RING : 0;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++)
            for (uint64_t k = first; k < ring_n; k++) {
                const Sample *s = &ring[k & (SLOW_RING - 1)];
                if (s->t < lo || s->t > hi) continue;
                if (pass) fprintf(f, "tstack %lu %.1f", s->tid, (s->t - lo) / 1e6);
                else fprintf(f, "stack 1");
                for (uint32_t d = 0; d < s->depth; d++) fprintf(f, " %llx", (unsigned long long)s->rip[d]);
                fputc('\n', f);
            }
        for (uint64_t k = stall_n > STALL_RING ? stall_n - STALL_RING : 0; k < stall_n; k++) {
            const Sample *s = &stalls[k & (STALL_RING - 1)];
            if (s->t + s->rip[PROF_DEPTH - 1] < lo || s->t > hi) continue;
            fprintf(f, "tstall %lu %.1f %.1f", s->tid, ((double)s->t - (double)lo) / 1e6, s->rip[PROF_DEPTH - 1] / 1e6);
            for (uint32_t d = 0; d < s->depth; d++) fprintf(f, " %llx", (unsigned long long)s->rip[d]);
            fputc('\n', f);
        }
        fclose(f);
        rt_log("prof: slow frame %llu (%.1f ms) -> %s", (unsigned long long)frame, (hi - lo) / 1e6 - 20, path);
    }
    InterlockedExchange64(&dump_hi, 0);
}

static DWORD WINAPI sampler_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    DWORD self = GetCurrentThreadId();
    SetThreadPriority(GetCurrentThread(), THREAD_PRIORITY_TIME_CRITICAL);
    HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    static CONTEXT ctx __attribute__((aligned(16)));
    for (unsigned tick = 0; !stop; tick++) {
        if (timer) {
            LARGE_INTEGER due = {.QuadPart = -10000};   // 1 ms
            SetWaitableTimer(timer, &due, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE);
            WaitForSingleObject(timer, 10);
        } else {
            Sleep(1);
        }
        if (tick % 64 == 0) refresh_threads(self);
        if (dump_hi) slow_dump();
        if (frame_hi && (cur_frame < frame_lo || cur_frame >= frame_hi)) continue;
        if (world_hi) {   // -1 before the world clock starts
            int64_t w = frame_step_world_us();
            if (w < world_lo || w >= world_hi) continue;
        }
        uint64_t now = slow_ns ? kern_now_ns() : 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n_threads; i++) {
            ThreadSlot *t = &threads[i];
            if ((only_render && t->tid != render_tid) || (only_main && t->tid != main_tid)) continue;
            uint64_t cyc = 0;
            if (slow_ns && t->depth && QueryThreadCycleTime(t->h, &cyc) && cyc == t->cycles) {   // still waiting
                Sample *s = &ring[ring_n++ & (SLOW_RING - 1)];
                s->t = now, s->tid = t->tid, s->depth = t->depth;
                memcpy(s->rip, t->last, t->depth * sizeof *t->last);
                continue;
            }
            ctx.ContextFlags = chains ? CONTEXT_CONTROL | CONTEXT_INTEGER : CONTEXT_CONTROL;
            uint64_t stop0 = slow_ns ? kern_now_ns() : 0;
            if (SuspendThread(t->h) == (DWORD)-1) continue;
            BOOL ok = GetThreadContext(t->h, &ctx);   // returns once the thread has stopped in user mode
            uint64_t stop_ns = slow_ns ? kern_now_ns() - stop0 : 0;
            size_t n = 0;
            MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION mb;
            // a thread stopped between its sub rsp and the stack probe has Rsp in the guard page: touching it would fault
            if (ok && chains && VirtualQuery((void *)ctx.Rsp, &mb, sizeof mb) && mb.State == MEM_COMMIT &&
                !(mb.Protect & (PAGE_GUARD | PAGE_NOACCESS))) {
                n = (uintptr_t)mb.BaseAddress + mb.RegionSize - ctx.Rsp;   // the committed stack above Rsp
                size_t cap = slow_ns && (ctx.Rip < exe_lo || ctx.Rip >= exe_hi) ? 8u << 10 : STK_COPY;
                if (n > cap) n = cap;
                memcpy(stk_buf, (void *)ctx.Rsp, n);
            }
            ResumeThread(t->h);
            if (!ok) continue;
            count_rip(ctx.Rip);
            uint64_t chain[PROF_DEPTH] = {ctx.Rip};
            uint32_t d = n ? unwind_copy(&ctx, ctx.Rsp, n, chain) : 0;
            if (d) count_stack(chain, d);
            if (slow_ns) {
                Sample *s = &ring[ring_n++ & (SLOW_RING - 1)];
                s->t = now, s->tid = t->tid, s->depth = d ? d : 1;
                memcpy(s->rip, chain, s->depth * sizeof *chain);
                if (stop_ns > 2000000) {
                    Sample *w = &stalls[stall_n++ & (STALL_RING - 1)];
                    *w = *s;
                    w->t = stop0;
                    if (w->depth > PROF_DEPTH - 1) w->depth = PROF_DEPTH - 1;
                    w->rip[PROF_DEPTH - 1] = stop_ns;
                }
                QueryThreadCycleTime(t->h, &t->cycles);   // after ResumeThread: the cycles the sample itself cost
                t->depth = s->depth;
                memcpy(t->last, chain, s->depth * sizeof *chain);
            }
            total++;
            t->n++;
            if (ctx.Rip >= exe_lo && ctx.Rip < exe_hi) t->in_exe++;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

static int cmp_desc(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = ((const RipCount *)a)->n, y = ((const RipCount *)b)->n;
    return (x < y) - (x > y);
}

static int cmp_stack_desc(const void *a, const void *b) {
    uint64_t x = ((const StackCount *)a)->n, y = ((const StackCount *)b)->n;
    return (x < y) - (x > y);
}

void prof_write(void) {
    perf_summary_flush();
    if (!out_path || InterlockedExchange(&written, 1)) return;
    InterlockedExchange(&stop, 1);
    if (WaitForSingleObject(sampler, 2000) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) return;   // sampler stuck: no half-written counts
    FILE *f = fopen(out_path, "w");
    if (!f) {
        rt_log("prof: cannot write %s", out_path);
        return;
    }
    fprintf(f, "totk-prof 1\nbase %llx\nperiod_us 1000\nsamples %llu\ndropped %llu\n", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)GetModuleHandleW(NULL),
            (unsigned long long)total, (unsigned long long)dropped);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_threads; i++)
        fprintf(f, "thread %lu %llu %llu\n", threads[i].tid, (unsigned long long)threads[i].n, (unsigned long long)threads[i].in_exe);
    write_modules(f);
    int cnt = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < PROF_SLOTS; i++)
        if (table[i].rip) table[cnt++] = table[i];
    qsort(table, cnt, sizeof *table, cmp_desc);
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt && i < PROF_TOP; i++) fprintf(f, "rip %llx %llu\n", (unsigned long long)table[i].rip, (unsigned long long)table[i].n);
    int ns = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < STK_SLOTS; i++)
        if (stacks[i].hash) stacks[ns++] = stacks[i];
    qsort(stacks, ns, sizeof *stacks, cmp_stack_desc);
    for (int i = 0; i < ns && i < PROF_STACKS; i++) {
        fprintf(f, "stack %llu", (unsigned long long)stacks[i].n);
        for (uint32_t d = 0; d < stacks[i].depth; d++) fprintf(f, " %llx", (unsigned long long)stacks[i].rip[d]);
        fputc('\n', f);
    }
    if (stacks_dropped) fprintf(f, "stacks_dropped %llu\n", (unsigned long long)stacks_dropped);
    fclose(f);
    rt_log("prof: %llu samples, %d Rips -> %s", (unsigned long long)total, cnt, out_path);
}

// TOTK_TRACE=perf, TOTK_FLIGHT=1 or the full performance overlay: event counts are taken. Wait times are always taken
// (frame-time summary). perf_base: the part fixed at start.
static int perf_on, perf_base;
static int overlay;   // performance overlay mode (perf_set_overlay): 0 off, 1 fps, 2 full

void perf_set_overlay(int mode) {
    __atomic_store_n(&overlay, mode, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_store_n(&perf_on, perf_base || mode == 2, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

int perf_gpu_timing(void) { return (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) || __atomic_load_n(&overlay, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) == 2; }

static volatile LONG64 gpu_busy_total;

void perf_gpu_busy(uint64_t ns) { InterlockedAdd64(&gpu_busy_total, (LONG64)ns); }

uint64_t perf_gpu_busy_total(void) { return (uint64_t)__atomic_load_n(&gpu_busy_total, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

void prof_start(void) {
    flight_init();
    atexit(perf_summary_flush);   // boot.c's _exit path goes through prof_write instead
    perf_base = (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) || flight_on;
    perf_on = perf_base || overlay == 2;
    out_path = cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE");
    if (!out_path || !*out_path) {
        out_path = NULL;
        return;
    }
    only_render = cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE_RENDER") != NULL;
    only_main = !only_render && cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE_MAIN") != NULL;
    const char *ch = cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE_CHAINS");
    const char *sl = cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE_SLOW");
    slow_ns = sl && atoi(sl) > 0 ? (uint64_t)atoi(sl) * 1000000ull : 0;
    chains = only_render || only_main || slow_ns || (ch && *ch && strcmp(ch, "0"));
    const char *fr = cfg_get("TOTK_PROFILE_FRAMES");
    double wl, wh;
    if (fr && fr[0] == 'w' && sscanf(fr + 1, "%lf-%lf", &wl, &wh) == 2 && wl >= 0 && wl < wh)
        world_lo = (int64_t)(wl * 1e6), world_hi = (int64_t)(wh * 1e6);
    else if (fr && sscanf(fr, "%llu-%llu", (unsigned long long *)&frame_lo, (unsigned long long *)&frame_hi) != 2) frame_hi = 0;
    MODULEINFO mi;
    if (GetModuleInformation(GetCurrentProcess(), GetModuleHandleW(NULL), &mi, sizeof mi)) {
        exe_lo = (uintptr_t)mi.lpBaseOfDll;
        exe_hi = exe_lo + mi.SizeOfImage;
    }
    sampler = CreateThread(NULL, 0, sampler_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
    if (!sampler) {
        rt_log("prof: cannot start the sampler (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        out_path = NULL;
        return;
    }
    atexit(prof_write);   // a --seconds run ends in _exit: boot.c calls prof_write itself first
}

// ---- TOTK_TRACE=perf: frame interval and the time the render thread spends waiting, logged every 60 presents. The
// flight recorder (TOTK_FLIGHT=1, flight.c) takes the same numbers per frame.
static uint64_t wait_ns[PERF_N], frame_ns[PERF_N], worst_ns[PERF_N];   // window totals, this frame, the slowest frame

uint64_t perf_begin(void) { return kern_now_ns(); }

void perf_replay_thread(void) { replay_tid = GetCurrentThreadId(); }
void perf_main_thread(void) { main_tid = GetCurrentThreadId(); }

void perf_end(int kind, uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0) return;
    DWORD tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    if (tid != render_tid && tid != replay_tid) return;
    uint64_t d = kern_now_ns() - t0;
    if (tid == render_tid && !replay_tid) {   // one thread adds: no atomics on the synchronous path
        wait_ns[kind] += d;
        frame_ns[kind] += d;
        return;
    }
    __atomic_fetch_add(&wait_ns[kind], d, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    __atomic_fetch_add(&frame_ns[kind], d, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

static volatile LONG64 other_wait_ns;     // perf_gpu_wait on threads other than the render thread, over the window
static volatile LONG64 render_wait_ns;    // the same on the render thread
void (*perf_gpu_stats)(PerfGpu *out);

void perf_gpu_wait(uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0 || !__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    LONG64 d = (LONG64)(kern_now_ns() - t0);
    InterlockedAdd64(GetCurrentThreadId() == render_tid ? &render_wait_ns : &other_wait_ns, d);
}

static volatile LONG64 replay_ns;         // perf_replay: summed over the window, any thread
static volatile LONG64 frame_replay_ns;   // the same since the previous present (frame-time summary)

void perf_replay(uint64_t t0) {
    if (!t0) return;
    LONG64 d = (LONG64)(kern_now_ns() - t0);
    InterlockedAdd64(&frame_replay_ns, d);
    if (__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) InterlockedAdd64(&replay_ns, d);
}

static volatile LONG64 counts[PERF_CNT_N];   // running totals: the perf log and the flight recorder take differences

void perf_count(int kind) {
    if (__atomic_load_n(&perf_on, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) InterlockedIncrement64(&counts[kind]);
}

// ---- Frame-time summary, always on: every 60 s of play and at exit one line of frame count, mean fps, 1% low and the
// frames over 25/50/100 ms, then the worst frames of the period with the render thread's waits in them. Per frame: a
// histogram increment, the compare against the worst list, a memset of the wait array. No allocation.
#define FT_BINS 1024              // 0.25 ms bins up to 256 ms; slower frames land in the last bin
#define FT_WORST 5
#define FT_PERIOD_NS 60000000000ull
typedef struct { uint64_t frame, ns, wait[PERF_N], replay; } FtWorst;
static struct {
    uint64_t t0, frames, sum, over25, over50, over100;
    uint32_t hist[FT_BINS];
    FtWorst worst[FT_WORST];   // slowest first
    int nworst;
} ft;
static uint64_t summary_t0;   // start of the current period (0: not started)

static void ft_report(uint64_t now, const char *tag) {
    if (ft.frames && ft.sum) {
        uint64_t cut = (ft.frames + 99) / 100, acc = 0, low = 0;   // the slowest 1% of frames
        for (int b = FT_BINS - 1; b >= 0; b--) {
            acc += ft.hist[b];
            if (acc >= cut) { low = (uint64_t)(b + 1) * 250000ull; break; }   // upper edge of the bin
        }
        rt_log("frametime: %s: %llu frames in %.1f s, mean %.1f fps, 1%% low %.1f fps, over 25 ms %llu, 50 ms %llu, 100 ms %llu",
               tag, (unsigned long long)ft.frames, (now - ft.t0) / 1e9, ft.frames * 1e9 / ft.sum, low ? 1e9 / low : 0.0,
               (unsigned long long)ft.over25, (unsigned long long)ft.over50, (unsigned long long)ft.over100);
        for (int i = 0; i < ft.nworst; i++) {
            const FtWorst *w = &ft.worst[i];
            rt_log("frametime:   worst frame %llu: %.1f ms; shader translation %.1f, pipeline build %.1f, texture upload %.1f (astc %.1f), replay %.1f, fence/present wait %.1f, pacing %.1f",
                   (unsigned long long)w->frame, w->ns / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6,
                   w->wait[PERF_TEX] / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, w->replay / 1e6,
                   (w->wait[PERF_FENCE] + w->wait[PERF_DRAIN]) / 1e6, w->wait[PERF_PACE] / 1e6);
        }
    }
    memset(&ft, 0, sizeof ft);
    ft.t0 = now;
}

__attribute__((weak)) void gfx_exit_log(void) {}

void perf_summary_flush(void) {   // at exit (prof_write)
    if (summary_t0) {
        ft_report(kern_now_ns(), "exit");
        gfx_exit_log();
    }
    summary_t0 = 0;
}

// Returns the replay time since the previous present.
static uint64_t ft_frame(uint64_t frame, uint64_t now, uint64_t d) {
    LONG64 rep = InterlockedExchange64(&frame_replay_ns, 0);
    if (!summary_t0) {   // the first present starts the period; there is no interval yet
        summary_t0 = now;
        ft.t0 = now;
        return (uint64_t)rep;
    }
    ft.frames++;
    ft.sum += d;
    uint64_t b = d / 250000ull;
    ft.hist[b < FT_BINS ? b : FT_BINS - 1]++;
    if (d > 25000000ull) ft.over25++;
    if (d > 50000000ull) ft.over50++;
    if (d > 100000000ull) ft.over100++;
    if (d > 25000000ull && (ft.nworst < FT_WORST || d > ft.worst[FT_WORST - 1].ns)) {
        int i = ft.nworst < FT_WORST ? ft.nworst++ : FT_WORST - 1;
        while (i > 0 && ft.worst[i - 1].ns < d) ft.worst[i] = ft.worst[i - 1], i--;
        ft.worst[i].frame = frame;
        ft.worst[i].ns = d;
        memcpy(ft.worst[i].wait, frame_ns, sizeof frame_ns);
        ft.worst[i].replay = (uint64_t)rep;
    }
    if (now - summary_t0 >= FT_PERIOD_NS) {
        ft_report(now, "60 s");
        summary_t0 = now;
    }
    return (uint64_t)rep;
}

// The second line of the 60-frame window: GPU busy time (timestamps), the time threads waited for GPU fences, VRAM and
// process memory, and which side holds the frame back. pace: the frame waited for pacing (vsync, the frame limiter) at
// least 15% of the window; gpu: the GPU was busy for 80% of the frame interval or more (without timestamps: threads
// waited for fences for half the interval or more); cpu otherwise.
static void perf_gpu_line(uint64_t frame, double interval_ms, double pace_share, uint64_t n) {
    PerfGpu g;
    memset(&g, 0, sizeof g);
    if (perf_gpu_stats) perf_gpu_stats(&g);
    double rw = InterlockedExchange64(&render_wait_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n, ow = InterlockedExchange64(&other_wait_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n;
    double gpu_ms = g.have_gpu ? g.gpu_ns / 1e6 / n : 0;
    char gs[96], vs[96];
    if (g.have_gpu) snprintf(gs, sizeof gs, "gpu avg %.2f ms (%llu parts timed, %llu not)", gpu_ms,
                             (unsigned long long)g.gpu_parts, (unsigned long long)g.gpu_missed);
    else snprintf(gs, sizeof gs, "gpu avg n/a");
    if (g.have_vram) snprintf(vs, sizeof vs, "vram %.0f of %.0f MiB%s", g.vram_used / 1048576.0, g.vram_budget / 1048576.0,
                              g.vram_exact ? "" : " (own allocations of the heap size)");
    else snprintf(vs, sizeof vs, "vram n/a");
    PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX pm = {.cb = sizeof pm};
    double ws = 0, priv = 0;
    if (K32GetProcessMemoryInfo(GetCurrentProcess(), (PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS *)&pm, sizeof pm))
        ws = pm.WorkingSetSize / 1048576.0, priv = pm.PrivateUsage / 1048576.0;
    const char *bound = pace_share >= 0.15 ? "pace"
                      : g.have_gpu ? (gpu_ms >= 0.8 * interval_ms ? "gpu" : "cpu")
                      : (rw + ow >= 0.5 * interval_ms ? "gpu" : "cpu");
    rt_log("perf: frame %llu: %s; fence wait per frame: render thread %.2f ms, other threads %.2f ms; %s; ram working set "
           "%.0f MiB, private %.0f MiB; bound: %s",
           (unsigned long long)frame, gs, rw, ow, vs, ws, priv, bound);
}

int rt_ab(void) {
    static int64_t period = -1;   // us of world clock; 0: off
    if (period < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_AB");
        period = e && *e ? (int64_t)(atof(e) * 1e6) : 0;
    }
    int64_t w = period ? frame_step_world_us() : -1;
    if (w < 0) return 0;   // before the world clock: A
    int64_t k = w / period % 4;
    return k == 1 || k == 2;
}

int rt_knob(const char *name, const char *def) {
    char key[64];
    snprintf(key, sizeof key, "TOTK_%s", name);
    const char *e = cfg_get(key);
    if (!e || !*e) e = def;
    return !strcmp(e, "ab") ? 2 : strcmp(e, "0") != 0;
}

// TOTK_ONE_PER_CORE=1: the process keeps the first logical processor of each physical core, so busy threads (the
// render thread, the guest cores, the job workers) never share a core's execution units with another; "ab" switches
// it with the A/B blocks. Off by default until measured here; Savage Wind Recomp
// reported +4-10% from the same rule on an 8-core SMT CPU.
static void cpu_placement(void) {
    static int mode = -1, applied = -1;
    static DWORD_PTR all, one;
    if (mode < 0) {
        mode = rt_knob("ONE_PER_CORE", "0");
        DWORD_PTR sys;
        GetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), &all, &sys);
        DWORD len = 0;
        GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, NULL, &len);
        SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *buf = len ? malloc(len) : NULL;
        int cores = 0;
        if (buf && GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx(RelationProcessorCore, buf, &len))
            for (DWORD off = 0; off < len;) {
                SYSTEM_LOGICAL_PROCESSOR_INFORMATION_EX *e = (void *)((char *)buf + off);
                KAFFINITY m = e->Processor.GroupMask[0].Mask & all;
                if (e->Processor.GroupMask[0].Group == 0 && m) one |= m & -m, cores++;   // the lowest of the core's
                off += e->Size;
            }
        free(buf);
        if (mode && one && one != all)
            rt_log("cpu: %d cores, %d logical processors: one per core%s", cores, __builtin_popcountll(all),
                   mode == 2 ? " in the B blocks" : "");
        else
            mode = 0;
    }
    int on = RT_KNOB_ON(mode);
    if (on == applied) return;
    applied = on;
    SetProcessAffinityMask(GetCurrentProcess(), on ? one : all);
}

void perf_present(uint64_t frame) {
    static uint64_t last, sum, max, n, win_start, ab_b;
    static LONG64 win_prev[PERF_CNT_N];
    render_tid = GetCurrentThreadId();
    cur_frame = frame;
    if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_SCHED) kern_sched_report(frame);
    uint64_t now = kern_now_ns(), d = last ? now - last : 0;
    if (slow_ns && last && d >= slow_ns && !dump_hi) {
        dump_lo = (LONG64)(now - d - 20000000ull);
        dump_frame = (LONG64)frame;
        InterlockedExchange64(&dump_hi, (LONG64)now);
    }
    uint64_t rep = ft_frame(frame, now, d);   // d is 0 on the first present: it only starts the period
    ab_b += rt_ab();
    cpu_placement();
    if (__atomic_load_n(&overlay, __ATOMIC_RELAXED))   // the overlay's only cost while it is off: this branch
        perfmon_frame(now, d, frame_ns, rep, __atomic_load_n(&counts[PERF_CNT_TEX_UP], __ATOMIC_RELAXED));
    kern_core_diag_frame(frame, d);
    if (flight_on) flight_frame(frame, now, d, frame_ns, counts);
    if (!(rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF)) {
        memset(frame_ns, 0, sizeof frame_ns);
        last = now;
        return;
    }
    static uint64_t slow_ns;   // TOTK_PERF_SLOW_MS (default 50): frames at least this long get a line of their own
    if (!slow_ns) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_PERF_SLOW_MS");
        slow_ns = (uint64_t)(e && atoi(e) > 0 ? atoi(e) : 50) * 1000000ull;
    }
    if (last) {
        sum += d;
        n++;
        if (d > max) max = d, memcpy(worst_ns, frame_ns, sizeof worst_ns);
        if (d >= slow_ns)
            rt_log("perf: slow frame %llu: %.1f ms; blocked pipeline %.1f xlate %.1f texture %.1f astc %.1f fence %.1f pacing %.1f",
                   (unsigned long long)frame, d / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6,
                   frame_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, frame_ns[PERF_FENCE] / 1e6,
                   frame_ns[PERF_PACE] / 1e6);
    }
    memset(frame_ns, 0, sizeof frame_ns);
    last = now;
    if (!win_start) win_start = now;
    if (frame % 60) return;
    uint64_t span = now - win_start;
    LONG64 win[PERF_CNT_N];
    for (int i = 0; i < PERF_CNT_N; i++) {
        LONG64 v = __atomic_load_n(&counts[i], __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        win[i] = v - win_prev[i];
        win_prev[i] = v;
    }
    LONG64 async = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_ASYNC], skips = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_SKIP], up = win[PERF_CNT_TEX_UP];
    LONG64 reup = win[PERF_CNT_TEX_REUP], sskip = win[PERF_CNT_SHADER_SKIP], waited = win[PERF_CNT_PIPE_WAIT];
    LONG64 oneshot = win[PERF_CNT_ONESHOT_WAIT];
    uint64_t shader_keys, shader_xlated;
    gfx_shader_counts(&shader_keys, &shader_xlated);
    if (n && span)
        rt_log("perf: frame %llu: interval avg %.2f ms max %.2f ms (%.1f fps); render thread blocked: pacing %.0f%% fence %.0f%% drain %.0f%% pipeline build %.0f%% shader xlate %.0f%% texture %.0f%% (astc %.0f%%); pipelines built in background %lld, draws skipped pending %lld, waited %lld, waiting for a shader %lld, one-shot waited %lld; textures uploaded %lld re-uploaded %lld; slowest frame: xlate %.1f ms texture %.1f ms (astc %.1f) pipeline %.1f ms fence %.1f ms; shaders: %llu keys, %llu translated; render busy avg %.2f ms; replay avg %.2f ms; ab %llu/%llu; world %.1f s",
               (unsigned long long)frame, sum / 1e6 / n, max / 1e6, n * 1e9 / sum, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_PACE] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_FENCE] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_DRAIN] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_PIPE] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_XLATE] / span,
               100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_TEX] / span, 100.0 * wait_ns[PERF_ASTC] / span, (long long)async, (long long)skips, (long long)waited, (long long)sskip, (long long)oneshot,
               (long long)up, (long long)reup, worst_ns[PERF_XLATE] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_TEX] / 1e6,
               worst_ns[PERF_ASTC] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_PIPE] / 1e6, worst_ns[PERF_FENCE] / 1e6,
               (unsigned long long)shader_keys, (unsigned long long)shader_xlated,
               (span > wait_ns[PERF_PACE] ? span - wait_ns[PERF_PACE] : 0) / 1e6 / n,
               InterlockedExchange64(&replay_ns, 0) / 1e6 / n, (unsigned long long)ab_b, (unsigned long long)n, frame_step_world_us() / 1e6);
    if (n && span) perf_gpu_line(frame, sum / 1e6 / n, (double)wait_ns[PERF_PACE] / span, n);
    sum = max = n = ab_b = 0;
    memset(wait_ns, 0, sizeof wait_ns);
    win_start = now;
}
```

`runtime/rdoc_win.c`:

```c
// RenderDoc in-app capture (debug tool). TOTK_RDOC=<frame>[,<frame>...] captures those presented frames; TOTK_RDOC_DIR is the
// output directory (default build/captures); TOTK_RDOC_DLL overrides the renderdoc.dll path. Only the API fields used are declared
// here (layout of RENDERDOC_API_1_4_1, renderdoc_app.h, MIT), so no RenderDoc header is vendored.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"

#define RDOC_API_1_4_1 10401
#define RDOC_MAX_FRAMES 64

typedef struct {
    void *GetAPIVersion;
    uint32_t (*SetCaptureOptionU32)(int opt, uint32_t val);
    void *fn2_10[9];    // SetCaptureOptionF32 .. UnloadCrashHandler
    void (*SetCaptureFilePathTemplate)(const char *);
    void *GetCaptureFilePathTemplate;
    uint32_t (*GetNumCaptures)(void);
    uint32_t (*GetCapture)(uint32_t idx, char *filename, uint32_t *pathlength, uint64_t *timestamp);
    void *TriggerCapture, *IsTargetControlConnected, *LaunchReplayUI, *SetActiveWindow;
    void (*StartFrameCapture)(void *device, void *window);
    uint32_t (*IsFrameCapturing)(void);
    uint32_t (*EndFrameCapture)(void *device, void *window);
} RdocApi;

static RdocApi *api;
static uint64_t targets[RDOC_MAX_FRAMES];
static int n_targets;
static int capturing;

int rdoc_active(void) { return api != NULL; }

void rdoc_init(void) {
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_RDOC");
    if (!e || !*e) return;
    for (const char *p = e; *p && n_targets < RDOC_MAX_FRAMES;) {
        char *end;
        unsigned long long v = strtoull(p, &end, 10);
        if (end == p) break;
        targets[n_targets++] = v;
        p = *end == ',' ? end + 1 : end;
        if (*end != ',') break;
    }
    if (!n_targets) { rt_log("rdoc: TOTK_RDOC=%s has no frame numbers", e); return; }
    const char *dll = cfg_get("TOTK_RDOC_DLL");
    HMODULE m = LoadLibraryExA(dll && *dll ? dll : "C:\\Program Files\\RenderDoc\\renderdoc.dll", NULL, LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH);
    if (!m) { rt_log("rdoc: cannot load renderdoc.dll (error %lu); set TOTK_RDOC_DLL", GetLastError()); return; }
    int (*get_api)(int, void **) = (int (*)(int, void **))(void *)GetProcAddress(m, "RENDERDOC_GetAPI");
    void *a = NULL;
    if (!get_api || get_api(RDOC_API_1_4_1, &a) != 1 || !a) { rt_log("rdoc: RENDERDOC_GetAPI(1.4.1) failed"); return; }
    api = a;
    // Option ids of eRENDERDOC_CaptureOption: 8 RefAllResources, 9 SaveAllInitials, 12 AllowUnsupportedVendorExtensions.
    // The back end imports guest pages with VK_EXT_external_memory_host, which RenderDoc hides unless 12 is set.
    rt_log("rdoc: AllowUnsupportedVendorExtensions -> %u", api->SetCaptureOptionU32(12, 1));
    api->SetCaptureOptionU32(8, 1);
    api->SetCaptureOptionU32(9, 1);
    const char *dir = cfg_get("TOTK_RDOC_DIR");
    char full[MAX_PATH], tmpl[MAX_PATH + 16];
    if (!_fullpath(full, dir && *dir ? dir : "build/captures", sizeof full)) return;
    CreateDirectoryA(full, NULL);
    snprintf(tmpl, sizeof tmpl, "%s\totk", full);
    api->SetCaptureFilePathTemplate(tmpl);
    rt_log("rdoc: ready, %d frame(s), captures %s", n_targets, full);
}

// Called by vk_be_present after frame `frame` was queued and the present drained. A capture of frame N starts after frame N-1's
// present finished and ends after frame N's present, so it holds frame N's submits and its blit/present.
void rdoc_after_present(uint64_t frame) {
    if (!api) return;
    if (capturing) {
        api->EndFrameCapture(NULL, NULL);
        capturing = 0;
        char path[MAX_PATH];
        uint32_t len = sizeof path, n = api->GetNumCaptures();
        if (n && api->GetCapture(n - 1, path, &len, NULL)) rt_log("rdoc: frame %llu captured: %s", (unsigned long long)frame, path);
        else rt_log("rdoc: frame %llu capture failed", (unsigned long long)frame);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n_targets; i++)
        if (targets[i] == frame + 1) { api->StartFrameCapture(NULL, NULL); capturing = 1; rt_log("rdoc: capture of frame %llu started", (unsigned long long)(frame + 1)); }
}
```
