`runtime/swkbd_win.c`:

```c
// Adapted from MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/swkbd_host.c @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 MacNativeGames
// contributors): the ShowKeyboardArg offsets, the UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, the disabled-key filter and the result codes.
// The macOS text bar is replaced by a Win32 window.
//
// nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: text entry for the game. On the Switch the call starts the keyboard library applet, which
// takes the screen until the player confirms or cancels. TotK calls it in one place, naming a horse at a stable
// (main+0x1ecbf64 -> main+0x1b2b3a0: UserName preset, at most 9 characters, '@' '%' '\' disabled, UTF-16 out, no
// header, guide or initial text; an empty answer counts as not named).
//
// Front end: a modal Win32 window owned by the game window, run on the guest thread that called (the call blocks, as
// on the Switch). The thread gives its virtual core up meanwhile, so the other guest threads keep running; it holds no
// lock across the wait. The text starts as the game's initial text, else a default name from the catalog (ui_text.c),
// selected, so a controller can confirm it: A = OK, B = cancel (each after it was seen released); Enter / Esc and the
// buttons work too. While the window is open, and after it closes until everything is released, the game reads no
// input (input_block). text_entry_run is the only front-end seam: an overlay (ImGui) can replace it.
//
// Environment:
//   TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER=<text>|<cancel>|<initial>   answer without a window (probes, scripted runs); <initial> keeps the
//                                                 starting text (the game's, else the default name)
//   TOTK_SWKBD_TEST=ok|cancel                     open the window, then press OK / Cancel on the first timer tick
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "input.h"
#include "ui_text.h"
#include "vk.h"

// KeyboardConfig then the work buffer {pointer, size}: offsets read from the SDK setters (MNG) and checked against
// the SDK by --probe-services. SDK 20.5 (1.4.3) put a text-check callback at +0x4c8 and grew KeyboardConfig from
// 0x4d0 to 0x518 bytes (SetInitialText, SetUserWordList read the work buffer there); the fields below +0x3d8 stay.
#define ARG_WORK (RT_V143 ? 0x518 : 0x4d0)
#define ARG_WORK_SIZE (ARG_WORK + 8)
enum {
    KB_TYPE = 0x00, KB_OK_TEXT = 0x04, KB_DISABLED = 0x1c, KB_HEADER = 0x24, KB_SUB = 0xa6, KB_GUIDE = 0x1a8,
    KB_MAX_LEN = 0x3ac, KB_MIN_LEN = 0x3b0, KB_PASSWORD = 0x3b4, KB_UTF8 = 0x3bd, KB_INIT_OFF = 0x3c0, KB_INIT_LEN = 0x3c4,
    KB_TYPE_NUMPAD = 1, KB_LIMIT = 500, SWKBD_CANCELED = 0x29f,
};
enum { B_A = 0, B_B = 1, B_PLUS = 10 };   // input.h bits

static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static uint64_t rd64(const uint8_t *p) { uint64_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 8); return v; }
static size_t u16_len(const uint16_t *s, size_t max) { size_t n = 0; while (n < max && s[n]) n++; return n; }

// UTF-16 (n units) -> NUL-terminated UTF-8 in cap bytes, cut at a character boundary. Returns the bytes written.
static size_t utf16_to_utf8(const uint16_t *s, size_t n, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t o = 0;
    if (!cap) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t c = s[i];
        if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n && s[i + 1] >= 0xdc00 && s[i + 1] < 0xe000)
            c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (s[++i] - 0xdc00);
        else if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000) c = 0xfffd;
        char b[4];
        size_t k;
        if (c < 0x80) { b[0] = (char)c; k = 1; }
        else if (c < 0x800) { b[0] = (char)(0xc0 | c >> 6); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 2; }
        else if (c < 0x10000) { b[0] = (char)(0xe0 | c >> 12); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 3; }
        else { b[0] = (char)(0xf0 | c >> 18); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[3] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 4; }
        if (o + k + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(out + o, b, k);
        o += k;
    }
    out[o] = 0;
    return o;
}

// UTF-8 -> UTF-16, at most cap units (a character that does not fit whole is dropped); bad bytes become U+FFFD.
static size_t utf8_to_utf16(const char *s, uint16_t *out, size_t cap) {
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)s;
    size_t n = 0;
    while (*p) {
        uint32_t c;
        int k;
        if (*p < 0x80) { c = *p; k = 0; }
        else if ((*p & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { c = *p & 0x1f; k = 1; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf0) == 0xe0) { c = *p & 0x0f; k = 2; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf8) == 0xf0) { c = *p & 0x07; k = 3; }
        else { c = 0xfffd; k = 0; }
        p++;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++, p++) {
            if ((*p & 0xc0) != 0x80) { c = 0xfffd; break; }
            c = c << 6 | (*p & 0x3f);
        }
        if (c > 0x10ffff || (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000)) c = 0xfffd;
        if (c >= 0x10000) {
            if (n + 2 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xd800 + ((c - 0x10000) >> 10));
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xdc00 + ((c - 0x10000) & 0x3ff));
        } else {
            if (n + 1 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)c;
        }
    }
    return n;
}

// Whether the applet would let this character through (single UTF-16 units; pairs are always allowed). Disabled-key
// bits as the applet's: 1 space, 2 '@', 3 '%', 4 '/', 5 '\', 6 digits.
static int allowed(uint16_t c, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    int digit = c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    if (digits_only && !digit) return 0;
    if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7f) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 1 && c == ' ') || (disabled & 1u << 2 && c == '@') || (disabled & 1u << 3 && c == '%')) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 4 && c == '/') || (disabled & 1u << 5 && c == '\\') || (disabled & 1u << 6 && digit)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

// Drop disallowed characters and keep at most max units without splitting a surrogate pair.
static size_t clean(uint16_t *t, size_t n, size_t max, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    size_t o = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int pair = t[i] >= 0xd800 && t[i] < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n;
        size_t k = pair ? 2 : 1;
        if (!pair && !allowed(t[i], disabled, digits_only)) continue;
        if (o + k > max) break;
        t[o++] = t[i];
        if (pair) t[o++] = t[++i];
    }
    return o;
}

// ---- the request, front-end independent
typedef struct {
    uint16_t prompt[0x101];              // header, else guide, else sub text (UTF-16, NUL-terminated; may be empty)
    uint16_t initial[KB_LIMIT + 1];      // starting text (the game's, else the catalog's default name)
    int game_initial;                    // the starting text is the game's
    int max_len, min_len, password, numeric;
    uint32_t disabled;
} SwkbdRequest;

// ---- Win32 front end
#define TIMER_ID 1
#define TIMER_MS 16
typedef struct {
    const SwkbdRequest *req;
    HWND wnd, edit;
    WNDPROC edit_proc;
    uint16_t text[KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1];
    size_t n;
    int result;                          // 0 open, 1 OK, -1 cancelled
    uint64_t armed;                      // buttons seen released since the window opened
    int test;                            // TOTK_SWKBD_TEST: 1 press OK, -1 press Cancel
} Entry;

static wchar_t *wide(const char *utf8, wchar_t *buf, int cap) {
    if (!MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, utf8, -1, buf, cap)) buf[0] = 0;
    return buf;
}

static void finish(Entry *e, int result) {
    if (e->result) return;
    if (result > 0) {
        int n = GetWindowTextW(e->edit, (wchar_t *)e->text, KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1);
        e->n = n > 0 ? (size_t)n : 0;
    }
    e->result = result;
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK edit_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    Entry *e = (Entry *)GetWindowLongPtrW(GetParent(h), GWLP_USERDATA);
    if (m == WM_CHAR && w >= 0x20 && !(w >= 0xd800 && w < 0xe000) &&
        !allowed((uint16_t)w, e->req->disabled, e->req->numeric)) {
        MessageBeep(MB_OK);
        return 0;
    }
    return CallWindowProcW(e->edit_proc, h, m, w, l);
}

static LRESULT CALLBACK entry_proc(HWND h, UINT m, WPARAM w, LPARAM l) {
    Entry *e = (Entry *)GetWindowLongPtrW(h, GWLP_USERDATA);
    switch (m) {
    case WM_COMMAND:
        if (LOWORD(w) == IDOK) finish(e, 1);
        else if (LOWORD(w) == IDCANCEL) finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    case WM_CLOSE:
        finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    case WM_TIMER: {
        if (e->test) { finish(e, e->test); return 0; }
        uint64_t b;
        int32_t lx, ly, rx, ry;
        input_poll_ui(&b, &lx, &ly, &rx, &ry);
        uint64_t pressed = b & e->armed;   // down now, up at the previous tick
        e->armed = ~b;
        if (pressed & (1ull << B_A | 1ull << B_PLUS)) finish(e, 1);
        else if (pressed & 1ull << B_B) finish(e, -1);
        return 0;
    }
    }
    return DefWindowProcW(h, m, w, l);
}

static HWND child(HWND parent, const wchar_t *cls, const wchar_t *text, DWORD style, int x, int y, int w, int h, int id,
                  HFONT font) {
    HWND c = CreateWindowExW(0, cls, text, WS_CHILD | WS_VISIBLE | style, x, y, w, h, parent, (HMENU)(intptr_t)id,
                             GetModuleHandleW(NULL), NULL);
    if (c) SendMessageW(c, WM_SETFONT, (WPARAM)font, FALSE);
    return c;
}

// Shows the window and waits for the answer. Returns 1 with the text in out (n units), 0 when cancelled.
static int text_entry_run(const SwkbdRequest *req, uint16_t *out, size_t cap, size_t *n) {
    static const wchar_t cls[] = L"TotKTextEntry";
    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleW(NULL);
    WNDCLASSEXW wc = {.cbSize = sizeof wc, .lpfnWndProc = entry_proc, .hInstance = inst,
                      .hCursor = LoadCursorW(NULL, (LPCWSTR)IDC_ARROW), .hbrBackground = (HBRUSH)(COLOR_BTNFACE + 1),
                      .lpszClassName = cls};
    if (!RegisterClassExW(&wc) && GetLastError() != ERROR_CLASS_ALREADY_EXISTS)
        rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: RegisterClassEx (error %lu)", GetLastError());

    Entry e = {.req = req, .armed = 0};
    const char *test = cfg_get("TOTK_SWKBD_TEST");
    if (test && *test) e.test = !strcmp(test, "cancel") ? -1 : 1;
    // The process is per-monitor DPI aware: the font and the layout below are measured at the game window's DPI, the
    // monitor the dialog opens on, not at the system DPI that plain SystemParametersInfo and AdjustWindowRectEx use.
    HWND owner = gfx_window_handle();
    UINT dpi = owner ? GetDpiForWindow(owner) : GetDpiForSystem();
    NONCLIENTMETRICSW ncm = {.cbSize = sizeof ncm};
    SystemParametersInfoForDpi(SPI_GETNONCLIENTMETRICS, sizeof ncm, &ncm, 0, dpi);
    HFONT font = CreateFontIndirectW(&ncm.lfMessageFont);
    HDC dc = GetDC(NULL);
    HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, font);
    TEXTMETRICW tm;
    GetTextMetricsW(dc, &tm);
    SelectObject(dc, old);
    ReleaseDC(NULL, dc);
    int u = tm.tmHeight > 8 ? tm.tmHeight : 16, pad = u, cw = 26 * u, bw = 6 * u, bh = u * 9 / 5;
    int y_prompt = pad, h_prompt = u * 5 / 2, y_edit = y_prompt + h_prompt + u / 4, h_edit = u * 9 / 5;
    int y_hint = y_edit + h_edit + u / 2, y_btn = y_hint + u * 3 / 2, ch = y_btn + bh + pad;

    RECT wr = {0, 0, cw + 2 * pad, ch};
    DWORD style = WS_POPUP | WS_CAPTION | WS_SYSMENU, ex = WS_EX_DLGMODALFRAME | WS_EX_CONTROLPARENT;
    AdjustWindowRectExForDpi(&wr, style, FALSE, ex, dpi);
    int ww = wr.right - wr.left, wh = wr.bottom - wr.top, x = CW_USEDEFAULT, y = CW_USEDEFAULT;
    RECT orc;
    if (owner && GetWindowRect(owner, &orc)) {
        x = orc.left + (orc.right - orc.left - ww) / 2;
        y = orc.top + (orc.bottom - orc.top - wh) / 2;
    }
    wchar_t title[128], ok[64], cancel[64], hint[160];
    e.wnd = CreateWindowExW(ex, cls, wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_TITLE), title, 128), style, x, y, ww, wh, owner, NULL, inst,
                            NULL);
    if (!e.wnd) rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard: CreateWindowEx (error %lu)", GetLastError());
    SetWindowLongPtrW(e.wnd, GWLP_USERDATA, (LONG_PTR)&e);
    wchar_t prompt[0x102];
    if (req->prompt[0]) memcpy(prompt, req->prompt, sizeof req->prompt), prompt[0x101] = 0;
    else wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_PROMPT), prompt, 0x102);
    child(e.wnd, L"STATIC", prompt, SS_LEFT | SS_NOPREFIX, pad, y_prompt, cw, h_prompt, -1, font);
    e.edit = child(e.wnd, L"EDIT", (const wchar_t *)req->initial,
                   WS_TABSTOP | WS_BORDER | ES_AUTOHSCROLL | (req->password ? ES_PASSWORD : 0) | (req->numeric ? ES_NUMBER : 0),
                   pad, y_edit, cw, h_edit, 100, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"STATIC", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_PAD_HINT), hint, 160), SS_LEFT | SS_NOPREFIX, pad, y_hint, cw, u * 3 / 2,
          -1, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"BUTTON", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_OK), ok, 64), WS_TABSTOP | BS_DEFPUSHBUTTON, pad + cw - 2 * bw - u / 2,
          y_btn, bw, bh, IDOK, font);
    child(e.wnd, L"BUTTON", wide(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_CANCEL), cancel, 64), WS_TABSTOP | BS_PUSHBUTTON, pad + cw - bw, y_btn,
          bw, bh, IDCANCEL, font);
    SendMessageW(e.edit, EM_LIMITTEXT, (WPARAM)req->max_len, 0);
    e.edit_proc = (WNDPROC)SetWindowLongPtrW(e.edit, GWLP_WNDPROC, (LONG_PTR)edit_proc);

    if (owner) EnableWindow(owner, FALSE);
    ShowWindow(e.wnd, SW_SHOW);
    SetForegroundWindow(e.wnd);
    SetFocus(e.edit);
    SendMessageW(e.edit, EM_SETSEL, 0, -1);
    SetTimer(e.wnd, TIMER_ID, TIMER_MS, NULL);
    MSG msg;
    int quit = 0;
    while (!e.result) {
        BOOL got = GetMessageW(&msg, NULL, 0, 0);
        if (got <= 0) { quit = got == 0; finish(&e, -1); break; }
        if (msg.message == WM_KEYDOWN && (msg.wParam == VK_RETURN || msg.wParam == VK_ESCAPE) &&
            (msg.hwnd == e.wnd || IsChild(e.wnd, msg.hwnd))) {
            // Enter on the Cancel button cancels; elsewhere it confirms
            finish(&e, msg.wParam == VK_ESCAPE || GetDlgCtrlID(msg.hwnd) == IDCANCEL ? -1 : 1);
            continue;
        }
        if (IsDialogMessageW(e.wnd, &msg)) continue;
        TranslateMessage(&msg);
        DispatchMessageW(&msg);
    }
    KillTimer(e.wnd, TIMER_ID);
    if (owner) EnableWindow(owner, TRUE);   // before the window goes, so activation returns to the game window
    DestroyWindow(e.wnd);
    if (owner) SetForegroundWindow(owner);
    DeleteObject(font);
    if (quit) PostQuitMessage((int)msg.wParam);
    if (e.result < 0) return 0;
    *n = e.n < cap ? e.n : cap;
    memcpy(out, e.text, *n * 2);
    return 1;
}

// ---- nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard
static void request_from(const uint8_t *arg, SwkbdRequest *r) {
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    int32_t max_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MAX_LEN), min_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MIN_LEN);
    r->max_len = max_len <= 0 || max_len > KB_LIMIT ? KB_LIMIT : max_len;
    r->min_len = min_len < 0 ? 0 : min_len > r->max_len ? r->max_len : min_len;
    r->password = rd32(arg + KB_PASSWORD) != 0;
    r->numeric = rd32(arg + KB_TYPE) == KB_TYPE_NUMPAD;
    r->disabled = rd32(arg + KB_DISABLED);
    static const struct { int off; size_t max; } texts[] = {{KB_HEADER, 0x40}, {KB_GUIDE, 0x100}, {KB_SUB, 0x80}};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 3 && !r->prompt[0]; i++) {
        const uint16_t *t = (const uint16_t *)(arg + texts[i].off);
        size_t n = u16_len(t, texts[i].max);
        memcpy(r->prompt, t, n * 2);
        r->prompt[n] = 0;
    }
    uint64_t work = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK), work_size = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK_SIZE);
    int32_t init_off = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_OFF), init_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_LEN);
    size_t n = 0;
    if (init_len > 0 && work && init_off >= 0 && (uint64_t)init_off + (uint64_t)init_len * 2 <= work_size) {
        const uint16_t *t = (const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(work + (uint64_t)init_off);
        n = u16_len(t, (size_t)(init_len > KB_LIMIT ? KB_LIMIT : init_len));
        memcpy(r->initial, t, n * 2);
        r->game_initial = n > 0;
    }
    if (!n) n = utf8_to_utf16(ui_text(UI_SWKBD_DEFAULT_NAME), r->initial, KB_LIMIT);
    n = clean(r->initial, n, (size_t)r->max_len, r->disabled, r->numeric);
    r->initial[n] = 0;
}

// Result ShowKeyboard(String *out, const ShowKeyboardArg &arg); String = {pointer, byte size}
static void ov_show_keyboard(Cpu *c) {
    uint64_t *str = arg_p(c, 0);
    const uint8_t *arg = arg_p(c, 1);
    char lr[96];
    if (!str || !arg) rt_fatal("nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard from %s: null argument", ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, lr, sizeof lr));
    static SwkbdRequest req;   // one keyboard at a time (the applet is modal too)
    static SRWLOCK one = SRWLOCK_INIT;
    int utf8 = arg[KB_UTF8] != 0;
    uint16_t u[KB_LIMIT * 2 + 1];
    size_t n = 0;
    int confirmed;
    const char *forced = cfg_get("TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER");
    int away = kern_core_away();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&one);
    request_from(arg, &req);
    if (forced && *forced) {
        confirmed = strcmp(forced, "<cancel>") != 0;
        if (!strcmp(forced, "<initial>")) n = u16_len(req.initial, KB_LIMIT), memcpy(u, req.initial, n * 2);
        else if (confirmed) n = utf8_to_utf16(forced, u, KB_LIMIT * 2);
    } else {
        input_block(1);
        confirmed = text_entry_run(&req, u, KB_LIMIT * 2, &n);
        input_block(0);
    }
    n = confirmed ? clean(u, n, (size_t)req.max_len, req.disabled, req.numeric) : 0;
    if (confirmed && (int)n < req.min_len) confirmed = 0, n = 0;
    uint64_t buf = str[0], size = str[1];
    if (buf && size) {
        if (utf8) utf16_to_utf8(u, n, (char *)(uintptr_t)buf, size);
        else {
            size_t units = size / 2;   // one kept for the terminator
            if (units) {
                if (n > units - 1) { n = units - 1; if (n && u[n - 1] >= 0xd800 && u[n - 1] < 0xdc00) n--; }
                memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)buf, u, n * 2);
                ((uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)buf)[n] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    char prompt[0x101 * 3 + 1], shown[KB_LIMIT * 3 + 1];
    utf16_to_utf8(req.prompt, u16_len(req.prompt, 0x100), prompt, sizeof prompt);
    utf16_to_utf8(u, n, shown, sizeof shown);
    if (req.password) snprintf(shown, sizeof shown, "(password, %zu units, not logged)", n);
    rt_log("swkbd: from %s: \"%s\" (%d-%d units, disabled keys %#x, %s out, %s start)%s -> %s%s%s",
           ldr_describe(c->x[30] - 4, lr, sizeof lr), prompt, req.min_len, req.max_len, req.disabled,
           utf8 ? "UTF-8" : "UTF-16", req.game_initial ? "game" : "default", forced && *forced ? " [TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER]" : "",
           confirmed ? "\"" : "cancelled", confirmed ? shown : "", confirmed ? "\"" : "");
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&one);
    kern_core_back(&away);
    ret_x(c, confirmed ? 0 : SWKBD_CANCELED);
}

HOST_OVERRIDE("_ZN2nn5swkbd12ShowKeyboardEPNS0_6StringERKNS0_15ShowKeyboardArgE", ov_show_keyboard);

```

`runtime/sysinfo.c`:

```c
// What a bug report needs about the machine (sysinfo.h). The OS calls sit behind platform.h; the GPU and driver come
// from the Vulkan device the game renders on.
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
#include <cpuid.h>
#endif

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "sysinfo.h"
#include "vk.h"

void sysinfo_cpu_name(char *out, size_t n) {
    out[0] = 0;
#if defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__)
    unsigned r[12];
    if (__get_cpuid_max(0x80000000, NULL) < 0x80000004) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) __get_cpuid(0x80000002 + i, &r[i * 4], &r[i * 4 + 1], &r[i * 4 + 2], &r[i * 4 + 3]);
    char b[49];
    memcpy(b, r, 48);
    b[48] = 0;
    const char *p = b;
    while (*p == ' ') p++;
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", p);
    for (char *e = out + strlen(out); e > out && e[-1] == ' '; e--) e[-1] = 0;
#endif
}

int sysinfo_log_folder(char *out, size_t n) {
    const char *log = rt_log_path();
    if (log) snprintf(out, n, "%s", log);
    else if (!plat_stderr_path(out, n) && !plat_exe_path(out, n)) return 0;
    char *s = strrchr(out, '\\'), *f = strrchr(out, '/');
    if (f > s) s = f;
    if (!s) return 0;
    *s = 0;
    return 1;
}

typedef struct { char *buf; size_t n, at; } Out;

static void put(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
static void put(Out *o, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (o->at + 1 >= o->n) return;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    int k = vsnprintf(o->buf + o->at, o->n - o->at, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (k > 0) o->at = o->at + (size_t)k < o->n ? o->at + (size_t)k : o->n - 1;
}

static void put_setting(const char *key, const char *value, int from_env, void *ctx) {
    put(ctx, from_env ? "  TOTK_%s=%s (environment)\n" : "  %s = %s\n", key, value);
}

int sysinfo_text(char *buf, size_t n) {
    if (!n) return 0;
    Out o = {buf, n, 0};
    buf[0] = 0;
    char s[256];
    put(&o, "TotK Recomp system info\n");
    put(&o, "OS: %s\n", plat_os_version(s, sizeof s) ? s : "unknown");
    sysinfo_cpu_name(s, sizeof s);
    put(&o, "CPU: %s, %u logical processors\n", s[0] ? s : "unknown", plat_cpu_count());
    float used, total, proc;
    plat_mem_info(&used, &total, &proc);
    if (total > 0) put(&o, "RAM: %.1f GB, %.1f GB in use, the game %.1f GB\n", total / 1024, used / 1024, proc / 1024);
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (c) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties dp = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &dp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(c->phys, &p2);
        const VkPhysicalDeviceProperties *p = &p2.properties;
        uint64_t vram = 0;
        for (uint32_t h = 0; h < c->mem_props.memoryHeapCount; h++)
            if (c->mem_props.memoryHeaps[h].flags & VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) vram += c->mem_props.memoryHeaps[h].size;
        put(&o, "GPU: %s (vendor 0x%04x, device 0x%04x), %.1f GB device-local memory\n", p->deviceName, p->vendorID,
            p->deviceID, vram / 1073741824.0);
        put(&o, "Driver: %s %s, driver version 0x%08x, Vulkan %u.%u.%u\n", dp.driverName, dp.driverInfo,
            p->driverVersion, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(p->apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(p->apiVersion),
            VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(p->apiVersion));
    } else {
        put(&o, "GPU: no Vulkan device yet\n");
    }
    put(&o, "Settings with a value:\n");
    size_t before = o.at;
    cfg_each_active(put_setting, &o);
    if (o.at == before) put(&o, "  none\n");
    return (int)o.at;
}
```

```h
// CPU-side texture code: block-linear <-> linear copies, ASTC decode, NVN format -> VkFormat. Vulkan memory and
// the texture objects are in vk_memory.c and vk_texture.c.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include "nvn_obj.h"
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include "vk.h"

// ---- tex_deswizzle.c (MacNativeGames nvn_deswizzle.c, MIT) ----
// Block-linear <-> linear for one level and layer of a texture. The linear side is laid out by block rows: dst_pitch
// bytes per row (>= row bytes of the level), compressed formats one block row per row, 3D textures slice k at
// dst + k * dst_pitch * block rows. LINEAR / LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET storage is copied by pitch. Multisampled and BUFFER
// textures return -1; success returns 0.
int nvn_deswizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src_storage, void *dst_linear,
                  size_t dst_pitch);
int nvn_swizzle(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, const void *src_linear, size_t src_pitch,
                void *dst_storage);
// One box of a level and layer, [x, x + wb) bytes by [y, y + h) block rows of slice z (3D textures), between the storage
// and caller rows of pitch bytes, touching nothing else of the level: ReadTexels / WriteTexels of a region cost the
// region, not the level. Same textures as nvn_deswizzle; -1 for others and for a box outside the level.
int nvn_texels_box(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t wb,
                   uint32_t h, void *storage, void *rows, size_t pitch, int to_linear);
// Byte offset of (x byte, y block row, z slice) inside one level of block height 2^th and block depth 2^td GOBs.
uint64_t nvn_bl_offset(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, unsigned th, unsigned td);
// Geometry of a level as the two functions above use it; -1 for textures they reject.
int nvn_deswizzle_geom(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned layer, uint32_t *row_bytes, uint32_t *rows,
                       uint32_t *slices, uint64_t *base, unsigned *th, unsigned *td, uint32_t *bpb);
// The copy loop on its own, for callers that know the level geometry (bl points at the level's first byte).
void tex_bl_copy(uint8_t *bl, uint8_t *lin, size_t pitch, uint32_t row_bytes, uint32_t rows, uint32_t slices,
                 unsigned th, unsigned td, int to_linear);

// ---- tex_astc.c (LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/astc.c, MIT) ----
// ASTC LDR 2D to RGBA8, bit-exact with astcenc's 8-bit decode. blocks: row-major 16-byte blocks covering
// ceil(width/bw) x ceil(height/bh); rgba_out: width*height*4 bytes. srgb only selects the sRGB endpoint expansion.
// Error blocks and HDR content decode to magenta.
void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                     uint8_t *rgba_out);
bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out);
// tex_astc_mt.c: the same bytes as astc_decode_ldr, large images split by block rows over a worker pool; blocks.
void astc_decode_ldr_mt(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                        uint8_t *rgba_out);

// ---- vk_formats.c (LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/textures.c format table, MIT) ----
typedef struct TexVkFormat {
    VkFormat vk;                  // format of the image created on this GPU
    VkFormat ideal;               // format the NVN format maps to by itself; differs from vk after a fallback
    VkFormatFeatureFlags need;    // optimal-tiling features vk must report for sampling and upload
    uint8_t expand_rgb;           // 3-component format: the upload expands each texel to 4 components (alpha / integer 1)
    uint8_t alpha_one;            // "X" format: sample alpha as 1 (view swizzle)
    uint8_t chan[4];              // nonzero chan[0]: vk stands in with another component order; chan[i] is the
                                  // NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R..A selector of the image component holding R, G, B, A
    uint8_t astc_bw, astc_bh;     // nonzero: ASTC decoded into vk (RGBA8, same colour space) by vk_astc.c or tex_astc.c;
                                  // zero for native ASTC (vk == ideal, raw blocks as for BC)
    uint8_t astc_srgb;
    uint8_t astc_bc;              // ASTC decoded and then encoded to BC3 (vk BC3, TOTK_ASTC_BC; vk_astc.c)
    uint8_t depth, stencil;       // aspect flags of depth / stencil formats
    const char *note;             // why a fallback or an expansion was chosen; NULL when the mapping is direct
    const char *reason;           // unmapped formats only: why there is no Vulkan format
} TexVkFormat;

// 1 when nvn_format (an NVNformat value) has a Vulkan mapping, 0 otherwise (out->reason says why). The mapping is
// fixed per device: ASTC decodes to RGBA8 unless vk_astc_native (TOTK_ASTC) takes the format as it is, D24S8 is
// D32S8, DEPTH24 is D32. Whether the GPU reports the features is a separate question (tex_vk_format_supported).
int tex_vk_format(int nvn_format, TexVkFormat *out);
// 1 when vk_ctx()->phys reports every bit of f->need for f->vk in optimal tiling. Needs vk_init().
int tex_vk_format_supported(const TexVkFormat *f);
```

```c
// decode bit for bit (the decode_unorm8 path its CLI uses for -dl / -ds into 8-bit images):
//   endpoints expand to 16 bits (linear: v * 257, sRGB: v << 8 | 0x80, all four channels),
//   texel = (e0 * (64 - w) + e1 * w + 32) >> 6, output = top 8 bits.

_Static_assert(sizeof wunq_data == 142 && sizeof cunq_data == 936, "unquantization table size");

// ---- bits ----

typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi; } Bits128;

static inline uint64_t load64(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) v = v << 8 | p[i];
    return v;
}

// n (<= 32) bits at pos; bits past 127 read as zero.
static inline uint32_t rbits(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int n) {
    if (n == 0 || pos >= 128) return 0;
    uint64_t v;
    if (pos >= 64) v = b->hi >> (pos - 64);
    else if (pos == 0) v = b->lo;
    else v = b->lo >> pos | b->hi << (64 - pos);
    return (uint32_t)(v & ((1ull << n) - 1));
}

static inline uint64_t bitrev64(uint64_t v) {
    v = (v >> 1 & 0x5555555555555555ull) | (v & 0x5555555555555555ull) << 1;
    v = (v >> 2 & 0x3333333333333333ull) | (v & 0x3333333333333333ull) << 2;
    v = (v >> 4 & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) | (v & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) << 4;
    v = (v >> 8 & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) | (v & 0x00FF00FF00FF00FFull) << 8;
    v = (v >> 16 & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) | (v & 0x0000FFFF0000FFFFull) << 16;
    return v >> 32 | v << 32;
}

// ---- integer sequence encoding ----

static int ise_bitcount(int count, int q) {
    int n = count * q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) n += (8 * count + 4) / 5;
    if (q_quints[q]) n += (7 * count + 2) / 3;
    return n;
}

static void trits_of(uint32_t T, int t[5]) {
    uint32_t C;
    if ((T >> 2 & 7) == 7) {
        C = (T >> 5 & 7) << 2 | (T & 3);
        t[4] = t[3] = 2;
    } else {
        C = T & 0x1F;
        if ((T >> 5 & 3) == 3) { t[4] = 2; t[3] = T >> 7 & 1; }
        else { t[4] = T >> 7 & 1; t[3] = T >> 5 & 3; }
    }
    if ((C & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = C >> 4 & 1;
        t[0] = (C >> 3 & 1) << 1 | ((C >> 2 & 1) & ~(C >> 3) & 1);
    } else if ((C >> 2 & 3) == 3) {
        t[2] = 2; t[1] = 2; t[0] = C & 3;
    } else {
        t[2] = C >> 4 & 1; t[1] = C >> 2 & 3;
        t[0] = (C >> 1 & 1) << 1 | ((C & 1) & ~(C >> 1) & 1);
    }
}

static void quints_of(uint32_t Q, int q[3]) {
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3 && (Q >> 5 & 3) == 0) {
        uint32_t q0 = Q & 1;
        q[2] = (int)(q0 << 2 | ((Q >> 4 & 1) & ~q0 & 1) << 1 | ((Q >> 3 & 1) & ~q0 & 1));
        q[1] = q[0] = 4;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t C;
    if ((Q >> 1 & 3) == 3) { q[2] = 4; C = (Q >> 3 & 3) << 3 | (~(Q >> 5) & 3) << 1 | (Q & 1); }
    else { q[2] = Q >> 5 & 3; C = Q & 0x1F; }
    if ((C & 7) == 5) { q[1] = 4; q[0] = C >> 3 & 3; }
    else { q[1] = C >> 3 & 3; q[0] = C & 7; }
}

// Decodes count raw ISE values (tq << bits | bits) starting at bit pos.
static void ise_decode(const Bits128 *b, int pos, int count, int q, uint8_t *out) {
    int nb = q_bits[q];
    if (q_trits[q]) {
        static const uint8_t tb[5] = {2, 2, 1, 2, 1}, ts[5] = {0, 2, 4, 5, 7};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 5) {
            uint32_t m[5], T = 0;
            int k = 0, t[5];
            for (; k < 5 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                T |= rbits(b, pos, tb[k]) << ts[k]; pos += tb[k];
            }
            trits_of(T, t);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)t[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else if (q_quints[q]) {
        static const uint8_t qb[3] = {3, 2, 2}, qs[3] = {0, 3, 5};
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i += 3) {
            uint32_t m[3], Q = 0;
            int k = 0, v[3];
            for (; k < 3 && i + k < count; k++) {
                m[k] = rbits(b, pos, nb); pos += nb;
                Q |= rbits(b, pos, qb[k]) << qs[k]; pos += qb[k];
            }
            quints_of(Q, v);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) out[i + j] = (uint8_t)((uint32_t)v[j] << nb | m[j]);
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++, pos += nb) out[i] = (uint8_t)rbits(b, pos, nb);
    }
}

// ---- block mode ----

typedef struct { int wx, wy, dual, quant, wbits; } BlockMode;

static bool block_mode_2d(uint32_t m, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, BlockMode *bm) {
    uint32_t r = m >> 4 & 1, h = m >> 9 & 1, d = m >> 10 & 1, a = m >> 5 & 3;
    int wx, wy;
    if (m & 3) {
        r |= (m & 3) << 1;
        uint32_t b = m >> 7 & 3;
        switch (m >> 2 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = b + 4; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = b + 8; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 2; wy = b + 8; break;
        default:
            b &= 1;
            if (m & 0x100) { wx = b + 2; wy = a + 2; }
            else { wx = a + 2; wy = b + 6; }
            break;
        }
    } else {
        r |= (m >> 2 & 3) << 1;
        if ((m >> 2 & 3) == 0) return false;
        uint32_t b = m >> 9 & 3;
        switch (m >> 7 & 3) {
        case 0: wx = 12; wy = a + 2; break;
        case 1: wx = a + 2; wy = 12; break;
        case 2: wx = a + 6; wy = b + 6; d = 0; h = 0; break;
        default:
            if (a == 0) { wx = 6; wy = 10; }
            else if (a == 1) { wx = 10; wy = 6; }
            else return false;
            break;
        }
    }
    int count = wx * wy * (int)(d + 1);
    bm->wx = wx; bm->wy = wy; bm->dual = (int)d;
    bm->quant = (int)(r - 2 + 6 * h);
    bm->wbits = ise_bitcount(count, bm->quant);
    return count <= 64 && bm->wbits >= 24 && bm->wbits <= 96 && wx <= (int)bw && wy <= (int)bh;
}

// ---- partitions ----

static uint32_t hash52(uint32_t p) {
    p ^= p >> 15; p -= p << 17; p += p << 7; p += p << 4;
    p ^= p >> 5;  p += p << 16; p ^= p >> 7; p ^= p >> 3;
    p ^= p << 6;  p ^= p >> 17;
    return p;
}

typedef struct { int s[8]; uint32_t r[4]; int count; } PartSel;

static void part_init(PartSel *ps, int seed, int count) {
    seed += (count - 1) * 1024;
    uint32_t rnum = hash52((uint32_t)seed);
    int s[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { int v = (int)(rnum >> (4 * i) & 0xF); s[i] = v * v; }
    int sh1, sh2;
    if (seed & 1) { sh1 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; sh2 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; }
    else { sh1 = count == 3 ? 6 : 5; sh2 = seed & 2 ? 4 : 5; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) ps->s[i] = s[i] >> (i & 1 ? sh2 : sh1);
    ps->r[0] = rnum >> 14; ps->r[1] = rnum >> 10; ps->r[2] = rnum >> 6; ps->r[3] = rnum >> 2;
    ps->count = count;
}

static inline int part_of(const PartSel *ps, int x, int y) {
    // z = 0 for 2D, so seeds 9..12 drop out
    int a = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[0] * x + ps->s[1] * y) + ps->r[0]) & 0x3F;
    int b = (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[2] * x + ps->s[3] * y) + ps->r[1]) & 0x3F;
    int c = ps->count >= 3 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[4] * x + ps->s[5] * y) + ps->r[2]) & 0x3F : 0;
    int d = ps->count >= 4 ? (int)((uint32_t)(ps->s[6] * x + ps->s[7] * y) + ps->r[3]) & 0x3F : 0;
    if (a >= b && a >= c && a >= d) return 0;
    if (b >= c && b >= d) return 1;
    if (c >= d) return 2;
    return 3;
}

// ---- colour endpoints ----

static inline int clamp255(int v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v; }

// e[0..3] endpoint 0, e[4..7] endpoint 1 (8-bit). Returns false for an HDR mode.
static bool unpack_endpoints(int cem, const uint8_t *v, int e0[4], int e1[4]) {
    switch (cem) {
    case 0:  // L direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    case 1: {  // L delta
        int l0 = v[0] >> 2 | (v[1] & 0xC0);
        int l1 = l0 + (v[1] & 0x3F);
        if (l1 > 255) l1 = 255;
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 4:  // LA direct
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = v[0]; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = v[1];
        e0[3] = v[2]; e1[3] = v[3];
        return true;
    case 5: {  // LA delta
        int l0 = v[0], l1 = v[1], a0 = v[2], a1 = v[3];
        l0 |= (l1 & 0x80) << 1; a0 |= (a1 & 0x80) << 1;
        l1 &= 0x7F; a1 &= 0x7F;
        if (l1 & 0x40) l1 -= 0x80;
        if (a1 & 0x40) a1 -= 0x80;
        l0 >>= 1; a0 >>= 1; l1 >>= 1; a1 >>= 1;  // arithmetic shift of the signed deltas
        l1 = clamp255(l1 + l0); a1 = clamp255(a1 + a0);
        e0[0] = e0[1] = e0[2] = l0; e1[0] = e1[1] = e1[2] = l1;
        e0[3] = a0; e1[3] = a1;
        return true;
    }
    case 6:  // RGB scale
    case 10: {  // RGB scale + two alphas
        int s = v[3];
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { e1[c] = v[c]; e0[c] = v[c] * s >> 8; }
        if (cem == 6) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        else { e0[3] = v[4]; e1[3] = v[5]; }
        return true;
    }
    case 8:  // RGB(A) direct
    case 12: {
        int a[4] = {v[0], v[2], v[4], cem == 12 ? v[6] : 0};
        int b[4] = {v[1], v[3], v[5], cem == 12 ? v[7] : 0};
        if (a[0] + a[1] + a[2] > b[0] + b[1] + b[2]) {  // blue contraction: swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        if (cem == 8) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    case 9:  // RGB(A) base + delta
    case 13: {
        int n = cem == 13 ? 4 : 3;
        int a[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0}, b[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
            int base = v[2 * c], delta = v[2 * c + 1];
            a[c] = base >> 1 | (delta & 0x80);
            b[c] = delta >> 1 & 0x3F;
            if (b[c] & 0x20) b[c] -= 0x40;
        }
        int sum = b[0] + b[1] + b[2];
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) b[c] += a[c];
        if (sum < 0) {  // swap + uncontract
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = b[c]; e1[c] = a[c]; }
            e0[0] = (e0[0] + e0[2]) >> 1; e0[1] = (e0[1] + e0[2]) >> 1;
            e1[0] = (e1[0] + e1[2]) >> 1; e1[1] = (e1[1] + e1[2]) >> 1;
        } else {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = a[c]; e1[c] = b[c]; }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { e0[c] = clamp255(e0[c]); e1[c] = clamp255(e1[c]); }
        if (cem == 9) e0[3] = e1[3] = 255;
        return true;
    }
    default:  // 2, 3, 7, 11, 14, 15: HDR
        return false;
    }
}

// ---- block ----

static void fill_error(uint8_t *out, int texels) {
    for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) {
        out[4 * i + 0] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 1] = 0x00; out[4 * i + 2] = 0xFF; out[4 * i + 3] = 0xFF;
    }
}

bool astc_decode_block(const uint8_t block[16], uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb, uint8_t *out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return false;  // not an ASTC 2D footprint
    int texels = (int)(bw * bh);
    Bits128 b = {load64(block), load64(block + 8)};
    uint32_t mode = (uint32_t)(b.lo & 0x7FF);

    if ((mode & 0x1FF) == 0x1FC) {  // void extent
        if (mode & 0x200) goto error;           // HDR (fp16) constant: error in LDR
        if ((b.lo >> 10 & 3) != 3) goto error;  // reserved bits
        uint32_t s0 = rbits(&b, 12, 13), s1 = rbits(&b, 25, 13);
        uint32_t t0 = rbits(&b, 38, 13), t1 = rbits(&b, 51, 13);
        bool all_ones = s0 == 0x1FFF && s1 == 0x1FFF && t0 == 0x1FFF && t1 == 0x1FFF;
        if ((s0 >= s1 || t0 >= t1) && !all_ones) goto error;
        uint8_t c[4] = {block[9], block[11], block[13], block[15]};  // top 8 bits of the UNORM16s
        for (int i = 0; i < texels; i++) memcpy(out + 4 * i, c, 4);
        return true;
    }

    BlockMode bm;
    if (!block_mode_2d(mode, bw, bh, &bm)) goto error;
    int pcount = (int)(b.lo >> 11 & 3) + 1;
    int wcount = bm.wx * bm.wy;

    // Weights, read backwards from the top of the block.
    uint8_t raw[64];
    Bits128 rev = {bitrev64(b.hi), bitrev64(b.lo)};
    ise_decode(&rev, 0, wcount << bm.dual, bm.quant, raw);
    if (bm.dual && pcount == 4) goto error;

    const uint8_t *wt = wunq_data + wunq_off[bm.quant];
    uint8_t grid[2][80];
    memset(grid, 0, sizeof grid);
    if (bm.dual) {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) { grid[0][i] = wt[raw[2 * i]]; grid[1][i] = wt[raw[2 * i + 1]]; }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < wcount; i++) grid[0][i] = wt[raw[i]];
    }

    // Colour endpoint modes.
    int cem[4];
    int below = 128 - bm.wbits, high = 0;
    if (pcount == 1) {
        cem[0] = (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0xF);
    } else {
        high = 3 * pcount - 4;
        below -= high;
        uint32_t enc = (uint32_t)(b.lo >> 23 & 0x3F) | rbits(&b, below, high) << 6;
        uint32_t base = enc & 3;
        if (base == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(enc >> 2 & 0xF);
            below += high;
            high = 0;
        } else {
            base--;
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] = (int)(((enc >> (2 + i) & 1) + base) << 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) cem[i] |= (int)(enc >> (2 + pcount + 2 * i) & 3);
        }
    }
    int ccount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < pcount; i++) ccount += ((cem[i] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
    if (ccount > 18) goto error;
    int cbits = (pcount == 1 ? 111 : 99) - bm.wbits - high - (bm.dual ? 2 : 0);
    if (cbits < 0) cbits = 0;
    int cq = -1;
    for (int q = 20; q >= 0; q--) {
        if (ise_bitcount(ccount, q) <= cbits) { cq = q; break; }
    }
    if (cq < QUANT_6) goto error;
    uint8_t cv[18];
    ise_decode(&b, pcount == 1 ? 17 : 29, ccount, cq, cv);
    if (cq != QUANT_256) {
        const uint8_t *ct = cunq_data + cunq_off[cq - QUANT_6];
        for (int i = 0; i < ccount; i++) cv[i] = ct[cv[i]];
    }
    int ccs = bm.dual ? (int)rbits(&b, below - 2, 2) : -1;

    // Endpoints, expanded to 16 bits.
    int ep[4][2][4];
    for (int p = 0, k = 0; p < pcount; p++) {
        int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
        if (!unpack_endpoints(cem[p], cv + k, e0, e1)) {
            static const int magenta[4] = {0xFF, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xFF};
            memcpy(e0, magenta, sizeof magenta);
            memcpy(e1, magenta, sizeof magenta);
        }
        k += ((cem[p] >> 2) + 1) * 2;
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
            e0[c] = srgb ? e0[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e0[c] * 257;
            e1[c] = srgb ? e1[c] << 8 | 0x80 : e1[c] * 257;
        }
    }

    // Weight grid -> texel weights (bilinear infill), per axis.
    int xi[12], xf[12], yi[12], yf[12];
    for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bw / 2) / (bw - 1)) * x * (uint32_t)(bm.wx - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        xi[x] = v >> 4; xf[x] = v & 0xF;
    }
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        int v = (int)(((1024 + bh / 2) / (bh - 1)) * y * (uint32_t)(bm.wy - 1) + 32) >> 6;
        yi[y] = (v >> 4) * bm.wx; yf[y] = v & 0xF;
    }

    PartSel ps = {0};
    if (pcount > 1) part_init(&ps, (int)(b.lo >> 13 & 0x3FF), pcount);
    int small = texels < 32;

    uint8_t *o = out;
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) {
        for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++, o += 4) {
            int fs = xf[x], ft = yf[y];
            int w11 = (fs * ft + 8) >> 4, w10 = fs - w11, w01 = ft - w11, w00 = 16 - fs - ft + w11;
            int i0 = yi[y] + xi[x];
            int w[2];
            for (int pl = 0; pl <= bm.dual; pl++) {
                const uint8_t *g = grid[pl];
                w[pl] = (g[i0] * w00 + g[i0 + 1] * w10 + g[i0 + bm.wx] * w01 + g[i0 + bm.wx + 1] * w11 + 8) >> 4;
            }
            int p = pcount > 1 ? part_of(&ps, small ? (int)x << 1 : (int)x, small ? (int)y << 1 : (int)y) : 0;
            const int *e0 = ep[p][0], *e1 = ep[p][1];
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                int wc = c == ccs ? w[1] : w[0];
                o[c] = (uint8_t)((e0[c] * (64 - wc) + e1[c] * wc + 32) >> 14);  // >> 6, then top 8 bits
            }
        }
    }
    return true;

error:
    fill_error(out, texels);
    return false;
}

void astc_decode_ldr(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh,
                     bool srgb, uint8_t *rgba_out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return;
    uint32_t bx = (width + bw - 1) / bw, by = (height + bh - 1) / bh;
    uint8_t tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < by; j++) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bx; i++) {
            const uint8_t *src = blocks + 16 * ((size_t)j * bx + i);
            uint32_t x0 = i * bw, y0 = j * bh;
            uint32_t cw = width - x0 < bw ? width - x0 : bw, ch = height - y0 < bh ? height - y0 : bh;
            // decode in place when the block's rows are contiguous in the output
            uint8_t *dst = width == bw && ch == bh ? rgba_out + (size_t)y0 * width * 4 : tmp;
            astc_decode_block(src, bw, bh, srgb, dst);
            if (dst == tmp) {
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                    memcpy(rgba_out + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * width + x0) * 4, tmp + y * bw * 4, cw * 4);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`runtime/tex_astc_mt.c`:

```c
// astc_decode_ldr_mt: astc_decode_ldr with the block rows of one image spread over a persistent worker pool. Each block
// goes through astc_decode_block and lands where astc_decode_ldr puts it, so the output is the same bytes. The caller
// takes part and returns when every row is done. One image at a time: a second caller while the pool is busy, or an
// image under MT_MIN_BLOCKS, decodes on its own thread.
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "tex.h"

#define MT_MIN_BLOCKS 1024   // below this, waking the pool costs about as much as the decode
#define MT_MAX_THREADS 8

static struct {
    INIT_ONCE once;
    CRITICAL_SECTION busy;                   // held by the caller for the whole image
    SRWLOCK lock;
    CONDITION_VARIABLE work, done;
    int threads;                             // workers, the caller not counted
    uint64_t gen;                            // bumped per image; a worker joins each generation once
    int active;                              // workers that have not finished the current generation
    // the current image (written under lock before gen is bumped)
    const uint8_t *blocks;
    uint8_t *out;
    uint32_t width, height, bw, bh, bx, by, chunk;
    bool srgb;
    volatile LONG next;                      // first block row not yet claimed
} P = {INIT_ONCE_STATIC_INIT, .lock = SRWLOCK_INIT, .work = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT, .done = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT};

// Block rows [j0, j1) of the current image, as astc_decode_ldr's loop does them.
static void decode_rows(uint32_t j0, uint32_t j1) {
    uint32_t bw = P.bw, bh = P.bh, width = P.width, height = P.height;
    uint8_t tmp[12 * 12 * 4];
    for (uint32_t j = j0; j < j1; j++) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < P.bx; i++) {
            const uint8_t *src = P.blocks + 16 * ((size_t)j * P.bx + i);
            uint32_t x0 = i * bw, y0 = j * bh;
            uint32_t cw = width - x0 < bw ? width - x0 : bw, ch = height - y0 < bh ? height - y0 : bh;
            uint8_t *dst = width == bw && ch == bh ? P.out + (size_t)y0 * width * 4 : tmp;
            astc_decode_block(src, bw, bh, P.srgb, dst);
            if (dst == tmp)
                for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++)
                    memcpy(P.out + ((size_t)(y0 + y) * width + x0) * 4, tmp + y * bw * 4, cw * 4);
        }
    }
}

static void claim_rows(void) {
    for (;;) {
        LONG j0 = InterlockedExchangeAdd(&P.next, (LONG)P.chunk);
        if ((uint32_t)j0 >= P.by) return;
        uint32_t j1 = (uint32_t)j0 + P.chunk;
        decode_rows((uint32_t)j0, j1 < P.by ? j1 : P.by);
    }
}

static DWORD WINAPI worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    uint64_t seen = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
    for (;;) {
        while (P.gen == seen) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&P.work, &P.lock, INFINITE, 0);
        seen = P.gen;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
        claim_rows();
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
        if (!--P.active) WakeAllConditionVariable(&P.done);
    }
    return 0;
}

// Hardware threads minus 2 (the render and the main guest thread), 1 to MT_MAX_THREADS; the caller is one of them.
static BOOL CALLBACK pool_init(PINIT_ONCE once, PVOID param, PVOID *ctx) {
    (void)once, (void)param, (void)ctx;
    InitializeCriticalSection(&P.busy);
    int cpus = (int)GetActiveProcessorCount(ALL_PROCESSOR_GROUPS) - 2;
    int n = (cpus < 1 ? 1 : cpus > MT_MAX_THREADS ? MT_MAX_THREADS : cpus) - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        HANDLE t = CreateThread(NULL, 0, worker, NULL, 0, NULL);
        if (!t) break;
        CloseHandle(t);
        P.threads++;
    }
    rt_log("tex_astc: %d ASTC decode workers", P.threads);
    return TRUE;
}

void astc_decode_ldr_mt(const uint8_t *blocks, uint32_t width, uint32_t height, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, bool srgb,
                        uint8_t *rgba_out) {
    if (bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return;
    uint32_t bx = (width + bw - 1) / bw, by = (height + bh - 1) / bh;
    if ((uint64_t)bx * by < MT_MIN_BLOCKS || by < 2) {
        astc_decode_ldr(blocks, width, height, bw, bh, srgb, rgba_out);
        return;
    }
    InitOnceExecuteOnce(&P.once, pool_init, NULL, NULL);
    if (!P.threads || !TryEnterCriticalSection(&P.busy)) {
        astc_decode_ldr(blocks, width, height, bw, bh, srgb, rgba_out);
        return;
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
    P.blocks = blocks, P.out = rgba_out, P.width = width, P.height = height, P.bw = bw, P.bh = bh, P.bx = bx, P.by = by;
    P.srgb = srgb;
    uint32_t parts = (uint32_t)(P.threads + 1) * 4;   // a few chunks per thread evens out uneven blocks
    P.chunk = by / parts ? by / parts : 1;
    P.next = 0;
    P.active = P.threads;
    P.gen++;
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&P.work);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
    claim_rows();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
    while (P.active) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&P.done, &P.lock, INFINITE, 0);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&P.lock);
    LeaveCriticalSection(&P.busy);
}
```
