```c
static void time_init(VkCtx *c) {   // t_lock held
    if (t_on < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_ASTC_TIME");
        t_on = e && *e && *e != '0';
    }
    if (t_on <= 0 || (t_pool && t_dev == c->device)) return;
    t_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    memset(t_slot, 0, sizeof t_slot);
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, .pNext = &f12};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(c->phys, &f2);
    uint32_t nq = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(c->phys, &nq, NULL);
    VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(c->phys, &nq, qp);
    uint32_t bits = c->gfx_family < nq ? qp[c->gfx_family].timestampValidBits : 0;
    free(qp);
    VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO, .queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP,
                                .queryCount = 2 * TQ};
    if (!f12.hostQueryReset || !bits || vkCreateQueryPool(c->device, &qi, NULL, &t_pool) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: TOTK_ASTC_TIME: no hostQueryReset or no timestamps on the queue; ASTC decodes not timed");
        t_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        t_on = 0;
        return;
    }
    vkResetQueryPool(c->device, t_pool, 0, 2 * TQ);
    t_dev = c->device;
    t_ns_per_tick = c->props.limits.timestampPeriod;
    t_mask = bits >= 64 ? ~0ull : (1ull << bits) - 1;
}

// Takes in the slots whose timestamps are available; t_lock held.
static void time_poll_locked(VkCtx *c) {
    if (!t_pool || t_dev != c->device) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < TQ; i++) {
        if (!t_slot[i].busy) continue;
        uint64_t r[4];
        if (vkGetQueryPoolResults(c->device, t_pool, 2 * (uint32_t)i, 2, sizeof r, r, 16,
                                  VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT | VK_QUERY_RESULT_WITH_AVAILABILITY_BIT) != VK_SUCCESS ||
            !r[1] || !r[3])
            continue;
        double us = (double)((r[2] - r[0]) & t_mask) * t_ns_per_tick / 1e3;
        int fp = t_slot[i].fp;
        if (!t_slot[i].whole) t_fp[fp].texels += t_slot[i].texels, t_fp[fp].chunks++, t_fp[fp].us += us;
        TCall *k = &t_call[t_slot[i].id % TA];
        if (k->id == t_slot[i].id) {
            if (t_slot[i].whole) k->total = us;
            else k->us += us, k->texels += t_slot[i].texels;
            if (++k->done == k->chunks + 1 && k->complete && k->texels > t_max_texels) {
                t_max_texels = k->texels, t_max_us = k->us, t_max_total = k->total, t_max_fp = k->fp;
                rt_log("vk: ASTC time: largest decode so far %.2f M texels (%dx%d; %u regions, the first %ux%u; %u scratch "
                       "chunks): dispatches %.0f us of GPU time (%.0f us per M texel), %.0f us with the copies",
                       (double)k->texels / 1e6, k->fp / 13, k->fp % 13, k->regions, k->w, k->h, k->chunks, k->us,
                       k->us * 1e6 / (double)k->texels, k->total);
            }
        }
        t_slot[i].busy = 0;
        vkResetQueryPool(c->device, t_pool, 2 * (uint32_t)i, 2);
    }
}

// A free slot for a call's id (t_lock held); -1 when the ring is full.
static int time_slot(uint32_t id, uint8_t fp, uint64_t texels, int whole) {
    for (int i = 0; i < TQ; i++, t_next = (t_next + 1) % TQ)
        if (!t_slot[t_next].busy) {
            int k = t_next;
            t_slot[k].busy = 1, t_slot[k].id = id, t_slot[k].fp = fp, t_slot[k].texels = texels;
            t_slot[k].whole = (uint8_t)whole;
            t_next = (k + 1) % TQ;
            return k;
        }
    return -1;
}

void vk_astc_time_enable(int on) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    t_on = on;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
}

int vk_astc_time_get(uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, uint64_t *texels, uint64_t *calls, double *us) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    time_poll_locked(c);
    int fp = (int)(bw * 13 + bh);
    *texels = t_fp[fp].texels, *calls = t_fp[fp].chunks, *us = t_fp[fp].us;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    return 1;
}

void vk_astc_time_summary(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    if (t_on > 0) {
        time_poll_locked(c);
        for (int fp = 0; fp < 13 * 13; fp++)
            if (t_fp[fp].chunks)
                rt_log("vk: ASTC time: %dx%d: %llu dispatch batches, %.2f M texels, %.0f us GPU (%.0f us per M texel)",
                       fp / 13, fp % 13, (unsigned long long)t_fp[fp].chunks, (double)t_fp[fp].texels / 1e6, t_fp[fp].us,
                       t_fp[fp].us * 1e6 / (double)t_fp[fp].texels);
        if (t_max_texels)
            rt_log("vk: ASTC time: largest decode %.2f M texels (%dx%d): dispatches %.0f us GPU, %.0f us with the copies",
                   (double)t_max_texels / 1e6, t_max_fp / 13, t_max_fp % 13, t_max_us, t_max_total);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
}

static void fill_tables(uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t off[28];
    for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) off[i] = TAB_WUNQ + wunq_off[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) off[12 + i] = TAB_CUNQ + cunq_off[i];
    memset(p, 0, TAB_SIZE);
    memcpy(p, off, sizeof off);
    memcpy(p + TAB_WUNQ, wunq_data, sizeof wunq_data);
    memcpy(p + TAB_CUNQ, cunq_data, sizeof cunq_data);
}

// Objects of the current device; under g_lock (exclusive).
static void reset_for(VkCtx *c) {
    if (G.dev == c->device) return;
    memset(&G.dsl, 0, sizeof G - offsetof(__typeof__(G), dsl));   // the old device's objects went with it
    G.dev = c->device;
    G.failed = 0;
    G.mode = -1;
}

static int create_pipeline(VkCtx *c) {
    G.push = (PFN_vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkCmdPushDescriptorSetKHR");
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        b[i] = (VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding){.binding = (uint32_t)i, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
                                              .descriptorCount = 1, .stageFlags = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT};
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo dci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO,
                                           .flags = VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR,
                                           .bindingCount = 3, .pBindings = b};
    VkPushConstantRange pr = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof(Push)};
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = sizeof astc_decode_spv,
                                   .pCode = astc_decode_spv};
    VkShaderModule m = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (!G.push || vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(c->device, &dci, NULL, &G.dsl) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkPipelineLayoutCreateInfo li = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO, .setLayoutCount = 1,
                                     .pSetLayouts = &G.dsl, .pushConstantRangeCount = 1, .pPushConstantRanges = &pr};
    if (vkCreatePipelineLayout(c->device, &li, NULL, &G.layout) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(c->device, &mi, NULL, &m) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1, fq;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, .module = m, .pName = "main"},
                                      .layout = G.layout};
    VkResult r = vkCreateComputePipelines(c->device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &ci, NULL, &G.pipe);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(c->device, m, NULL);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = TAB_SIZE,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo aci = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &aci, &G.tab, &G.tab_alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&fq);
    rt_log("vk: ASTC compute decoder ready (pipeline built in %.1f ms)", (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) * 1e3 / (double)fq.QuadPart);
    return 1;
}

// TOTK_ASTC_BC=1: the BC3 encoder, when the device samples BC3 (every desktop GPU does); 0 leaves ASTC as RGBA8.
static int create_bc_pipeline(VkCtx *c) {
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_ASTC_BC");
    if (!e || !*e || *e == '0') return 0;
    VkFormatProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(c->phys, VK_FORMAT_BC3_SRGB_BLOCK, &p);
    VkFormatFeatureFlags need = VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    if ((p.optimalTilingFeatures & need) != need) {
        rt_log("vk: TOTK_ASTC_BC: the device does not sample BC3; ASTC stays RGBA8");
        return 0;
    }
    VkShaderModuleCreateInfo mi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SHADER_MODULE_CREATE_INFO, .codeSize = sizeof bc3_encode_spv,
                                   .pCode = bc3_encode_spv};
    VkShaderModule m = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateShaderModule(c->device, &mi, NULL, &m) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkComputePipelineCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMPUTE_PIPELINE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .stage = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PIPELINE_SHADER_STAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                                .stage = VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, .module = m, .pName = "main"},
                                      .layout = G.layout};
    VkResult r = vkCreateComputePipelines(c->device, VK_NULL_HANDLE, 1, &ci, NULL, &G.bc_pipe);
    vkDestroyShaderModule(c->device, m, NULL);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) {
        G.bc_pipe = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        rt_log("vk: TOTK_ASTC_BC: the BC3 encoder pipeline failed (%d); ASTC stays RGBA8", (int)r);
        return 0;
    }
    rt_log("vk: ASTC textures are encoded to BC3 after the decode (TOTK_ASTC_BC)");
    return 1;
}

static int native_device(VkCtx *c) { return c->has_astc_ldr; }

static const char *mode_name(int m) {
    return m == VK_ASTC_CPU ? "cpu" : m == VK_ASTC_GPU ? "gpu" : m == VK_ASTC_NATIVE ? "native" : "check";
}

int vk_astc_mode(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c) return VK_ASTC_CPU;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    int m = G.dev == c->device ? G.mode : -1;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    if (m >= 0) return m;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    reset_for(c);
    if (G.mode < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_value("TOTK_ASTC");
        int want = !strcmp(e, "auto") ? -1 : !strcmp(e, "cpu") ? VK_ASTC_CPU : !strcmp(e, "gpu") ? VK_ASTC_GPU
                 : !strcmp(e, "native") ? VK_ASTC_NATIVE : !strcmp(e, "check") ? VK_ASTC_CHECK : -2;
        if (want == -2) rt_log("vk: TOTK_ASTC=%s is not cpu, gpu, native, check or auto: auto", e), want = -1;
        if ((want == -1 || want == VK_ASTC_NATIVE) && native_device(c)) m = VK_ASTC_NATIVE;
        else {
            if (want == VK_ASTC_NATIVE) rt_log("vk: TOTK_ASTC=native: the device lacks textureCompressionASTC_LDR; gpu");
            m = want == VK_ASTC_CPU ? VK_ASTC_CPU : want == VK_ASTC_CHECK ? VK_ASTC_CHECK : VK_ASTC_GPU;
        }
        if ((m == VK_ASTC_GPU || m == VK_ASTC_CHECK || m == VK_ASTC_NATIVE) && !G.pipe && !G.failed &&
            !create_pipeline(c)) {
            G.failed = 1;
            rt_log("vk: ASTC compute decoder unavailable on %s: ASTC decodes on the CPU", c->props.deviceName);
        }
        if (G.failed && m != VK_ASTC_NATIVE) m = VK_ASTC_CPU;
        G.bc = m == VK_ASTC_GPU && G.pipe && create_bc_pipeline(c);
        G.mode = m;
        rt_log("vk: ASTC textures: %s (textureCompressionASTC_LDR %d)", mode_name(m), native_device(c));
    }
    m = G.mode;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    return m;
}

int vk_astc_native(VkFormat astc_format) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c || vk_astc_mode() != VK_ASTC_NATIVE) return 0;
    VkFormatProperties p;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(c->phys, astc_format, &p);
    VkFormatFeatureFlags need = VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_SAMPLED_IMAGE_BIT | VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT |
                                VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    return (p.optimalTilingFeatures & need) == need;
}

int vk_astc_gpu(void) {
    int m = vk_astc_mode();
    if (m == VK_ASTC_GPU || m == VK_ASTC_CHECK) return 1;
    if (m != VK_ASTC_NATIVE) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);   // native mode, a format the device lacks: the decoder when it exists
    int ok = G.pipe != VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    return ok;
}

int vk_astc_bc(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c || vk_astc_mode() != VK_ASTC_GPU) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    int on = G.dev == c->device && G.bc;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    return on;
}

static void mem_barrier(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkPipelineStageFlags2 src, VkAccessFlags2 sa, VkPipelineStageFlags2 dst,
                        VkAccessFlags2 da) {
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2, .srcStageMask = src, .srcAccessMask = sa,
                           .dstStageMask = dst, .dstAccessMask = da};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
}

// Scratch per vk_astc_record: texels of at most this many bytes at a time (or one region, when larger), so a large
// texture array (169 M texels, 677 MB as RGBA8, on monsters2) does not need its whole RGBA8 copy as scratch.
#define CHUNK_OUT (32ull << 20)

static VkDeviceSize region_out(const VkAstcRegion *r) { return (VkDeviceSize)r->w * r->h * r->slices * 4; }
static VkDeviceSize region_in(const VkAstcRegion *r, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh) {
    return (VkDeviceSize)((r->w + bw - 1) / bw) * ((r->h + bh - 1) / bh) * r->slices * 16;
}
static VkDeviceSize region_bc(const VkAstcRegion *r) { return region_in(r, 4, 4); }   // BC3: 16 bytes per 4x4 block

typedef struct { uint32_t in_base, out_base, width, height, bx, bslice; } BcPush;   // bc3_encode.comp Params

int vk_astc_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, VkBuffer src, VkDeviceSize src_size, const VkAstcRegion *rg, int n, uint32_t bw,
                   uint32_t bh, int srgb, int bc, VkImage img, VkImageAspectFlags aspect, VkBuffer readback) {
    static volatile long n_fail, n_unaligned;
    (void)src_size;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (!c || !vk_astc_gpu() || bw < 4 || bh < 4 || bw > 12 || bh > 12) return 0;
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    VkPipeline pipe = G.dev == c->device ? G.pipe : VK_NULL_HANDLE, bc_pipe = G.dev == c->device ? G.bc_pipe : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&g_lock);
    if (!pipe || (bc && !bc_pipe)) return 0;
    if (bc) {
        readback = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)   // a BC copy starts on a block corner; a WriteTexels region of a 5x5 or 6x6 footprint may not
            if ((rg[i].offset.x & 3) || (rg[i].offset.y & 3)) {
                if (InterlockedIncrement(&n_unaligned) <= 16)
                    rt_log("vk: ASTC to BC3: region at %d,%d is not on a 4x4 block corner: texture left as it was",
                           rg[i].offset.x, rg[i].offset.y);
                return 0;
            }
    }
    // chunks of consecutive regions; scratch = the largest chunk's blocks, then its texels, then (bc) its BC3 blocks
    VkDeviceSize out_total = 0, cap_in = 0, cap_out = 0, cap_bc = 0, ci = 0, co = 0, cb3 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        VkDeviceSize o = region_out(&rg[i]), b = region_in(&rg[i], bw, bh);
        if (co && co + o > CHUNK_OUT) ci = co = cb3 = 0;
        ci += b, co += o, cb3 += region_bc(&rg[i]), out_total += o;
        if (ci > cap_in) cap_in = ci;
        if (co > cap_out) cap_out = co;
        if (cb3 > cap_bc) cap_bc = cb3;
    }
    if (!out_total) return 1;
    VkDeviceSize al = c->props.limits.minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment;   // the texels bind at cap_in, the BC3 blocks after them
    if (al < 16) al = 16;
    cap_in = (cap_in + al - 1) / al * al;
    cap_out = (cap_out + al - 1) / al * al;
    if (!bc) cap_bc = 0;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = cap_in + cap_out + cap_bc,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT |
                                      VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo aci = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    VkBuffer sb;
    VmaAllocation sa;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &aci, &sb, &sa, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        if (InterlockedIncrement(&n_fail) <= 16)
            rt_log("vk: ASTC scratch buffer of %llu bytes failed: texture left undecoded",
                   (unsigned long long)(cap_in + cap_out));
        return 0;
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    int need_tab = !G.tab_uploaded;
    G.tab_uploaded = 1;
    VkBuffer tab = G.tab;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    if (need_tab) {   // first use on this device: the tables go up in this batch, before the dispatch
        VkBuffer tb;
        uint8_t *p = vk_staging(TAB_SIZE, &tb, NULL);
        fill_tables(p);
        VkBufferCopy cp = {0, 0, TAB_SIZE};
        vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, tb, tab, 1, &cp);
    }
    int timed = 0, whole = -1;
    uint32_t id = 0;
    uint8_t fp = (uint8_t)(bw * 13 + bh);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    time_init(c);
    if (t_on > 0 && t_pool) {
        time_poll_locked(c);
        timed = 1;
        id = ++t_id;
        t_call[id % TA] = (TCall){.id = id, .w = rg[0].w, .h = rg[0].h, .regions = (uint32_t)n, .fp = fp, .complete = 1};
        whole = time_slot(id, fp, out_total / 4, 1);
        if (whole < 0) t_call[id % TA].complete = 0;
    }
    VkQueryPool tpool = t_pool;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    if (whole >= 0) vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, tpool, 2 * (uint32_t)whole);
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo dbi[3] = {{sb, 0, cap_in}, {sb, cap_in, cap_out}, {tab, 0, TAB_SIZE}};
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        w[i] = (VkWriteDescriptorSet){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstBinding = (uint32_t)i,
                                      .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
                                      .pBufferInfo = &dbi[i]};
    VkBufferImageCopy *copies = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *copies);
    VkBufferCopy *bcp = calloc((size_t)n, sizeof *bcp);
    if (!copies || !bcp) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory (ASTC regions)");
    VkDeviceSize rb_off = 0;
    int chunks = 0;
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < n; chunks++) {
        int i1 = i0;
        VkDeviceSize in = 0, out = 0;
        for (; i1 < n && (i1 == i0 || out + region_out(&rg[i1]) <= CHUNK_OUT); i1++) {
            bcp[i1 - i0] = (VkBufferCopy){rg[i1].src, in, region_in(&rg[i1], bw, bh)};
            in += region_in(&rg[i1], bw, bh), out += region_out(&rg[i1]);
        }
        vk_crumb(cb, VK_CRUMB_ASTC, ++n_chunks);
        if (chunks)   // the previous chunk's dispatches and image copy are done with the scratch
            mem_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                        VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT,
                        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                        VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT);
        vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, src, sb, (uint32_t)(i1 - i0), bcp);
        mem_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT,
                    VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT);
        int slot = -1;   // the timestamps bracket this chunk's dispatches: the first waits for the blocks copy
        if (timed) {
            AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
            slot = time_slot(id, fp, out / 4, 0);
            if (slot < 0) t_call[id % TA].complete = 0;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
        }
        if (slot >= 0) vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, tpool, 2 * (uint32_t)slot);
        vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, pipe);
        rec_push(G.push, cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, G.layout, 0, 3, w);
        VkDeviceSize ib = 0, ob = 0;
        for (int i = i0; i < i1; i++) {
            const VkAstcRegion *r = &rg[i];
            uint32_t bx = (r->w + bw - 1) / bw, by = (r->h + bh - 1) / bh;
            Push pc = {.in_base = (uint32_t)(ib / 16), .out_base = (uint32_t)(ob / 4), .width = r->w, .height = r->h,
                       .bw = bw, .bh = bh, .bx = bx, .bslice = bx * by, .srgb = (uint32_t)(srgb != 0)};
            vkCmdPushConstants(cb, G.layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof pc, &pc);
            uint32_t bpw = bw * bh <= 64 ? 64 / (bw * bh) : 1;   // blocks per workgroup, as astc_decode.comp main
            vkCmdDispatch(cb, (bx + bpw - 1) / bpw, by, r->slices);
            copies[i - i0] = (VkBufferImageCopy){.bufferOffset = cap_in + ob, .bufferRowLength = r->w,
                                                 .bufferImageHeight = r->h, .imageSubresource = {aspect, r->level, r->layer, 1},
                                                 .imageOffset = r->offset, .imageExtent = {r->w, r->h, r->slices}};
            ib += region_in(r, bw, bh), ob += region_out(r);
            n_texels += (uint64_t)r->w * r->h * r->slices;
        }
        if (slot >= 0)
            vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, tpool, 2 * (uint32_t)slot + 1);
        if (bc) {   // the chunk's texels to BC3 blocks behind them; the image copy then takes the blocks
            mem_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT,
                        VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT);
            VkDescriptorBufferInfo bdi[2] = {{sb, cap_in, cap_out}, {sb, cap_in + cap_out, cap_bc}};
            VkWriteDescriptorSet bw2[2];
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
                bw2[k] = (VkWriteDescriptorSet){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET, .dstBinding = (uint32_t)k,
                                                .descriptorCount = 1, .descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER,
                                                .pBufferInfo = &bdi[k]};
            vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, bc_pipe);
            rec_push(G.push, cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, G.layout, 0, 2, bw2);
            VkDeviceSize to = 0, bo = 0;
            for (int i = i0; i < i1; i++) {
                const VkAstcRegion *r = &rg[i];
                uint32_t bx4 = (r->w + 3) / 4, by4 = (r->h + 3) / 4;
                BcPush pc = {.in_base = (uint32_t)(to / 4), .out_base = (uint32_t)(bo / 16), .width = r->w, .height = r->h,
                             .bx = bx4, .bslice = bx4 * by4};
                vkCmdPushConstants(cb, G.layout, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT, 0, sizeof pc, &pc);
                vkCmdDispatch(cb, (bx4 + 7) / 8, (by4 + 7) / 8, r->slices);
                VkBufferImageCopy *cp = &copies[i - i0];
                cp->bufferOffset = cap_in + cap_out + bo, cp->bufferRowLength = bx4 * 4, cp->bufferImageHeight = by4 * 4;
                to += region_out(r), bo += region_bc(r);
            }
        }
        mem_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT,
                    VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT);
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, sb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, (uint32_t)(i1 - i0), copies);
        if (readback) {
            VkBufferCopy rc = {cap_in, rb_off, out};
            vkCmdCopyBuffer(cb, sb, readback, 1, &rc);
            rb_off += out;
        }
        i0 = i1;
    }
    if (readback)
        mem_barrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT, VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT,
                    VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT);
    if (whole >= 0) vkCmdWriteTimestamp2(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, tpool, 2 * (uint32_t)whole + 1);
    if (timed) {
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
        t_call[id % TA].chunks = (uint32_t)chunks;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    }
    if ((n_dispatch + (uint64_t)n) / 1024 != n_dispatch / 1024 || !n_dispatch) {
        rt_log("vk: ASTC: %llu regions, %.1f M texels decoded on the GPU so far",
               (unsigned long long)(n_dispatch + (uint64_t)n), (double)n_texels / 1e6);
        vk_astc_time_summary();
    }
    n_dispatch += (uint64_t)n;
    free(copies), free(bcp);
    vk_defer_buffer(sb, sa);
    return 1;
}

void vk_astc_release(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    vk_astc_time_summary();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    if (c && t_pool && t_dev == c->device) vkDestroyQueryPool(c->device, t_pool, NULL);
    t_pool = VK_NULL_HANDLE, t_dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&t_lock);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
    if (c && G.dev == c->device) {
        if (G.pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(c->device, G.pipe, NULL);
        if (G.bc_pipe) vkDestroyPipeline(c->device, G.bc_pipe, NULL);
        if (G.layout) vkDestroyPipelineLayout(c->device, G.layout, NULL);
        if (G.dsl) vkDestroyDescriptorSetLayout(c->device, G.dsl, NULL);
        if (G.tab) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, G.tab, G.tab_alloc);
    }
    memset(&G.dsl, 0, sizeof G - offsetof(__typeof__(G), dsl));
    G.dev = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    G.mode = -1;
    G.failed = 0;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&g_lock);
}

void vk_astc_stats(uint64_t *dispatches, uint64_t *texels) {
    *dispatches = n_dispatch;
    *texels = n_texels;
}

```

`runtime/vk_backend.c`:

```c
// The Vulkan graphics back end: gfx_vulkan_backend wires the memory and
// texture layer (vk_memory.c, vk_texture.c), submission and fences (vk_sync.c) and the present. Every entry starts the
// device on first use.
//
// Present: the game texture is resolved on the calling thread and its blit is handed to a present thread, so
// nvnQueuePresentTexture returns at once (section 5). Queue order does the rest: the submissions that wrote the texture
// are already on gfx_queue, and every call that may write or free GPU state the blit reads (submit, finish, pool and
// texture teardown, texel writes) first waits until the queued blit was submitted (vk_present_drain).
//
// Back-edge pacing: the present thread submits the blit at once, then holds the host present (vkQueuePresentKHR) until
// the frame's display time from the pacer (nvn_api_obj.c), so present-to-present intervals stay even whatever the
// replay took. The blit is already on the queue, so the wait blocks no submission.
//
// Asynchronous replay (TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC, default 0; 1 turns it on): nvnQueueSubmitCommands
// and nvnQueuePresentTexture only queue. Each item gets its timeline value at enqueue (vk_sync_reserve), in queue
// order; the replay thread runs the synchronous submit and present bodies in that order, so every value is signalled
// by the submission it was handed out for. The game runs at most one frame ahead: queueing present N waits until the
// replay thread handled present N-1. Calls that read or free GPU state that queued work may use drain the queue first
// (replay_drain), each cause counted.
#include <windows.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "flight.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"

#define WEAK __attribute__((weak))

typedef struct { VkImage image; VkFormat format; int w, h, has_crop, crop[4]; uint64_t frame, at, queued, value; } PresentJob;

static SRWLOCK pl = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static CONDITION_VARIABLE pcv = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT;   // job queued, job taken, job submitted
static PresentJob job;
static int pending, busy, present_thread;

// Sleeps on a high-resolution timer to 1 ms before at, then yields until at: the timer alone wakes up to ~0.5 ms late.
static void wait_until(HANDLE timer, uint64_t at) {
    uint64_t now = kern_now_ns();
    if (at > now + 1500000 && timer) {
        LARGE_INTEGER d = {.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)((at - now - 1000000) / 100)};
        if (SetWaitableTimer(timer, &d, 0, NULL, NULL, FALSE)) WaitForSingleObject(timer, INFINITE);
    }
    while (kern_now_ns() < at) SwitchToThread();
}

static DWORD WINAPI present_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    HANDLE timer = CreateWaitableTimerExW(NULL, NULL, CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION, TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
    uint64_t last = 0, last_queued = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    for (;;) {
        while (!pending) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&pcv, &pl, INFINITE, 0);
        PresentJob j = job;
        pending = 0;
        busy = 1;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&pcv);
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
        if (flight_on) vk_thumbs_frame(j.frame);
        vk_present_blit(j.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, j.format, j.w, j.h, j.has_crop ? j.crop : NULL);
        uint64_t f = vk_sync_submit(NULL, 0);   // a timeline value after the blit: deferred destruction waits for the blit too
        if (j.value && f != j.value)
            rt_fatal("vk: the present of frame %llu signalled %llu, queued as %llu", (unsigned long long)j.frame,
                     (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)j.value);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
        busy = 0;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&pcv);
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
        uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
        wait_until(timer, j.at);
        uint64_t t1 = kern_now_ns();
        vk_present_flip();
        // TOTK_TRACE=present: one line per present: the host present's interval, the interval of the game's present
        // calls (when the host present went out before back-edge pacing), the wait and how far past its target it went
        if (rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PRESENT)
            rt_log("present: frame %llu interval %.3f ms, game %.3f ms, waited %.3f ms, %.3f ms past target",
                   (unsigned long long)j.frame, last ? (t1 - last) / 1e6 : 0.0,
                   last_queued ? (j.queued - last_queued) / 1e6 : 0.0, (t1 - t0) / 1e6,
                   j.at && t1 > j.at ? (t1 - j.at) / 1e6 : 0.0);
        last = t1;
        last_queued = j.queued;
        vk_pipeline_autosave();   // starts the autosave thread once
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    }
    return 0;
}

void vk_present_drain(void) {
    uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    while (pending || busy) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&pcv, &pl, INFINITE, 0);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    perf_end(PERF_DRAIN, p0);
}

// The present after the frame count: resolves the image and hands the blit to the present thread. queued: when the game
// presented; value: the timeline value queued for this present (asynchronous replay), 0 for the next one (synchronous).
static void present_image(const tex_t *t, const int crop[4], uint64_t at_ns, uint64_t queued, uint64_t frame,
                          uint64_t value) {
    static volatile long n_skipped;
    vk_exec_frame_log(t, frame);
    vk_mem_census(frame);
    if (vk_dump_armed) vk_dump_present(frame);
    __atomic_store_n(&gfx_counters.validation_errors, (uint64_t)vk_validation_errors_total(), __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    const VkTexImage *img = vk_texture_get(t);
    if (!img || !(img->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT)) {
        if (InterlockedIncrement(&n_skipped) <= 8)
            rt_log("vk: present of texture %p (format %#x) skipped: no colour image", (const void *)t, t ? t->d.format : 0);
        if (value) {   // the queued value is still signalled, in order
            vk_present_drain();
            uint64_t f = vk_sync_submit(NULL, 0);
            if (f != value) rt_fatal("vk: skipped present signalled %llu, queued as %llu", (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)value);
        }
        return;
    }
    PresentJob j = {.image = img->image, .format = img->format, .w = (int)img->width, .h = (int)img->height, .frame = frame,
                    .at = at_ns, .queued = queued, .value = value};
    if (crop) {
        j.has_crop = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) j.crop[i] = crop[i];
    }
    vk_upload_flush(0);   // an upload vk_texture_get just recorded goes before the blit
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    if (!present_thread) {
        HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, present_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
        if (!h) rt_fatal("vk: cannot start the present thread (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        CloseHandle(h);
        present_thread = 1;
    }
    while (pending) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&pcv, &pl, INFINITE, 0);   // one present in waiting at most
    job = j;
    pending = 1;
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&pcv);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&pl);
    if (rdoc_active()) { vk_present_drain(); rdoc_after_present(frame); }
}

// ---- Asynchronous replay
enum { RI_SUBMIT, RI_PRESENT, RI_RELEASE };
typedef struct {
    int kind, n, has_crop, crop[4];
    uint64_t value, submit_no, at, queued;
    uint64_t *h;
    const tex_t *tex;   // RI_RELEASE: a copy the item owns (the game may reuse the object's memory)
} ReplayItem;
#define RQ_CAP 1024   // a frame queues 1 submit and 1 present, and up to a few hundred releases
enum { DR_POOL_FINI, DR_MAP_VIRTUAL, DR_TEX_RELEASE, DR_PROG_RELEASE, DR_FINISH, DR_READ_TEXELS, DR_WRITE_TEXELS,
       DR_GUEST_READ, DR_FRAME, DR_FULL, DR_CHECK, DR_N };
static const char *const dr_name[DR_N] = {
    "pool_fini", "map_virtual", "texture_release (queued)", "program_release", "finish", "read_texels (writer fence)",
    "write_texels", "guest_read (writer fence)", "frame bound", "queue full", "check drain"};

static SRWLOCK rl = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static CONDITION_VARIABLE rcv = CONDITION_VARIABLE_INIT;   // item queued, item taken, item done
static ReplayItem rq[RQ_CAP];
static int rq_head, rq_n, r_busy, r_started;
static uint64_t r_presents_queued, r_presents_done, r_submit_done, game_frames;
// Under rl: calls, calls that waited and the time waited per cause, since the last replay_log line and over the run.
static uint64_t dr_calls[DR_N], dr_waits[DR_N], dr_ns[DR_N], dr_tcalls[DR_N], dr_twaits[DR_N], dr_tns[DR_N];
// TOTK_REPLAY_CHECK: ReadTexels compared with a read after a full drain (under rl): checked, differing, differing
// although no submission recorded a write to the texture in between, differing with the queue idle at the first read.
static uint64_t ck_reads, ck_diff, ck_diff_unexplained, ck_diff_idle;

int vk_replay_async(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) {
        on = cfg_bool("TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC");   // off by default: no measured gain yet, one more frame of latency
        rt_log("vk: replay %s (TOTK_REPLAY_ASYNC=%d)",
               on ? "on its own thread, at most one frame behind the game" : "on the submitting thread", on);
    }
    return on;
}

// The front end's view (nvn_api_core.c, nvn_api_cmd.c): replay is asynchronous only on this back end.
int gfx_replay_async(void) { return gfx_backend() == &gfx_vulkan_backend && vk_replay_async(); }

// The newest submit number (nvn_submit_count) whose replay is done: recording copies it used may be freed.
uint64_t gfx_replayed_submits(void) {
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) return nvn_submit_count();
    AcquireSRWLockShared(&rl);
    uint64_t v = r_submit_done;
    ReleaseSRWLockShared(&rl);
    return v;
}

static uint64_t submit_sync(const uint64_t *handles, int n) {
    vk_sync_start();
    vk_present_drain();
    vk_texture_new_submit();
    return vk_sync_submit(handles, n);
}

static DWORD WINAPI replay_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    perf_replay_thread();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    for (;;) {
        while (!rq_n) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&rcv, &rl, INFINITE, 0);
        ReplayItem it = rq[rq_head];
        rq_head = (rq_head + 1) % RQ_CAP;
        rq_n--;
        r_busy = 1;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&rcv);
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        if (it.kind == RI_SUBMIT) {
            uint64_t f = submit_sync(it.h, it.n);
            if (f != it.value)
                rt_fatal("vk: replayed submission signalled %llu, queued as %llu", (unsigned long long)f,
                         (unsigned long long)it.value);
            free(it.h);
        } else if (it.kind == RI_RELEASE) {
            vk_present_drain();
            vk_texture_release(it.tex);
            free((void *)it.tex);
        } else {
            uint64_t frame = __atomic_add_fetch(&gfx_counters.frames, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            present_image(it.tex, it.has_crop ? it.crop : NULL, it.at, it.queued, frame, it.value);
        }
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        if (it.kind == RI_SUBMIT) r_submit_done = it.submit_no;
        else r_presents_done++;
        r_busy = 0;
        WakeAllConditionVariable(&rcv);
    }
    return 0;
}

static void wait_counted(int why, uint64_t t0) {   // rl held
    uint64_t d = kern_now_ns() - t0;
    dr_waits[why]++, dr_twaits[why]++;
    dr_ns[why] += d, dr_tns[why] += d;
    perf_end(PERF_DRAIN, t0);
}

// A guest thread waiting for the replay gives its virtual core up, as around any blocking host wait (NVN_BLOCKING):
// guest_read (memcpy, pool invalidate), pool and texture finalize run without it, and a drain lasts up to a replay.
// Called and returning with rl held; rl is not held while the core is taken back.
static int core_away_unlocked(void) {
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    int away = kern_core_away();
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    return away;
}
static void core_back_unlocked(int *away) {
    if (!*away) return;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    kern_core_back(away);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
}

// Queues an item (waits while the queue is full) and returns its value, reserved under rl so values follow queue order.
static uint64_t replay_enqueue(ReplayItem *it) {
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    if (!r_started) {
        HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, replay_main, NULL, 0, NULL);
        if (!h) rt_fatal("vk: cannot start the replay thread (error %lu)", GetLastError());
        CloseHandle(h);
        r_started = 1;
    }
    // rl is dropped while the core is taken back, and another thread may fill the queue again meanwhile: check again.
    while (rq_n == RQ_CAP) {
        uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
        dr_calls[DR_FULL]++, dr_tcalls[DR_FULL]++;
        int away = core_away_unlocked();
        while (rq_n == RQ_CAP) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&rcv, &rl, INFINITE, 0);
        wait_counted(DR_FULL, p0);
        core_back_unlocked(&away);
    }
    it->value = it->kind == RI_RELEASE ? 0 : vk_sync_reserve();   // a release signals nothing
    rq[(rq_head + rq_n) % RQ_CAP] = *it;
    rq_n++;
    WakeAllConditionVariable(&rcv);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    return it->value;
}

// Returns once every queued item was replayed and submitted. Back-end entries only: the replay thread never calls them.
static void replay_drain(int why) {
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) return;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    dr_calls[why]++, dr_tcalls[why]++;
    if (rq_n || r_busy) {
        uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
        int away = core_away_unlocked();
        while (rq_n || r_busy) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&rcv, &rl, INFINITE, 0);
        wait_counted(why, p0);
        core_back_unlocked(&away);
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
}

// What made the game wait for the replay: since the last line (every 1800 game frames), or over the run (at exit).
static void replay_log(uint64_t frame, int total) {
    char buf[1024];
    int k = 0;
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    const uint64_t *c = total ? dr_tcalls : dr_calls, *w = total ? dr_twaits : dr_waits, *t = total ? dr_tns : dr_ns;
    for (int i = 0; i < DR_N && k < (int)sizeof buf - 96; i++)
        if (c[i] || w[i])
            k += snprintf(buf + k, sizeof buf - (size_t)k, "%s %s %llu calls, %llu waited %.1f ms", k ? ";" : "", dr_name[i],
                          (unsigned long long)c[i], (unsigned long long)w[i], t[i] / 1e6);
    if (ck_reads && k < (int)sizeof buf - 128)
        k += snprintf(buf + k, sizeof buf - (size_t)k, "; check (run): %llu reads, %llu differ, %llu without a recorded write, %llu with the queue idle",
                      (unsigned long long)ck_reads, (unsigned long long)ck_diff, (unsigned long long)ck_diff_unexplained,
                      (unsigned long long)ck_diff_idle);
    memset(dr_calls, 0, sizeof dr_calls);
    memset(dr_waits, 0, sizeof dr_waits);
    memset(dr_ns, 0, sizeof dr_ns);
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    rt_log("vk: replay queue %s frame %llu:%s", total ? "over the run to" : "at", (unsigned long long)frame,
           k ? buf : " no waits");
}

// The run total, once: the game exits through prof_write (boot.c _exit, the window close), probes through
// vk_backend_shutdown.
void gfx_exit_log(void) {
    static LONG done;
    if (gfx_replay_async() && r_started && !InterlockedExchange(&done, 1)) replay_log(game_frames, 1);
}

static void vk_be_present(const tex_t *t, const int crop[4], uint64_t at_ns) {
    vk_sync_start();
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) {
        uint64_t frame = __atomic_add_fetch(&gfx_counters.frames, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        perf_present(frame);   // before vk_exec_frame_log, which resets the frame's exec counts the flight recorder reads
        present_image(t, crop, at_ns, kern_now_ns(), frame, 0);
        return;
    }
    // Frame bound: the replay thread handled the previous present before this one is queued.
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    dr_calls[DR_FRAME]++, dr_tcalls[DR_FRAME]++;
    if (r_presents_done < r_presents_queued) {
        uint64_t p0 = perf_begin();
        while (r_presents_done < r_presents_queued) SleepConditionVariableSRW(&rcv, &rl, INFINITE, 0);
        wait_counted(DR_FRAME, p0);
    }
    r_presents_queued++;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    uint64_t frame = ++game_frames;
    perf_present(frame);
    if (frame % 1800 == 0) replay_log(frame, 0);
    ReplayItem it = {.kind = RI_PRESENT, .tex = t, .at = at_ns, .queued = kern_now_ns()};
    if (crop) {
        it.has_crop = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) it.crop[i] = crop[i];
    }
    replay_enqueue(&it);
}

// vk_pipeline.c drops a released program's pipelines here.
WEAK void vk_program_release(const prog_t *p) { (void)p; }

static int vk_be_pool_init(pool_t *p) { vk_sync_start(); return vk_pool_init(p); }
static void vk_be_pool_fini(pool_t *p) { vk_sync_start(); replay_drain(DR_POOL_FINI); vk_present_drain(); vk_pool_fini(p); }
static int vk_be_pool_map_virtual(pool_t *v, int n, const void *requests) {
    vk_sync_start();
    replay_drain(DR_MAP_VIRTUAL);
    vk_present_drain();
    return vk_pool_map_virtual(v, n, requests);
}
static void vk_be_texture_register(int id, const tex_t *t, const view_t *v) { vk_sync_start(); vk_texture_register(id, t, v); }
static void vk_be_sampler_register(int id, const samp_par *s) { vk_sync_start(); vk_sampler_register(id, s); }
// Asynchronous: the release is queued behind the submissions before it, so their replay still resolves the texture's
// slots to its image (a released slot follows another live texture at the storage), and the ones after it see it
// released, the order of the synchronous replay. vk_texture_release reads only the object's key fields: a copy.
static void vk_be_texture_release(const tex_t *t) {
    vk_sync_start();
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) {
        vk_present_drain();
        vk_texture_release(t);
        return;
    }
    if (!t || !t->mem) return;
    tex_t *copy = malloc(sizeof *copy);
    if (!copy) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory (replay queue)");
    *copy = *t;
    ReplayItem it = {.kind = RI_RELEASE, .tex = copy};
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    dr_calls[DR_TEX_RELEASE]++, dr_tcalls[DR_TEX_RELEASE]++;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    replay_enqueue(&it);
}
static void vk_be_program_release(const prog_t *p) { replay_drain(DR_PROG_RELEASE); vk_program_release(p); }
// Asynchronous: the handles (nvn_submit_prepare_async ran under the front end's submit lock) are copied and queued;
// the value returned is the one the replay will signal.
static uint64_t vk_be_submit(const uint64_t *handles, int n) {
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) return submit_sync(handles, n);
    vk_sync_start();
    ReplayItem it = {.kind = RI_SUBMIT, .n = n, .submit_no = nvn_submit_count()};
    if (n > 0) {
        it.h = malloc(sizeof *it.h * (size_t)n);
        if (!it.h) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory (replay queue)");
        memcpy(it.h, handles, sizeof *it.h * (size_t)n);
    }
    return replay_enqueue(&it);
}
static void vk_be_finish(void) { vk_sync_start(); replay_drain(DR_FINISH); vk_present_drain(); vk_sync_finish(); }
static int replay_check(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_REPLAY_CHECK");
        on = e && strcmp(e, "0");
        if (on) rt_log("vk: TOTK_REPLAY_CHECK: every ReadTexels is read again after a full replay drain and compared");
    }
    return on;
}

// ReadTexels with the replay queued: waits for the newest submission recorded to write the texture (replayed and
// completed), not for the whole queue. The readback copy goes through the upload batch on the same queue, after every
// submission the replay has submitted. Submissions still queued or being recorded run after the copy, as on hardware
// when the GPU has not reached them yet: the game only sees their texels after waiting on a sync, and every sync
// value covers replay and GPU, so a read the game synchronised sees them. TOTK_REPLAY_CHECK compares with a full drain.
static void vk_be_read_texels(const tex_t *t, const view_t *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, uint8_t *dst, uint64_t row,
                              uint64_t img) {
    vk_sync_start();
    if (!gfx_replay_async()) {
        vk_read_texels(t, v, r, dst, row, img);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t f = vk_texture_last_write(t);
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    dr_calls[DR_READ_TEXELS]++, dr_tcalls[DR_READ_TEXELS]++;
    int idle = !rq_n && !r_busy;
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    if (f && vk_sync_fence_done() < f) {
        uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
        vk_sync_fence_wait(f, UINT64_MAX);   // counts as a fence wait in perf
        uint64_t d = kern_now_ns() - t0;
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        dr_waits[DR_READ_TEXELS]++, dr_twaits[DR_READ_TEXELS]++;
        dr_ns[DR_READ_TEXELS] += d, dr_tns[DR_READ_TEXELS] += d;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    }
    vk_read_texels(t, v, r, dst, row, img);
    if (!replay_check()) return;
    size_t n = vk_texture_texel_span(t, v, r, row, img);
    uint8_t *again = n ? malloc(n) : NULL;
    if (!again) return;
    memcpy(again, dst, n);   // bytes between the rows stay the caller's
    uint64_t f0 = vk_texture_last_write(t);
    replay_drain(DR_CHECK);
    uint64_t f1 = vk_texture_last_write(t);
    vk_read_texels(t, v, r, again, row, img);
    int differ = memcmp(again, dst, n) != 0;
    static volatile long n_logged;
    if (differ && InterlockedIncrement(&n_logged) <= 40) {
        size_t at = 0;
        while (at < n && again[at] == dst[at]) at++;
        rt_log("vk: replay check: ReadTexels of %p (format %#x, %dx%dx%d at %d,%d,%d) differs at byte %zu of %zu; writer "
               "fence %llu at the read, %llu after the drain, done %llu; queue %s at the read",
               (void *)t->mem, t->d.format, r->width, r->height, r->depth, r->xoffset, r->yoffset, r->zoffset, at, n,
               (unsigned long long)f0, (unsigned long long)f1, (unsigned long long)vk_sync_fence_done(), idle ? "idle" : "busy");
    }
    AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    ck_reads++;
    if (differ) {
        ck_diff++;
        if (f1 == f0) ck_diff_unexplained++;
        if (idle) ck_diff_idle++;
    }
    ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
    free(again);
}
static void vk_be_write_texels(const tex_t *t, const view_t *v, const NVNcopyRegion *r, const uint8_t *src, uint64_t row,
                               uint64_t img) {
    vk_sync_start();
    replay_drain(DR_WRITE_TEXELS);
    vk_present_drain();
    vk_write_texels(t, v, r, src, row, img);
}
static void vk_be_guest_written(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) { vk_sync_start(); vk_guest_written(addr, size); }
// A CPU read of GPU-written mirrored storage (memcpy, pool invalidate). With the replay queued it waits for the newest
// submission recorded to write the textures there, not for the whole queue: the write-back copy then runs after their
// renders, and clears gpu_dirty only for content that is on the queue. Submissions not replayed yet render after the
// copy, as on hardware when the GPU has not reached them; they mark the texture dirty again for a later read.
static void vk_be_guest_read(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!vk_texture_cpu_stale(addr, size)) return;
    vk_sync_start();
    if (gfx_replay_async()) {
        uint64_t f = vk_texture_dirty_fence(addr, size);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        dr_calls[DR_GUEST_READ]++, dr_tcalls[DR_GUEST_READ]++;
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        if (f && vk_sync_fence_done() < f) {
            uint64_t t0 = kern_now_ns();
            NVN_BLOCKING();
            vk_sync_fence_wait(f, UINT64_MAX);
            uint64_t d = kern_now_ns() - t0;
            AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
            dr_waits[DR_GUEST_READ]++, dr_twaits[DR_GUEST_READ]++;
            dr_ns[DR_GUEST_READ] += d, dr_tns[DR_GUEST_READ] += d;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&rl);
        }
    }
    vk_present_drain();
    vk_texture_write_back(addr, size);
}
// After a fence wait: the value is done, so its replay is too; a later submission the replay records meanwhile marks
// its targets with a later fence, which write_back_small leaves alone. No drain.
static void vk_be_cpu_synced(uint64_t fence) {
    if (!vk_texture_small_dirty()) return;
    vk_sync_start();
    vk_present_drain();
    vk_texture_write_back_small(fence);
}

const GfxBackend gfx_vulkan_backend = {
    .name = "vulkan",
    .pool_init = vk_be_pool_init,
    .pool_fini = vk_be_pool_fini,
    .pool_map_virtual = vk_be_pool_map_virtual,
    .texture_register = vk_be_texture_register,
    .sampler_register = vk_be_sampler_register,
    .texture_release = vk_be_texture_release,
    .program_release = vk_be_program_release,
    .submit = vk_be_submit,
    .fence_wait = vk_sync_fence_wait,
    .fence_done = vk_sync_fence_done,
    .present = vk_be_present,
    .finish = vk_be_finish,
    .read_texels = vk_be_read_texels,
    .write_texels = vk_be_write_texels,
    .guest_written = vk_be_guest_written,
    .guest_read = vk_be_guest_read,
    .cpu_synced = vk_be_cpu_synced,
};

void vk_backend_shutdown(void) {
    replay_drain(DR_FINISH);
    gfx_exit_log();
    vk_present_drain();
    vk_sync_shutdown();
    vk_mem_shutdown();
    vk_shutdown();
}
```

`runtime/vk_caps.c`:

```c
// What the runtime branches on, logged once at device creation, and the fallbacks for GPUs other than the RX 9070.
//
// Fallbacks (each also forced on any GPU by an environment switch, to test it where the GPU does not need it):
//   - no shaderFloat64 (TOTK_VK_NO_FLOAT64=1 clears the feature before vkCreateDevice): the translator lowers FP64 to
//     FP32 ("softfloat64"), so no shader declares Float64.
//   - minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment above 4 (TOTK_VK_SSBO_ALIGN=<power of two> raises it): the translator computes
//     storage offsets from the guest address rounded down to that alignment (Ryujinx's unaligned storage path), and
//     vk_exec_draw.c ssbo_info binds the rounded-down address, so shader writes reach guest memory instead of a copy.
//   - no graphics pipeline library with fast linking (TOTK_GPL=0 forces it; the default on AMD's RDNA 1/2 driver):
//     vk_caps.gpl = 0, the extension stays disabled, and pipelines are built whole.
//   - no 32-lane pin (no subgroupSizeControl, 32 outside min..max, or TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP_PIN=0): stages run at the
//     device's subgroupSize (SPIR-V 1.3 without a required size) and the translator is told that size.
//     TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP=<n> pins n instead of 32 where the driver allows it.
// The defaults (Float64, no storage rounding, 32 everywhere) leave the shader cache keys as they were (gfx_shader.c).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"

VkCaps vk_caps = {.float64 = 1, .sg_size = 32};
static int f64_supported;
static VkBool32 gpl_lib, gpl_fast;   // the driver's graphicsPipelineLibrary (feature), ...FastLinking (property)

static uint32_t env_u32(const char *name, uint32_t def) {
    const char *e = cfg_get(name);
    return e && *e ? (uint32_t)strtoul(e, NULL, 0) : def;
}

void vk_caps_features(VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures *f) {
    f64_supported = f->shaderFloat64;
    if (env_u32("TOTK_VK_NO_FLOAT64", 0)) f->shaderFloat64 = VK_FALSE;
    vk_caps.float64 = f->shaderFloat64;
}

void vk_caps_driver(VkPhysicalDevice p) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties drv = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &drv};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(p, &p2);
    vk_caps.amd = p2.properties.vendorID == 0x1002;
    // AMD split RDNA 1 and 2 off into a driver branch of their own; its driverInfo reads
    // "26.10.1 (AMD proprietary shader compiler)" where the RDNA 3 and 4 driver names LLPC.
    vk_caps.amd_sc = drv.driverID == VK_DRIVER_ID_AMD_PROPRIETARY && strstr(drv.driverInfo, "shader compiler");
}

// TOTK_GPL=0/1 forces graphics pipeline libraries off or on. Default off on AMD's RDNA 1/2 driver branch: every boot
// that lost the device there had a cold pipeline cache and draws waiting on fast-linked pipelines, and a run with GPL
// off booted (issue #5); Savage Wind Recomp turns GPL off on RDNA 4 under RADV for a GPU hang at the title screen.
int vk_caps_gpl(const VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryFeaturesEXT *f,
                const VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryPropertiesEXT *p) {
    gpl_lib = f->graphicsPipelineLibrary;
    gpl_fast = p->graphicsPipelineLibraryFastLinking;
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_GPL");   // no fixed default: it depends on the driver, see above
    vk_caps.gpl = gpl_lib && gpl_fast && (e && *e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : !vk_caps.amd_sc);
    return vk_caps.gpl;
}

static int has_ext(const VkExtensionProperties *ep, uint32_t n, const char *name) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(ep[i].extensionName, name)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static char depth_ok(VkPhysicalDevice p, VkFormat f) {
    VkFormatProperties fp;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(p, f, &fp);
    return fp.optimalTilingFeatures & VK_FORMAT_FEATURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT ? 'y' : 'n';
}

static void driver_version(char *o, size_t n, uint32_t vendor, uint32_t v) {
    if (vendor == 0x10de) snprintf(o, n, "%u.%u.%u.%u", v >> 22, v >> 14 & 0xff, v >> 6 & 0xff, v & 0x3f);
    else if (vendor == 0x8086) snprintf(o, n, "%u.%u", v >> 14, v & 0x3fff);
    else snprintf(o, n, "%u.%u.%u", VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(v));
}

void vk_caps_init(VkCtx *c) {
    VkPhysicalDeviceLimits *l = &c->props.limits;
    VkPhysicalDeviceDriverProperties drv = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DRIVER_PROPERTIES};
    VkPhysicalDeviceSubgroupProperties sg = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_SUBGROUP_PROPERTIES, .pNext = &drv};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Properties p13 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_PROPERTIES, .pNext = &sg};
    VkPhysicalDevicePushDescriptorPropertiesKHR pd = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_PROPERTIES_KHR,
                                                      .pNext = &p13};
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &pd};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(c->phys, &p2);
    VkPhysicalDeviceProvokingVertexFeaturesEXT pvf = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROVOKING_VERTEX_FEATURES_EXT};
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES,
                                            .pNext = c->has_provoking_vertex ? &pvf : NULL};
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2, .pNext = &f13};
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(c->phys, &f2);
    uint32_t ne = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(c->phys, NULL, &ne, NULL);
    VkExtensionProperties *ep = calloc(ne ? ne : 1, sizeof *ep);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(c->phys, NULL, &ne, ep);

    uint32_t real_align = (uint32_t)l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, a = env_u32("TOTK_VK_SSBO_ALIGN", 0);
    if (a && !(a & (a - 1)) && a > real_align) l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment = a;
    vk_caps.sbuf_align = l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment > 4 ? (uint32_t)l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment : 0;

    uint32_t want = env_u32("TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP", 32);
    int pin = f13.subgroupSizeControl && cfg_bool("TOTK_VK_SUBGROUP_PIN") && p13.minSubgroupSize <= want &&
              want <= p13.maxSubgroupSize;
    vk_caps.sg_size = want;
    vk_caps.sg_pin_stages = pin ? p13.requiredSubgroupSizeStages : 0;
    static const VkShaderStageFlags stage[3] = {VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT, VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT};
    uint32_t told[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) told[i] = vk_caps.sg_pin_stages & stage[i] ? want : sg.subgroupSize;
    gfx_shader_set_host(vk_caps.float64, vk_caps.sbuf_align, told);

    char dv[32];
    driver_version(dv, sizeof dv, c->props.vendorID, c->props.driverVersion);
    uint32_t v = c->props.apiVersion;
    VkPhysicalDevice p = c->phys;
    rt_log("vk caps: %s, vendor %#06x device %#06x, driver %s \"%s\" (id %d, version %s, raw %#x), api %u.%u.%u",
           c->props.deviceName, c->props.vendorID, c->props.deviceID, drv.driverName, drv.driverInfo, (int)drv.driverID, dv,
           c->props.driverVersion, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(v), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(v));
    rt_log("vk caps: subgroup size %u, stages %#x, ops %#x; size control %d (%u-%u, required stages %#x)", sg.subgroupSize,
           (unsigned)sg.supportedStages, (unsigned)sg.supportedOperations, (int)f13.subgroupSizeControl, p13.minSubgroupSize,
           p13.maxSubgroupSize, (unsigned)p13.requiredSubgroupSizeStages);
    rt_log("vk caps: shaderFloat64 %d (enabled %d), storage buffer offset alignment %u (device %u), uniform %llu, "
           "maxPushDescriptors %u, provoking vertex ext %d last %d",
           f64_supported, vk_caps.float64, (unsigned)l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, real_align,
           (unsigned long long)l->minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment, pd.maxPushDescriptors, c->has_provoking_vertex,
           (int)pvf.provokingVertexLast);
    rt_log("vk caps: ext index_type_uint8 khr %d ext %d, attachment_feedback_loop_layout %d dynamic_state %d, "
           "graphics_pipeline_library %d; depth attachment D16 %c D24S8 %c X8D24 %c D32 %c D32S8 %c",
           has_ext(ep, ne, "VK_KHR_index_type_uint8"), has_ext(ep, ne, "VK_EXT_index_type_uint8"),
           has_ext(ep, ne, "VK_EXT_attachment_feedback_loop_layout"), has_ext(ep, ne, "VK_EXT_attachment_feedback_loop_dynamic_state"),
           has_ext(ep, ne, "VK_EXT_graphics_pipeline_library"), depth_ok(p, VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM),
           depth_ok(p, VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT), depth_ok(p, VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32), depth_ok(p, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT),
           depth_ok(p, VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT));
    const char *ge = cfg_get("TOTK_GPL");
    rt_log("vk caps: gpl %s fast-link %s (graphicsPipelineLibrary %u%s)", vk_caps.gpl ? "yes" : "no",
           gpl_fast ? "yes" : "no", (unsigned)gpl_lib,
           !gpl_lib || !gpl_fast || vk_caps.gpl ? "" : ge && *ge ? ", off by TOTK_GPL=0" : ", off on AMD's RDNA 1/2 driver");
    rt_log("vk caps: fallbacks: float64 %s, storage buffers %s %u, subgroup pin %u on stages %#x, translator subgroup vs/fs/cs %u/%u/%u",
           vk_caps.float64 ? "native" : "softfloat64", vk_caps.sbuf_align ? "rounded down to" : "exact, alignment",
           (unsigned)l->minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment, want, (unsigned)vk_caps.sg_pin_stages, told[0], told[1], told[2]);
    free(ep);
}
```

`runtime/vk_crumbs.c`:

```c
// GPU breadcrumbs for a lost device (vk.h vk_crumb). VK_AMD_buffer_marker writes a 32-bit code into a buffer from
// the command stream: at TOP_OF_PIPE once the command processor reaches the marker, at BOTTOM_OF_PIPE once every
// command before it has finished. Each crumb writes both, into two words of one host-coherent buffer, so after a
// device loss word 0 names the newest point the GPU reached and word 1 the newest point it had finished: the hang lies
// between them. A code is the crumb kind in the top 4 bits and its number in the low 28. The markers cost two small
// writes per crumb, and crumbs mark submissions, upload batches, ASTC chunks and presents, not draws.
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"

static PFN_vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD write_marker;
static VkBuffer buf;
static VmaAllocation alloc;
static volatile uint32_t *words;

void vk_crumbs_init(VkCtx *c) {
    if (!c->has_buffer_marker) return;
    write_marker = (PFN_vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD)vkGetDeviceProcAddr(c->device, "vkCmdWriteBufferMarkerAMD");
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = 16,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT,
                                  .requiredFlags = VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (!write_marker || vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &buf, &alloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs unavailable");
        write_marker = NULL;
        return;
    }
    words = info.pMappedData;
    words[0] = words[1] = 0;
    rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs on (VK_AMD_buffer_marker)");
}

void vk_crumbs_release(void) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    if (buf && c) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, buf, alloc);
    buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE, alloc = NULL, words = NULL, write_marker = NULL;
}

void vk_crumb(VkCommandBuffer cb, int kind, uint64_t n) {
    if (!write_marker || !cb) return;
    uint32_t code = (uint32_t)kind << 28 | (uint32_t)(n & 0x0fffffff);
    write_marker(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, buf, 0, code);
    write_marker(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, buf, 4, code);
}

static void describe(uint32_t code, char *o, size_t size) {
    static const char *const kinds[] = {"nothing", "the start of a part of submission", "the end of submission",
                                        "the start of upload batch", "the end of upload batch",
                                        "ASTC decode chunk", "the start of present",
                                        "the end of present"};
    unsigned k = code >> 28;
    if (!code) snprintf(o, size, "nothing yet");
    else if (k < sizeof kinds / sizeof *kinds) snprintf(o, size, "%s %u", kinds[k], code & 0x0fffffff);
    else snprintf(o, size, "unknown code %#x", code);
}

void vk_crumbs_report(void) {
    if (!words) return;
    char reached[96], finished[96];
    describe(words[0], reached, sizeof reached);
    describe(words[1], finished, sizeof finished);
    rt_log("vk: GPU breadcrumbs: the GPU last reached %s; everything before %s had finished", reached, finished);
}
```

`runtime/vk_device.c`:

```c
// Vulkan instance, physical device choice, logical device, VMA, timeline semaphore and the validation messenger.
// Ported from LAS Recomp, runtime/nvn/vulkan/device.c:33-330
// (https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp @ da35b83a9611d046a9a681aae668d7085954d37f, MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai),
// without SDL. The VMA implementation is runtime/vk_vma.cpp (VMA is C++ only).
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "vk.h"

static VkCtx g_vk;
static int g_ready;
static SRWLOCK g_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;

static VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debug_cb(VkDebugUtilsMessageSeverityFlagBitsEXT sev, VkDebugUtilsMessageTypeFlagsEXT type,
                                               const VkDebugUtilsMessengerCallbackDataEXT *d, void *user) {
    (void)type, (void)user;
    int err = (sev & VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT) != 0;
    if (err) InterlockedIncrement(&g_vk.validation_errors);
    static volatile long logged;
    if (InterlockedIncrement(&logged) <= 500) rt_log("vk validation %s: %s", err ? "error" : "warning", d->pMessage);
    return VK_FALSE;
}

static int has_ext(const VkExtensionProperties *e, uint32_t n, const char *name) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(e[i].extensionName, name)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static int layer_present(const char *name) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, NULL);
    VkLayerProperties *l = calloc(n ? n : 1, sizeof *l);
    vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(&n, l);
    int found = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(l[i].layerName, name)) found = 1;
    free(l);
    return found;
}

static int create_instance(void) {
    const char *ext[4] = {VK_KHR_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_KHR_WIN32_SURFACE_EXTENSION_NAME};
    uint32_t n_ext = 2;
    const char *layers[] = {"VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation"};
    int validate = cfg_bool("TOTK_VK_VALIDATION");
    if (validate && !layer_present(layers[0])) {
        rt_log("vk: TOTK_VK_VALIDATION set but %s is not installed; continuing without", layers[0]);
        validate = 0;
    }
    if (validate) ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_DEBUG_UTILS_EXTENSION_NAME;
    VkApplicationInfo app = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO, .pApplicationName = "TotK Recomp",
                             .pEngineName = "TotK Recomp", .apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3};
    VkInstanceCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO, .pApplicationInfo = &app,
                               .enabledExtensionCount = n_ext, .ppEnabledExtensionNames = ext,
                               .enabledLayerCount = validate ? 1 : 0, .ppEnabledLayerNames = layers};
    rdoc_init();
    VkResult r = vkCreateInstance(&ci, NULL, &g_vk.instance);
    if (r != VK_SUCCESS) { rt_log("vk: vkCreateInstance failed (%d); is a Vulkan 1.3 driver installed?", (int)r); return 0; }
    g_vk.validation = validate;
    if (validate) {
        PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT f =
            (PFN_vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT)vkGetInstanceProcAddr(g_vk.instance, "vkCreateDebugUtilsMessengerEXT");
        VkDebugUtilsMessengerCreateInfoEXT mi = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSENGER_CREATE_INFO_EXT,
            .messageSeverity = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_WARNING_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_SEVERITY_ERROR_BIT_EXT,
            .messageType = VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_GENERAL_BIT_EXT | VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_VALIDATION_BIT_EXT |
                           VK_DEBUG_UTILS_MESSAGE_TYPE_PERFORMANCE_BIT_EXT,
            .pfnUserCallback = debug_cb};
        if (f) f(g_vk.instance, &mi, NULL, &g_vk.messenger);
    }
    return 1;
}

static const char *const k_required_ext[] = {
    VK_KHR_SWAPCHAIN_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_KHR_PUSH_DESCRIPTOR_EXTENSION_NAME, VK_EXT_DEPTH_CLIP_CONTROL_EXTENSION_NAME,
    VK_EXT_EXTERNAL_MEMORY_HOST_EXTENSION_NAME};

// Name of the first missing required extension, or NULL.
static const char *missing_required(VkPhysicalDevice pd) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(pd, NULL, &n, NULL);
    VkExtensionProperties *e = calloc(n ? n : 1, sizeof *e);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(pd, NULL, &n, e);
    const char *miss = NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_required_ext / sizeof *k_required_ext && !miss; i++)
        if (!has_ext(e, n, k_required_ext[i])) miss = k_required_ext[i];
    free(e);
    return miss;
}

// Graphics+compute family that can present on win32.
static uint32_t find_gfx_family(VkPhysicalDevice pd, const VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp, uint32_t nq) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++)
        if ((qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT) && (qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT) &&
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceWin32PresentationSupportKHR(pd, i))
            return i;
    return UINT32_MAX;
}

static int name_has(const char *s, const char *sub) {
    for (size_t n = strlen(sub); *s; s++)
        if (!_strnicmp(s, sub, n)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

// First discrete GPU with Vulkan 1.3, the required extensions and a graphics+present queue; TOTK_GPU_INDEX (index) or
// TOTK_GPU_NAME (case-insensitive part of the name) overrides.
static int pick_device(void) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(g_vk.instance, &n, NULL);
    if (!n) { rt_log("vk: no Vulkan device"); return 0; }
    VkPhysicalDevice *pd = calloc(n, sizeof *pd);
    vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(g_vk.instance, &n, pd);
    const char *e = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_INDEX");   // no fixed default: the best device when unset
    int want = e && *e ? atoi(e) : -1;
    const char *name = cfg_get("TOTK_GPU_NAME");
    int best = -1, best_score = -1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties p;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(pd[i], &p);
        rt_log("vk: gpu %u: %s (type %d, api %u.%u.%u)", i, p.deviceName, (int)p.deviceType, VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(p.apiVersion),
               VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(p.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_PATCH(p.apiVersion));
        if (want >= 0 && (int)i != want) continue;
        if (name && *name && !name_has(p.deviceName, name)) continue;
        if (p.apiVersion < VK_API_VERSION_1_3) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: Vulkan below 1.3", i); continue; }
        const char *miss = missing_required(pd[i]);
        if (miss) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: missing extension %s", i, miss); continue; }
        uint32_t nq = 0;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd[i], &nq, NULL);
        VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(pd[i], &nq, qp);
        uint32_t fam = find_gfx_family(pd[i], qp, nq);
        free(qp);
        if (fam == UINT32_MAX) { rt_log("vk: gpu %u skipped: no graphics+compute+present queue family", i); continue; }
        int score = (int)i == want ? 100 : p.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_DISCRETE_GPU ? 3
                  : p.deviceType == VK_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TYPE_INTEGRATED_GPU ? 2 : 1;
        if (score > best_score) { best_score = score; best = (int)i; }
    }
    if (best < 0) {
        if (want >= 0) rt_log("vk: TOTK_GPU_INDEX=%d is not usable (see above)", want);
        else if (name && *name) rt_log("vk: no usable gpu matches TOTK_GPU_NAME=%s (see above)", name);
        else rt_log("vk: no device with Vulkan 1.3 and the required extensions (see above)");
        free(pd);
        return 0;
    }
    g_vk.phys = pd[best];
    g_vk.device_index = best;
    free(pd);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(g_vk.phys, &g_vk.props);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(g_vk.phys, &g_vk.mem_props);
    uint32_t nq = 0;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(g_vk.phys, &nq, NULL);
    VkQueueFamilyProperties *qp = calloc(nq ? nq : 1, sizeof *qp);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(g_vk.phys, &nq, qp);
    g_vk.gfx_family = find_gfx_family(g_vk.phys, qp, nq);
    g_vk.xfer_family = g_vk.gfx_family;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nq; i++)   // a family that does transfer only (async DMA engine)
        if ((qp[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_TRANSFER_BIT) && !(qp[i].queueFlags & (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT))) {
            g_vk.xfer_family = i;
            break;
        }
    free(qp);
    rt_log("vk: using gpu %d: %s", best, g_vk.props.deviceName);
    vk_mem_class_log(&g_vk.props, &g_vk.mem_props);
    return 1;
}

typedef struct {
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 f2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features f11;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features f12;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features f13;
    VkPhysicalDeviceDepthClipControlFeaturesEXT clip;
    VkPhysicalDeviceCustomBorderColorFeaturesEXT cbc;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicStateFeaturesEXT eds;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicState2FeaturesEXT eds2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicState3FeaturesEXT eds3;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVertexInputDynamicStateFeaturesEXT vids;
    VkPhysicalDeviceConditionalRenderingFeaturesEXT cond;
    VkPhysicalDeviceTransformFeedbackFeaturesEXT xfb;
    VkPhysicalDeviceProvokingVertexFeaturesEXT pv;
    VkPhysicalDeviceRobustness2FeaturesEXT rob2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFaultFeaturesEXT fault;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentShaderInterlockFeaturesEXT fsi;
    VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryFeaturesEXT gpl;
    VkPhysicalDeviceAttachmentFeedbackLoopLayoutFeaturesEXT fbl;
    VkPhysicalDeviceDynamicRenderingLocalReadFeaturesKHR lr;
} FeatureChain;

static int create_device(void) {
    uint32_t ne = 0;
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(g_vk.phys, NULL, &ne, NULL);
    VkExtensionProperties *ep = calloc(ne ? ne : 1, sizeof *ep);
    vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(g_vk.phys, NULL, &ne, ep);
    const char *ext[28];
    uint32_t n_ext = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof k_required_ext / sizeof *k_required_ext; i++) ext[n_ext++] = k_required_ext[i];

    FeatureChain *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c);
    void **tail = &c->f2.pNext;
#define CHAIN(member, stype) do { c->member.sType = stype; *tail = &c->member; tail = &c->member.pNext; } while (0)
    c->f2.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2;
    CHAIN(f11, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(f12, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(f13, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES);
    CHAIN(clip, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DEPTH_CLIP_CONTROL_FEATURES_EXT);
#define OPTIONAL_EXT(flag, name, member, stype) do { \
        if (has_ext(ep, ne, name)) { g_vk.flag = 1; ext[n_ext++] = name; CHAIN(member, stype); } } while (0)
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_custom_border_color, VK_EXT_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_EXTENSION_NAME, cbc, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CUSTOM_BORDER_COLOR_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_EXTENSION_NAME, eds, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds2, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_2_EXTENSION_NAME, eds2, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_2_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_eds3, VK_EXT_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_EXTENSION_NAME, eds3, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_vertex_input_dynamic_state, VK_EXT_VERTEX_INPUT_DYNAMIC_STATE_EXTENSION_NAME, vids, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VERTEX_INPUT_DYNAMIC_STATE_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_conditional_rendering, VK_EXT_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_EXTENSION_NAME, cond, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_transform_feedback, VK_EXT_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_EXTENSION_NAME, xfb, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_provoking_vertex, VK_EXT_PROVOKING_VERTEX_EXTENSION_NAME, pv, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROVOKING_VERTEX_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_robustness2, VK_EXT_ROBUSTNESS_2_EXTENSION_NAME, rob2, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ROBUSTNESS_2_FEATURES_EXT);
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_device_fault, VK_EXT_DEVICE_FAULT_EXTENSION_NAME, fault, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FAULT_FEATURES_EXT);
    // Ryujinx's SPIR-V declares fragment shader interlock whenever the host reports it (vk_pipeline.c spirv_fixup).
    OPTIONAL_EXT(has_fragment_shader_interlock, VK_EXT_FRAGMENT_SHADER_INTERLOCK_EXTENSION_NAME, fsi,
                 VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_INTERLOCK_FEATURES_EXT);
    // Feedback loops (vk.h VkCtx.feedback): the layout, and barriers inside dynamic rendering
    int has_fbl = 0, has_lr = 0;
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_EXTENSION_NAME) &&
        has_ext(ep, ne, VK_KHR_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
        has_fbl = has_lr = 1;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_EXTENSION_NAME;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_KHR_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_EXTENSION_NAME;
        CHAIN(fbl, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_LAYOUT_FEATURES_EXT);
        CHAIN(lr, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_DYNAMIC_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ_FEATURES_KHR);
    }
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME)) { g_vk.has_memory_budget = 1; ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_MEMORY_BUDGET_EXTENSION_NAME; }
    // GPU breadcrumbs for a lost device (vk_crumbs.c): AMD's drivers and RADV report it.
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_AMD_BUFFER_MARKER_EXTENSION_NAME)) { g_vk.has_buffer_marker = 1; ext[n_ext++] = VK_AMD_BUFFER_MARKER_EXTENSION_NAME; }
    // Graphics pipeline library: chained last so it can be dropped again when vk_caps_gpl declines it.
    void **gpl_link = NULL;
    if (has_ext(ep, ne, VK_KHR_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME) && has_ext(ep, ne, VK_EXT_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME)) {
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_KHR_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME;
        ext[n_ext++] = VK_EXT_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_EXTENSION_NAME;
        gpl_link = tail;
        CHAIN(gpl, VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_FEATURES_EXT);
    }
    free(ep);

    // The driver fills the chain with what it supports; the same chain then enables all of it (robustBufferAccess
    // stays on: guest shaders index constant buffers freely and out-of-range reads must stay harmless).
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(g_vk.phys, &c->f2);
    vk_caps_driver(g_vk.phys);
    vk_caps_features(&c->f2.features);
    if (gpl_link) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceGraphicsPipelineLibraryPropertiesEXT gp = {
            .sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_LIBRARY_PROPERTIES_EXT};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2, .pNext = &gp};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(g_vk.phys, &p2);
        if (!vk_caps_gpl(&c->gpl, &gp)) { *gpl_link = NULL; n_ext -= 2; }
    }
    const VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures *h = &c->f2.features;
    const char *miss = NULL;
    if (!c->f12.timelineSemaphore) miss = "timelineSemaphore";
    else if (!c->f13.dynamicRendering) miss = "dynamicRendering";
    else if (!c->f13.synchronization2) miss = "synchronization2";
    else if (!h->shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat) miss = "shaderStorageImageWriteWithoutFormat";
    else if (!c->clip.depthClipControl) miss = "depthClipControl";
    else if (!h->shaderInt64) miss = "shaderInt64";
    else if (!h->samplerAnisotropy) miss = "samplerAnisotropy";
    else if (!h->independentBlend) miss = "independentBlend";
    else if (!h->geometryShader) miss = "geometryShader";
    else if (!h->textureCompressionBC) miss = "textureCompressionBC";
```
