```c
        if (logged < 8 && ex->has_vp && (ex->vp[0][0] != 0 || ex->vp[0][1] != 0 || ex->vp[0][2] != w || ex->vp[0][3] != h))
            logged++, rt_log("vk_exec: pass without attachments %ux%u for viewport %g,%g %gx%g", w, h, ex->vp[0][0],
                             ex->vp[0][1], ex->vp[0][2], ex->vp[0][3]);
    }
    ex->pass_w = w, ex->pass_h = h, ex->pass_layers = layers;
    ex->pass_ncolor = (uint32_t)n;
    ex->pass_samples = samples ? samples : 1;
    ex->pipe.samples = (uint8_t)ex->pass_samples;
}

// The attachment view of a target. A registered texture's view lives as long as its image (vk_exec_target_view); any
// other image's view is made for this command buffer and freed at its fence.
static VkImageView view_of(VkExec *ex, const VkExecTarget *t) {
    if (t->img && t->img->image == t->image)
        return vk_exec_target_view(t->img, t->format, t->view_type, t->aspect, t->level, t->base_layer, t->layers, t->blocks);
    ViewEnt *v = ex->views;
    for (int i = 0; i < ex->nviews; i++)
        if (v[i].image == t->image && v[i].format == t->format && v[i].type == t->view_type && v[i].aspect == t->aspect &&
            v[i].level == t->level && v[i].base == t->base_layer && v[i].layers == t->layers)
            return v[i].view;
    VkImageViewCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = t->image,
                                .viewType = t->view_type, .format = t->format,
                                .subresourceRange = {t->aspect, t->level, 1, t->base_layer, t->layers}};
    VkImageViewUsageCreateInfo use = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_USAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT};
    if (t->blocks) ci.pNext = &use;   // not the BC image's sampling and transfer usages
    VkImageView view;
    if (vkCreateImageView(vk_ctx()->device, &ci, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS)
        rt_fatal("vk: render target view (format %d, %ux%u) could not be created", (int)t->format, t->width, t->height);
    if (ex->nviews == ex->cap_views) {
        ex->cap_views = ex->cap_views ? ex->cap_views * 2 : 16;
        ex->views = realloc(ex->views, sizeof(ViewEnt) * (size_t)ex->cap_views);
        if (!ex->views) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
        v = ex->views;
    }
    v[ex->nviews++] = (ViewEnt){t->image, t->format, t->view_type, t->aspect, t->level, t->base_layer, t->layers, view};
    return view;
}

typedef struct { int n; VkImageView v[]; } ViewList;

static void free_views(void *arg) {   // completion thread, once the submission that used them is done
    ViewList *l = arg;
    VkDevice dev = vk_ctx()->device;
    for (int i = 0; i < l->n; i++) vkDestroyImageView(dev, l->v[i], NULL);
    free(l);
}

// ---- target history
// The presented frame (gfx_counters.frames + 1; 0: never) each target subresource was last rendered into, and the one
// before. prepare_draw lets a draw into a target the previous frame did not render (a one-shot draw: a volume or LUT
// generated once) wait for its shaders and pipeline instead of skipping it. Per subresource, not per image: a volume
// may be generated a few slices per frame. Direct-mapped: a slot another subresource took reads as not rendered, so a
// collision makes a draw wait rather than skip.
typedef struct { VkImage image; uint32_t level, layer; uint64_t last, prev; } TargetFrames;
static TargetFrames tfr[1024];

static TargetFrames *tfr_slot(const VkExecTarget *t) {
    uint64_t h = ((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->image ^ (uint64_t)t->level << 56 ^ (uint64_t)t->base_layer << 40) *
                 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    return &tfr[h >> 54];
}

static int tfr_match(const TargetFrames *e, const VkExecTarget *t) {
    return e->image == t->image && e->level == t->level && e->layer == t->base_layer;
}

static void tfr_note(const VkExecTarget *t, uint64_t stamp) {
    TargetFrames *e = tfr_slot(t);
    if (!tfr_match(e, t)) *e = (TargetFrames){t->image, t->level, t->base_layer, 0, 0};
    if (e->last != stamp) e->prev = e->last, e->last = stamp;
}

static int tfr_recent(const VkExecTarget *t, uint64_t stamp) {
    const TargetFrames *e = tfr_slot(t);
    return tfr_match(e, t) && (e->last == stamp ? e->prev : e->last) == stamp - 1;
}

int vk_exec_targets_recent(VkExec *ex, int any) {
    resolve_rt(ex);
    uint64_t stamp = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1;
    int n = 0, recent = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const VkExecTarget *t = i < 8 ? &ex->color[i] : &ex->depth;
        if (!t->image) continue;
        n++;
        if (tfr_recent(t, stamp)) recent++;
        else if (!any) return 0;
    }
    return any ? recent > 0 : n > 0;
}

// One line naming each target of the current pass: format, extent, layer and the two frames it was last rendered in
// (prepare_draw's pipeline wait log).
void vk_exec_targets_describe(VkExec *ex, char *buf, size_t cap) {
    resolve_rt(ex);
    size_t n = 0;
    buf[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 9 && n < cap; i++) {
        const VkExecTarget *t = i < 8 ? &ex->color[i] : &ex->depth;
        if (!t->image) continue;
        const TargetFrames *e = tfr_slot(t);
        int m = tfr_match(e, t);
        int w = snprintf(buf + n, cap - n, "%s%c%d fmt %d %ux%u L%u seen %llu/%llu", n ? "; " : "", i < 8 ? 'c' : 'd',
                         i < 8 ? i : 0, (int)t->format, t->width, t->height, t->base_layer,
                         (unsigned long long)(m ? e->last : 0), (unsigned long long)(m ? e->prev : 0));
        if (w < 0) break;
        n += (size_t)w;
    }
    if (!n) snprintf(buf, cap, "no targets");
}

// ---- passes and barriers

static int has_image(const VkImage *list, int n, VkImage img) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (list[i] == img) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static VkImageMemoryBarrier2 layout_barrier(VkImage img, VkImageAspectFlags aspect, VkImageLayout from, VkImageLayout to) {
    return (VkImageMemoryBarrier2){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                                   .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                                   .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                                   .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                                   .oldLayout = from, .newLayout = to, .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                                   .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .image = img,
                                   .subresourceRange = {aspect, 0, VK_REMAINING_MIP_LEVELS, 0, VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS}};
}

// Full barrier. The images in the feedback layout become want[] (pass begin) or none (every other barrier): the others
// go back to GENERAL and the new ones leave it, in the same command.
static void barrier_to(VkExec *ex, const VkImage *want, const VkImageAspectFlags *wasp, int nwant) {
    vk_exec_pass_end(ex);
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 ib[18];
    uint32_t n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ex->nfbl; i++)
        if (!has_image(want, nwant, ex->fbl_img[i]))
            ib[n++] = layout_barrier(ex->fbl_img[i], ex->fbl_aspect[i], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT,
                                     VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL);
    for (int i = 0; i < nwant; i++)
        if (!has_image(ex->fbl_img, ex->nfbl, want[i]))
            ib[n++] = layout_barrier(want[i], wasp[i], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT);
    for (int i = 0; i < nwant; i++) ex->fbl_img[i] = want[i], ex->fbl_aspect[i] = wasp[i];
    ex->nfbl = nwant;
    if (ex->barrier_at == ex->recorded && !n) return;
    vk_exec_frame.fb_layouts += n;
    VkMemoryBarrier2 mb = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                           .srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                           .srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                           .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                           .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT};
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .memoryBarrierCount = 1, .pMemoryBarriers = &mb,
                           .imageMemoryBarrierCount = n, .pImageMemoryBarriers = ib};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(ex->cb, &di);
    ex->barrier_at = ++ex->recorded;
}

void vk_exec_barrier(VkExec *ex) { barrier_to(ex, NULL, NULL, 0); }

void vk_exec_pass_begin(VkExec *ex) {
    if (ex->in_pass) return;
    resolve_rt(ex);
    // Learned targets (VkTexImage.fb_learned) are attached in the feedback layout
    VkImage want[9];
    VkImageAspectFlags wasp[9];
    int nwant = 0;
    uint32_t fbl = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        const VkExecTarget *t = i < 8 ? &ex->color[i] : &ex->depth;
        if ((i < 8 && i >= ex->pass_ncolor) || !t->image || !t->img || !t->img->fb_learned) continue;
        fbl |= 1u << i;
        if (has_image(want, nwant, t->image)) continue;
        want[nwant] = t->image, wasp[nwant++] = i < 8 ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT : t->img->aspect;
    }
    barrier_to(ex, want, wasp, nwant);   // passes, clears, copies and dispatches see each other's results
    ex->fbl_mask = fbl;
    ex->fb_dirty = 0;
    ex->pass_serial++;
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfo ca[8], da = {0}, sa = {0};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < ex->pass_ncolor; i++) {
        const VkExecTarget *t = &ex->color[i];
        ca[i] = (VkRenderingAttachmentInfo){.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO};
        if (!t->image) continue;
        ca[i].imageView = view_of(ex, t);
        ca[i].imageLayout = fbl >> i & 1 ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL;
        ca[i].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD;
        ca[i].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;    }
    const VkExecTarget *d = &ex->depth;
    if (d->image) {
        VkRenderingAttachmentInfo a = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO, .imageView = view_of(ex, d),
                                       .imageLayout = fbl >> 8 & 1 ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT
                                                                   : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                                       .loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD, .storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE};
        if (d->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) da = a;
        if (d->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT) sa = a;
    }
    VkRenderingInfo ri = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO, .renderArea = {{0, 0}, {ex->pass_w, ex->pass_h}},
                          .layerCount = ex->pass_layers, .colorAttachmentCount = ex->pass_ncolor,
                          .pColorAttachments = ca,
                          .pDepthAttachment = ex->pass_depth ? &da : NULL,
                          .pStencilAttachment = ex->pass_stencil ? &sa : NULL};
    vkCmdBeginRendering(ex->cb, &ri);
    vk_exec_frame.passes++;
    ex->recorded++;
    ex->in_pass = 1;
}

void vk_exec_pass_end(VkExec *ex) {
    if (!ex->in_pass) return;
    vk_exec_oq_pass_end(ex);
    vkCmdEndRendering(ex->cb);
    ex->recorded++;
    ex->in_pass = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ex->pass_ncolor && i < 8; i++)   // stand-ins of 3D BC targets go to their textures
        if (ex->color[i].image && ex->color[i].img && ex->color[i].img->image != ex->color[i].image)
            bc_copy_back(ex, &ex->color[i]);
    if (vk_dump_armed) vk_dump_pass_end(ex);
    uint64_t stamp = __atomic_load_n(&gfx_counters.frames, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        if (ex->color[i].image) vk_texture_gpu_written(ex->color[i].tex), tfr_note(&ex->color[i], stamp);
    if (ex->depth.image) vk_texture_gpu_written(ex->depth.tex), tfr_note(&ex->depth, stamp);
}

VkCommandBuffer vk_exec_inline_begin(int *reopen) {
    VkExec *ex = &X;
    *reopen = 0;
    if (!x_here || !ex->cb) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    *reopen = ex->in_pass;
    vk_exec_barrier(ex);   // ends the pass; feedback-layout targets go back to GENERAL
    return ex->cb;
}

void vk_exec_inline_end(int reopen) {
    X.recorded++;
    if (reopen) vk_exec_pass_begin(&X);
}

typedef struct { VkBuffer b; VmaAllocation a; } InlineBuf;
static void free_inline_buf(void *arg) {   // completion thread
    InlineBuf *t = arg;
    vmaDestroyBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, t->b, t->a);
    free(t);
}

VkBuffer vk_exec_inline_buffer(VkDeviceSize size) {
    InlineBuf *t = calloc(1, sizeof *t);
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = size,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT,
                             .sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (!t || vmaCreateBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, &bi, &ai, &t->b, &t->a, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) { free(t); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    vk_completion_add(X.fence, free_inline_buf, t);
    return t->b;
}

VkRect2D vk_exec_scissor(const VkExec *ex) {
    int64_t w = ex->pass_w, h = ex->pass_h;
    if (!ex->has_scissor) return (VkRect2D){{0, 0}, {(uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h}};
    int64_t x0 = ex->scissor.x, y0 = ex->scissor.y;
    int64_t x1 = x0 + ex->scissor.w, y1 = y0 + ex->scissor.h;
    if (x0 < 0) x0 = 0;
    if (y0 < 0) y0 = 0;
    if (x1 > w) x1 = w;
    if (y1 > h) y1 = h;
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return (VkRect2D){{0, 0}, {0, 0}};
    return (VkRect2D){{(int32_t)x0, (int32_t)y0}, {(uint32_t)(x1 - x0), (uint32_t)(y1 - y0)}};
}

// ---- clears

// Outside a pass, a clear of a whole target (no narrower scissor, the target as large as the render area) clears the
// image directly instead of opening a pass for it.
static int whole_target(const VkExec *ex, const VkExecTarget *t) {
    // vkCmdClear*Image addresses a 3D level whole, not one depth plane: slices of a 3D target clear in a pass; it
    // cannot clear a compressed image: views of BC blocks clear in a pass too
    if (ex->in_pass || t->is3d || t->blocks || t->width != ex->pass_w || t->height != ex->pass_h) return 0;
    if (!ex->has_scissor) return 1;
    const p_scissor *s = &ex->scissor;
    return s->x <= 0 && s->y <= 0 && (int64_t)s->x + s->w >= t->width && (int64_t)s->y + s->h >= t->height;
}

static void clear_attachment(VkExec *ex, const VkClearAttachment *a) {
    vk_exec_pass_begin(ex);
    VkClearRect cr = {vk_exec_scissor(ex), 0, ex->pass_layers};
    if (!cr.rect.extent.width || !cr.rect.extent.height) return;
    vkCmdClearAttachments(ex->cb, 1, a, 1, &cr);
    ex->recorded++;
    ex->fb_dirty |= a->aspectMask & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT ? 1u << a->colorAttachment : 0x100u;
}

static void clear_color(VkExec *ex, const p_clear_color *c) {
    vk_exec_frame.clears++;
    if (ex->render_disabled) return;
    resolve_rt(ex);
    int i = c->index;
    if (i < 0 || i >= (int)ex->pass_ncolor || !ex->color[i].image) {
        warn_once(W_CLEAR_TARGET, "colour clear of target %d, which is not bound or not renderable: skipped", i);
        return;
    }
    uint32_t mask = (uint32_t)c->mask & 0xf;
    if (!mask) return;
    if (mask != 0xf) {   // vkCmdClearAttachments ignores write masks; a masked clear needs a draw (vk_exec_draw.c)
        warn_once(W_CLEAR_MASK, "colour clear with channel mask %#x is not replayed: skipped", mask);
        return;
    }
    const VkExecTarget *t = &ex->color[i];
    VkClearColorValue cv;
    memcpy(cv.float32, c->rgba, sizeof cv.float32);   // integer targets: the payload's bits as the front end stored them
    if (whole_target(ex, t)) {
        vk_exec_barrier(ex);
        VkImageSubresourceRange r = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, t->level, 1, t->base_layer, t->layers};
        vkCmdClearColorImage(ex->cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &cv, 1, &r);
        ex->recorded++;
        vk_texture_gpu_written(t->tex);
        return;
    }
    VkClearAttachment a = {.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, .colorAttachment = (uint32_t)i};
    a.clearValue.color = cv;
    clear_attachment(ex, &a);
}

static void clear_ds(VkExec *ex, const p_clear_ds *c) {
    if (ex->render_disabled) return;
    resolve_rt(ex);
    const VkExecTarget *t = &ex->depth;
    if (!t->image) return;
    VkImageAspectFlags asp = 0;
    if (c->depth_mask && (t->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT)) asp |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT;
    uint32_t sm = (uint32_t)c->stencil_mask & 0xff;
    if (sm && (t->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT)) {
        if (sm == 0xff) asp |= VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
        else warn_once(W_STENCIL_MASK, "stencil clear with mask %#x is not replayed: skipped", sm);
    }
    if (!asp) return;
    float d = c->depth < 0.0f ? 0.0f : c->depth > 1.0f ? 1.0f : c->depth;
    VkClearDepthStencilValue v = {d, (uint32_t)c->stencil & 0xff};
    if (whole_target(ex, t)) {
        vk_exec_barrier(ex);
        VkImageSubresourceRange r = {asp, t->level, 1, t->base_layer, t->layers};
        vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(ex->cb, t->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL, &v, 1, &r);
        ex->recorded++;
        vk_texture_gpu_written(t->tex);
        return;
    }
    VkClearAttachment a = {.aspectMask = asp};
    a.clearValue.depthStencil = v;
    clear_attachment(ex, &a);
}

// ---- the op loop

static void set_rt(VkExec *ex, const p_set_rt *r) {
    if (!memcmp(&ex->rt, r, sizeof *r)) return;   // the same targets again: the pass goes on
    vk_exec_pass_end(ex);
    ex->rt = *r;
    ex->rt_resolved = 0;
}

// ---- command buffer parts
// NVN starts the GPU as soon as commands are submitted; one Vulkan command buffer per submission starts it only after
// the whole replay. Between passes, once TOTK_SPLIT_DRAWS (64; 0 off) draws and dispatches were recorded since the
// last part, the part goes to the queue (vk_sync_split) and the replay continues in a new command buffer. Only
// command-buffer state is lost there (bindings and dynamic state: vk_exec_draw_new_cb, ex->dirty); barriers, layouts and
// queries are not: a barrier's first scope is everything earlier in submission order, image layouts belong to the image,
// and occlusion queries end with their pass. Fences, completion callbacks and reports stay per submission: only the last
// part signals the value. nxnative commits every 64 draws between passes; MacNativeGames after 30, then every 40.
// A part also spans at least TOTK_SPLIT_US (1000) of replay time: a split costs about 40 us of the render thread
// (vkQueueSubmit2, a command buffer, the mirror prologue), and a fight frame of 2,000 draws made 15 parts on the 7900X;
// a millisecond of recording is a fraction of a millisecond of GPU work, so the GPU still starts early.
static int split_n = -1, split_draws, part_start;
static uint64_t split_ns, part_t0;
static uint64_t n_parts, n_subs;

static void maybe_split(VkExec *ex) {
    if (split_n < 0) {
        split_n = cfg_int("TOTK_SPLIT_DRAWS");
        if (split_n < 0) split_n = 0;
        int us = cfg_int("TOTK_SPLIT_US");
        split_ns = us > 0 ? (uint64_t)us * 1000 : 0;
        rt_log("vk: replay command buffer split every %d draws between passes, parts of at least %d us%s", split_n,
               us > 0 ? us : 0, split_n ? "" : " (off)");
    }
    if (!split_n || ex->in_pass || split_draws < split_n) return;
    if (split_ns && kern_now_ns() - part_t0 < split_ns) return;   // split_draws stays: the next draw asks again
    split_draws = 0;
    if (ex->recorded == part_start) return;
    ex->cb = vk_sync_split();
    part_start = ex->recorded;
    part_t0 = kern_now_ns();
    ex->dirty = VK_EXEC_DIRTY_ALL;
    vk_exec_draw_new_cb();
    n_parts++;
}

static void walk(VkExec *ex, const op_hdr *h, int depth) {
    for (;;) {
        if (h->size < sizeof *h || (h->size & 7) || h->op >= OP_COUNT_)
            rt_fatal("vk: corrupt command record at %p: op %u size %u", (const void *)h, h->op, h->size);
        const void *a = nvn_op_payload(h);
        switch (h->op) {
        case OP_END: return;
        case OP_BEGIN: break;
        case OP_JUMP: h = (const op_hdr *)(uintptr_t)((const p_jump *)a)->target; continue;
        case OP_CALL:
            if (depth >= CALL_DEPTH) rt_fatal("vk: command buffer calls nested deeper than %d", CALL_DEPTH);
            walk(ex, nvn_op_first(((const p_jump *)a)->target), depth + 1);
            break;
        case OP_SET_RT: set_rt(ex, a); break;
        case OP_CLEAR_COLOR: clear_color(ex, a); break;
        case OP_CLEAR_DS: clear_ds(ex, a); break;
        case OP_VIEWPORTS: {
            const p_viewports *v = a;
            for (int i = 0; i < v->n && v->first + i < 16; i++)
                if (v->first + i >= 0) memcpy(ex->vp[v->first + i], v->v[i], sizeof ex->vp[0]);
            ex->has_vp = 1;
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_VIEWPORT;
            break;
        }
        case OP_SCISSOR:
            ex->scissor = *(const p_scissor *)a;
            ex->has_scissor = 1;
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_SCISSOR;
            break;
        case OP_DEPTH_RANGE: {
            const p_depth_range *r = a;
            ex->depth_range[0] = r->n, ex->depth_range[1] = r->f;
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_VIEWPORT;
            break;
        }
        case OP_STENCIL: {
            const p_stencil *s = a;
            for (int f = 0; f < 2; f++) {
                if (!(s->face & (1 << f))) continue;
                if (s->which == 0) ex->st_vmask[f] = (uint32_t)s->value_mask;
                else if (s->which == 1) ex->st_wmask[f] = (uint32_t)s->mask;
                else ex->st_ref[f] = (uint32_t)s->ref;
            }
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_STENCIL;
            break;
        }
        case OP_POLY_OFFSET:
            ex->poly_offset = *(const p_poly_offset *)a;
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_DEPTH_BIAS;
            break;
        case OP_BLEND_COLOR:
            memcpy(ex->blend_color, ((const p_blend_color *)a)->rgba, sizeof ex->blend_color);
            ex->dirty |= VK_EXEC_DIRTY_BLEND_CONST;
            break;
        case OP_DEPTH_CLAMP: ex->pipe.depth_clamp = ((const p_flag *)a)->value != 0; break;
        case OP_RASTER_DISCARD: ex->pipe.raster_discard = ((const p_flag *)a)->value != 0; break;
        case OP_PRIM_RESTART: ex->prim_restart = *(const p_prim_restart *)a; break;
        case OP_COPY_STRIDE: ex->copy_stride = ((const p_copy_stride *)a)->stride; break;
        case OP_SET_TEX_POOL: ex->tex_pool = ((const p_set_pool *)a)->pool, ex->tex_serial++; break;
        case OP_SET_SAMP_POOL: ex->samp_pool = ((const p_set_pool *)a)->pool; break;
        case OP_BARRIER: vk_exec_barrier(ex); break;
        case OP_DRAW: case OP_DRAW_IDX: case OP_DISPATCH: case OP_UPDATE_UB: case OP_DRAW_IDX_IND: case OP_DISPATCH_IND:
            if (h->op == OP_DRAW || h->op == OP_DRAW_IDX || h->op == OP_DRAW_IDX_IND) vk_exec_frame.draws_seen++, split_draws++;
            if (h->op == OP_DISPATCH || h->op == OP_DISPATCH_IND) vk_exec_frame.dispatches++, split_draws++;
        case OP_BIND_PROGRAM: case OP_BIND_STATE: case OP_BIND_VATTR: case OP_BIND_VSTREAM: case OP_BIND_VBUF:
        case OP_BIND_UBO: case OP_BIND_SSBO: case OP_BIND_TEX: case OP_BIND_SAMP: case OP_BIND_IMG:
            vk_exec_op_draw(ex, h->op, a);
            break;
        case OP_COPY_B2B: case OP_COPY_B2T: case OP_COPY_T2B: case OP_COPY_T2T: case OP_CLEAR_TEX:
            if (h->op != OP_CLEAR_TEX) vk_exec_frame.copies++;
            if (vk_dump_armed) vk_dump_copy(ex, h->op, a);
            // fall through
        case OP_SIGNAL_EVENT: case OP_REPORT_COUNTER: case OP_RESET_COUNTER: case OP_RENDER_ENABLE: case OP_RENDER_COND:
        case OP_CLEAR_BUF:
            vk_exec_op_xfer(ex, h->op, a);
            break;
        default: rt_fatal("vk: op %s has no replay handler", nvn_op_name(h->op));
        }
        if (split_draws >= split_n) maybe_split(ex);
        h = nvn_op_next(h);
    }
}

int vk_exec_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, const uint64_t *handles, int n, uint64_t fence) {
    VkExec *ex = &X;
    if (!x_ready) state_reset(ex), vk_dump_init(), x_ready = 1;
    ex->cb = cb;
    ex->fence = fence;
    ex->recorded = 0;
    ex->in_pass = 0;
    ex->dirty = VK_EXEC_DIRTY_ALL;
    ex->rt_resolved = 0;   // images may have changed since the last command buffer
    ex->nviews = 0;
    ex->barrier_at = -1;
    ex->nfbl = 0;   // the previous command buffer ended with a full barrier: every image is in GENERAL
    vk_exec_frame.submits++;
    split_draws = part_start = 0;
    part_t0 = kern_now_ns();
    x_here = 1;
    if (n) vk_mem_mirror_begin(), vk_usnap_begin(handles, n, fence);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!handles[i]) rt_fatal("vk: command handle %d of a submission is null", i);
        walk(ex, nvn_op_first(handles[i]), 0);
    }
    vk_exec_pass_end(ex);
    x_here = 0;
    if (ex->recorded) vk_exec_barrier(ex);   // later submissions see this one's writes
    if (n) ex->recorded += vk_mem_mirror_end(ex->cb, fence), vk_usnap_end(fence);   // VRAM mirror bytes the GPU wrote go back to guest memory
    if (ex->nviews) {
        ViewList *l = malloc(sizeof *l + sizeof(VkImageView) * (size_t)ex->nviews);
        if (!l) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
        l->n = ex->nviews;
        for (int i = 0; i < ex->nviews; i++) l->v[i] = ((ViewEnt *)ex->views)[i].view;
        vk_completion_add(fence, free_views, l);
        ex->nviews = 0;
    }
    ex->cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (n) n_subs++;
    if ((rt_trace & RT_TRACE_PERF) && n_subs >= 240) {
        rt_log("perf: replay command buffer parts per submission %.2f", (double)(n_subs + n_parts) / (double)n_subs);
        n_subs = n_parts = 0;
    }
    return ex->recorded - part_start;   // what the last part holds
}

```

`runtime/vk_exec.h`:

```h
// The op-stream replay of the Vulkan back end. vk_exec.c walks the command
// handles of a submission, keeps render targets, passes, clears and fixed-function state; draws, binds and dispatches
// (vk_exec_draw.c) and copies, counters, events and conditional rendering (vk_exec_xfer.c) plug in through the two
// hooks at the bottom.
// Runs on the submitting thread under vk_sync_submit's lock: no locking inside.
// The op loop follows MacNativeGames nvn_mtl.m (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou) and the pass handling LAS Recomp
// (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai); vk_exec.c names the sources.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "vk.h"

// Dynamic state the next draw must record (VkExec.dirty). vk_exec_record sets them all at the start of each command
// buffer; the state ops set theirs; vk_exec_draw.c clears what it recorded.
enum {
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_VIEWPORT = 1 << 0,     // viewports or depth range
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_SCISSOR = 1 << 1,
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_DEPTH_BIAS = 1 << 2,   // polygon offset
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_BLEND_CONST = 1 << 3,
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_STENCIL = 1 << 4,      // compare and write masks, references
    VK_EXEC_DIRTY_ALL = (1 << 5) - 1,
};

// One render target of OP_SET_RT, resolved to its vk_texture.c image for the current command buffer.
typedef struct {
    const tex_t *tex;                    // payload copy (lives for the run); NULL: no target in this slot
    VkImage image;                       // VK_NULL_HANDLE: no target or not renderable (logged once)
    VkFormat format;                     // view format: the view's when it reinterprets a same-size format
    VkImageViewType view_type;           // 2D, or 2D_ARRAY for more than one layer
    VkImageAspectFlags aspect;
    uint32_t level, base_layer, layers;  // subresource of the view; of a 3D image: depth planes
    uint8_t is3d;                        // a 3D image (colour only), viewed through 2D views of its slices
    uint8_t blocks;                      // a BC image viewed as one texel per block (VkTexImage.block_views)
    uint32_t width, height, samples;     // extent of that level; with blocks, in blocks
    int32_t nvn_format;                  // NVNformat of the view (VkPipeState.color_fmt / depth_fmt)
    const VkTexImage *img;               // the image (fb_usage, fb_learned)
} VkExecTarget;

// The replay state. One instance lives for the run: NVN state is queue state and carries over from one submission to
// the next, as in MacNativeGames' and LAS Recomp's replays. The "per command buffer" fields are reset by vk_exec_record.
typedef struct VkExec {
    // ---- per command buffer
    VkCommandBuffer cb;                  // being recorded
    uint64_t fence;                      // timeline value the submission signals (vk_completion_add)
    int recorded;                        // Vulkan commands recorded so far; every handler adds the ones it records
    int in_pass;                         // inside vkCmdBeginRendering
    uint32_t dirty;                      // VK_EXEC_DIRTY_*

    // ---- render targets (OP_SET_RT) and the current pass
    p_set_rt rt;                         // last OP_SET_RT payload (a change ends the open pass); rt.n 0, no depth: none
    int rt_resolved;                   // color[] and depth hold this command buffer's images for rt
    VkExecTarget color[8], depth;        // resolved targets
    uint32_t pass_w, pass_h, pass_layers;            // render area and layer count of the open (or next) pass
    int pass_noatt;                                   // the pass has no attachment: its size follows the draws (vk_exec_noatt_dims)
    VkFormat pass_color[8], pass_depth, pass_stencil; // attachment formats of the pass (VkPipelineRenderingCreateInfo);
                                                      // VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED: none
    uint32_t pass_ncolor, pass_samples;               // colorAttachmentCount and rasterization samples of the pass

    // ---- fixed-function state (vk_exec.c keeps it; vk_exec_draw.c records it before draws)
    float vp[16][6];                     // OP_VIEWPORTS: x, y, w, h, near, far
    int has_vp;                          // a viewport was set; else the render area
    p_scissor scissor;                   // OP_SCISSOR (scissor 0)
    int has_scissor;                     // a scissor was set; else unbounded
    float depth_range[2];                // OP_DEPTH_RANGE: overrides the viewports' near and far
    uint32_t st_vmask[2], st_wmask[2], st_ref[2];   // OP_STENCIL per face (0 front, 1 back): compare mask, write mask, ref
    float point_size;                    // OP_BIND_STATE kind 6: NVN point size for the support buffer; 0 = never set = 1
    p_poly_offset poly_offset;           // OP_POLY_OFFSET: depth bias factor, units, clamp
    p_prim_restart prim_restart;         // OP_PRIM_RESTART: applied to indexed strip and fan draws (op_draw_idx)
    float blend_color[4];                // OP_BLEND_COLOR
    int64_t copy_stride;                 // OP_COPY_STRIDE: row stride of buffer <-> texture copies (vk_exec_xfer.c)
    const dpool_t *tex_pool, *samp_pool; // OP_SET_TEX_POOL, OP_SET_SAMP_POOL
    // Pipeline inputs. vk_exec.c writes depth_clamp (OP_DEPTH_CLAMP), raster_discard (OP_RASTER_DISCARD) and, at pass
    // begin, color_fmt, depth_fmt and samples; vk_exec_draw.c owns every other field (shaders, prim, y_flip, state
    // objects, vertex input).
    VkPipeState pipe;

    // ---- vk_exec_draw.c slots (draws, binds, dispatch): left empty by vk_exec.c
    const prog_t *prog;                  // OP_BIND_PROGRAM
    int32_t prog_stages;
    NVNbufferRange vbuf[16];             // OP_BIND_VBUF
    p_bind_buf ubo[6][18], ssbo[6][16];  // OP_BIND_UBO / OP_BIND_SSBO per stage and index
    uint64_t tex[6][128], samp[6][128], img[6][32];   // OP_BIND_TEX / OP_BIND_SAMP / OP_BIND_IMG handles per stage

    // ---- vk_exec_xfer.c slots (render enable, conditional rendering): left empty by vk_exec.c
    int render_disabled;                 // OP_RENDER_ENABLE false or a failed OP_RENDER_COND: clears and draws skip
    p_render_cond render_cond;           // last OP_RENDER_COND
    int has_render_cond;

    // ---- internal to vk_exec.c
    void *views;                         // image views created for this command buffer (freed at its fence)
    int nviews, cap_views;
    int barrier_at;                      // recorded right after the last full barrier (-1: none yet)

    // Feedback loops (vk.h VkCtx.feedback, vk_exec_draw.c feedback_prepare). Learned targets are attached in
    // ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT; they stay in it across consecutive passes and go back to GENERAL at the next
    // full barrier that is not a pass begin.
    VkImage fbl_img[9];                  // images in the feedback layout now
    VkImageAspectFlags fbl_aspect[9];
    int nfbl;
    uint32_t fbl_mask;                   // attachments of the open pass in that layout: bit i colour i, bit 8 depth
    uint32_t fb_dirty;                   // attachments of the open pass written by a draw or clear since the pass began
                                         // or the last in-pass barrier
    const void *fb_fs;                   // feedback_scan's memo: fragment shader, texture bind serial, pass serial
    uint32_t fb_serial, fb_pass, fb_sampled;
    uint32_t tex_serial, pass_serial;    // bumped by every texture or image bind and pass begin
} VkExec;

// Begins dynamic rendering with the current targets unless a pass is open (a full memory barrier precedes it). Call
// before a draw or an attachment clear.
void vk_exec_pass_begin(VkExec *ex);
// Ends the open pass (no-op without one) and marks its targets GPU-written. Call before copies and dispatches.
void vk_exec_pass_end(VkExec *ex);
// Full memory barrier (all commands, all memory); ends the open pass first. Copies and dispatches order themselves with
// it. Skipped when nothing was recorded since the last one.
void vk_exec_barrier(VkExec *ex);
// vk_texture.c (TOTK_TEX_ALIAS): commands that must run at the replay's current position. vk_exec_inline_begin returns
// the command buffer being recorded after a full barrier (an open pass is ended; *reopen says so), or VK_NULL_HANDLE
// when this thread is not recording a replay. vk_exec_inline_end begins the pass again when it was open.
// vk_exec_inline_buffer: a device buffer for transfers, destroyed when the submission completes.
VkCommandBuffer vk_exec_inline_begin(int *reopen);
void vk_exec_inline_end(int reopen);
// vk_exec_draw.c: forget what the command buffer being recorded has bound (pipeline, sets, dynamic state, vertex
// buffers): the replay continues in a new one (vk_sync_split).
void vk_exec_draw_new_cb(void);
VkBuffer vk_exec_inline_buffer(VkDeviceSize size);
// vk_exec.c: the stand-in a 3D BC render target is drawn through goes with its image (vk_exec_image_gone).
void vk_exec_bc_gone(VkImage image);
// Scissor 0 clipped to the render area of the open pass; extent 0: nothing to draw.
VkRect2D vk_exec_scissor(const VkExec *ex);
void vk_exec_noatt_dims(const VkExec *ex, uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h);   // pass size when no attachment is set
// 1: every target of the current pass (any 1: at least one) was rendered in the previous presented frame (per-frame
// targets); 0 otherwise, or when the pass has none.
int vk_exec_targets_recent(VkExec *ex, int any);
// The current pass's targets with their formats, extents and the frames they were last rendered in (diagnostics).
void vk_exec_targets_describe(VkExec *ex, char *buf, size_t cap);

// TOTK_TRACE=gfx: replay counters of the current frame, logged and reset at each present (vk_exec_frame_log).
typedef struct {
    uint64_t passes, draws_seen, draws, clears, copies, dispatches, submits;
    uint64_t fb_draws, fb_barriers, fb_restarts, fb_layouts;   // feedback loops: draws sampling a written target of
                                                               // their pass, in-pass barriers, pass restarts, layout
                                                               // transitions
} VkExecFrame;
extern VkExecFrame vk_exec_frame;
void vk_exec_frame_written(const tex_t *t);                    // vk_texture_gpu_written: t rendered or copied into
uint64_t vk_exec_recording_fence(void);                        // fence of the submission this thread records, else 0
void vk_exec_frame_log(const tex_t *presented, uint64_t frame);

// TOTK_DUMP=<frame> (vk_dump.c): between presents frame-1 and frame, every pass's targets and every dispatch's storage
// images are copied out and written as PNGs to TOTK_DUMP_DIR (default "dump"), with passes.txt (targets, pipelines,
// textures, samplers) and images.txt (per image value statistics). The hooks run only when vk_dump_armed is set.
extern int vk_dump_armed;
void vk_dump_init(void);                 // reads the environment; vk_exec_record's first call
void vk_dump_pass_end(VkExec *ex);       // after vkCmdEndRendering
void vk_dump_draw(VkExec *ex, const VkPipeState *s, VkPipeline p, const VkPipeInfo *info);   // after a draw's binds
void vk_dump_dispatch(VkExec *ex, const GfxShader *cs, VkPipeline p, const VkPipeInfo *info, const p_dispatch *d);
void vk_dump_copy(VkExec *ex, uint32_t op, const void *payload);   // before a copy or texture clear is replayed
void vk_dump_present(uint64_t frame);    // vk_be_present: waits for the dump frame's copies and closes the logs

// c0, the NVN driver constant bank of one stage (vk_exec_draw.c; TOTK_FIX_C0=0 binds zeros instead): bank is
// VK_C0_BYTES, stage an NVN stage (0 vertex, 1 fragment, 5 compute), ssbo and ubo the 16 bound slots of that stage.
#define VK_C0_BYTES 0x800u
void vk_c0_fill(uint8_t bank[VK_C0_BYTES], int stage, const p_bind_buf ssbo[16], const p_bind_buf ubo[16],
                const uint32_t dispatch[3], uint32_t base_instance);

// Handler hooks. vk_exec.c defines both WEAK: they stop with rt_fatal naming the op.
// vk_exec_draw.c: OP_DRAW, OP_DRAW_IDX, OP_DISPATCH, OP_BIND_* (program, state, vattr, vstream, vbuf, ubo, ssbo, tex,
// samp, img), OP_UPDATE_UB, OP_DRAW_IDX_IND, OP_DISPATCH_IND. payload: nvn_op_payload of the record.
void vk_exec_op_draw(VkExec *ex, uint32_t op, const void *payload);
// The aspect a sampled view of img reads (vk_exec_draw.c get_view): stencil for a view in STENCIL depth-stencil mode.
VkImageAspectFlags vk_exec_view_aspect(const VkTexImage *img, const view_t *v, int hv);
VkImageView vk_exec_target_view(const VkTexImage *img, VkFormat format, VkImageViewType type, uint32_t aspect,
                                uint32_t level, uint32_t base, uint32_t layers, int blocks);   // kept for the image's life
// vk_exec_xfer.c: OP_COPY_B2B, OP_COPY_B2T, OP_COPY_T2B, OP_COPY_T2T, OP_CLEAR_TEX, OP_SIGNAL_EVENT, OP_REPORT_COUNTER,
// OP_RESET_COUNTER, OP_RENDER_ENABLE, OP_RENDER_COND, OP_CLEAR_BUF.
void vk_exec_op_xfer(VkExec *ex, uint32_t op, const void *payload);
// vk_exec_xfer.c, samples-passed counting: a draw about to be recorded in the open pass (begins an occlusion query
// when counting and none is active), and the open pass about to end (ends the active query).
void vk_exec_oq_draw(VkExec *ex);
void vk_exec_oq_pass_end(VkExec *ex);

```

`runtime/vk_exec_draw.c`:

```c
// Draws, binds and dispatches of the Vulkan op-stream replay: the strong
// vk_exec_op_draw behind vk_exec.c's weak hook. The bind ops fill the VkExec slots; a draw opens the pass, resolves the
// bound program to translated shaders (the translator's answers come from the bound state), asks vk_pipeline.c for the
// pipeline, pushes (or allocates) set 0 as VkPipeInfo.bindings says and records the dynamic state, vertex and index
// buffers and the draw. A dispatch ends the pass and does the same for the compute shader. UPDATE_UB is a buffer copy
// from transient memory between full barriers.
//
// Per command buffer the replay keeps transient memory (support buffers, copied uniform ranges, generated indices),
// descriptor pools, image views and the storage-buffer ranges the GPU may write; all of it is freed, and the ranges are
// reported with vk_guest_written, from one completion callback once the submission's fence is done (the write watch
// does not see GPU writes). Nothing here locks: it runs on the submitting thread under vk_sync_submit's lock.
//
// Provenance: the op semantics (bind ops, program and slot conventions, draw and dispatch flow, vertex streams with a
// zeroed buffer for unbound ones) follow MacNativeGames games/totk/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_mtl.m:7409-7460,
// 9365-9488, 9489-9921, 10013-10079 @ b75be8cf (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 jhaizhou); the uniform-buffer spans, texture and
// sampler descriptor lookups and the dispatch flow follow LAS Recomp runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c:1851-1908, 2300-2516
// @ da35b83a (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai). The support buffer layout is Ryujinx's SupportBuffer.cs (MIT).
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "cfg.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "nvn_api.h"
#include "nvn_hmap.h"
#include "vk.h"
#include "vk_exec.h"

#define MAX_BINDINGS 128
#define MAX_DESC 1024
#define CHUNK_BYTES (4u << 20)
#define ZERO_BYTES 65536u
#define SUPPORT_BYTES 1408u   // Ryujinx SupportBuffer (std140): alpha_test, is_bgra[8], viewport_inverse, viewport_size, ...
#define NVN_STAGE_VS 0
#define NVN_STAGE_FS 1
#define NVN_STAGE_CS 5
#define ONESHOT_WAIT_MS 30000u   // prepare_draw: how long a one-shot draw waits for its pipeline before it is skipped

enum { W_PROGRAM, W_SHADER, W_PIPELINE, W_NO_VS, W_INDEX, W_UB, W_BIND, W_SSBO_ALIGN, W_SSBO_SLOT, W_RESTART, W_INDIRECT, W_COUNT };

static void warn_once(int key, const char *fmt, ...) {
    static volatile long seen[W_COUNT];
    if (__atomic_exchange_n(&seen[key], 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED)) return;
    char msg[256];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(msg, sizeof msg, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    rt_log("vk: %s (logged once)", msg);
}

static void *grow(void *p, int *cap, size_t elem) {
    *cap = *cap ? *cap * 2 : 8;
    p = realloc(p, elem * (size_t)*cap);
    if (!p) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
    return p;
}

// ---- resources of one command buffer, freed by its completion callback

typedef struct { VkBuffer buf; VmaAllocation alloc; uint8_t *map; uint64_t size, used; } Chunk;
typedef struct {
    VkImage image;
    VkFormat format;
    VkImageViewType type;
    uint32_t aspect, level0, levels, layer0, layers, swz;
} ViewKey;
_Static_assert(sizeof(ViewKey) == 40, "ViewKey is hashed as bytes: no padding");
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; } Range;
typedef struct {
    Chunk *chunks;
    int nchunks, cchunks;
    VkDescriptorPool *pools;
    int npools, cpools;
    Range *written;
    int nwritten, cwritten;
} CbRes;

static CbRes *cur;
static uint64_t cur_fence;

// Descriptor pools and full-size transient chunks go back to these lists when their command buffer completes, instead
// of being destroyed and created again for the next one: each creation is a driver memory allocation (on Windows an
// allocation, a map and a paging-fence wait on the CPU), about ten of them per frame inside the replay.
#define SPARE_POOLS 64
#define SPARE_CHUNKS 16
static SRWLOCK spare_lock = SRWLOCK_INIT;
static VkDescriptorPool spare_pool[SPARE_POOLS];
static Chunk spare_chunk[SPARE_CHUNKS];
static int nspare_pool, nspare_chunk;

// State of the command buffer being recorded that the Vulkan command buffer itself holds.
static struct {
    VkPipeline pipe[2];                  // bound per bind point: 0 graphics, 1 compute
    VkPipeState st;                      // the state vk_pipeline_set_dynamic last recorded
    int st_valid;
    VkBuffer vb[17];                     // vertex buffers last bound
    VkDeviceSize vo[17], vsz[17], vstr[17];
    int vcls[17];                        // their pool class and pool record, for the census
    void *vpool[17];
    NVNbufferRange vin[16];              // the ranges they were resolved from, under vk_mem_gen vgen
    uint64_t vgen;
    int vb_valid;
    uint8_t support[SUPPORT_BYTES];      // last support buffer and where it lives
    float sup_in[3];                     // the support_fill arguments it was filled from
    VkBuffer sup_buf;
    VkDeviceSize sup_off;
    int sup_valid;
    uint8_t c0[3][VK_C0_BYTES];          // last c0 bank per stage (vertex, fragment, compute) and where it lives
    VkBuffer c0_buf[3];
    VkDeviceSize c0_off[3];
    int c0_valid[3];
    struct { p_bind_buf ssbo[16], ubo[16]; uint32_t dim[3], binst; } c0_in[3];   // what vk_c0_fill read for c0[k]
    VkPipelineLayout ds_layout;          // graphics layout the sets below were last pushed or bound with
    VkDescriptorSet ds_bound[2];         // allocated set bound per set number (0: none or pushed since)
    VkDescriptorSet ds_last[2];          // last allocated and written set per set number, contents in DS
    VkDescriptorSetLayout ds_last_layout[2];
    int ds_pushed[2];                    // set number holds the push of DS.psig under ds_layout
    int res_valid;                       // the graphics sets bound hold what the inputs in RS give (bind_resources)
} B;

// Contents of B.ds_last: the set's packed descriptors (VkDescSlot), which with its layout determine every write. A draw
// whose allocated set would hold the same reuses the set instead of allocating and writing one (a per-draw
// cost). psig: the same for the last push per set number; a push equal to it under the same layout is not recorded
// again (the descriptors stay bound across pipeline binds of that layout).
#define DS_SIG_BYTES (MAX_DESC * sizeof(VkDescSlot))
static struct { uint32_t n[2], pn[2]; uint8_t sig[2][DS_SIG_BYTES], psig[2][DS_SIG_BYTES]; } DS;

// TOTK_BIND_STATS counters (bind_stats).
static struct {
    int on;
    uint64_t draws, bind[2], desc[2], push, push_skip, set_new, set_reuse, ac_miss, same_prog, same_all, bind_skip;
} BS = {-1};

// The inputs of the last graphics bind_resources (bind_sig) and what its build counted for the traffic census, which a
// skipped build counts again. RS_BYTES bounds the bound-slot bytes a pipeline reads (RsList): per binding at most one
// c0 storage table, otherwise one bound range or handle per descriptor.
#define RS_BYTES (MAX_BINDINGS * sizeof(((VkExec *)0)->ssbo[0]) + MAX_DESC * sizeof(p_bind_buf))
typedef struct { int cls, use; uint64_t bytes; } RsCount;
static struct {
    int on;                              // TOTK_BIND_SKIP: 1 skip (default), 2 check, 0 off
    uint32_t hn;                         // words of h the last signature filled; 0: none
    uint64_t h[24];                      // generations, feedback images, support inputs, base instance
    const VkPipeInfo *info;              // the pipeline whose RsList ranges body holds, as of bind op generation gen
    uint64_t gen;
    uint8_t body[RS_BYTES];
    int rec;                             // a graphics build is running: count_use records, scratch copies mark volatile
    int volatile_;                       // the build copied guest bytes into transient memory: a rebuild differs
    RsCount cnt[2 * VK_MCLS_N], pcnt[2 * VK_MCLS_N];
    int ncnt, pncnt, cnt_over;
    int cmds;                            // check mode: pushes, binds and set writes the build recorded
    uint32_t ckn;                        // check mode: the last build's packed descriptors (bytes in ck)
    uint8_t ck[DS_SIG_BYTES];
} RS = {-1};

// The bound-slot bytes of VkExec a pipeline's descriptors read, as ranges merged where they touch, built once per
// pipeline info: c0's storage table, the uniform and storage ranges of the bound slots and the texture and image
// handles. sup and c0: the support inputs and the base instance count too. p: storage buffers whose address the shader
// loads from a user uniform block; the address read from the block counts too. ok 0: never skipped (too many
// descriptors or such buffers).
#define RS_PTRS 4
typedef struct { uint32_t off, len; } RsRange;
typedef struct { int st; const GfxShaderRes *res; } RsPtr;
typedef struct { uint32_t n, bytes; uint8_t sup, c0, ok, np; RsPtr p[RS_PTRS]; RsRange r[]; } RsList;
static nvn_hmap rs_lists;                // VkPipeInfo pointer -> RsList, until shutdown
static const VkPipeInfo *rs_last;        // the last lookup
static const RsList *rs_last_l;

static uint32_t c0_dim[3], c0_binst;     // the dispatch size and base instance of the draw or dispatch being bound
static uint64_t bind_gen = 1;            // bumped by every bind op that writes ex->prog, ubo, ssbo, tex or img

static void cb_done(void *arg) {   // completion thread
    CbRes *r = arg;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    for (int i = 0; i < r->nwritten; i++) vk_guest_written(r->written[i].addr, r->written[i].size);
    for (int i = 0; i < r->npools; i++) {
        vkResetDescriptorPool(c->device, r->pools[i], 0);
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
        int kept = nspare_pool < SPARE_POOLS;
        if (kept) spare_pool[nspare_pool++] = r->pools[i];
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
        if (!kept) vkDestroyDescriptorPool(c->device, r->pools[i], NULL);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < r->nchunks; i++) {
        AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
        int kept = r->chunks[i].size == CHUNK_BYTES && nspare_chunk < SPARE_CHUNKS;
        if (kept) spare_chunk[nspare_chunk++] = r->chunks[i];
        ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
        if (!kept) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, r->chunks[i].buf, r->chunks[i].alloc);
    }
    free(r->written), free(r->pools), free(r->chunks), free(r);
}

void vk_exec_draw_new_cb(void) { memset(&B, 0, sizeof B); }

static CbRes *cb_res(VkExec *ex) {
    if (cur && cur_fence == ex->fence) return cur;
    cur = calloc(1, sizeof *cur);
    if (!cur) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
    cur_fence = ex->fence;
    memset(&B, 0, sizeof B);
    vk_completion_add(ex->fence, cb_done, cur);
    return cur;
}

static uint8_t *scratch(VkExec *ex, uint64_t size, VkBuffer *buf, VkDeviceSize *off) {
    CbRes *r = cb_res(ex);
    size = (size + 255) & ~255ull;
    Chunk *c = r->nchunks ? &r->chunks[r->nchunks - 1] : NULL;
    if (!c || c->used + size > c->size) {
        if (r->nchunks == r->cchunks) r->chunks = grow(r->chunks, &r->cchunks, sizeof *r->chunks);
        c = &r->chunks[r->nchunks];
        uint64_t n = size > CHUNK_BYTES ? size : CHUNK_BYTES;
        int reused = 0;
        if (n == CHUNK_BYTES) {
            AcquireSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
            if (nspare_chunk) *c = spare_chunk[--nspare_chunk], reused = 1;
            ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(&spare_lock);
        }
        if (reused) {
            c->used = 0;
            r->nchunks++;
            *buf = c->buf;
            *off = 0;
            c->used = size;
            return c->map;
        }
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = n,
                                 .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT |
                                          VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                                          VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT};
        VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                      .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
        VmaAllocationInfo info;
        VkResult res = vmaCreateBuffer(vk_ctx()->vma, &bi, &ai, &c->buf, &c->alloc, &info);
        if (res != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: transient buffer of %llu bytes failed (%d)", (unsigned long long)n, (int)res);
        c->map = info.pMappedData, c->size = n, c->used = 0;
        r->nchunks++;
    }
    *buf = c->buf;
    *off = c->used;
    uint8_t *p = c->map + c->used;
    c->used += size;
    return p;
}

static void note_written(VkExec *ex, uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    CbRes *r = cb_res(ex);
    for (int i = 0; i < r->nwritten; i++)
        if (r->written[i].addr == addr && r->written[i].size == size) return;
    if (r->nwritten == r->cwritten) r->written = grow(r->written, &r->cwritten, sizeof *r->written);
    r->written[r->nwritten++] = (Range){addr, size};
}

// ---- stand-ins for what a binding names but the game did not bind (zeros, a 1x1 image, the default sampler)

enum { DV_1D, DV_1D_ARRAY, DV_2D, DV_2D_ARRAY, DV_3D, DV_CUBE, DV_CUBE_ARRAY, DV_2D_MS, DV_2D_MS_ARRAY, DV_COUNT };

static struct {
    int ready;
    VkBuffer zbuf;
    VmaAllocation zalloc;
    VkBufferView zview;
    VkSampler samp, samp_shadow;
    struct { VkImage image; VmaAllocation alloc; VkImageView view, sview; } img[DV_COUNT];
} Z;

static const struct { VkImageType t; VkImageViewType vt; uint32_t layers; VkSampleCountFlagBits s; VkImageCreateFlags f; } dinfo[DV_COUNT] = {
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE, 6, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY, 6, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT, VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT, 0},
    {VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY, 1, VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_4_BIT, 0}};

// A 1x1 stand-in image of view type dinfo[i] in `fmt`, moved to GENERAL by the upload batch (which reaches the queue before
// the submission that uses it). *sview is the view a storage descriptor takes (a cube becomes a 2D array).
static void make_dummy(int i, VkFormat fmt, VkImage *image, VmaAllocation *alloc, VkImageView *view, VkImageView *sview) {
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    int ms = dinfo[i].s != VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO, .flags = dinfo[i].f, .imageType = dinfo[i].t,
                            .format = fmt, .extent = {1, 1, 1}, .mipLevels = 1, .arrayLayers = dinfo[i].layers,
                            .samples = dinfo[i].s, .tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL,
                            .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | (ms ? 0 : VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT),
                            .initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ia = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_DEVICE};
    if (vmaCreateImage(c->vma, &ii, &ia, image, alloc, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: stand-in image %d failed", i);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = *image,
                                .viewType = dinfo[i].vt, .format = fmt,
                                .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, dinfo[i].layers}};
    if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, view) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: stand-in view failed");
    *sview = *view;
    if (!ms && (dinfo[i].vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE || dinfo[i].vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY)) {
        vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
        if (vkCreateImageView(c->device, &vi, NULL, sview) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: stand-in view failed");
    }
    VkImageMemoryBarrier2 bar = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2,
                                 .dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                                 .dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT,
                                 .oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED, .newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL,
                                 .srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED, .dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
                                 .image = *image, .subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, dinfo[i].layers}};
    VkCommandBuffer cb = vk_upload_begin();
    VkDependencyInfo di = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO, .imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1, .pImageMemoryBarriers = &bar};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(cb, &di);
    vk_upload_end();
}

// Storage image stand-ins in the format a shader declares (GfxShaderRes.format: Ryujinx TextureFormat order); Vulkan wants
// the view format to match the declaration. Created on first use.
static const VkFormat tex_format[40] = {
    VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8_SNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R8_SINT,
    VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R16_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16_SNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R16_SINT,
    VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R32_SINT, VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SNORM,
    VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SINT, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM,
    VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SINT,
    VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT,
    VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_UINT,
    VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_UINT, VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SINT,
    VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32, VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UINT_PACK32, VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32};
static struct { int used, di; VkFormat fmt; VkImage image; VmaAllocation alloc; VkImageView view, sview; } SD[48];

static VkImageView storage_dummy(int di, int code) {
    VkFormat fmt = code > 0 && code < 40 ? tex_format[code] : VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    if (fmt == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM || dinfo[di].s != VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT) return Z.img[di].sview;
    for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
        if (!SD[i].used) {
            SD[i].used = 1, SD[i].di = di, SD[i].fmt = fmt;
            make_dummy(di, fmt, &SD[i].image, &SD[i].alloc, &SD[i].view, &SD[i].sview);
            return SD[i].sview;
        }
        if (SD[i].di == di && SD[i].fmt == fmt) return SD[i].sview;
    }
    return Z.img[di].sview;
}

static void dummies_init(void) {
    if (Z.ready) return;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO, .size = ZERO_BYTES,
                             .usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT |
                                      VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT |
                                      VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT};
    VmaAllocationCreateInfo ai = {.usage = VMA_MEMORY_USAGE_AUTO_PREFER_HOST,
                                  .flags = VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_HOST_ACCESS_RANDOM_BIT | VMA_ALLOCATION_CREATE_MAPPED_BIT};
    VmaAllocationInfo info;
    if (vmaCreateBuffer(c->vma, &bi, &ai, &Z.zbuf, &Z.zalloc, &info) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: zero buffer failed");
    memset(info.pMappedData, 0, ZERO_BYTES);
    VkBufferViewCreateInfo bv = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .buffer = Z.zbuf,
                                 .format = VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT, .range = ZERO_BYTES};
    if (vkCreateBufferView(c->device, &bv, NULL, &Z.zview) != VK_SUCCESS) rt_fatal("vk: zero buffer view failed");
    samp_par sp;
    memset(&sp, 0, sizeof sp);
    sp.lod_max = 1000.0f;
    Z.samp = vk_sampler_for(&sp);
    sp.cmp_mode = 1, sp.cmp_func = NVN_DEPTH_FUNC_ALWAYS;
    Z.samp_shadow = vk_sampler_for(&sp);

    for (int i = 0; i < DV_COUNT; i++)
        make_dummy(i, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, &Z.img[i].image, &Z.img[i].alloc, &Z.img[i].view, &Z.img[i].sview);
    Z.ready = 1;
}

static void twins_release(VkCtx *c);

// Releases the stand-ins and the depth twins. The device must be idle; the game path leaves them to process exit like
// the pipelines.
void vk_exec_draw_shutdown(void) {
    if (!Z.ready) return;
    VkCtx *c = vk_ctx();
    twins_release(c);
    for (int i = 0; i < DV_COUNT; i++) {
        if (Z.img[i].sview != Z.img[i].view) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, Z.img[i].sview, NULL);
        vkDestroyImageView(c->device, Z.img[i].view, NULL);
        vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, Z.img[i].image, Z.img[i].alloc);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 48 && SD[i].used; i++) {
        if (SD[i].sview != SD[i].view) vkDestroyImageView(c->device, SD[i].sview, NULL);
        vkDestroyImageView(c->device, SD[i].view, NULL);
        vmaDestroyImage(c->vma, SD[i].image, SD[i].alloc);
    }
    memset(SD, 0, sizeof SD);
    nvn_hm_clear(&rs_lists, free);
    rs_last = NULL, rs_last_l = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < nspare_pool; i++) vkDestroyDescriptorPool(c->device, spare_pool[i], NULL);
    for (int i = 0; i < nspare_chunk; i++) vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, spare_chunk[i].buf, spare_chunk[i].alloc);
    nspare_pool = nspare_chunk = 0;
    vk_usnap_shutdown();
    vkDestroyBufferView(c->device, Z.zview, NULL);
    vmaDestroyBuffer(c->vma, Z.zbuf, Z.zalloc);
    memset(&Z, 0, sizeof Z);
}

// ---- resource types

static VkImageViewType res_view_type(uint16_t t) {
    int arr = t & 0x100;
    switch (t & 0xff) {
    case 1: return arr ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D;
    case 4: return VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D;
    case 5: return arr ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE;
    default: return arr ? VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY : VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    }
}

static int dummy_index(VkImageViewType vt, int ms) {
    switch (vt) {
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D: return DV_1D;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY: return DV_1D_ARRAY;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D: return DV_3D;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE: return DV_CUBE;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY: return DV_CUBE_ARRAY;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY: return ms ? DV_2D_MS_ARRAY : DV_2D_ARRAY;
    default: return ms ? DV_2D_MS : DV_2D;
    }
}

// GFX_TEX_* of a bound texture slot (the translator's tex_type / img_type answers).
static int gfx_type_of(const VkTexImage *img, const view_t *v, int hv) {
    if (hv && v->set_target) return vk_pipeline_tex_type(v->target);
    int ms = img->samples > 1;
    switch (img->view_type) {
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D: return GFX_TEX_1D;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY: return GFX_TEX_1D_ARRAY;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY: return ms ? GFX_TEX_2D_MS_ARRAY : GFX_TEX_2D_ARRAY;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D: return GFX_TEX_3D;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE: return GFX_TEX_CUBE;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY: return GFX_TEX_CUBE_ARRAY;
    default: return ms ? GFX_TEX_2D_MS : GFX_TEX_2D;
    }
}

static VkComponentSwizzle swz_of(uint8_t s) {
    switch (s) {
    case NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_ZERO: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ZERO;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_ONE: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_ONE;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_R;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_G: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_G;
    case NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_B: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_B;
    default: return VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_A;
    }
}

// A view in STENCIL mode samples the stencil plane (TextureViewSetDepthStencilMode); otherwise depth wins. The
// translator declares every sampled image float and the shader takes the raw bits, as for integer formats (nxnative
// nvn_mtl.m).
VkImageAspectFlags vk_exec_view_aspect(const VkTexImage *img, const view_t *v, int hv) {
    if (hv && v->set_dsmode && v->dsmode == NVN_TEXTURE_DEPTH_STENCIL_MODE_STENCIL && (img->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT))
        return VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT;
    return img->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT     ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT
           : img->aspect & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT
                                                       : VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
}

// Image views of registered textures, kept for their image's lifetime: made per command buffer they were created again
// every frame (vkCreateImageView took about 8% of the fight replay on the 7900X). Used under the texture lock, as
// vk_exec_image_gone is (destroy_tex), which hands the views of a destroyed image to the deferred release with it.
typedef struct ViewNode { struct ViewNode *next; ViewKey k; VkImageView view; } ViewNode;
static nvn_hmap view_of;                 // ViewKey -> VkImageView
static nvn_hmap views_by_image;          // VkImage -> its first ViewNode

// An image view of a registered texture for a shader resource of type `rtype` (GfxShaderRes.type); VK_NULL_HANDLE when
// the image cannot serve it (the caller binds a stand-in). Texture lock held.
static VkImageView get_view(VkExec *ex, const VkTexImage *img, const view_t *v, int hv, uint16_t rtype, int storage) {
    VkImageViewType vt = res_view_type(rtype);
    int ms = (rtype & 0x200) != 0;
    if ((img->samples > 1) != ms || (storage && ms)) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (storage && !(img->usage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT)) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    int cube = vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE || vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY;
    int ok = 0;
    switch (vt) {
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D:
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY: ok = img->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_1D; break;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D: ok = img->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D; break;
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE:
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY:
        ok = img->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D && (img->view_type == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE || img->view_type == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY);
        break;
    default: ok = img->type == VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; break;
    }
    if (!ok) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t l0 = hv && v->set_levels ? v->base_level : 0;
    if (l0 >= img->levels) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    uint32_t nl = hv && v->set_levels && v->nlevels ? v->nlevels : img->levels - l0;
    if (l0 + nl > img->levels) nl = img->levels - l0;
    if (storage) nl = 1;
    uint32_t y0 = 0, ny = 1;
    if (vt != VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D) {
        y0 = hv && v->set_layers ? v->min_layer : 0;
        if (y0 >= img->layers) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        uint32_t rest = hv && v->set_layers && v->nlayers ? v->nlayers : img->layers - y0;
        if (y0 + rest > img->layers) rest = img->layers - y0;
        if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D || vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D) ny = 1;
        else if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE) ny = 6;
        else if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY) ny = rest / 6 * 6;
        else ny = rest;
        if (!ny || y0 + ny > img->layers) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (storage && cube) vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
    uint32_t aspect = vk_exec_view_aspect(img, v, hv);
    uint8_t sw[4] = {NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R, NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_G, NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_B, NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_A};
    if (!storage) {   // MNG nvn_mtl.m tex_swizzle_sel: view selectors replace the texture's, then the format remap
        memcpy(sw, hv && v->set_swizzle ? v->swz : img->swz, 4);
        if (img->alpha_one || img->chan[0])
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                if (img->alpha_one && sw[i] == NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_A) sw[i] = NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_ONE;
                else if (img->chan[0] && sw[i] >= NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R && sw[i] <= NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_A)
                    sw[i] = img->chan[sw[i] - NVN_TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R];
            }
    }
    uint32_t swz = (uint32_t)sw[0] | (uint32_t)sw[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)sw[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)sw[3] << 24;
    ViewKey k = {img->image, img->format, vt, aspect, l0, nl, y0, ny, swz};
    if (!view_of.klen) nvn_hm_init(&view_of, sizeof(ViewKey)), nvn_hm_init(&views_by_image, sizeof(VkImage));
    VkImageView found = (VkImageView)nvn_hm_get(&view_of, &k);
    if (found) return found;
    VkImageViewCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = img->image, .viewType = vt,
                                .format = img->format,
                                .components = {swz_of(sw[0]), swz_of(sw[1]), swz_of(sw[2]), swz_of(sw[3])},
                                .subresourceRange = {aspect, l0, nl, y0, ny}};
    VkImageViewUsageCreateInfo use = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_USAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                      .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT};
    if (img->block_views) ci.pNext = &use;   // the image's COLOR_ATTACHMENT usage is its block views' (vk_texture.c)
    VkImageView view;
    if (vkCreateImageView(vk_ctx()->device, &ci, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    ViewNode *n = malloc(sizeof *n);
    if (!n) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
    *n = (ViewNode){nvn_hm_get(&views_by_image, &img->image), k, view};
    nvn_hm_put(&views_by_image, &img->image, n);
    nvn_hm_put(&view_of, &k, (void *)view);
    return view;
}

// An attachment view of a registered texture, kept with its sampled views for the image's lifetime: made per command
// buffer, every render target's views were created again each frame (vkCreateImageView under vk_exec_pass_begin, 2%
// of the fight replay on the 7900X). Attachment keys carry a swizzle word no sampled key has (those hold four NVN
// selectors, each below 8). The texture lock guards the tables, as for get_view; vk_exec_pass_begin may already hold it.
VkImageView vk_exec_target_view(const VkTexImage *img, VkFormat format, VkImageViewType type, uint32_t aspect,
                                uint32_t level, uint32_t base, uint32_t layers, int blocks) {
    ViewKey k = {img->image, format, type, aspect, level, 1, base, layers, blocks ? 0xfffffffeu : 0xffffffffu};
    vk_texture_lock();
    if (!view_of.klen) nvn_hm_init(&view_of, sizeof(ViewKey)), nvn_hm_init(&views_by_image, sizeof(VkImage));
    VkImageView view = (VkImageView)nvn_hm_get(&view_of, &k);
    if (!view) {
        VkImageViewCreateInfo ci = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO, .image = img->image,
                                    .viewType = type, .format = format, .subresourceRange = {aspect, level, 1, base, layers}};
        VkImageViewUsageCreateInfo use = {.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_USAGE_CREATE_INFO,
                                          .usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT};
        if (blocks) ci.pNext = &use;   // not the BC image's sampling and transfer usages
        if (vkCreateImageView(vk_ctx()->device, &ci, NULL, &view) != VK_SUCCESS)
            rt_fatal("vk: render target view (format %d) could not be created", (int)format);
        ViewNode *n = malloc(sizeof *n);
        if (!n) rt_fatal("vk: out of memory");
        *n = (ViewNode){nvn_hm_get(&views_by_image, &img->image), k, view};
        nvn_hm_put(&views_by_image, &img->image, n);
        nvn_hm_put(&view_of, &k, (void *)view);
    }
    vk_texture_unlock();
    return view;
}

void vk_exec_image_gone(VkImage image) {
    vk_exec_bc_gone(image);
    if (!views_by_image.klen) return;
    for (ViewNode *n = nvn_hm_del(&views_by_image, &image), *next; n; n = next) {
        next = n->next;
        nvn_hm_del(&view_of, &n->k);
        vk_defer_view(n->view);
        free(n);
    }
}

// ---- program to shaders

// (program, stage, answers) -> shader, 4-way set-associative, most recently used first. A miss costs a SHA-256 of the
// whole shader code (gfx_shader.c req_init), slow on CPUs without SHA instructions: a field frame looks up ~3000 and
// the 2048-slot direct-mapped table this replaced missed 3% of them on conflicts.
#define SHADER_SETS 2048
#define SHADER_WAYS 4
typedef struct { uint64_t serial; int stage; int used; GfxShaderAnswers a; const GfxShader *s; } ShaderEnt;
static ShaderEnt shader_tab[SHADER_SETS][SHADER_WAYS];

static int find_stage_scan(const prog_t *p, int nvn_stage, const uint8_t **ctl, const uint8_t **code, uint32_t *len) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->nstage && i < 6; i++) {
        const uint8_t *c = p->sd[i].control;
        if (!c || !p->sd[i].data) continue;
        uint32_t st;
        memcpy(&st, c + 0x714, 4);
        if ((int)st != nvn_stage) continue;
        memcpy(len, c + 0x704, 4);
        *ctl = c, *code = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// Which shader of a program serves each NVN stage, and its code length, per program serial (new at every
// nvnProgramSetShaders): the scan reads two words of every stage's control block, cold guest cache lines, and runs
// several times a draw. Direct-mapped; a collision only scans again.
#define STAGEM_N 512
static struct { uint64_t serial; int8_t idx[6]; uint32_t len[6]; } stagem[STAGEM_N];

static int find_stage(const prog_t *p, int nvn_stage, const uint8_t **ctl, const uint8_t **code, uint32_t *len) {
    if (!p->serial || (unsigned)nvn_stage >= 6) return find_stage_scan(p, nvn_stage, ctl, code, len);
    typeof(stagem[0]) *m = &stagem[p->serial * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 55];
    if (m->serial != p->serial) {
        m->serial = p->serial;
        memset(m->idx, -1, sizeof m->idx);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p->nstage && i < 6; i++) {
            const uint8_t *c = p->sd[i].control;
            if (!c || !p->sd[i].data) continue;
            uint32_t st;
            memcpy(&st, c + 0x714, 4);
            if (st < 6 && m->idx[st] < 0) m->idx[st] = (int8_t)i, memcpy(&m->len[st], c + 0x704, 4);
        }
    }
    int i = m->idx[nvn_stage];
    if (i < 0) return 0;
    *ctl = p->sd[i].control, *code = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data, *len = m->len[nvn_stage];
    return 1;
}

// Texture and image types of a stage's first 32 slots, each kept with the handle and the generation and slot token it
// was looked up under: a slot is looked up again, a hash probe, only when the handle changed or its slot may resolve
// otherwise (slot_still).
static struct { uint64_t tex[32], img[32], ttok[32], itok[32]; uint32_t tgen[32], igen[32]; uint8_t tt[32], it[32]; } AC[6];

// vk_texture_slot_token of the slot a texture or image handle names; an empty handle always resolves to nothing.
static uint64_t token_of(uint64_t h) { return h ? vk_texture_slot_token((int)(h & 0xfffff)) : 1; }

// Whether what handle h resolved to under the global generation *egen and its slot token etok (both read before that
// lookup) still holds at global generation gen: nothing at all changed since, or not its slot (the token, read only when
// the global generation moved, about every 16 draws). A token hit moves *egen to gen.
static int slot_still(uint32_t *egen, uint64_t etok, uint64_t h, uint32_t gen) {
    if (*egen == gen) return 1;
    uint64_t t = token_of(h);
    if (!t || t != etok) return 0;
    *egen = gen;
    return 1;
}
static int shader_memo_on(void);

// The slots of (program, stage) whose types its translation reads (gfx_shader_slot_mask), learned from its first
// shader; ~0u while unknown. The types of other slots select the same shader, so answers_for leaves them zero instead
// of looking up all 64 handles. Direct-mapped by serial and stage; a collision only relearns.
#define SLOTM_N 4096
static struct { uint64_t serial; int st; uint32_t m; } slotm[SLOTM_N];

static uint32_t slotm_idx(uint64_t serial, int st) { return (uint32_t)((serial * 8 + (uint64_t)st) * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 52); }

static uint32_t slot_mask_of(uint64_t serial, int st) {
    const typeof(slotm[0]) *e = &slotm[slotm_idx(serial, st)];
    return serial && e->serial == serial && e->st == st ? e->m : ~0u;
}

static void slot_mask_learn(uint64_t serial, int st, const GfxShader *s) {
    if (!serial || slot_mask_of(serial, st) != ~0u) return;
    slotm[slotm_idx(serial, st)] = (typeof(slotm[0])){serial, st, gfx_shader_slot_mask(s)};
}

static uint8_t type_of_handle(uint64_t h) {   // texture lock held
    view_t v;
    int hv;
    const VkTexImage *img = h ? vk_texture_by_id_locked((int)(h & 0xfffff), &v, &hv) : NULL;
    return img ? (uint8_t)gfx_type_of(img, &v, hv) : 0;
}

// The answers of stage st for the slots in mask; the types of other slots stay zero.
static void answers_for(VkExec *ex, int st, const uint8_t *ctl, uint32_t mask, GfxShaderAnswers *a) {
    memset(a, 0, sizeof *a);
    if (st == NVN_STAGE_VS) vk_pipeline_answers(&ex->pipe, a, NULL);
    else if (st == NVN_STAGE_FS) vk_pipeline_answers(&ex->pipe, NULL, a);
    else
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            uint32_t l;
            memcpy(&l, ctl + 0x748 + 4 * k, 4);
            a->local[k] = (uint16_t)(l ? l : 1);
        }
    typeof(AC[0]) *c = &AC[st];
    // The generation and tokens are read before the lookups (one that creates an entry changes them) and unlocked: a
    // registration racing with them is ordered after this draw, and a slot stored under older ones is only looked up
    // again.
    uint32_t gen = vk_texture_slots_gen();
    int locked = 0, check = shader_memo_on() == 2;
    for (uint32_t m = mask; m; m &= m - 1) {
        int slot = __builtin_ctz(m);
        uint64_t h = ex->tex[st][slot], hi = ex->img[st][slot];
        int tmiss = c->tex[slot] != h || !c->ttok[slot] || !slot_still(&c->tgen[slot], c->ttok[slot], h, gen);
        int imiss = c->img[slot] != hi || !c->itok[slot] || !slot_still(&c->igen[slot], c->itok[slot], hi, gen);
        uint64_t tt = tmiss ? token_of(h) : 0, it = imiss ? token_of(hi) : 0;
        if ((tmiss || imiss || check) && !locked) vk_texture_lock(), locked = 1, BS.ac_miss++;
        if (tmiss) c->tt[slot] = type_of_handle(h), c->tex[slot] = h, c->ttok[slot] = tt, c->tgen[slot] = gen;
        if (imiss) c->it[slot] = type_of_handle(hi), c->img[slot] = hi, c->itok[slot] = it, c->igen[slot] = gen;
        if (check && (type_of_handle(h) != c->tt[slot] || type_of_handle(hi) != c->it[slot]))   // TOTK_SHADER_MEMO=check
            rt_fatal("vk_exec: kept texture types of stage %d slot %d differ from a lookup", st, slot);
        a->tex_type[slot] = c->tt[slot], a->img_type[slot] = c->it[slot];
    }
    if (locked) vk_texture_unlock();
}

// *present: the program has this stage. Returns NULL when it has not or the translation failed. pending (graphics
// stages, vk_pipeline_async_on): a shader not translated yet is queued and NULL returned with *pending = 1. await: a
// shader queued earlier is waited for (gfx_shader_await) instead.
static const GfxShader *shader_for(VkExec *ex, int st, int *present, int *pending, int await) {
    const uint8_t *ctl, *code;
    uint32_t len;
    *present = 0;
    if (pending) *pending = 0;
    if (!ex->prog || !find_stage(ex->prog, st, &ctl, &code, &len)) return NULL;
    *present = 1;
    GfxShaderAnswers a;
    uint64_t serial = ex->prog->serial;
    answers_for(ex, st, ctl, slot_mask_of(serial, st), &a);
    ShaderEnt *set = NULL;
    if (serial) {
        uint64_t h = (serial * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull ^ (uint64_t)st) ^ nvn_hm_hash(&a, sizeof a);   // a is zero-padded
        set = shader_tab[(h ^ h >> 29) & (SHADER_SETS - 1)];
        for (int w = 0; w < SHADER_WAYS && set[w].used; w++) {
            ShaderEnt *e = &set[w];
            if (e->serial != serial || e->stage != st || memcmp(&e->a, &a, sizeof a)) continue;
            if (w) {   // to the front
                ShaderEnt hit = *e;
                memmove(&set[1], &set[0], w * sizeof *set);
                set[0] = hit;
            }
            return set[0].s;
        }
    }
    int gs = st == NVN_STAGE_VS ? GFX_STAGE_VS : st == NVN_STAGE_FS ? GFX_STAGE_FS : GFX_STAGE_CS;
    const GfxShader *s = await ? gfx_shader_await(gs, ctl, code, len, &a)
                       : pending && vk_pipeline_async_on() ? gfx_shader_get_async(gs, ctl, code, len, &a, pending)
                                                           : gfx_shader_get(gs, ctl, code, len, NULL, &a);
    if (pending && *pending) return NULL;
    if (s) slot_mask_learn(serial, st, s);
```
