`tools/vendor/ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/Instruction.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    public sealed class Instruction : IOperand, IEquatable<Instruction>
    {
        public const uint InvalidId = uint.MaxValue;

        public Specification.Op Opcode { get; private set; }
        private Instruction _resultType;
        private InstructionOperands _operands;

        public uint Id { get; set; }

        public Instruction() { }

        public void Set(Specification.Op opcode, uint id = InvalidId, Instruction resultType = null)
        {
            Opcode = opcode;
            Id = id;
            _resultType = resultType;

            _operands = new InstructionOperands();
        }

        public void SetId(uint id)
        {
            Id = id;
        }

        public OperandType Type => OperandType.Instruction;

        public ushort GetTotalWordCount()
        {
            ushort result = WordCount;

            if (Id != InvalidId)
            {
                result++;
            }

            if (_resultType != null)
            {
                result += _resultType.WordCount;
            }

            Span<IOperand> operands = _operands.AsSpan();
            for (int i = 0; i < operands.Length; i++)
            {
                result += operands[i].WordCount;
            }

            return result;
        }

        public ushort WordCount => 1;

        public void AddOperand(IOperand value)
        {
            Debug.Assert(value != null);
            _operands.Add(value);
        }

        public void AddOperand(ReadOnlySpan<IOperand> value)
        {
            foreach (IOperand instruction in value)
            {
                AddOperand(instruction);
            }
        }

        public void AddOperand(ReadOnlySpan<LiteralInteger> value)
        {
            foreach (LiteralInteger instruction in value)
            {
                AddOperand(instruction);
            }
        }

        public void AddOperand(LiteralInteger value)
        {
            AddOperand((IOperand)value);
        }

        public void AddOperand(ReadOnlySpan<Instruction> value)
        {
            foreach (Instruction instruction in value)
            {
                AddOperand(instruction);
            }
        }

        public void AddOperand(Instruction value)
        {
            AddOperand((IOperand)value);
        }

        public void AddOperand(string value)
        {
            AddOperand(new LiteralString(value));
        }

        public void AddOperand<T>(T value) where T : Enum
        {
            AddOperand(LiteralInteger.CreateForEnum(value));
        }

        public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
        {
            // Word 0
            writer.Write((ushort)Opcode);
            writer.Write(GetTotalWordCount());

            _resultType?.WriteOperand(writer);

            if (Id != InvalidId)
            {
                writer.Write(Id);
            }

            Span<IOperand> operands = _operands.AsSpan();
            for (int i = 0; i < operands.Length; i++)
            {
                operands[i].WriteOperand(writer);
            }
        }

        public void WriteOperand(BinaryWriter writer)
        {
            Debug.Assert(Id != InvalidId);

            if (Id == InvalidId)
            {
                string methodToCall;

                if (Opcode == Specification.Op.OpVariable)
                {
                    methodToCall = "AddLocalVariable or AddGlobalVariable";
                }
                else if (Opcode == Specification.Op.OpLabel)
                {
                    methodToCall = "AddLabel";
                }
                else
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Internal error");
                }

                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Id wasn't bound to the module, please make sure to call {methodToCall}");
            }

            writer.Write(Id);
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is Instruction instruction && Equals(instruction);
        }

        public bool Equals(Instruction cmpObj)
        {
            bool result = Type == cmpObj.Type && Id == cmpObj.Id;

            if (result)
            {
                if (_resultType != null && cmpObj._resultType != null)
                {
                    result &= _resultType.Equals(cmpObj._resultType);
                }
                else if (_resultType != null || cmpObj._resultType != null)
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            if (result)
            {
                result &= EqualsContent(cmpObj);
            }

            return result;
        }

        public bool EqualsContent(Instruction cmpObj)
        {
            Span<IOperand> thisOperands = _operands.AsSpan();
            Span<IOperand> cmpOperands = cmpObj._operands.AsSpan();

            if (thisOperands.Length != cmpOperands.Length)
            {
                return false;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < thisOperands.Length; i++)
            {
                if (!thisOperands[i].Equals(cmpOperands[i]))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            return true;
        }

        public bool EqualsResultType(Instruction cmpObj)
        {
            return _resultType.Opcode == cmpObj._resultType.Opcode && _resultType.EqualsContent(cmpObj._resultType);
        }

        public int GetHashCodeContent()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine<IOperand>(_operands.AsSpan());
        }

        public int GetHashCodeResultType()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine(_resultType.Opcode, _resultType.GetHashCodeContent());
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine(Opcode, Id, _resultType, DeterministicHashCode.Combine<IOperand>(_operands.AsSpan()));
        }

        public bool Equals(IOperand obj)
        {
            return obj is Instruction instruction && Equals(instruction);
        }

        private static readonly Dictionary<Specification.Op, string[]> _operandLabels = new()
        {
            { Specification.Op.OpConstant, ["Value"] },
            { Specification.Op.OpTypeInt, ["Width", "Signed"] },
            { Specification.Op.OpTypeFloat, ["Width"] },
        };

        public override string ToString()
        {
            string[] labels = _operandLabels.TryGetValue(Opcode, out string[] opLabels) ? opLabels : [];
            string result = _resultType == null ? string.Empty : $"{_resultType} ";
            return $"{result}{Opcode}{_operands.ToString(labels)}";
        }
    }
}
```

`tools/vendor/ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/InstructionOperands.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    public struct InstructionOperands
    {
        private const int InternalCount = 5;

        public int Count;
        public IOperand Operand1;
        public IOperand Operand2;
        public IOperand Operand3;
        public IOperand Operand4;
        public IOperand Operand5;
        public IOperand[] Overflow;

        public Span<IOperand> AsSpan()
        {
            if (Count > InternalCount)
            {
                return MemoryMarshal.CreateSpan(ref this.Overflow[0], Count);
            }
            else
            {
                return MemoryMarshal.CreateSpan(ref this.Operand1, Count);
            }
        }

        public void Add(IOperand operand)
        {
            if (Count < InternalCount)
            {
                MemoryMarshal.CreateSpan(ref this.Operand1, Count + 1)[Count] = operand;
                Count++;
            }
            else
            {
                if (Overflow == null)
                {
                    Overflow = new IOperand[InternalCount * 2];
                    MemoryMarshal.CreateSpan(ref this.Operand1, InternalCount).CopyTo(Overflow.AsSpan());
                }
                else if (Count == Overflow.Length)
                {
                    Array.Resize(ref Overflow, Overflow.Length * 2);
                }

                Overflow[Count++] = operand;
            }
        }

        private readonly IEnumerable<IOperand> AllOperands => new[] { Operand1, Operand2, Operand3, Operand4, Operand5 }
            .Concat(Overflow ?? [])
            .Take(Count);

        public readonly override string ToString()
        {
            return $"({string.Join(", ", AllOperands)})";
        }

        public readonly string ToString(string[] labels)
        {
            IEnumerable<string> labeledParams = AllOperands.Zip(labels, (op, label) => $"{label}: {op}");
            IEnumerable<string> unlabeledParams = AllOperands.Skip(labels.Length).Select(op => op.ToString());
            IEnumerable<string> paramsToPrint = labeledParams.Concat(unlabeledParams);
            return $"({string.Join(", ", paramsToPrint)})";
        }
    }
}
```

`tools/vendor/ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/LiteralInteger.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    public class LiteralInteger : IOperand, IEquatable<LiteralInteger>
    {
        [ThreadStatic]
        private static GeneratorPool<LiteralInteger> _pool;

        internal static void RegisterPool(GeneratorPool<LiteralInteger> pool)
        {
            _pool = pool;
        }

        internal static void UnregisterPool()
        {
            _pool = null;
        }

        public OperandType Type => OperandType.Number;

        private enum IntegerType
        {
            UInt32,
            Int32,
            UInt64,
            Int64,
            Float32,
            Float64,
        }

        private IntegerType _integerType;
        private ulong _data;

        public ushort WordCount { get; private set; }

        public LiteralInteger() { }

        private static LiteralInteger New()
        {
            return _pool.Allocate();
        }

        private LiteralInteger Set(ulong data, IntegerType integerType, ushort wordCount)
        {
            _data = data;
            _integerType = integerType;

            WordCount = wordCount;

            return this;
        }

        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(int value) => New().Set((ulong)value, IntegerType.Int32, 1);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(uint value) => New().Set(value, IntegerType.UInt32, 1);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(long value) => New().Set((ulong)value, IntegerType.Int64, 2);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(ulong value) => New().Set(value, IntegerType.UInt64, 2);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(float value) => New().Set(BitConverter.SingleToUInt32Bits(value), IntegerType.Float32, 1);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(double value) => New().Set(BitConverter.DoubleToUInt64Bits(value), IntegerType.Float64, 2);
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(Enum value) => New().Set((ulong)(int)(object)value, IntegerType.Int32, 1);

        // NOTE: this is not in the standard, but this is some syntax sugar useful in some instructions (TypeInt ect)
        public static implicit operator LiteralInteger(bool value) => New().Set(Convert.ToUInt64(value), IntegerType.Int32, 1);

        public static LiteralInteger CreateForEnum<T>(T value) where T : Enum
        {
            return value;
        }

        public void WriteOperand(BinaryWriter writer)
        {
            if (WordCount == 1)
            {
                writer.Write((uint)_data);
            }
            else
            {
                writer.Write(_data);
            }
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is LiteralInteger literalInteger && Equals(literalInteger);
        }

        public bool Equals(LiteralInteger cmpObj)
        {
            return Type == cmpObj.Type && _integerType == cmpObj._integerType && _data == cmpObj._data;
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine(Type, _data);
        }

        public bool Equals(IOperand obj)
        {
            return obj is LiteralInteger literalInteger && Equals(literalInteger);
        }

        public override string ToString() => $"{_integerType} {_data}";
    }
}
```

`tools/vendor/ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/LiteralString.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    public class LiteralString : IOperand, IEquatable<LiteralString>
    {
        public OperandType Type => OperandType.String;

        private readonly string _value;

        public LiteralString(string value)
        {
            _value = value;
        }

        public ushort WordCount => (ushort)(_value.Length / 4 + 1);

        public void WriteOperand(BinaryWriter writer)
        {
            writer.Write(_value.AsSpan());

            // String must be padded to the word size (which is 4 bytes).
            int paddingSize = 4 - (Encoding.ASCII.GetByteCount(_value) % 4);

            Span<byte> padding = stackalloc byte[paddingSize];

            writer.Write(padding);
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is LiteralString literalString && Equals(literalString);
        }

        public bool Equals(LiteralString cmpObj)
        {
            return Type == cmpObj.Type && _value.Equals(cmpObj._value);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine(Type, DeterministicHashCode.GetHashCode(_value));
        }

        public bool Equals(IOperand obj)
        {
            return obj is LiteralString literalString && Equals(literalString);
        }

        public override string ToString() => _value;
    }
}
```

`tools/vendor/ryujinx/src/Spv.Generator/Module.cs`:

```cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using static Spv.Specification;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    public partial class Module
    {
        // TODO: Register on SPIR-V registry.
        private const int GeneratorId = 0;

        private readonly uint _version;

        private uint _bound;

        // Follow spec order here while keeping it as simple as possible.
        private readonly List<Capability> _capabilities;
        private readonly List<string> _extensions;
        private readonly Dictionary<DeterministicStringKey, Instruction> _extInstImports;
        private AddressingModel _addressingModel;
        private MemoryModel _memoryModel;

        private readonly List<Instruction> _entrypoints;
        private readonly List<Instruction> _executionModes;
        private readonly List<Instruction> _debug;
        private readonly List<Instruction> _annotations;

        // In the declaration block.
        private readonly Dictionary<TypeDeclarationKey, Instruction> _typeDeclarations;
        private readonly List<Instruction> _typeDeclarationsList;
        // In the declaration block.
        private readonly List<Instruction> _globals;
        // In the declaration block.
        private readonly Dictionary<ConstantKey, Instruction> _constants;
        // In the declaration block, for function that aren't defined in the module.
        private readonly List<Instruction> _functionsDeclarations;

        private readonly List<Instruction> _functionsDefinitions;

        private readonly GeneratorPool<Instruction> _instPool;
        private readonly GeneratorPool<LiteralInteger> _integerPool;

        public Module(uint version, GeneratorPool<Instruction> instPool = null, GeneratorPool<LiteralInteger> integerPool = null)
        {
            _version = version;
            _bound = 1;
            _capabilities = [];
            _extensions = [];
            _extInstImports = new Dictionary<DeterministicStringKey, Instruction>();
            _addressingModel = AddressingModel.Logical;
            _memoryModel = MemoryModel.Simple;
            _entrypoints = [];
            _executionModes = [];
            _debug = [];
            _annotations = [];
            _typeDeclarations = new Dictionary<TypeDeclarationKey, Instruction>();
            _typeDeclarationsList = [];
            _constants = new Dictionary<ConstantKey, Instruction>();
            _globals = [];
            _functionsDeclarations = [];
            _functionsDefinitions = [];

            _instPool = instPool ?? new GeneratorPool<Instruction>();
            _integerPool = integerPool ?? new GeneratorPool<LiteralInteger>();

            LiteralInteger.RegisterPool(_integerPool);
        }

        private uint GetNewId()
        {
            return _bound++;
        }

        public void AddCapability(Capability capability)
        {
            _capabilities.Add(capability);
        }

        public void AddExtension(string extension)
        {
            _extensions.Add(extension);
        }

        public Instruction NewInstruction(Op opcode, uint id = Instruction.InvalidId, Instruction resultType = null)
        {
            Instruction result = _instPool.Allocate();
            result.Set(opcode, id, resultType);

            return result;
        }

        public Instruction AddExtInstImport(string import)
        {
            DeterministicStringKey key = new(import);

            if (_extInstImports.TryGetValue(key, out Instruction extInstImport))
            {
                // Update the duplicate instance to use the good id so it ends up being encoded correctly.
                return extInstImport;
            }

            Instruction instruction = NewInstruction(Op.OpExtInstImport);
            instruction.AddOperand(import);

            instruction.SetId(GetNewId());

            _extInstImports.Add(key, instruction);

            return instruction;
        }

        private void AddTypeDeclaration(Instruction instruction, bool forceIdAllocation)
        {
            TypeDeclarationKey key = new(instruction);

            if (!forceIdAllocation)
            {
                if (_typeDeclarations.TryGetValue(key, out Instruction typeDeclaration))
                {
                    // Update the duplicate instance to use the good id so it ends up being encoded correctly.

                    instruction.SetId(typeDeclaration.Id);

                    return;
                }
            }

            instruction.SetId(GetNewId());

            _typeDeclarations[key] = instruction;
            _typeDeclarationsList.Add(instruction);
        }

        public void AddEntryPoint(ExecutionModel executionModel, Instruction function, string name, params ReadOnlySpan<Instruction> interfaces)
        {
            Debug.Assert(function.Opcode == Op.OpFunction);

            Instruction entryPoint = NewInstruction(Op.OpEntryPoint);

            entryPoint.AddOperand(executionModel);
            entryPoint.AddOperand(function);
            entryPoint.AddOperand(name);
            entryPoint.AddOperand(interfaces);

            _entrypoints.Add(entryPoint);
        }

        public void AddExecutionMode(Instruction function, ExecutionMode mode, params ReadOnlySpan<IOperand> parameters)
        {
            Debug.Assert(function.Opcode == Op.OpFunction);

            Instruction executionModeInstruction = NewInstruction(Op.OpExecutionMode);

            executionModeInstruction.AddOperand(function);
            executionModeInstruction.AddOperand(mode);
            executionModeInstruction.AddOperand(parameters);

            _executionModes.Add(executionModeInstruction);
        }

        private void AddToFunctionDefinitions(Instruction instruction)
        {
            Debug.Assert(instruction.Opcode != Op.OpTypeInt);
            _functionsDefinitions.Add(instruction);
        }

        private void AddAnnotation(Instruction annotation)
        {
            _annotations.Add(annotation);
        }

        private void AddDebug(Instruction debug)
        {
            _debug.Add(debug);
        }

        public void AddLabel(Instruction label)
        {
            Debug.Assert(label.Opcode == Op.OpLabel);

            label.SetId(GetNewId());

            AddToFunctionDefinitions(label);
        }

        public void AddLocalVariable(Instruction variable)
        {
            // TODO: Ensure it has the local modifier.
            Debug.Assert(variable.Opcode == Op.OpVariable);

            variable.SetId(GetNewId());

            AddToFunctionDefinitions(variable);
        }

        public void AddGlobalVariable(Instruction variable)
        {
            // TODO: Ensure it has the global modifier.
            // TODO: All constants opcodes (OpSpecXXX and the rest of the OpConstantXXX).
            Debug.Assert(variable.Opcode == Op.OpVariable);

            variable.SetId(GetNewId());

            _globals.Add(variable);
        }

        private void AddConstant(Instruction constant)
        {
            Debug.Assert(constant.Opcode is Op.OpConstant or
                         Op.OpConstantFalse or
                         Op.OpConstantTrue or
                         Op.OpConstantNull or
                         Op.OpConstantComposite);

            ConstantKey key = new(constant);

            if (_constants.TryGetValue(key, out Instruction global))
            {
                // Update the duplicate instance to use the good id so it ends up being encoded correctly.
                constant.SetId(global.Id);

                return;
            }

            constant.SetId(GetNewId());

            _constants.Add(key, constant);
        }

        public Instruction ExtInst(Instruction resultType, Instruction set, LiteralInteger instruction, params ReadOnlySpan<IOperand> parameters)
        {
            Instruction result = NewInstruction(Op.OpExtInst, GetNewId(), resultType);

            result.AddOperand(set);
            result.AddOperand(instruction);
            result.AddOperand(parameters);
            AddToFunctionDefinitions(result);

            return result;
        }

        public void SetMemoryModel(AddressingModel addressingModel, MemoryModel memoryModel)
        {
            _addressingModel = addressingModel;
            _memoryModel = memoryModel;
        }

        // TODO: Find a way to make the auto generate one used.
        public Instruction OpenClPrintf(Instruction resultType, Instruction format, params ReadOnlySpan<Instruction> additionalarguments)
        {
            Instruction result = NewInstruction(Op.OpExtInst, GetNewId(), resultType);

            result.AddOperand(AddExtInstImport("OpenCL.std"));
            result.AddOperand((LiteralInteger)184);
            result.AddOperand(format);
            result.AddOperand(additionalarguments);
            AddToFunctionDefinitions(result);

            return result;
        }

        public byte[] Generate()
        {
            // Estimate the size needed for the generated code, to avoid expanding the MemoryStream.
            int sizeEstimate = 1024 + _functionsDefinitions.Count * 32;

            using MemoryStream stream = new(sizeEstimate);

            BinaryWriter writer = new(stream, System.Text.Encoding.ASCII);

            // Header
            writer.Write(MagicNumber);
            writer.Write(_version);
            writer.Write(GeneratorId);
            writer.Write(_bound);
            writer.Write(0u);

            // 1.
            foreach (Capability capability in _capabilities)
            {
                Instruction capabilityInstruction = NewInstruction(Op.OpCapability);

                capabilityInstruction.AddOperand(capability);
                capabilityInstruction.Write(writer);
            }

            // 2.
            foreach (string extension in _extensions)
            {
                Instruction extensionInstruction = NewInstruction(Op.OpExtension);

                extensionInstruction.AddOperand(extension);
                extensionInstruction.Write(writer);
            }

            // 3.
            foreach (Instruction extInstImport in _extInstImports.Values)
            {
                extInstImport.Write(writer);
            }

            // 4.
            Instruction memoryModelInstruction = NewInstruction(Op.OpMemoryModel);
            memoryModelInstruction.AddOperand(_addressingModel);
            memoryModelInstruction.AddOperand(_memoryModel);
            memoryModelInstruction.Write(writer);

            // 5.
            foreach (Instruction entrypoint in _entrypoints)
            {
                entrypoint.Write(writer);
            }

            // 6.
            foreach (Instruction executionMode in _executionModes)
            {
                executionMode.Write(writer);
            }

            // 7.
            // TODO: Order debug information correctly.
            foreach (Instruction debug in _debug)
            {
                debug.Write(writer);
            }

            // 8.
            foreach (Instruction annotation in _annotations)
            {
                annotation.Write(writer);
            }

            // Ensure that everything is in the right order in the declarations section.
            List<Instruction> declarations = [];
            declarations.AddRange(_typeDeclarationsList);
            declarations.AddRange(_globals);
            declarations.AddRange(_constants.Values);
            declarations.Sort((x, y) => x.Id.CompareTo(y.Id));

            // 9.
            foreach (Instruction declaration in declarations)
            {
                declaration.Write(writer);
            }

            // 10.
            foreach (Instruction functionDeclaration in _functionsDeclarations)
            {
                functionDeclaration.Write(writer);
            }

            // 11.
            foreach (Instruction functionDefinition in _functionsDefinitions)
            {
                functionDefinition.Write(writer);
            }

            _instPool.Clear();
            _integerPool.Clear();

            LiteralInteger.UnregisterPool();

            return stream.ToArray();
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;

namespace Spv.Generator
{
    internal readonly struct TypeDeclarationKey : IEquatable<TypeDeclarationKey>
    {
        private readonly Instruction _typeDeclaration;

        public TypeDeclarationKey(Instruction typeDeclaration)
        {
            _typeDeclaration = typeDeclaration;
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return DeterministicHashCode.Combine(_typeDeclaration.Opcode, _typeDeclaration.GetHashCodeContent());
        }

        public bool Equals(TypeDeclarationKey other)
        {
            return _typeDeclaration.Opcode == other._typeDeclaration.Opcode && _typeDeclaration.EqualsContent(other._typeDeclaration);
        }

        public override bool Equals([NotNullWhen(true)] object obj)
        {
            return obj is TypeDeclarationKey key && Equals(key);
        }
    }
}

```

`tools/worktree.py`:

```py
"""Git worktrees for agent tasks: .worktrees/<tag> on branch task/<tag>, linked to the main checkout's ignored data.

  worktree.py new <tag> [--base REF]       create the worktree and the links, print its path
  worktree.py list                         worktrees with branch, ahead/behind main, dirty or not
  worktree.py remove <tag> [--delete-branch] [--force]

A worktree holds tracked files only. build/, generated/, refs/, toolchain/, .venv/, .venv-py314/, game/, and the local
agent setup .claude/ and notes/ of the main checkout appear in it as directory junctions, config.local.toml and
CLAUDE.local.md as hard links. Nothing is copied.
`remove` deletes the links first (os.rmdir / os.unlink never follow a junction), checks that none is left, and only
then lets git delete the worktree. Stdlib only.
"""
import argparse
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

LINK_DIRS = ['build', 'generated', 'refs', 'toolchain', '.venv', '.venv-py314', 'game', '.claude', 'notes']
LINK_FILES = ['config.local.toml', 'CLAUDE.local.md']
MAIN_BRANCH = 'main'
TAG_RE = re.compile(r'^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$')


def git(cwd, *args, check=True):
    r = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(cwd), *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if check and r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f'git {" ".join(args)} failed: {(r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()}')
    return r


def main_checkout(start):
    """The main checkout: the parent of the shared .git directory, whichever worktree `start` is in."""
    common = git(start, 'rev-parse', '--path-format=absolute', '--git-common-dir').stdout.strip()
    return Path(common).resolve().parent


def is_link(p):
    """True for a junction or symlink."""
    return os.path.islink(p) or os.path.isjunction(p)


def make_junction(target, link):
    if os.name == 'nt':
        import _winapi
        _winapi.CreateJunction(str(target), str(link))
    else:
        os.symlink(target, link, target_is_directory=True)


def drop_link(p):
    """Remove one link without touching what it points at. A real directory or file is left alone."""
    if os.path.isjunction(p) or os.path.islink(p):
        os.rmdir(p) if os.path.isjunction(p) else os.unlink(p)
        return True
    return False


def link_data(main, wt):
    made = []
    for name in LINK_DIRS:
        src, dst = main / name, wt / name
        if not src.is_dir() or os.path.lexists(dst):
            continue
        make_junction(src, dst)
        made.append(name)
    for name in LINK_FILES:
        src, dst = main / name, wt / name
        if not src.is_file() or os.path.lexists(dst):
            continue
        os.link(src, dst)
        made.append(name)
    return made


def unlink_data(wt):
    """Remove the links of a worktree. A file link goes by os.unlink: it only drops one name of the data."""
    for name in LINK_DIRS:
        drop_link(wt / name)
    for name in LINK_FILES:
        p = wt / name
        if os.path.lexists(p) and not is_link(p):
            os.unlink(p)    # a hard link looks like a plain file; its data survives under the main checkout's name
    left = [n for n in LINK_DIRS if is_link(wt / n)]
    if left:
        sys.exit(f'links still present in {wt}: {left}; not removing the worktree')


def wt_path(main, tag):
    return main / '.worktrees' / tag


def cmd_new(a):
    if not TAG_RE.match(a.tag):
        sys.exit(f'bad tag {a.tag!r}')
    main = main_checkout(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    wt = wt_path(main, a.tag)
    if wt.exists():
        sys.exit(f'{wt} exists')
    git(main, 'worktree', 'add', str(wt), '-b', f'task/{a.tag}', a.base)
    made = link_data(main, wt)
    print(wt)
    print('linked: ' + ', '.join(made), file=sys.stderr)


def worktrees(main):
    out, cur = [], {}
    for line in git(main, 'worktree', 'list', '--porcelain').stdout.splitlines() + ['']:
        if not line:
            if cur:
                out.append(cur)
            cur = {}
        else:
            k, _, v = line.partition(' ')
            cur[k] = v
    return out


def cmd_list(a):
    main = main_checkout(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    for w in worktrees(main):
        path = Path(w['worktree'])
        branch = w.get('branch', '(detached)').removeprefix('refs/heads/')
        r = git(path, 'rev-list', '--left-right', '--count', f'{MAIN_BRANCH}...HEAD', check=False)
        behind, ahead = r.stdout.split() if r.returncode == 0 else ('?', '?')
        dirty = bool(git(path, 'status', '--porcelain', check=False).stdout.strip())
        print(f'{path}  {branch}  ahead {ahead} behind {behind}  {"dirty" if dirty else "clean"}')


def cmd_remove(a):
    main = main_checkout(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    wt = wt_path(main, a.tag)
    branch = f'task/{a.tag}'
    if not wt.is_dir():
        sys.exit(f'{wt} not found')
    if git(wt, 'status', '--porcelain').stdout.strip() and not a.force:
        sys.exit(f'{wt} has uncommitted changes; commit them or pass --force')
    if a.delete_branch and not a.force:
        merged = git(main, 'branch', '--merged', MAIN_BRANCH, '--format=%(refname:short)').stdout.split()
        if branch not in merged:
            sys.exit(f'{branch} is not merged into {MAIN_BRANCH}; pass --force to delete it anyway')
    unlink_data(wt)
    git(main, 'worktree', 'remove', *(['--force'] if a.force else []), str(wt))
    print(f'removed {wt}')
    if a.delete_branch:
        git(main, 'branch', '-D', branch)
        print(f'deleted branch {branch}')


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest='cmd', required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser('new')
    p.add_argument('tag')
    p.add_argument('--base', default=MAIN_BRANCH)
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_new)
    sub.add_parser('list').set_defaults(fn=cmd_list)
    p = sub.add_parser('remove')
    p.add_argument('tag')
    p.add_argument('--delete-branch', action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--force', action='store_true')
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_remove)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    a.fn(a)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```cs
// TOTK Vulkan adaptation of MacNativeGames games/totk/tools/totk_xlate/Program.cs (MIT, see LICENSE; MNG commit b75be8cf).
// Provenance: that file is based on D2R Mobile dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate/Program.cs. Changes here: SPIR-V for Vulkan is the final
// output (no MSL service, no VertexCounterLowering, no NEAR_IS_MINUS_W rewrite), depth clip control reported as supported,
// non-constant texture offsets reported as unsupported, --disasm dropped.
// Protocol (stdout carries replies only; diagnostics go to stderr):
//   totk_xlate --serve              one request per stdin line: {"job": {...}, "out": "<dir>"}; one reply line per request:
//                                   "ok <key>" or "fail <key> <message>"; a malformed line gets "fail ? <message>" and the loop continues.
//   totk_xlate <jobs.json> <outdir> batch mode: a JSON array of jobs, prints a summary, exit 1 if any failed.
//   job: { "key", "stage": "vs|ps|cs", "code": path (graphics = 0x50-byte SPH + instructions, compute = instructions), "c1": hex,
//          "tex": {slot: type}, "img": {slot: {type, fmt}}, "attr": {loc: float|sint|uint}, "fout": {idx: float|sint|uint},
//          "local": [x, y, z], "shared": bytes, "debug": bool, "reduced": bool, "softfloat64": bool,
//          "sbuf_align": int, "subgroup": int }
//   Output: <out>/<key>.spv and <out>/<key>.res.json (bindings, queried slots, notes).
using Ryujinx.Common.Memory;
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader;
using Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader.Translation;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;

static class SwshXlate
{
    const int TexBase = 0x168, SampBase = 0x568;   // NVN 分离贴图 / 采样器句柄在 c[2] 的字节基址（每槽 8 字节；dm/gfx/tools/maxwell_refs.py 全量实测） | byte base of NVN separate texture / sampler handles in c[2] (8 bytes per slot; full measurement in dm/gfx/tools/maxwell_refs.py)

    sealed class Accessor : IGpuAccessor
    {
        readonly byte[] _code; readonly JsonObject _job; int _binding = 1; public readonly List<string> Notes = new(); public readonly SortedSet<int> TexQueried = new(), ImgQueried = new();
        readonly byte[] _c1;
        public Accessor(byte[] code, JsonObject job) { _code = code; _job = job; _c1 = job["c1"] is JsonNode h ? Convert.FromHexString((string)h) : Array.Empty<byte>(); }
        // c1 常数段（着色器包控制段前 0x100 字节）：间接跳转 BRX 的跳转表在这里（LDC c[1]）；不提供时翻译器解不出跳转目标、控制流出错（粒子着色器死循环）
        // c1 constant segment (the 0x100 bytes before the control segment in the shader package): the jump table of indirect jump BRX lives here (LDC c[1]); without it the translator cannot resolve jump targets and control flow goes wrong (particle shaders loop forever)
        public uint ConstantBuffer1Read(int offset) { if (offset >= 0 && offset + 4 <= _c1.Length) return BitConverter.ToUInt32(_c1, offset); Notes.Add($"c1 读越界 +{offset:X}（c1 长 {_c1.Length}）"); return 0; }
        // 全部资源放进第 0 组，各占不同绑定号（spirv-cross 出成一个参数缓冲）；常量段号 index 的缓冲由翻译器给 binding = index+1 的惯例不依赖
        // All resources go into set 0, each with a distinct binding number (spirv-cross emits them as one argument buffer); the translator's convention of giving the buffer of constant segment number index binding = index+1 is not relied on
        public SetBindingPair CreateConstantBufferBinding(int index) => new(0, _binding++);
        public SetBindingPair CreateImageBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _binding; _binding += count; return new(0, b); }
        public SetBindingPair CreateStorageBufferBinding(int index) => new(0, _binding++);
        public SetBindingPair CreateTextureBinding(int count, bool isBuffer) { int b = _binding; _binding += count; return new(0, b); }
        public ReadOnlySpan<ulong> GetCode(ulong address, int minimumSize) => MemoryMarshal.Cast<byte, ulong>(new ReadOnlySpan<byte>(_code)[(int)address..]);
        public int QuerySamplerArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;
        public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromBuffer(int slot) => 32;
        public int QueryTextureArrayLengthFromPool() => 32;

        string Get(string table, int slot) => _job[table] is JsonObject t && t[slot.ToString()] is JsonNode n ? (n is JsonObject o ? (string)o["type"] : (string)n) : null;
        int TexSlot(int handle, int cbufSlot)
        {
            (int off0, _, _) = TextureHandle.UnpackOffsets(handle);
            int bytes = off0 * 4;
            return (cbufSlot < 0 || (cbufSlot & 0xffff) == 2) && bytes >= TexBase && bytes < SampBase && (bytes - TexBase) % 8 == 0 ? (bytes - TexBase) / 8 : -1;
        }
        public SamplerType QuerySamplerType(int handle, int cbufSlot = -1)
        {
            int slot = TexSlot(handle, cbufSlot);
            if (slot >= 0) TexQueried.Add(slot);
            string t = slot >= 0 ? Get("tex", slot) ?? Get("img", slot) : null;
            if (t == null) { Notes.Add($"贴图句柄 {handle:X}（常量段 {cbufSlot}，槽 {slot}）无 PC 类型，按 2D"); return SamplerType.Texture2D; }
            if (t.EndsWith("_depth")) t = t.Substring(0, t.Length - 6);   // depth-format texture: same sampler type here; the host binds a depth view
            return t switch
            {
                "1d" => SamplerType.Texture1D, "1darray" => SamplerType.Texture1D | SamplerType.Array,
                "buffer" => SamplerType.TextureBuffer, "2d" => SamplerType.Texture2D, "2darray" => SamplerType.Texture2D | SamplerType.Array,
                "2dms" => SamplerType.Texture2D | SamplerType.Multisample, "2dmsarray" => SamplerType.Texture2D | SamplerType.Multisample | SamplerType.Array,
                "3d" => SamplerType.Texture3D, "cube" => SamplerType.TextureCube, "cubearray" => SamplerType.TextureCube | SamplerType.Array,
                _ => SamplerType.Texture2D,
            };
        }
        public TextureFormat QueryTextureFormat(int handle, int cbufSlot = -1)
        {
            int slot = TexSlot(handle, cbufSlot);
            if (slot >= 0) ImgQueried.Add(slot);
            string f = _job["img"] is JsonObject t && slot >= 0 && t[slot.ToString()] is JsonObject o ? (string)o["fmt"] : null;
            if (f == null) { Notes.Add($"图像句柄 {handle:X} 槽 {slot} 无 PC 格式，按 R8G8B8A8Unorm"); return TextureFormat.R8G8B8A8Unorm; }
            return Enum.TryParse(f, true, out TextureFormat tf) ? tf : TextureFormat.R8G8B8A8Unorm;
        }
        int Local(int i) => _job["local"] is JsonArray a && a.Count > i ? (int)a[i] : 1;
        public int QueryComputeLocalSizeX() => Local(0);
        public int QueryComputeLocalSizeY() => Local(1);
        public int QueryComputeLocalSizeZ() => Local(2);
        public int QueryComputeSharedMemorySize() => _job["shared"] is JsonNode n ? (int)n : 0;   // 配对 PC 的 groupshared 声明之和 | sum of the paired PC shader's groupshared declarations
        static AttributeType Attr(string s) => s switch { "sint" => AttributeType.Sint, "uint" => AttributeType.Uint, _ => AttributeType.Float };
        public GpuGraphicsState QueryGraphicsState()
        {
            Array32<AttributeType> attr = default; Array8<AttributeType> fout = default;
            if (_job["attr"] is JsonObject a) foreach (var kv in a) attr[int.Parse(kv.Key)] = Attr((string)kv.Value);
            if (_job["fout"] is JsonObject f) foreach (var kv in f) fout[int.Parse(kv.Key)] = Attr((string)kv.Value);
            // Vulkan: VK_EXT_depth_clip_control handles NEAR_IS_MINUS_W, so the shader is never rewritten ("depth_minus_w" in a job is ignored).
            const bool depthMinusW = false;
            // "early_fragment_tests": the fragment shader's NVN control byte +0x718 (the driver's early-Z-force, Ryujinx's
            // EarlyZForce); the SPIR-V then declares EarlyFragmentTests (MacNativeGames ae8f4f4).
            bool earlyZ = _job["early_fragment_tests"] is JsonValue ez && ez.TryGetValue<bool>(out bool eb) && eb;
            return new GpuGraphicsState(earlyZ, InputTopology.Triangles, false, TessPatchType.Triangles, TessSpacing.EqualSpacing,
                false, false, false, depthMinusW, false, 1f, AlphaTestOp.Always, 0f, attr, false, fout, false,
                false /* 不做 Y 取反 | no Y flip */, true /* 原点左上 | origin upper-left */, false);
        }
        public bool QueryHostSupportsDepthClipControl() => true;
        // Vulkan: the ConstOffset / ConstOffsets image operands Ryujinx emits must be constants. A TLD4.PTP whose offsets
        // come from registers (agl_technique_pfx compute b940aa86, dfe7662f) otherwise becomes an OpConstantComposite over
        // computed ids, which spirv-val rejects; false makes TexturePass emulate only non-constant offsets.
        public bool QueryHostSupportsNonConstantTextureOffset() => false;
        // "softfloat64": true lowers FP64 operations to FP32 (Ryujinx's DoubleToFloat pass), for a host without shaderFloat64.
        public bool QueryHostSupportsShaderFloat64() => _job["softfloat64"] is not JsonValue v || !(v.TryGetValue<bool>(out bool b) && b);
        public bool QueryHostSupportsTextureShadowLod() => true;
        // 作业 reduced = true：放宽精度——翻译器只给强制精确的运算打 NoContraction（缺省全部打：保持 Maxwell 分开舍入的逐位结果，代价是 MSL 里大量禁优化的 spvFMul 等）
        // Job reduced = true: relaxed precision - the translator marks NoContraction only on operations that must be exact (the default marks all: keeps the bit-exact results of Maxwell's separate rounding, at the cost of many optimization-disabled spvFMul etc. in the MSL)
        public bool QueryHostReducedPrecision() => _job["reduced"] is JsonNode n && (bool)n;
        // Host answers for GPUs other than the RX 9070 (runtime/vk_caps.c); absent from the job they keep Ryujinx's defaults.
        // "sbuf_align": n: the host binds each storage buffer at its guest address rounded down to n (minStorageBufferOffsetAlignment
        // above 4), so storage offsets count from there (Ryujinx's unaligned path; the multi-target path uses n too).
        public bool QueryHasUnalignedStorageBuffer() => _job["sbuf_align"] is JsonNode;
        public int QueryHostStorageBufferOffsetAlignment() => _job["sbuf_align"] is JsonNode n ? (int)n : 16;
        // "subgroup": n: lanes per subgroup when the host cannot pin 32 (AMD GCN/Vega run 64): ballots and votes span n lanes.
        public int QueryHostSubgroupSize() => _job["subgroup"] is JsonNode n ? (int)n : 32;
    }


    internal static string Translate(JsonObject job, string outDir)   // also called by the --service mode (Service.cs)
    {
        string key = (string)job["key"];
            try
            {
                byte[] code = File.ReadAllBytes((string)job["code"]);
                var acc = new Accessor(code, job);
                // 作业 debug = false：关 DebugMode（DebugMode 会跳过 AST 优化器，产物满是临时变量；不改语义）
                // Job debug = false: turn off DebugMode (DebugMode skips the AST optimizer and the output is full of temporaries; semantics unchanged)
                var flags = (job["debug"] is JsonNode dbg && !(bool)dbg ? 0 : TranslationFlags.DebugMode) | ((string)job["stage"] == "cs" ? TranslationFlags.Compute : 0);
                var ctx = Translator.CreateContext(0, acc, new TranslationOptions(TargetLanguage.Spirv, TargetApi.Vulkan, flags));
                ShaderProgram p = ctx.Translate();
                File.WriteAllBytes(Path.Combine(outDir, key + ".spv"), p.BinaryCode);
                var res = new JsonObject
                {
                    ["key"] = key, ["stage"] = (string)job["stage"], ["notes"] = new JsonArray(acc.Notes.ConvertAll(n => (JsonNode)n).ToArray()),
                    ["cbufs"] = new JsonArray(), ["sbufs"] = new JsonArray(), ["textures"] = new JsonArray(), ["images"] = new JsonArray(),
                    ["uses_frag_coord"] = p.Info.UsesFragCoord, ["frag_out_map"] = p.Info.FragmentOutputMap,
                    ["tex_queried"] = new JsonArray(acc.TexQueried.Select(x => (JsonNode)x).ToArray()), ["img_queried"] = new JsonArray(acc.ImgQueried.Select(x => (JsonNode)x).ToArray()),
                };
                foreach (var b in p.Info.CBuffers) res["cbufs"].AsArray().Add((JsonNode)new JsonObject { ["binding"] = b.Binding, ["slot"] = b.Slot });
                foreach (var b in p.Info.SBuffers) res["sbufs"].AsArray().Add((JsonNode)new JsonObject { ["binding"] = b.Binding, ["slot"] = b.Slot, ["cb_slot"] = b.SbCbSlot, ["cb_offset"] = b.SbCbOffset, ["flags"] = (int)b.Flags });
                foreach (var (list, name) in new[] { (p.Info.Textures, "textures"), (p.Info.Images, "images") })
                    foreach (var t in list) res[name].AsArray().Add((JsonNode)new JsonObject { ["binding"] = t.Binding, ["type"] = (int)t.Type, ["format"] = t.Format.ToString(), ["cbuf_slot"] = t.CbufSlot, ["handle"] = t.HandleIndex, ["array"] = t.ArrayLength, ["separate"] = t.Separate, ["flags"] = (int)t.Flags });
                File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outDir, key + ".res.json"), res.ToJsonString(new JsonSerializerOptions { WriteIndented = true }));
                return null;
            }
            catch (Exception e) { if (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DMSH_STACK") != null) Console.Error.WriteLine(e.StackTrace); return $"{e.GetType().Name}: {e.Message.Split('\n')[0]}"; }
    }

    static int Main(string[] args)
    {
        if (args.Length == 1 && args[0] == "--serve")
        {
            // One request per line: {"job": {...}, "out": "<dir>"}; one reply line "ok <key>" / "fail <key> <message>".
            string line;
            while ((line = Console.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                if (line.Length == 0) continue;
                string key = "?", err;
                try
                {
                    var req = JsonNode.Parse(line).AsObject(); var job = req["job"].AsObject(); string o = (string)req["out"];
                    key = (string)job["key"];
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(o);
                    err = Translate(job, o);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { err = $"{e.GetType().Name}: {e.Message.Split((char)10)[0]}"; }
                Console.WriteLine(err == null ? $"ok {key}" : $"fail {key} {err}");
                Console.Out.Flush();
            }
            return 0;
        }
        var jobs = JsonNode.Parse(File.ReadAllText(args[0])).AsArray(); string outDir = args[1]; Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
        int ok = 0, bad = 0;
        foreach (JsonObject job in jobs)
        {
            string err = Translate(job, outDir);
            if (err == null) ok++; else { bad++; Console.Error.WriteLine($"【红】{(string)job["key"]}：{err}"); }
        }
        Console.WriteLine($"翻译 {ok} 成功，{bad} 失败");
        return bad == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }
}
```

`tools/xlate/patches/0003-keep-side-effect-assignments-in-the-ast-optimizer.patch`:

```patch
--- a/src/Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/StructuredIr/AstOptimizer.cs
+++ b/src/Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/StructuredIr/AstOptimizer.cs
@@ -22,7 +22,12 @@
                 {
                     if (node is AstAssignment assignment && assignment.Destination is AstOperand propVar)
                     {
-                        bool isWorthPropagating = propVar.Uses.Count == 1 || IsWorthPropagating(assignment.Source);

+                        // use, and removing the assignment removed the operation itself (the reduction kernel c7830fac
```

`tools/xlate_smoke.py`:

```py
"""Smoke test for build/xlate/totk_xlate.exe: no game files needed.

Sends one hand-assembled Maxwell fragment shader (writes the constant colour 1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 1.0 to render target 0)
through --serve, checks the reply, validates the SPIR-V with spirv-val, then sends a malformed line and checks the
service survives and still answers.

  python tools/xlate_smoke.py
"""

import json
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
EXE = ROOT / "build" / "xlate" / "totk_xlate.exe"
SPIRV_VAL = Path(r"C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\spirv-val.exe")

PT = 7 << 16  # predicate "always"


def mov32i(dest: int, value: float) -> int:
    imm = struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", value))[0]
    return 0x0100000000000000 | (imm << 20) | (0xF << 12) | PT | dest


EXIT = 0xE30000000000000F | PT
SCHED = 0x001F8000FC0007E0  # scheduling control word; the decoder skips it


def fragment_code() -> bytes:
    header = [0] * 20
    header[0] = 2 | (3 << 5) | (5 << 10)  # SPH type 2, version 3, stage fragment
    header[18] = 0xF  # OMAP: render target 0, components xyzw
    words = [SCHED, mov32i(0, 1.0), mov32i(1, 0.5), mov32i(2, 0.25),
             SCHED, mov32i(3, 1.0), EXIT, 0]
    return struct.pack("<20I", *header) + struct.pack(f"<{len(words)}Q", *words)


def main() -> int:
    if not EXE.is_file():
        print(f"missing {EXE}; run tools/build_xlate.py", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmp = Path(tmp)
        code = tmp / "ps.bin"
        code.write_bytes(fragment_code())
        out = tmp / "out"
        job = {"key": "const_ps", "stage": "ps", "code": str(code), "debug": False, "fout": {"0": "float"}}
        lines = [
            json.dumps({"job": job, "out": str(out)}),
            "this is not json",
            json.dumps({"job": dict(job, key="again"), "out": str(out)}),
        ]
        r = subprocess.run([str(EXE), "--serve"], input="\n".join(lines) + "\n", capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
        replies = r.stdout.splitlines()
        print("replies:", replies)
        if len(replies) != 3 or replies[0] != "ok const_ps" or not replies[1].startswith("fail ") or replies[2] != "ok again":
            print("unexpected replies; stderr:", r.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        spv = out / "const_ps.spv"
        data = spv.read_bytes()
        if len(data) < 20 or struct.unpack("<I", data[:4])[0] != 0x07230203:
            print("reply is not SPIR-V", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        v = subprocess.run([str(SPIRV_VAL), "--target-env", "vulkan1.3", str(spv)], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f"spirv-val exit {v.returncode} ({len(data)} bytes) {v.stdout}{v.stderr}")
        return v.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`totk.ini.example`:

```example
# totk.ini: settings for totk.exe. Copy this file to totk.ini next to totk.exe and remove the '#' of a line to change it.
# Each line shows the default. A TOTK_* environment variable of the same name (TOTK_FPS_LIMIT for fps_limit) overrides the
# file. Keys are case-insensitive; '#' and ';' start a comment; [sections] only group lines.

[frame rate]
# Frame rate limit: 30, 60, 90, 120, 144, any whole rate from 30 to 360, or display (the refresh rate of the window's
# monitor). Above 60 is experimental and needs realtime = 1. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
# fps_limit = 60
# Older key, read only while fps_limit is unset: fps60 = 0 means a limit of 30.
# fps60 = 1
# Real-time frame step: game speed follows the clock instead of the frame count.
# realtime = 1
# Cloth simulation on the real-time clock. Needs realtime = 1.
# cloth_realtime = 1
# Fix for physics that bounce at high frame rates.
# highfps_fix = 1

[performance]
# The keys of this section and of [diagnostics] are for testing and troubleshooting, and take effect at the next start.
# The Advanced tab of the settings menu (F1) shows all of them except zstd_native and zstd_check.

# Scheduling.
# A thread waiting for a virtual core interrupts the owner when it runs game code: 1 = on, 2 = priority inheritance
# without the interrupt, 0 = off (the old scheduling).
# async_preempt = 1
# Replay NVN submissions on their own thread, at most one frame behind the game (1 = on). Adds up to a frame of latency.
# replay_async = 0
# 1 lifts the virtual core gate: guest threads run without the console's limit of one thread per core.
# free_cores = 0
# Windows timer resolution of 1 ms for steadier frame pacing (0 = the Windows default).
# timer_1ms = 1

# Shaders and pipelines.
# Draws whose pipeline is still building: default waits on a reserved worker; draw is the previous scheduling.
# pipe_wait = default
# Which draws are dropped instead of waiting for their pipeline: strict (only draws into per-frame passes), any (also
# draws into passes whose target the previous frame rendered) or fullscreen (those and full-screen draws).
# pipe_skip = fullscreen
# Build shader stage libraries in the background ahead of time, and the threads for it (1 to 16; default: a quarter of
# the CPU threads).
# lib_prebuild = 1
# lib_prebuild_threads = 4
# Build known pipelines ahead of time.
# pipe_prebuild = 1
# Threads that translate known shaders at start (1 to 64; default: half the CPU threads, at most 16).
# prewarm_xlate = 8
# Vulkan graphics pipeline library, 0 or 1. Default: on, except on AMD's driver for RDNA 1 and 2 (RX 5000 and 6000).
# gpl = 1

# Textures and memory.
# ASTC texture decoding: native (the GPU's own ASTC support), gpu (a compute shader), cpu, or auto (native when the GPU
# has it, gpu otherwise).
# astc = auto
# Game memory shared with the GPU: auto (mirror on a discrete GPU, import on an integrated one), import (host memory
# imported into Vulkan), mirror (pools used as buffers get a copy in video memory) or verify (mirror plus a check of
# every copy; slow).
# memory = auto
# A new texture created over a live texture's memory starts with that content instead of empty.
# tex_alias = 1
# Host zstd decoder in place of the game's (0 = the game's), and a check that decodes every call both ways and logs
# the differences (1 = on; slow).
# zstd_native = 1
# zstd_check = 0

# Render fixes.
# Wait for the game to finish rewriting level-of-detail data before the GPU reads it: stops objects flashing in the
# wrong place and a flat far field for a frame.
# lod_guard = 1
# Fill the driver-reserved constant bank c0 (storage sizes, dispatch size, point size, base instance) instead of zeros.
# fix_c0 = 1
# New GPU memory pools start zero-filled, as Switch memory does.
# fix_zero = 1
# Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous
# draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk,
# skip push constants that did not change.
# bind_skip = 1
# shader_memo = 1
# pipe_memo = 1
# tex_memo = 1
# desc_template = 1
# push_skip = 1
# Submit GPU work in parts every N draws between passes so the GPU starts earlier (0 to 1000; 0 = off), each part at
# least split_us microseconds long (0 to 20000).
# split_draws = 64
# split_us = 1000

# Vulkan.
# Vulkan validation layer: checks every call and slows the game down a lot. Needs the layer installed (Vulkan SDK).
# vk_validation = 0
# A thread of its own makes the Vulkan calls of each frame, 0 or 1. Default: on, except on AMD GPUs.
# vk_recorder = 1
# Dynamic vertex input, 0 or 1. Default: on, except on Intel's older integrated GPU drivers (Vulkan 1.3.215 and older).
# vk_dyn_vertex = 1
# Pin the shader subgroup size to 32 when the GPU allows it.
# vk_subgroup_pin = 1

[display]
# Presentation mode: mailbox (default when the driver offers it, vsync otherwise), fifo (vsync) or immediate.
# vk_present = mailbox
# Window client area in screen pixels (640x360 to 7680x4320), and borderless fullscreen. Windows display scaling does
# not apply: at 150% scale, 1920x1080 covers the area 1280x720 covers at 100%. F11 switches fullscreen and saves it
# here. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
# window_size = 1920x1080
# fullscreen = 0
# Performance overlay in the top right corner: off, fps, or full (frame rate, mean and longest frame time). F10
# cycles the modes in game.
# perf_overlay = off
# Which GPU to use: its index in the log, or part of its name. Default: the first discrete GPU with Vulkan 1.3.
# gpu_index = 0
# gpu_name = NVIDIA
# Game resolution: the size the game draws its picture and interface in (1280x720 to 7680x4320). Above 1920x1080 the
# game's texture heap and memory pool grow with it. A size wider than 16:9, such as 3440x1440 on a 21:9 monitor, widens
# the camera's view to that shape and lays the HUD out for it. That is 1.4.3 only (1.2.1 keeps the 16:9 view), and the
# installer prepares the UI layout for four sizes: 2560x1080, 3440x1440, 3840x1600 and 5120x2160. Any other shape
# (16:10, 32:9) gets the camera's view but a 16:9 HUD, stretched over the picture, unless you build its layout with
# tools/make_romfs_patches.py --aspect WxH (wider than 16:9 only). Read at start.
# output_res = 1920x1080
# 3D render scale: the scene's size relative to the game resolution, game (5/6, the game's own 1600x900 at 1080p) or
# a percentage (25 to 400, at most 4096 pixels a side); above 100 supersamples the scene (anti-aliasing). Read at start.
# render_scale = game
# Scaling to the window when it is larger than the game resolution: fsr (AMD FSR 1) or bilinear, and FSR's sharpening
# from 0 (off) to 100. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
# upscaler = fsr
# sharpness = 80
# Picture shape when the window's shape differs from the game resolution's (a 16:9 picture in a 21:9 fullscreen
# window): fit, the default, keeps the shape, with black bars at the sides or above and below, so a 16:9 game in a wider
# window is no longer stretched as it used to be; stretch fills the window. Changes while the game runs take effect at
# once.
# aspect = fit

# Language: a Windows locale such as de-DE, or a Switch code (en-US, ja, zh-Hant, ...). Default: the Windows locale.
# locale = en-US

# operation_mode = docked

# menu_lang = en

# none mixes without opening an audio device.

# audio_prefill_ms = 20
# Volume in percent (0 to 100), on top of the game's own. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
# volume = 100

[input]
# Gamepad motion controls (0 = off) and vibration (0 = off).
# motion = 1
# rumble = 1
# Rumble strength in percent (0 to 300; 0 = off) and the exponent on the amplitude (0.2 to 1.5; lower = weak pulses
# stronger, 1 = linear). rumble_triggers = 1 also drives the impulse triggers of an Xbox pad.
# rumble_strength = 130
# rumble_curve = 0.6
# rumble_triggers = 0
# Which gamepad button is Switch A: nintendo (by position: east A, south B, west Y, north X), xbox (south A, east B,
# west X, north Y, as an Xbox pad labels them; cross A on a PlayStation pad) or auto (nintendo for a pad with Nintendo
# labels, xbox for the others). xbox_prompts: the buttons as nintendo, and the game's prompts swapped to the Xbox
# labels (A with B, X with Y; it loads romfs-patches-xbox, docs/controls.md, "Xbox button prompts"). The bind_ lines
# below apply on top. Changes while the game runs take effect at once; the xbox_prompts prompts at the next start.
# pad_layout = auto
# Gamepad stick dead zone in percent of full deflection (0 to 50). Raise it for a stick that drifts: inside the circle
# the stick reads centred, and the rest of its travel is scaled to start there.
# stick_deadzone = 8
# Mouse camera sensitivity (0 to 10; 0 = no mouse camera and no cursor capture).
# mouse_sens = 1
# Write the input of this run to a file that replays as a script (docs/controls.md, "Scripted input"). Default: off.
# input_record = input.txt
# Remap buttons: the Controls tab of the settings menu (F1) writes these lines. One line per Switch button or stick
# direction: bind_<A B X Y L R ZL ZR PLUS MINUS LEFT UP RIGHT DOWN LCLICK RCLICK> or bind_<LSTICK RSTICK>_<LEFT UP RIGHT
# DOWN> = comma separated pad:<name> and key:<name> entries, key:default / pad:default for that part's defaults, or none.
# A line replaces that button's defaults (pad and keyboard); buttons without a line keep them. Stick directions take keys
# only. Invalid entries are logged and skipped. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
#   pad names: south east west north l r zl zr start back lstick rstick dpad_left dpad_up dpad_right dpad_down
#   lpaddle1 rpaddle1 lpaddle2 rpaddle2 (the back buttons of an Xbox Elite, DualSense Edge or Steam Controller)
#   key names: a-z 0-9 f2-f7 f9 f12 num0-num9 space tab enter backspace lshift rshift lctrl rctrl lalt capslock insert
#   delete home end pageup pagedown up down left right num_add num_sub num_mul num_div num_decimal minus equals
#   lbracket rbracket semicolon apostrophe comma period slash backslash grave mouse_l mouse_r mouse_m mouse_x1 mouse_x2
# Defaults (pad_layout = nintendo): A = pad:east, key:E. B = pad:south, key:lshift. X = pad:north, key:space.
# Y = pad:west, key:mouse_l. A pad that reports A/B and X/Y swapped (some GuliKit models): set pad_layout = xbox, or
# swap them back here (keyboard keys stay):
# bind_A = pad:south, key:E
# bind_B = pad:east, key:lshift
# bind_X = pad:west, key:space
# bind_Y = pad:north, key:mouse_l

# Extra lines in the log, comma separated: svc, host, ipc, fs, gfx, perf, sched, audio, present or all. The menu's
# Performance log sets perf (frame timings). Default: none.
# trace = perf
# Flight recorder: keeps the last frames and saves them to a flight folder next to the folder of totk.exe when a frame
# takes longer than flight_spike_ms (0 to 60000).
# flight = 0
# flight_spike_ms = 100
# Largest render target (bytes, 0 to 1073741824) that goes back to its game memory when the game waits for a GPU fence.
# A game that reads a larger target without invalidating it sees stale bytes at the default. With trace = gfx the log
# names each dirty target over the limit that stays on the GPU ("fence write-back skipped-for-size") and each one over
# 65536 bytes that went back ("over-default"). Raising it costs a copy per such target and wait.
# wb_fence_limit = 65536
```
